text.body:
{kaularahasya}
(ṃany folios are missing in this manuscript.) (ṇote that the conjunct letter 'ṛ' written above the word is frequently added by the scribe with no reason.)
(folio 1-8 not found)
(* * * * * * * * * * * * *) (* * *?) hito dakṣiṇācārasaṃjñakaḥ |
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrā maithunameva ca | makārapaṃcakairdevi yonau kaulaḥ prapūjayet ||
vāmahastāt pānapūjā kramād vāmī prakīrtitaḥ | dakṣihastāt pānavāgād vāmahastapratarpaṇāt ||
dakṣahastāpūjanāddhi kaula ityabhidhīyate | kevalaṃ dakṣahastena pūjaṇād dakṣiṇābhidhaḥ ||
upāsanād vidhā proktā sakāmākāmavarjitā | mokṣabījaṃ bhumiḥ kāmā sakāmā bhavatījakaṃ ||
paṃthā tu dakṣiṇaḥ śreṣṭho vāmaḥ śreṣṭhātaro mataḥ | yastu vāmaṃ vijā (* *?) sa eva paramo guruḥ ||
ahaṃ jānāmi pūrṇaṃ pādāna sanakādayaḥ | arddha ca pipaśiṣṭhādyāḥ sa (* * * *?) saṃmitaṃ ||
<9a>
(*?) nanti (*?) thāḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ koghaṃ śatitare janāḥ | paṭanti koṭayaścātra jāyante kṛmi yoniṣu ||
taṃ mārgaye vijānanti te muktā nātrasaṃśayaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇā vāmamārgaṃ tu phalgunāyopadiṣṭavān ||
mayā cintāyatā dṛṣṭāmunityaśvanirūpitaḥ | cāṇḍālo vā turuṣko vā brahmahā vātha maskarī ||
śrotriyo vā vāmamārgī bhuktimuktyoḥ sa bhājanaṃ | vāmadikṣiṇamāgo hi kālītārā vidhau smṛtaḥ ||
chinnāvidhau vāmamārgo vagalāvāmadakṣagā | suṃdarī vāmadivyā ca dakṣamārge ca saṃsthitā ||
vālāvidyā dakṣavidyā mātaṃgī vāmadakṣiṇā | kevalā bhuvanā lakṣmā dhūmādakṣiṇamārgagā ||
sumukhīvāmasaṃtuṣṭhā vaṭukovāmadakṣiṇaḥ |
<9b>
(* * * * * * * * * * * * *) (*?) dakṣiṇā |
pūrvāmnāye dakṣi vāmau dakṣiṇe divyavāmake | kauladakṣau paścime tu kaulavāmau tathottare ||
ūrddhadivyau maheśāni pātāle vāma eva ca | yakṣiṇyādyāḥ sarvavidyāḥ kāminīyoganāyikā ||
vāmamārgeṇa siddhyanti nānyathā siddhidā kvacit | vāmadakṣiṇayogena ubhayācāratatparā ||
śaive śākte gāṇapatya saure svāyaṃbhuve tathā | cāndre cīne pāṃcarātre vaiṣṇave vaidikepi ca ||
vāma cokte bhaviṣyanti kale dvaijātayaḥ | evaṃ darśanamārge pi na hi vamaṃ karoti cet ||
tasya siddhirna deveśi mama vairī prakīrtitaḥ | sarvasmādedhiko vāmadharmaḥ proktaḥ kulāgame ||
tatrāpi kālikā tārā vidhau priyataraḥ smṛtaḥ | kāpālike maheśāni vāmamārgotra kāraṇaṃ ||
<10a>
vāmamārgaprakāreṇa sarva siddhyanti nānyathā | vāmamārga vinā devi na hi siddhyanti devatāḥ ||
uttarāmnāyasaṃproktā devyāstuṣyanti paṃcamaiḥ | ūnaḥ padārtha ekaścet sādhakaṃ te śapanti ca ||
paścimāmnāyadevānāṃ surāpānaṃ kṛtākṛtaṃ | macatuṣṭayamicchanti taṃ vinā praśapanti ca ||
pūrvvāmnāyoktadevānāṃ tatsmāṃsasaśca kṛtākṛtaṃ | āvaśyakaṃ matrayaṃ ca taṃ vinā praśapanti te ||
ūrddhāmnāyoktadevīnāṃ ta matsyaśca kṛtākṛtāḥ | āvaśyakaṃ madvayaṃ ca taṃ vinā praśapanti te ||
dakṣiṇāmnāyadevānāṃ niṣirddhaṃ macatuṣṭāyaṃ | menakaina vinā te pi praśapanti hi sādhakaṃ ||
kaulikaṃ kurvataḥ karma vaidikaṃ nābhidhāyate |
<10b>
vaidikaṃ kurvataḥ karma kaulikaṃ nābhidhīyate ||
virurddhādubhayaṃ naṣṭaṃ tasmādeva padhā caret | vāmamāgī yadā dakṣaṃ praviśet tatsuraiḥ sa tu ||
vighnyate pīḍyate cāpi na siddhimadhigacchati | dakṣamārgī yadā vāmaṃ praviśet tatsurāstadā ||
lokadvayādvyāpayanti taṃ grasanti ca vāminaṃ | tasmāt svakulamārgaṃ tu jñātvā kuryādupāsanāṃ ||
yadṛcchayā śrutaṃ tantraṃ cchadmanāpi valena vā | pareritaṃ vāgāthā vā tarjaped yadyanarthakṛt ||
na śāstramālokya vadet nācarenna jat kvacit | na paśyennopadiśyacca na kuryānnaiva sādhayet ||
pustake likhitān mantrānālokya prajapanti ye | brahmahatvā samaṃ teṣāṃ pātakaṃ parikīrtitaṃ ||
tasmād dikṣāṃ prayatnena sadā kuryācca tāntrikīṃ |
<11a>
[iti śrīkaularahasya dvitiye paṭalaḥ] || 2 ||
atha dīkṣā tatrādau daśasaṃskāraḥ |
jananaṃ jivanaṃ paśyā tāḍanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathā | tathābhiseko vimalīkaraṇārpyāyane punaḥ ||
tarpaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ tupti daśa yaite mantrasaṃskriyā | ataḥ prathamato dīkṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi viśeṣataḥ ||
dīyate jñānaṃ kṣīyante pāpanāśayaḥ | tena dīkṣā iti proktā prāpta cet sadgurormukhāt ||
adīkṣitānāṃ martyānāṃ doṣaṃ śṛṇuntu sādhakāḥ | annaṃ viṣṭāsamaṃ sūtramasantathā ||
adīkṣitakṛtaṃ śrārddhaṃ cādīkṣitasya vā | gṛhītvā pitarasteṣāṃ narake ca sudāruṇe ||
pataṃtyeva na saṃdeho yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa | sahasrairupacāraiśca bhaktiyukto ya japed yadi ||
tathārpyadī tasyārcaṃ devā gṛhnanti naiva ca |
<11b>
karṇākhitvaṃ vṛthā yasmāt tasmādadīkṣitaḥ paśuḥ | tasmādadīkṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃcit kārya na sādhayet ||
dīkṣāgrahaṇakāle tu pāparāśiḥ palāyate | nirvāṇapadasaṃyukto vahi gacchati tatparaḥ ||
tadā devapitṛṇāṃ tu karyāho bhavati svayaṃ | anyathātkṛtaṃ karma hutaṃ bhasmani havyava ||
sarvvāśrame tu dīkṣāyā nityatvaṃ parivakṣate | anīsvarasya mantrasya nāsti trātā jano bhuvi ||
tathā dīkṣāvihinasya neha svāmi paratra ca | na tapobhirjipaihomairvvidhidhairvvāpi sādhanaiḥ ||
na kriyāpi kadācit tu dīkṣāhīnyasya siddhyati | dvijānāmanupetānāṃ svakarmmādhyayanādiṣu ||
yathādhikāro nāstīha syāccopanayanādiṣu |
<12a>
tathā cādīkṣitānāṃ ca mantradevācca nādiṣu | nāmadhikkārossyataḥ kuryādātmānaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtaṃ ||
dīkṣāmūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ dīkṣāmūlaṃ parantapa | dīkṣāmāśritya nivased yatra kutrāśrame japena ||
adīkṣātaśca maraṇai raurame narake vrajet | ato dīkṣeti sā proktā deśikaistantravedibhiḥ ||
yāvan na prāpyate dīkṣā puruṣārtha phalapradā | sarvasiddhikarīkṣā sarvasaṃpat pradāyanī ||
pratibhāsvaravarṇāni kāntipuṣṭi dhanāni ca | mohanaṃ staṃbhanā kṛṣṭimāraṇoccāṭanāni ca ||
vaśīryasukavitābuddhiṃśvadhāraṇāyutā | tāraṇaṃ ca samudrasya vahneśaitvaṃ raṇe jayaṃ ||
vipine cābhayaṃ caiva śokaduḥkhāpahaṃ tathā | dharmārtha kāmamokṣāṇi dadātyeṣā na saṃśayaḥ ||
<12b>
anekakoṭi mantrebhyastathā vidyā sva eva ca | ekaṃ guru mukhāllabdhaṃ sarvasiddhi pravartakaṃ ||
gurupadeśato labdhaṃ japanyāsārcanādikaṃ | paścāt tat sādhayet sarvaṃ sa tadā bhāvabhāvitaḥ ||
vicāre gururityukta upadeśe guru guruḥ | parāparatvaṃ pūjāyāṃ prayoge parameṣṭhisau ||
na guroḥ sadṛśaṃ vastu na devaḥ śaṃkaropamaḥ | na ca kaurāt paroyāgo na vidyā kālikā samā ||
gakārāt jñānasaṃpattīraktārastat prakāśakaḥ | ukārācchivadātmyaṃ dadyāditi guru smṛtaḥ ||
pāśavarddhaḥ paśuḥ proktaḥ pāśamukto maheśvaraḥ | tasmāt pāśaharopyatre sa gurunānya ucyate ||
nirvīyyo hi piturmantraḥ śaive śākte na duṣyati | dakṣamārge tu nirvīryaḥ piturmmātā mahasya ca ||
<13a>
sodarasya gṛhasthasya vāmamārgeti viryavān | na patnī dīkṣāyedbhartā na pitāṃ dīkṣayet sutāṃ ||
na putraṃ ca tathā bhrātā bhrātaraṃ na ca dīkṣayet | striyo dīkṣā śubhā proktā mātuścāṣṭa guṇā smṛtā ||
sādhya caiva sadācārā gurubhaktyā jitendriyā | sarvamamantrārtha tatvajñā śūśīlā pūjane ratā ||
guru yogyā bhavet sāhi vidhā vā parivarjitā | mātrā dīkṣā pradeyā vai strīśāṃsatya na śāṃbhavi ||
devīparaṃparā prāptā dīkṣā strīṇāṃ śubhā matā | devī paraṃparāyāṃ tu viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sādaraṃ ||
devī paraṃ parod diṣṭaṃ pāraṃparya kramāgatā | strīṇāṃ dīkṣāparaṃ yātā devī dīkṣā śubhā matā ||
puruṣāṇāṃ tatsakāśāt dīkṣī jātā paraṃparā | mukhaṃ śṛṇu mahādevi strīṇāṃ na niyamo mataḥ ||
<13b>
niyamaḥ puruṣe jñeyo na yoṣitsu kathaṃcana | śākte vikalpā sahite katha dīkṣā bhavet priye ||
guroḥ sakāśā ced deyā tadasā bhaginī matā | svayaṃ vai yadi ced deyā tadā kanyā prakīrtitā ||
anyatopanīyā cenanmāga bhraṣṭā tadā bhavet | mantraśāstre vahuvidhāmārga devimayeritāḥ ||
tadartha śaṃkate cittaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ vada śaṃkara | svayaṃ pradāyavyaḥ śreṣṭhastatsakāśāttu dīkṣaṇaṃ ||
śubhaṃ proktaṃ mahādevi hyabhāve śṛṇu sādaraṃ | trayodaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe candravāsarasaṃyute ||
tālapatramanurlekhya saṃskāradaśakaṃ caret | (* * * * * * * *?) siddhamantrā bhaviṣyati ||
tad dine pāyasaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃnidhau | pāyasādi nivedyātha vilvaiḥ saṃpūjyaśaṃkaraṃ ||
iti kṛtvā vācanīyamaṣṭottarasahasrakaṃ |
<14a>
saṃjapya homayed devi tattanmantrokta vartmaṇā ||
vācane nāsti cecchaktistadā kiṃ vā vidhīyate | putradvārā vācanīyaṃ saputro guruvevatu ||
evaṃ gṛhīta mantrastu siddhirbhavati hi priye | atha vānyakākeṇa dīkṣāṇaṃ śṛṇu sāṃprataṃ ||
nadyāṃ samudragāminyāṃ śubhe lagne śubhe dine | saṃpradāyaṃ purāpṛṣṭvā śrīsūryamaṇḍalaṃ likhet ||
sāṃgaṃ sāvaraṇaṃ sūryaṃ saṃpūjya prāṇavallabhe | tāraṃ phaṭ manumālikhya vācayet tatsukāśataḥ ||
śataṣṭavāraṃ saṃvācya (*?) kānāṃ vāmato gatiḥ | tatra sūrya guruṃ pūjya sarvasiddhiśvaro bhavet ||
idaṃ paśuparaṃ proktaṃ na tu vīraparaṃ priye | vīrāṇāṃ kaulikānāṃ tu bhartā dīkṣaṇamācaret ||
bhattu dīkṣā pradāne tu na doṣa kālikā tame |
<14b>
śīvena dīkṣāpūrvaṃ tu goryadarbhā śubhāvahā ||
sā ca putrāthavā bhāryā tadvadatrāpi pārvati | na putrī gaditā sā tu vīrabhāryā prakīrtitā ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya tṛtīyapaṭalaḥ] || 3 ||
śrīdevyūvāca ||
asiddhaguruṇā datto mantraḥ śiṣyāya vā guruḥ | siddhā mantrāntare deva naiva siddhāthavā guruḥ ||
bhinnāmnāya dāśipyastadbhinnāmnāya devatāṃ | sevate tatra deveśa kīdṛk siddhistu tadvadaḥ ||
īśvara uvāca ||
gurustu dakṣiṇāmnāyī sarvāmnāyaṣu dīkṣitaḥ | ūrddhāmnāyī tathānyeṣu pūrvāmnāyī pareṣu ca ||
dvayostu paścimāmnāyī uttarastvadhare bhavet | adhare naiva kutrāpi gurusvaṃ pāralaukikīṃ ||
<15a>
dakṣiṇopāsakaḥ kāle ūrddhaḥ sāyujyamāpnuyāt | devatāyāstathā pūrvaḥ sārupyaṃ labhate paraḥ ||
sāmīpyaṃ cottare lokamadhogastyai hi kaṃ phalaṃ | lobhatyāgaiścāpakāro hyadhomārgepyudarkakṛt ||
mantrāntare ca saṃsiddho gururmantraṃ pravacchitī | yathoktā caraṇāt tasya siddhiḥ śiṣyasya jāyate ||
kṛpā vaśāt siddhamantraṃ dadāti ca yadā guruḥ | vinājapaṃ vināpūjāṃ siddhiyet tat kare sthitāḥ ||
tatra sūrjagrahaḥ śaste na tu catugraha kvacit | candragrahe tu dāridraṃ saure sarvasamṛddhayaḥ ||
sūryagraha śiva proktaścandrāṣyaśaktireva ca | sūryagrahe śaktidīkṣā paśudīkṣānākārayet ||
<15b>
(ḥere matter not continue.)
prakīrtitā ||
niḥkalāguhyaśaṃśaṃtā kālī bhedena kīrtitā | kevalayaṃ bhavenmadhāhvayī sāmrājyarūpiṇī ||
candrāgni vedapaṃcārṇā tathā nīlā kramena ca | haṃsatārā mahānīlā tadante vīnaśāṃbhavī ||
kevalā tu bhaven madhā siddhikriyā dvidhā | tritayā divyasāmrājya me dīkṣāṃ prakīrtitā ||
devarūpā divyarūpā mahāparā | sarvarūpā sarvapūrvā mahāsāmrājyameva yā ||
siddhi ṛddhi krameṇaivaḥ bhedavāhulyamiritaṃ | vidyārājyā vidhādīkṣā cchinnamastā vidhau smṛtā ||
candravahni raso rakta śyāmā ca ṣoḍaśī tathā | paraṣoḍhā saptadaśī tadajātā parā bhavet ||
dāpi malini kullā kramādvighvādi rājyada |
<16a>
vagalāyā mahesāni sāmrājya parameṣyate | candra veda sūkṣameru mantrīhīnaṃ śivāntaraṃ ||
hṛdayaṃ ca śatārṇā ca paṃcāstraṃ kullukā tathā | gāyatrī krame yogena sāmrājya parameṣṭhyadhṛk ||
etat paṃcakasaṃyuktoḥ sarvasāmrājya buddhidhṛk | śrīdivyasarvasāmrājya dīkṣāsarvottarā bhavet ||
tatopi dīkṣā deveśi nāsti brahmāṇḍa golake | daśavidyā prabhedāśca mahāvidyā pra (*?) dajā ||
siddhividyā prabhedāśca mahāmantrāstathaiva ca | tadaṃgamantrā deveśi śāvaraṃ daśaśāvaraṃ ||
kālaśāvarakaṃ devi tathaiva siddhaśāvaraṃ | tridhādarśanamantrā ca tathāmnāya kramod bhavet ||
kādihādi kahartvena
<16b>
dryāśirosya hṛdayaṃñjaliḥ | kṛtāñjali puṭā ūrddhaṃ khaḍgakhetaka pānayaḥ ||
brahmāṇaṃ saṃnirīkṣyānta tadvaktrābhimukhāśca te | svasvasthāna sthitāścaiva sādhāraṇamudāhṛtaṃ ||
svapnastuti ||
bhagavan devadeveśa śūladbhṛvṛṣavāhana | iṣṭāniṣṭa samācakṣa svapnasuptasya sāpravaṃ ||
niśānte paśyati svapnaṃ subhaṃ vāyadivāśubhaṃ | oṃ hṛtsakalalokāya viṣṇuve prabhaviṣṇave ||
viśvārūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ |
namo jāya trinetrāye piṃgalāya mahātmane | vāmāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ ||
svapne tu prathame yāme saṃvatsara phalaṃ bhavet | ṣadbhirmāsaidviyātthastribhimāsaistriyāmakaḥ ||
caturthe māsamātreṇa prātaḥkāle tu satvaraṃ |
<17a>
atha dusvapnaśānti ||
trirātro doṣito bhūtvā haviṣyāsī purohitaḥ | sakṣīrāṇāṃ ghṛtāṃktānāṃ samidhānāṃ śataṃ dehet ||
pāśānāṃ tu gāyātryā śūdraḥsvāhaviṣya bhuk | dīpaṃ dadyād vipragṛhe viṣṇo gehe śivālaye ||
evaṃ dṛṣṭā śubhaṃ svapnaṃ gṛhnīyāmanumanyathā | gṛhī (* *?) rita ca syādvānyaṃ vedaṃ vicintayet ||
atha kaulikopadeśa ||
nyāsajālaṃ vi (* * *?) śaṃkhapātrādi sthāpanaṃ | kṛtvā devī samabhyarcamakāraṃ paṃcakaiḥ plutaḥ ||
kāraṇaṃ taṃ mukhe paścā mantravidyāṃ samurcaye | kathitoyaṃ maheśāni upadeśastu kaulikaḥ ||
anyāyena cāyo dadyāt gṛhnānyāyataśca yaḥ |
<17b>
dadato gṛhnato vāpi kulaśāpo bhaviṣyati ||
guruśiṣyāvubhau mohādaparīkṣya parasparaṃ | aśāstrīyopadeśaṃ tu yo gṛhnāti dadāti ca ||
bhujīte tāvubhau ghorānnarakānekaviṃśatiḥ | asaṃskṛtyopadeśastu yaḥ karoti vimūdhadhīḥ saikate śālibījavat ||
anarhe mantravijñānaṃ na tiṣṭhanti kadācana | tasmāsarvaprakaktavyamanyathā niḥphalaṃ bhavet ||
sacchiṣyāyāti bhaktāyā tajñāmamupadiśyate | ta prāpnoti vrati nityaṃ gokṣīrā tu yathāghṛtaṃ ||
dhanecchābhabhaye lobhādyairayogyaṃ yadi dīkṣayet | devatāśāpamāpnoti kṛtaṃ vavikṛtaṃ bhavet ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya caturthapaṭalaḥ] || 4 ||
atha pūrṇābhiṣekadīkṣā māhapūrṇābhiṣekadīkṣā tu candrasūryāpraha bhavet ||
<18a>
sundarī tāliṇīkālī kramadīkṣātrigāminī | kramapūrṇe maheśāni kramācchustu haviṣyati ||
candrāgni pakṣaṣoḍhāṣya parānirvāṇa tatparā | ṣaṭsāṃbhavaṃ tato devi cakrasaṃbhedanena ca ||
svacakraṃ deha vijñānaṃ parakāye praveśanaṃ | etat jñānā bhaven maedhā dīkṣā proktā mayā tava ||
hādāvidaṃ nigaditaṃ śṛṇukādau maheśvari | candrāgnirasarājñī ca mahārājñī tataḥ śive ||
mahākāmākalākālī guhyakāli tataḥ śive | guhyakālī dvidhā proktā sakalāniḥkalā kramāt ||
daśavaktrā tu sakalā proktā vā sṛṣṭi kā kalā | ugrā saumyā mahākrūrā tridhā sāpi
<18b>
candra grahe viṣṇu dīkṣā paṃcarātre na kārayet |
candrasūrya grahe dīkṣā sarvadīkṣā (* * * *?) | candragrahe śaktidīkṣā sarvadīkṣottamattamā ||

vakṣetha tāṃtrikīṃ sadhyāṃ mūlānācamana trayaṃ |
vidyābhedasaṃdhyāsaṃkhyāmāha ||
sundaryāstu catuḥkālaṃ saṃdhyāvandanamācaret | prātaḥkāle ca madhyāhne sāyāhneṣyarddhe rātrake ||
caturvidhā gugāyatrī japadyatnena pārvati |
<45a>
prastārā kṛti rūpā ca upasthānābhidhā tathā | vāṃcchā kalpalatā devi caturthī parikīrtitā ||
ṣaṣṭhī pārāyaṇaṃ prātamadhyāhne nāmasaṃjñakaṃ | mantrapārāyanaṃ rātrau niśāyāṃ cakrasaṃjñakaṃ ||
kālikāyāmidaṃ proktaṃmupasthānavivarjitaṃ | medhādīkṣādirājñī tvāt kālyāsaṃdhyā catuṣṭayaṃ ||
saṃdhyā trayaṃ ca tārāyāṃ chinnāyāṃ trividhaṃ bhavet | etāsāṃ na hi bhedoṣṭi bhedaśne narakaṃ vrajet ||
atha daśavidyā gāyatrīrdvāramāha ||
kāliyā ||
kālikāya padaṃ coktā vidmahe tadanantaraṃ | śmaśāna vāśinī ṅentaṃ dhīmahīti padaṃ vadet ||
tanno ghora padaṃ procya pravade ca pracodayāt |
atha tārāyā ||
tārāyaṃ padamābhāṣya vidmahe tadanaṃtaraṃ | mahogrāyai padaṃ procya dhīmahīti tata punaḥ ||
<45b>
tanno devi padaṃ procya vadet paratpracodayāt |
atha chinnāyā ||
vairocanyai vidmahe ca cchinna mastāyai dhīmahi | tanno devi padaṃ coktvā yojanīyaṃ pracodayāt ||
atha tripurasundaryā ||
vāgbhavaṃ tripurā devi vidmahe tadanantaraṃ | kāmabījaṃ samuccārya kāmeśvarayyai ca dhīmahi ||
tannaḥ klinne padaṃ coktvā vadet paścāt pracodayāt |
atha bhairavyāḥ ||
tripurā ca tathā ṅentaṃ vidmahe padamurddharet | bhairavyaiśca tataścoktvā dhīmahīti tato vadet ||
tato devī padaṃ coktvā pracodayādudīrayet | gāyatrī traipurākhyātā vādyaṃ samuddharet ||
atha kamalāyā ||
mahālakṣmī padaṃ procya vidmahe tadanantaraṃ | mahāśriyai padaṃ coktvā dhīmahī ca padaṃ vadet ||
<46a>
tannaḥ śabdāt śrīpadaṃ ca tato dadyāt trayodayāt ||
atha bhuvaneśvaryāḥ ||
māyābījaṃ samuccārya bhuvaneśvaryai ca vidmahe | ādyāyai padamuccārya dhīmahī tadanantaraṃ ||
tannoḥ devī padaṃ procya tato deyaṃ pracodayāt ||
atha mātaṅgī ||
atha vakṣyāmi gāyatrī sādhakasya varadaṃ | śuka priyāyai vidmahe śrīkāmeśvarī dhīmahi | tannaḥ śyāmā pracodayāt ||
atha dhūmāvatī ||
dhūmiti bījamuccārya dhumāvatīti vidmaho vivarṇā devī padatoḥ dhīmahī padamurddharet ||
dhūmā devyāstu gāyatrī tanno ghora pracodayāt ||
atha vagalāmukhī ||
sthīramāyā samuccārya vagalā padatomukhī | vidmahe duṣṭa padataḥ stambhinī padamuccaret ||
<46b>
dhīmahīti padasyāntare tanno devī pracodayāt | vagalāyā maheśāni gāyatrīyaṃ prakīrtitā ||
atha niṣiddhāsanaṃ ||
bhṛṇapallavakāṣṭāni pāṣāṇāṃ mṛṇmaya tathā | vaṃśāsanaṃ ca vastraṃ ca kevalaṃ kṣitimāsanaṃ ||
(* * *?) ṣṭi vidhaṃ devi cāsanaṃ parivarjayet ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya daśamapaṭalaḥ] || 10 ||
atha mātṛkāmudrāmāha ||
lalāṭe nāmikā madhye nyasecca mukhavṛttake | tarjanī madhyamā nāmā vinyaseccaiva nyatrayoḥ ||
tarjanāmīkāsaṃyujya nyase sādhakasattamaḥ | aṃguṣṭhaṃ karṇayā nyasya kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhako nasau ||
madhyamā gaṇḍayo nyasya madhyamāṣṭhayornyaset | arāmādantayornyasya madhyamā cottamāṃgake ||
mukhe nāmāṃ madhyamāṃ ca hastapādaṃ ca pārśvayoḥ | kaniṣṭhānāmikā madhya nyastavyo pṛṣṭhatastathā ||
<47a>
sāṃguṣṭhāstānābhideśe sarvāḥ kuśau ca vinyaset | hṛtadayet sādhaka sarvamaṃśayoścakakutsthale ||
hṛtpūrvahastapatkukṣi mukheṣu talameva ca | etāstu mātṛkā mudrāḥ krameṇa parikīrtitā ||
ajñātvā vinyased yastu nyāsaḥ syāt tasya nisphalaḥ ||
atha ṛkhyādi nyāsanya krameṇa sthānāni mudrāścāha | ṛṣiṃ nyasen murddhni deśe cchandrastu mukhapaṃkaje || devatā hṛye caiva bījantu guhya deśake |
śaktipādayoścaiva sarvāṅgakīlake smṛtaṃ |
atha ṣaḍaṃgārthamāha ||
hṛdayāyeti śabdena hṛstho deva savigrahaḥ | ucyate nama ityasthā jñānaṃ tadviparya paraṃ ||
śiraḥ śabdo devatāyā utkṛṣṭatvābhidhāyakaḥ | svāheti viṣayāḥ sarve devatāyāṃ samarpitaḥ ||
śikhāyai ca svarūpatvaṃ vaṣaḍapi taducyate |
<47b>
devatāyā vyāpakatvaṃ kevacāyābhidhīyate ||
humapi vyāpaka tejo devatāyāḥ prakāśyate | netre śabdena devasya prakāśyatvaṃ prakāśyate ||
vauṣaḍapi tadaivokta mantraśabdena vāraṇaṃ | aniṣṭasya phaṭ śabdena dāhakaṃ teja ucyate ||
jñātvaivamaṃgamantrārthamaṃgaṃ nyāsaṃ karoti yaḥ | pracayāstasya sarvārthāḥ pujyate stridaśairapi ||
athāntarvidhiḥ ||
evaṃ dehamayāṃ pīṭhe cintayediṣṭa devatāṃ | dhyānaṃ kuryāt tato mantrī tat tat kalpokta vatmanā ||
tadapi dvividhaṃ proktaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā | ātmanā hṛdayāsbhāje karṇikā keśaro jvale ||
prahṛllesomasūryāgni maṇḍalena virājite | svīyeṣṭa devatāṃ tatra jajedogamabodhitāṃ ||
evaṃ yadvedanaṃ tadvisaguṇaṃ dhyānamucyate |
<48a>
athāntaryajanaṃ vakṣye dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭaphala pradaṃ | yogiṇāṃ yena jāyante adhīrāmānavāḥ sadā ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
vāhya pūjāṃ vināsvāmitkathamantaḥ prapūjanaṃ | pūjā jñānaṃ yadājātaṃ tadāntaḥ pūjanaṃ bhavet ||
sāmagrī jñāna hīnatvāt kathamantaḥ prapūjanaṃ |
śrīśiva uvāca ||
satya me tanmaheśāni rahasyaṃ śṛṇu yatnataḥ | viṣṭhāpūrṇe svadire tu vahiḥ śuddhau tu kiṃ phalaṃ ||
aṃtaḥ śuddhi samāsādya vahīḥ śuddhīṃ samācaret | vadbhiḥ pūjāṃ vidhau devi sāmagrī durmilokalau ||
vyaṃgyatā jāyate satyaṃ sarvatra pūjana śive | tasmāṃgatā siddhi hetoranta pūjā prakīrtitā ||
bhāvanā mātragamyeyaṃ koṭiratnanikalpayet | aṃtapūjā vihinenaḥ kṛtaṃ tadaphalaṃ bhavet ||
<48b>
saṃyogaṃ tu vinā devi yo garbhādhānamicchati | sa cāntaḥ pūjāṃ tyaktvā vahiḥ pūjāṃ samicchati ||
sadaridrī mahoghorī kathamantra sukhaṃ bhavet | aṃtapūjāṃ samāsādya vahipūjāṃ samācaret ||
saṃbhāvya pūjanaṃ svānte tathaivarayedvahi ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
tathā muktaṃ tvayā deva saṃśayāmastiśaṃkara | vahiḥ pūjā namāsādya cāṃtaḥ pūjāṃ samācaret ||
evaṃ krameṇa deveśi pūjā kiṃ na bhaviṣyati |
śrīśiva uvāca ||
mṛdaparkvaṃ samāsādya yathā devi ghaṭodbhavet | ghaṭaḥ parkvamṛdā devi pūrvavat kiṃ bhaviṣyati ||
aparkvāmṛtsamānīya yathā devi ghaṭo bhavet | tataḥ parkva prakartavyaḥ suṃndraraḥ sa tu jāyate ||
antapūjana vahiḥ pūrṇaṃ vahi nyūnatarā bhavet |
<49a>
anyonyāśayasaṃyogāt pūjanaṃ sakalaṃ bhavet ||
devo bhūtvā yad devaṃ nādevo devamarcayet | tasmād devatva māsādya cāṃtapūjādi mārgataḥ ||
gurodhyānaṃ prakurvīta yathāpūrvaviśoladhīḥ |
iti brāhmī muhūrtakṛtyaṃ ||
snānaṃ budhastataḥ kuryāt succidānandasiddhaye | snāyārca vimale tīrthe puṣṭhare hṛdayāśrite ||
bindu tīrthe naraḥ snāyāt punarjanma na vidyate |
iti snānaṃ ||
mulādhālāt kaṇḍali nimutthāpyajo jayacchive | śivaḥ saktyāḥ samāyogo yasmikāle prajāyate ||
sāsandhyā kulaniṣṭānāṃ samādhistaiḥ pragīyate |
iti saṃdhyā ||
candrārkānalasaṃghaṭṭāṅgalitaṃ yatparāmṛtaṃ | tenāmṛtena divyena tatpayet paradevatāṃ ||
<49b>
brahmaraṃdhrādadho bhāge yaccāndraṃ pātramurtama | kalāsāreṇa saṃpūrya tarpayet tena khecarī ||
iti tarpaṇa ||
ādhāliṃṅganābhau hṛdaya śaśakaletyādi |
ityantamātṛkāṃ nyāsaḥ || athāntaṃ ṣaḍaṅga nyāsaḥ ||
sahasrāre maṇi nibhe sarvavarṇavibhūṣite | athādi trilekhāḍhyai halakṣatrayavibhūṣite ||
tanmadhye parabinduṃ ca sṛṣṭisthitirayātmakaṃ | evaṃ samāhitamanāṃ dhyāyen nyāsoyamāntaraḥ ||
mūlādi brahmaraṃdhrāntaṃ vindvaṃdhvāyecciddātmakaṃ | bindusrutasudhāsāraistarpayatmātṛkāṃ nyaset ||
ekaikaṃ vargamuccārya mūlādhārāt bhrūvāntikaṃ | namonta iti vinyasaḥ āntaraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
hṛdyān manohṛdānmāyāṃ dṛdayesyarciddānmatkaṃ | kriyate tatparasya na hṛnmantre tataḥ paraṃ ||
<50a>
sarvajñādviguṇārtuṃṅge sarccidrupe parātmani | kriyayā viṣayā hāraḥ śiro mantreṇa deśikaiḥ ||
hṛcchiro rūpacirddhāma layatā bhāvanā dṛḍhā | kriyate nija dehasya śikhāmantreṇa deśikaiḥ ||
mantrāmatkasya dehasya mantravāhya na tejasā | sarvato varmamantreṇa kriyate'hanyasaṃvyataḥ ||
yad dedāti paraṃ jñānaṃ sacidrūpe parānmani | hṛdayādi mayaṃ tejaḥ syād detantatra saṃjñitaṃ ||
adhyātmikādi rūpaṃ ca sādhakasya vināśayet | avidyā jāla mantraṃ tatpalaṃdhamasamīritaṃ ||
athādhyānaṃ ||
kilakasthaṃṇatadagnisthaṃ candrabhāskaramadhyanaṃ | mahāśūnyalayaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇatiṣṭheti yogilāt ||
jarjīva brahmaṇoraikyaṃ sohaṃ syāmiti vedanaṃ |
<50b>
tadandhanirguṇaṃ dhyānaṃ miti deva vido binduḥ |
iti dhyānaṃ || athārcanaṃ ||
arcayed vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ tatkṣaṇāt tanmayo bhavet | nyāsastanmayatā buddhiḥ sohaṃ bhāvena pūjayet ||
amāyāmena haṃkāra manāgamamadaṃ tathā | amohakaṃ madaṃ hastamahyeṣā kṣobhakauvataḥ ||
amātsarya malobha (*?) darśapuṣpaṃ bindubudhāḥ | ahiṃsā paramaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindri graha tathā ||
dayā puṣpaṃ kṣamāpuṣpaṃ jñānapuṣpaṃ ca paṃcamaṃ | ityuktairuttamai puṣpaiḥ pūjaya paradevatāṃ ||
ityarcanaṃ ||
mālāpaṃśikā proktā sutraṃ śaktiśivātmakaṃ | gratthikuṇḍalanī śakti kalānte meru siṃsthiti ||
iti japaḥ || atha homa ||
mūlādhāra gate kuṇḍe devatāgni samujvale |
<51a>
dharmādharmanvite ṛsramūlamantre puraḥsaraṃ ||
ahaṃjuhomi svāheti pratyekaṃ juyāt sudhīḥ | ahātā'satyapaiśunya kāmakrodhādikaṃ haviḥ ||
manaḥ evaśruvaḥ prokta unmanī śrugudīritā ||
atra mūlānte ||
nābhau caitanya rūpāgnau haviṣā manasā śrucā | jñānapradīpite nityamakṣavṛttirjuhomyahaṃ ||
svāhā prathamāhuti || mūlānte ||
dharmādharma havi dīptā ātmāśvai manasā śrucā | suṣumnāvatmanā nityamakṣavṛttyurjuhomyahaṃ ||
svāhā iti dvitiyāhutiṃ || mūlānte ||
prakāśākāsahastābhyāṃmavalaṃvyomanī srūvā | dharmādharmakalāsneha pūrṇamagnau juhomyahaṃ ||
svāhā iti tṛtiyāhuti || mūlānte ||
anantaraniraṃndhananivandhana medhamāne māyāndhakārapariparipaṃthini saṃvidagdhau |
<51b>
kasmiṃścida bhutamarīrivikāśabhūmau viśvaṃ juhomi vasudhādi vakhāvasānaṃ ||
iti caturthāhuti ||
ityanta yajanaṃ kṛtvā sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavet | na tasya pāpapuṇyāni jīvanmukto bhaveddhruvaṃ ||
ityantaryāga ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya ekādaśapaṭalaḥ] ||
arghyādikapātrāṇāṃ phalaṃ vakṣya śubhāśubhaṃ | sarvakāmaphalaṃ svarṇaṃ raumyamāyuḥ sutapradaṃ ||
saubhāgyaṃ tāmrapātreṇa dharmāvṛddhistu mṛtmaye | nālikeledave tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭidaṃ kācasaṃbhavaṃ ||
lakṣmī prāptirvilvapātre brahmaṇyaṃ brahmavṛkṣaje | māraṇāccatane lohaṃstaṃbhaḥ pāṣāṇaje bhavet ||
mantrasyārādhane kāṣṭaṃ vāmamārge (* *?) cchritaṃ |
<52a>
arghyapātramidaṃ proktaṃ sarvadevamanoramaṃ | ādhārasthālikāmānaṃ ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṃṅgulaṃ ||
vasvartutauvikaṃ ||
ratnādīnāṃ tu pātrāni śubhalekhāṃkitāni ca | adyenaivyadya pūjārtha validāne prakalpayet ||
pātrāṇamādaraḥ kāryaḥ pātrāṇyovāttamāṇi tu | valihoma kriyādyaṃ hi vinā pātraṃ na sidhyati ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ pātraṃmuttamaṃ parikīrtitaṃ | madhyamaṃ tu tribhāgonaṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ dvādaśāṃgulaṃ ||
vasvaṃgula vihīnaṃ tu na pātraṃ kārayet kvacit | arghyamānaṃ tu pādeśaṃ caturagulaṃ cakramasaḥ uttamādi prabhedataḥ ||
puṣpapātraṃ gandhapātraṃ yathālābhena kalpayet | śvetādītpatiśastāni viprādīnāṃ krameṇa ca ||
mecayen prokṣanī pātravoyaimūlāstre mucaret | ātmānaṃ yāgavasbhūmi pūjādravyāṇi maṇḍalaṃ ||
darśayeddhanumudrāṃ ca dravyaśuddhiriyaṃ matā |
<52b>
tataḥ saṃpūjayed devaṃ śaktyāṃlatvā (*?) pacārakaiḥ | āsanaṃ svāgataṃ cārgha pādyamācamanīyukaṃ ||
madhuparkā tathā camaṃ snānaṃ vastramalaṃ kṛtiṃḥ | gaṃdhapuṣpaṇidhupaśca dīpanaivedyacaṃdanāḥ ||
prayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṃstu ṣoḍaśī | daśopacārā madhyā syāt sā gṛhasthai vidhīyate ||
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tathā cārmo madhuparkastathā ca yaḥ | gaṃdhādayo nivedyaṃtā upacārā daśa smṛtāḥ ||
atha rahasya puṣpaṃ ||
yoni puṣpaṃ maheśāni vajrapuṣpaṃ nigadyate | āṣāḍaśādaruḍhāyā uttamaṃ sarva (* *?) daṃ ||
valāt krameṇa ūḍhāyā madhyamaṃ bhogavarddhanaṃ | rajo yogavaśādanyaṃ dharmasukhadāyakaṃ ||
svayaṃbhu kusume devi trividhaṃ bhuvi jāyate |
<53a>
sarvaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sadā pūjyā vihitā vihitairapi | kartavyā sarvadevānāṃ bhaktiṃ yogotra kāraṇaṃ ||
anayo grahaṇopāyamāha ||
sūtreṇa paṭṭavastreṇa vīravastrena pārvati | kāśmīravastrasūtreṇa paṭṭasūtreṇa pārvati ||
kastulakuṃkumantra candanāgurukādikaṃ | nānāsugaṃdhikaṃ datvā ekīkṛtvā tu sādhakaḥ ||
aṣṭagaṃdhena saṃpuṣpai saṃyuktaṃ puṣpamāharet | etenākṣatayogena pūjayet parameśvari ||
āsanārthe ca homārthe cakra pūjā kramāt binduḥ | svayaṃbhu saṃyutaṃ puṣpaṃ siddhapuṣpaṃ vidurvadhāḥ ||
rati mālyāni deveśi na ca payukhitāni ca | sadā suddhāni puṣpāṇi navīnāni dine dine ||
eta sarvaṃ samādāya tārāṃ kālī ca pūjayet |
<53b>
puṣpadānaphalātkoṭi guṇitatphalatāpnuyāt ||
atha daśavidyādhūpavidhi ||
idānī śṛṇu viprarṣṇa dhūpanirūpanaṃ mama | gugguluṃśarasraṃdāru pātraṃ malaya sambhavaṃ ||
hrīveramaguruṃ kuṣṭaṃ guḍaṃ sarkarasaṃghanaṃ | haritakī nakhīlākṣājaṭāmāṃsāṃ sa śailajaṃ ||
ṣoḍaśāṅgī vidudhūpaṃ devapaitre ca karmaṇi | madhumuṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ gaṃdho gugulaṃ gurulajanaṃ ||
śaraṇaṃśālasiddhitha daśāṅgodhūmucyate | sitājyamadhūsaṃmiśraṃ gurguruṃ gurucandanaṃ ||
ṣaḍaṅgadhūpametantu sarvadevapriyaṃ sadā | guggulva guru śīlaṃ ca śarkarāmadhucandanaṃ ||
dhūpayedājyasaṃmiśrai devavasya deśikaḥ | lohavāṇau ṣoḍaśāṃgaṃ trividyāyāṃ prakīrtitau ||
<54a>
kālī vidyā vidhau devi aguruśca daśāṃśakaṃ | aṣṭādaśāṅgaṃ śrīkhaṇḍatārā vidyāvidhau smṛtaṃ ||
cchinnāvidyā vidhau devi pañcāṃgaṃ guggulustathā | kṛṣṇāṃguruṃ pītasāro brahmāstra manugocaraṃ ||
rāloḍyagurucandraraṃ mātaṃgyāparikīrtitaṃ | kastūrī caiva karpūramaṣṭagaṃdhaṃ tathaiva ca ||
bhairavyāṃ kartitaṃ devi navicaiva śilānasaḥ | bhuvaneśyāmayo proktaṃ śrīkhaṇḍakamalāmatau ||
lakṣāguḍā hi dhūmrāyāṃ siddhavidyā vidhau śive ||
atha dīpavidhi ||
dīrghājñāna mahādhyāntā haṃkāraparivarjanāt | paratatva prakāśācca dīpa ityabhidhīyate ||
ghṛtadīpaḥ prathamatastilatailasamudbhavaḥ |
<54b>
sārṣapaḥ phalaniryāsa jāto vocorijodbhavaḥ | dadhijagdhaunnajaścaiva dīpasapta prakīrtitā ||
padmasūtra bhavāvarti darbhasūtra bhavāthavā | jālājāvādalī vāpi bhūlakoṣodbhavāthavā ||
vartikī dīpa kṛtyeṣu sadāpañca vidhauḥ smṛtaḥ |
atha ṣoḍaśopacārāṇāṃ krameṇa mudrāmāha ||
dravyadanasthalaṃ vakṣya nibodhātaḥ paraṃ mama | gandhapuṣpaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca suṃmukhe saṃniyojayet ||
dakṣiṇe pradīpo deyo vāme dhūpaṃstathā dvija | naivyadyaṃ dakṣiṇe deśe pakvaṃ yatnatvivedayet ||
apakvaṃ vāmabhāge ca dīpasyātaḥ paraṃ śṛṇu | ghṛtayuktaṃ ca yo dīpo sitāvarti yutopi vā ||
dakṣe deśe ca taṃ dadyāt anyantu vāmadeśake | āsane padmamudrāsyāddhastadvayamadhomukhaṃ ||
<55a>
mundraiṣā kuśalaprasne tadaivordhvamukhaṃ punaḥ | mudrā syāt svāgate cārya mudrātvaṃjali rūpinī ||
anāmāṃguṣṭhayoryogāt saivoktā padyamudrikā | uttānaṃ dakṣahastaṃ tu kṛtvā nimnatalaṃ sudhī ||
kaniṣṭhahīnāsaṃyuktā catasrodgulya unnatāḥ | mūdraiṣā camane proktādhomukhī sātvanāmayā ||
spṛṣṭāṃguṣṭā bhavet mudrā madhuparkaṃ varānane | adhomukhī dakṣahasta kṛtvā muṣṭiḥ kaniṣṭayoḥ ||
vimukto svānamudraiṣā gaditā parameśvari | urtānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ kṛtvā tatmadhyamāpnunaḥ ||
aṃguṣṭhena pṛśedreṣā mudrāvastrasyartitā | eṣai vā nāmikā sparśot mudrābhūṣaṇasaṃjñakāḥ ||
kaniṣṭāsparśato svaṣyā dravitasya ca mudrikā |
<55b>
aṣṭāgreṇa kaniṣṭāgraṃ spṛśet gandhasya mudrikā | adhomukhaṃ karaṃ kṛtvā tarjanyāgreṇa yojayet ||
aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa mudreyaṃ puṣpākhyā parameśvari | aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa tarjanyā spṛśedagraṃ maheśvari ||
dhūpamudreyamākhyātā sarvadeva priyaṃ kare | jyeṣṭhāgreṇa spṛśedagraṃ madhyamāyā surārcite ||
dīpamudreyamuditā sarvadevāśrayā śubhā | anāmāgraṃ spṛśed devi jyeṣṭhāgrena tu deśikaḥ ||
naivya?dyamudrā kathitā tatvamudreti kīrtitā ||
atha nityahoma ||
vāminastūpacārāṃte kuryāmadya na tarpaṇaṃ | te nāma nitya homastu nityaṃ tarpaṇa sevanaṃ ||
kṛtvā stutvā namaskṛtya bindu maṇḍale ||
pradakṣiṇa ||
trikoṇākāra sarvatra natiḥ śaktaḥ samīritā |
<56a>
arddhacandraṃ maheśasya pṛṣṭhataśca samīritā ||
mohādvā kāmataḥ śudraḥ purāṇāṃ sahitā smṛtiṃ | paṭhannarakamāpnoti pitṛbhiḥ saha pāpakṛt ||
śūdrasaṃsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjayed vā nametavā | tatsarvaṃdhiprasādādi gṛhṇanniyamāpnuyāt ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya dvādaśapaṭalaḥ] || 12 ||
atha kaulācārino (kauravāmino) nityārcanamāha ||
dakṣayajña yadā devi tvayā svaktaṃ vārevaraṃ | ahaṃ gṛhṇītvā tatkaṃdhe citāṃ praveṣṭumudyataḥ ||
vaḍavāgnergaveṣārthaṃ yatra yatrā bhavet sa tu | tatra tatra ca śakreṇa bhūṣaṇaṃ nirvāpito jalaiḥ ||
evaṃ paryaṭato varṣaṃ prasvedo me mahāna bhūt | tadviṃdupātanidagdhā dharaṇīya bhaviṣyati ||
<56b>
tadā saṃprārthitā viṣṇu dharaṇī rakṣaṇāya ca | tadā śutvaghubhivāṇaistvadaṃgāni samācchitaḥ ||
caturāśīti khaṃḍāniḥ kṛtvāsau pātayadbhuvi | gatena vījitaścāhaṃ prītohamakhilastadā ||
viṣṇuśca prakaṭī bhūya pādayā patito mama | utthāpya ca pariṣṭhaktastavaśokaśca vismṛtaḥ ||
tāvadbrahmādikā devānāradādyāmaharṣayaḥ | māṃtuṣṭhuvustadā vākyaṃ viṣṇuḥ provāca pārvati ||
jñānadāsi maheśatvaṃ kathamohamupāgata | satyāḥ śarīreṇa sahasa praveṣṭu havya vāhanaṃ ||
amugacchet patiṃ nārī na pumān tāṃ ca gacchati | iti sāstra manādṛtya kathaṃ deva vimohitaḥ ||
evaṃ vadati deveśaṃ brahmaṇāmāṃhariṃstathā |
<57a>
śleṣālaṃṣālaṃkāla vākyaiścatuṣṭe vinā buddhi saha ||
āvābhyāṃ tu tadā proktā yācayādhyavaraṃ dvijā | tadā tai brāhmaṇai yuktaṃ jātoyaṃ dharmaviplavaḥ ||
dakṣayajñā śribhaiḥ śaivā brāhmaṇyāṅguśitā dvijāḥ | yajñāgatāśca sarvepi śaivaiḥ saptādvijātayaḥ ||
viṣṇuṇā kartitauraṃśai satyāścedaṃdharātalaṃ | sthare sthare śavasparścā sarvaṃ brahmakarmaṃ vivarjitaṃ ||
tasyāddharāyāsaṃśuddhiṃ viprāṇāṃ cāpi śuddhyatiṃ | brahmavākyasya satyaṃ tvaṃ yathā bhavati tat kuru ||
tato dhyātvā mayā proktaṃ saṃmatī kṛtya viṣṇunā | yatra veda kriyā dhvastā tatra taṃtra pravatyatāṃ ||
ye viprā (*?) śāpanirdagdhā brahmakarmavivarjitā | teṣāṃ tu kaula dharmoyaṃ bhuktimuktyāstu śādhanaṃ ||
<57b>
ye viprāḥ pīṭhasaṃjāta śāpanirdagdha śāpatāḥ | teṣāṃ kuledhikāroyaṃ mārgasyāsya prajāyate ||
tatkule eva pūjyatvā kauloyaṃ mārga ucyate | vāmamārga tato nyūnasteṣāṃ kṣatriya vaiśyakau ||
yajamānaustayostatrādhikāraḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | siddhāntoyastato nyūnastatrā śūdrādhikāritā ||
ye pāraṃparyamajñātvā kauladharmaviśaṃtite | niḥsvāsaṃ tatīhīnāśca rogino nātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
kaulajñānajya siddhoyastadravyaṃ bhostumicchati | samahāpātakī devī sarvakarma vahiḥkṛtaḥ ||
samayācāra hīnasya svairavṛttadurātmanāḥ | na siddhiḥ kulatraṃśastatsasagaṃ na kālayet ||
yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya varttate kāmacārataḥ | sasiddhimihimāpnoti paratra ca parāṃgatiṃḥ ||
kuladravyāṇi sevaṃte yenmadarśanamāśritā | taṃ(?) daṃgaromasaṃkhyātaṃ bhūtayoniṣu pūjāyate ||
<58a>
madapraskhalitātmā ca na kiṃcidapi varti cet | na dhyānaṃta tapaścarcāṃ na dharma na ca saskriyāṃ ||
na daivaṃ na gurunmantra vicāro yadi kaulike | kevalaṃ viṣayā saktaḥ patatyavanasaṃśayaḥ ||
śrīgurāḥ kulaśāstrebhyaḥ sasyagvijñāpavāsanāṃ | paṃcamudrāṃ niṣecata cānyathā patito bhavet ||
āvṛrti gurupaktiṃśca vaṭukādīnna pūjayaḥ | vīrāpyevaṃ vṛthāpānād devatā śrāpamāpnuyāt ||
atha muṇḍagrahaṇa ||
muṇḍaprahaṇakāle tu sarvathā tu śivā valiḥ | śivāṃ śaktiṃ ca vā pūjyā dikpālānvavaliṃ yutān ||
pūjayet parameśāni sāyudhādi yathākramaṃ | evaṃ krameṇa vīrendre sasarveṣāṃ valiṃ māharet ||
vaṅmāyā kamalā procya devyāstu muṣavai yajuḥ | pravartate imaṃ bhāva valiṃ gṛhna tu yugmakaṃ ||
athāsanavidhi ||
ṛtumabhyāsane devi tridinā triguṇākṛtiḥ | ṛtu vastrāsanaṃ devi trimāsāt phaladāyakaṃ ||
<58b>
muṇḍāsanaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsairdināṃtaṃtu śavāsanaṃ | naracarmāsanaṃ devi pakṣāṃtaṃtu phalaṃ bhavet ||
mṛdvāsane tu māsena kāmalaṃ tatvamāsikaṃ | phalaṃ bhavati deveśi urṇākhya daśa varṣataḥ ||
yonitvāgāsane devi saptāhena phalaṃ bhavet | yonyāsane pakṣānte surātākhya dināṣṭakaṃ ||
viparīte ṣaṭ dinaiśca jihvā sparśo dvikedakaiḥ | saptacuṃvanake devi saptahetu phalaṃ bhavet ||
viṣṭare māsaṣaḍgaiśca phalaṃ bhavati pārvati ||
athāsanasyāvasya kartāmāha ||
mṛtāsanaṃ vinā devi yojayet kālikānnaraḥ | tāvat sa nārakī jñeyā yāvadāhutasaṃplavaṃ ||
atha mṛdvāsanādya bhāve anukalpamāha ||
mṛtābhāve kuśarūpaṃ viṣṭaraṃ parikalpayet | pūjyaṃ pīṭhaṃ viṣṭarākhyāṃ pūjyātārāṃvikā parā ||
śrīdevyāviṣṭaro devi dhārāstasyāḥ sphūtāsti caḥ |
<59a>
viṣṭakaṃ sādhakasyārtha kathyate śṛṇu śāṃprataṃ | bhūtapatrāṇi yasmitvai śakuśet savidhiyate ||
hastapāde daśamitādik yugaṃ hṛtsarāje viṃśatsasaṃkhyāsakalavarade mastake kīrtitāśca ||
guhye jihvā vadanaradare ghrāṇarṇastaneṣu liṃge candrā ce yugaparimitā yojanīyāḥ kuśāśca ||
ityaṣaḥ viṣṭaraḥ sarva sarvasiddhi pradāyaḥ | kuśairvvā bandhanaṃ kāryaṃ nāḍyā vā parameśvari ||
raktamiśrita sūtreṇa paṭṭasūtreṇa vā punaḥ | viṣṭalaṃ palikalpātha tasyopari japaṃ caret ||
vidhivistara padmasya vidhiyokto mayā tavaḥ | śarūpaṃ prakalpārtha kavi vāgmī bhaven naraḥ ||
svayaṃ (* *?) ktaṃ sūtrakartavyaṃ sarvasiddhiya | savabhāve vistarastu śavarūpaprakīrtitāḥ ||
<59b>
sākṣāntu śivarūpo hi viṣṭaraḥ parikīrtitāḥ | viṣṭaraḥ śivarūpaḥ syāt svasya śaktitva kalpanā ||
śivaśaktisamāyogāt kiṃ na siddhyati bhūtale | śavarīrottamaṃ vastraṃ dvitīyo viṣṭaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tṛtīyaṃ śṛṇu deveśi sarvasiddhi pradāyakaṃ | viṣṭaraṃ śaṃbhurūpaḥ syāt sa śivāśivaviṣṭaraḥ ||
samayāśodhanaṃ kṛtvā śaktisodhanamācaret | śaktiṃ saṃśodhanaṃ kṛtvā surāśodhanaṃ ||
vijayā || oṃ brāhmai namaḥ svāhā || aiṁ kṣatriyāyai namaḥ svāhā || hrīṁ vaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhā || klīṁ śūdrāyai namaḥ svāhā || atha dhyānaṃ || siddhāddhyāṃ śivabodhinīṃ karalasat pāśāṃkuśāṃ bhairavīṃ bhaktābhīṣṭavalapradānakuśalāṃ saṃsāravaṃdhaṣṭhidāṃ ||
<60a>
pīyuṣāṃ budhimaṃthanodbhavarasāṃ saṃsāravaṃdhacchidāṃ vīrārādhitapādukāṃ suvijayāṃ dhyāyarjaganmohini ||
atha śakti śaudhanaṃ ||
sadhodhanaṃ manāścaryastriṣu madyeṣu sādhakaḥ | kṛtegri siddhi hāni syāt kurddhā bhavati caṇḍikā ||
abhiṣekād bhave śakti mantrasyoccāranāśrutau | ratikāre maheśāni dīkṣākāle ca kanyakā ||
kalā dvā yatnatarpyarthāddabhiśeṣaṃ samācaret | surāpāretasā vāpi jalena manunāpurā ||
ādau vālāṃ samuccārya tripulāyai samuccaret | namaḥ śabdaṃ samuccārya imāṃ śaktiṃ tato vadet ||
<60b>
pavitrī kuluśabdānte mama śakti kuru priye | vahnijāyāṃ samuccārya suddhimantra prakīrtitaṃ ||
anena vidhinā devi abhisiktāstriyaḥ sadā | ramamāṇotra sanityaṃ sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt ||
ihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā pare muktimavāpnuyāt | asyā karṇe bhedabudhyā māyābījaṃ samuccaret ||
tena suddhā bhavennārī pūjā yogyā sadaiva hi |
[iti śrīkaularahasya trayodaśa paṭalaḥ] || 13 ||
atha dravyāṃgīkāre adhikārikā virekamāha ||
dravyena sātvike naiva brahmaṇa pūjayecchivāṃ | brāhmaṇo madirāṃ datvā brahmaṇyā deva hīyate ||
brāhmaṇastvanukalpaṃ ca kṛtvā caṇḍālatā miyāt | evaṃ dadyāt kṣitriyopi paiṣṭikīṃ nā kadācana ||
<61a>
evaṃ pradā (? * ?) mātre hīnāyu brāhmano bhavet | kāmre gavyaṃ madhulamaṃ daivapaitrye na dudhyati ||
ata eva maheśāni homa tāmre pragṛhyate | brāhmanena tathā kārya brāhmaṇyaṃ na ca viśyati ||
varṇānukrama bhedena dravyabhedā bhavaṃti ca | kṣīreṇa brāhmaṇaistarpyaṃ ghṛtena nṛpavaṃśajaiḥ ||
mākṣikarvaiśyavaryastu āsavai śūdrajātibhiḥ | yatrāvaśyaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ madirādānamuttamaṃ ||
brāhmaṇastāṃmra pātre tu gavyamadyaṃ prakalpayet | matyakramārcaturvarṇai kṣīrājye madhupi(?)ṣṭajaiḥ ||
tretāyāṃ pūjitā devi ghṛtena sarvajātibhiḥ | mabhīḥ sarvaṇeśca pūjitā dvāpare yuge ||
pūjanīyā kalau devi kevalaṃ rāsa vai niśi |
<61b>
brāhmaṇaiśca sadāgre yā kṣatriyaiśca raṇāgame | vaiśvairddhana prayoge ca śūdranaiva kadācana ||
brāhmaṇasya munmadya vāsanā pravedyati | cāṇḍāladvahikāryā nāsye vā mīna kaulikā ||
trāhmanomaspṛte madyaṃ vaidike ca tvani sthitaṃ | paṃcalakṣaṇaṃ yuktā brāhmanadāra eva saḥ ||
ahaṃ brahmā tathā viṣṇu tadā jñānaśavartinī | sa ced vāme pathaṃ prāptaḥ punasnānobhiyāyate ||
catulakṣala sayukto viprājñāyastu madhyama | tādsvāṃ dartābhāgya vā tāntrikaḥ kopi cenmunu ||
sadya phativāśyasya kriyayā vāpi tasya tu | lakṣaṇayayuktoyastasya vaidika tāntrike ||
yathoktā caraṇādeva phaladastumavāmakaḥ | lakṣaṇadvayasaṃyuktāstasya vāmaśca dakṣiṇa ||
samatulya phalau syātāṃ na kadācana daidikaḥ |
<62a>
ekalakṣaṇasaṃyukto samastasya phalaprādaḥ | sautrāminyāṃ kulacāre brāhmaṇaḥ prapicetsurāṃ ||
anyatra kāmataḥ pītvā prāyaścittī bhaven naraḥ | brāhmaṇaiḥ kaulikaiḥ peyaṃ devatā tṛpti hetave ||
vāminīṃ kaulikānāṃ ca mukhe tiṣṭhanti devatāḥ |
nayanti tu vaṃdyo hi rerapi ||
devatā yasya na mukhe sākṣāccāṃḍāla eva saḥ || sevetamadhūmāṃsāni bhṛsnayā cet sa pātakī ||
mantrapūtaṃ kula dravyaṃ guru devārpitaṃ priye | ye pivanti janāsteṣāṃstana pānaṃ punarma ca ||
bahunoktena kiṃ devī yathāśaktyā dadāti yaḥ | kulāryāya pūjanārtha kuladravyaṃ sadharmavit ||
śauve tu vaiṣṇave śākte saure sugatadaśane | boddhapāśupate sāṃkhya mantrakālā mukhe tathā ||
<62b>
sa dakṣe vāmasiddhānte vaidikādiṣu pārvati | nivāli pisitātpāṃtu pūjanaṃ niḥphalaṃ bhavet ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣāmi kaulikā caraṇaṃ yathā | pāṇe bhāṃti bhedyasya mṛṇāsyādraktaretasauḥ ||
śuddhau vā śuddhitā buddhiḥ pāpaśaṃkā ca maithune | sa bhraṣṭa pūjayed devī caṇḍī mantraṃ kathaṃ japet ||
atha dravya nāmavaśyatāmāha ||
vinālivedānātyāṃ na prasīdati kālikā | madhubhāṇḍasahasraistu māṃśabhāśuśatairapi ||
naiva tuṣṭā bhavedevi bhagaliṃgāmṛtaṃ ṛtā ||
atha kārāṇāṃ kramaphalamāha ||
kaloti surāpānaṃ jīvanmuktaḥ sa jāyate | vinā dravyādhivāsena na smarana japaṃttathā ||
ye smaraṃti mahāmūḍhā teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ pade pade |
<63a>
tyasavena vināmantraṃ vinā mantrena cāsanaṃ | paraspara virodhitvā kathaṃ pūjā vidhiyate ||
tatsasayanivṛtī ca jñātvā guru mukhā jayet | sāsaṃkhādati yo martyastathā mṛtyu bhayaṃ kutaḥ ||
yo bhakṣayakṣimatsvāśvesa śivo nātra saṃśayaḥ | mudrāṃ bhakṣayate yastu sasiddhānāpati bhavet ||
surataṃ yaḥ prakurute trailokya karaṇa kṣamaḥ | etasyācārtha tritayaṃ sātvikārājasastathā ||
tāmasaśveti tatrādyau rāmādityanirūpitaḥ | taṃ margaye vijānanti te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
athāsavasyatraividhimāha ||
madirā trividhā proktā uttamāmadhyamādhamā | uttamasvagṛhotpannā madhyamā cānnyagehajā ||
adhamāsadṛśaṃkītā evaṃ sātrividhā matā |
<63b>
śrīśīva uvāca ||
devāsuraiḥ purākalpe madhyamāne mahodadhau | tatra śyāmā samutpanā surākalaśadhāriṇi ||
gaurāṃścaruṇa cailā ca bhāvasvarddharitaṃvukā | śvetārtarapadā devī traulokyasyāpi mohine ||
dṛṣṭvātāṃ dānavāḥ sarvaśukrācārya valāt surān | jitvāstāṃjagṛhustasyāḥ kalaśārcanapuḥ surāṃ ||
devānyelapitān dṛṣṭvā śastayastatra saṃsthitāḥ | papustā apitāṃ puṇyāṃ surānapi vahṛnadyuḥ surāpāḥ suramātakaraḥ ||
abhayāsmārta payaṃti śeṣaṃ gṛhnaṃti ye narā | te smadrūpā na saṃdeho bhukti muktikabhājanaṃ ||
surāgaṃgā surāsinduḥ surā devī sarasvatī | surāgoḍāvarī revā suraiva paramaṃ padaṃ ||
sūranindaṃtiya mūḍhā mūḍhāste janmani |
<64a>
gandharvai bhūyamānasto śaktayaste ca dānavā ||
utpartiḥ kathitā devi pānaṃ ca kathayāmidaṃ | jihvā mūlaṃ samārabhya hṛdayaṃ yāva sundarī ||
ṣoḍaśāṅgula vijñeyā sthānaśvedāmṛ padaṃ | ṣoḍaśaiva kalāyuktaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgalamayataṃ ||
pivateddaivataiddevi madyamamṛtarūpiṇaṃ | prathamaṃ pivate vahni dvītīyaṃ śaninā pibet ||
viṣṇunā ca tṛtīyastu caturthaṃ varuṇa pibet | kuṁ caṁ maṃ devi ṣaṣṭha tu vā sava pibet ||
saptamaṃ ṛṣibhiḥ sarvai gaṇeśvarāṣṭamaṃtripe | navamaṃ dharma rājena marutai daśamaṃ pibet ||
ekādaśayasasthāna brahmaputro pibet priye | kumāradvādasaṃ yāti vaināyakatrodaśaṃ ||
caturdaśyā paśupatiṃ etai pitvā daśaiḥ pañca ṣoḍaśaṃ na prakāśayet |
<64b>
na pitaṃ mānuṣairbhadre devai pītvā ca śaṃbhavaiḥ ||
pītvā ca kathitaṃ bhadre adhunā devatā śṛṇu | surāsā ca umā devī yo madyaḥ samaheśvaraḥ ||
yāvarṇaḥ sasvayaṃ brahmā yo gandhaḥ sajanārdanaḥ |
ya svādaḥ sa tu somoyaṃ ||
jñānavijñānasaṃpannaṃ sadya vidyā suleśvarī |
atha pāka prakālamāha ||
aṃsāṃ dvādasā pracatuprasthaṃ ca taṃḍulāḥ | prasthārddhasthaṃḍūlaṃ proktaṃ tāvarmātrāṃstadaṃ kulāt ||
śītādi na hite sthāne divasadvayamāsya tat | paścābhānau samāropya jaṃvāla sadṛśaṃ pacet ||
pradapasthaṃ taṃḍulāṃśca tanmātrānaṃ kulā kṣipet | dina dvayaṃ tu saṃsthāpya narevaṃ prakalalpayet ||
arddha tasya samādāya taḍuleṣu vinikṣipet |
<65a>
(* * * * * * * * *?) ṇḍalī sāsurā smṛtā | puyameva bhavet somaḥ somayāga phalapradaḥ ||
iti yāgo bhaved yāgaḥ somapāna tu ta smṛtaṃ | yā gatiḥ soma ca jñāna kaulikā nāmanenasā ||
bhogasvarga ca bhavati vinā kaṣṭena vāmināṃ | evaṃ tu yava piṣṭottho devasoma iti smṛtaḥ ||
ye ca taṇḍula yogena śakti somo nigadyateḥ |
svinnakubuṭṭitagodhūmāḥ samakliśye na saṃyutāḥ | sthāpitā dvādaśāhaṃ ca vāruṇyāṃ paripācitāḥ ||
tanmandyaṃ sūryasaṃjñaṃ syād yoginī madavarddhanaṃ | pītaṃ taccakra pūjānte vājapeya phalaṃ labhet ||
idameva tridhā yuktaṃ dalaṃ madyaṃ ca sādhitaṃ | agnirbhavet tasya pānādagniho phalaṃ bhavet ||
<65b>
adhasumaṃ ca tadardhaṃ syāt tadarddhaṃ ca harītakī | tāvad vibhitakaṃ proktaṃ caturthā śaṃkaṭu trayaṃ ||
tārcca citrakaṃ tasmā guḍo dvādaśa bhāgikaḥ | kareṇa bhrāmayet samyak nnugaloma vilomataḥ ||
aṣṭottara śatāvṛtyā trisaṃdhyaṃ pratipārakaṃ | dvādaśāhena pākaḥ syād vāruṇī yantragaṃ pacet ||
eṣāgauḍīti vikhyātā mahāmadakarī samatāṃ | śivena nirmitā pūrvaṃ svayaṃ pītvā ca bhairavai ||
dviguṇaṃ makaraṃdākhyā vārisaṃyojaye guḍe | ṣoḍaśāhena pākaḥ syāccheṣamanya puroktavat ||
sarvadevi priyā ceva vaśikaraṇamadbhutaṃ | devonāṃ śaktayo vaśyāmānuṣīnāṃ tu kā kathā ||
harītakī citrakaṃ ca manīcaṃ dhyātakī tathā | madhupuṣpaṃ cadraṃ ca bhāgaikena vivarddhitaṃ ||
<66a>
aśīti guḍasaṃmiśraṃ śeṣaṃ manyat puroktavat | idaṃ manoharaṃ dravyaṃ yoginī pānamuttamaṃ ||
madyā bhave pravakṣyāmi bindumadyādhikaṃ surā | mahaṣaṃ dadhisaṃgrāhyā caturdaśaguṇaṃ surāṃ ||
māvānhalasya pakvasya marditasya rasastathā | grāhyaṃ dadhi caturthāśe tatsaṃmadyaṃ ghaṭe kṣipet ||
catvāri śabdinānyaṣṭau paṃkapaṃkajasaṃkule | nidhāyoddhṛtya kiraṇaiḥ sauraiḥ (* * * *?) ṣayet ||
yadā tatkaṭhiṇī bhāvastadā kuryādvitī śubhāṃ | guṃjābhīṃjalasaṃpūrṇe tāṃmrapātreṇidhāpayet ||
idasurātopyadhikaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ praṇasyate | gauḍīmadhvī tathā paiṣṭhī trividhā tu surā smṛtā ||
śūdrāṇamuciceyaṃte vaṃśākṣatriya vaiśayoḥ | brāhmanandasurāyaistu pitā (* * *?) kaulikaiḥ ||
<66b>
na conmādakarī teṣāṃ sureyaṃ buddhivaddhinī | sarvasiddhi karī ṣaṣṭhī goḍībhāga pradāyiṇi ||
mādhī muktikarījñāyādrākṣārāja pradā matā | vidya pradaikṣavīhālākhārjurīripunāśinī ||
tālajā stambhane śastāpanasākhyā śubha pradā | nārikerodbhavā śrīdāniṃvajārogeginī ||
dhūmakajājñākanarī caila pāpāpanāśinī | yatsā nandaruci karaṃ sā modaṃ ca manoharaṃ ||
mṛdyaṃ taduttamaṃ devā devatā prīti kārakaṃ | brahmā syāt salile viṣṇu gaṃdhe rudraśca tadrucauḥ ||
paramātmā tadā nande tasmāt sevyamidaṃ priye | dṛṣṭvā praṇamya prathamaṃ tadrūpāmvāruṇī kalāṃ ||
varuṇe nārcitā devī vāruṇī iti viśrutā | suraistu pivata nityaṃ surānāma iti smṛta ||
<67a>
madanenārcitā nityai madireyaṃ prakīrtitāḥ | paramārthe tu utpannā parāśaktiḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
yathāmṛtaṃ tathā madyaṃ proktakāle niṣevitaṃ | amṛtena sahotpanna sthāne madyaṃ sudhāyata ||
viṣenāmahotpannaṃ tena madyaṃ viyāyate |
atha niṣiddhamāha ||
naṣṭai payuṣitocchiṣṭaidurgādhvaigaṃdha varjitaiḥ | hetubhiḥ parapātrasthaistarpaṇaṃ niḥphalaṃ bhavet ||
manohaśca devīnāṃ tarpaṇaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet | svapātraṃ sthaṃ ca hetuśca na dadyān bhairavāya ca ||
dastra ca siddhi hāni syādityājñā śaṃkarai kṛtāḥ | māṃsaṃ tu trividhaṃ proktaṃ jalakhecala bhūcalaṃ ||
jala carāsyuḥ kūrmādyā khecarā karkaṭādayaḥ | bhūcarā tu mṛgādyāsyuḥ teṣāṃ bhedāṣṭakaṃ bhavet ||
gonarephāsvamahiṣa varāhāja mṛgodbhavaṃ |
<67b>
ca vistarṇamuttānena samākṛti |
athavā devadeveśi pātraṃ carcartulī kṛtaṃ | aśvattha patrākāraṃ kakutayākārameva ca ||
trikoṇākāra pātraṃ ca trī trī yoni samanvitaṃ | madhya bindu yutaṃ pātraṃ dhvaja cihna samanvitaṃ ||
athavā bhubhagākāraṃ dhvajabindu sa keśarī | evaṃ pātraṃ samānīya mahācīneśvarī yajet ||
atha pātramāha ||
nārikera svarṇatāmraṃ kāca śukti śirodbhaṃ | śaṃkhasaddāndakurmotthaṃ kapālācūmṛnmayaṃ ||
kapālapātreṇa deveśi kāpālisiddhirasti ca | yadyadvāṃcchati kāmāni guḍikāṃjana siddhayaḥ ||
siddhadravyaṃ kāmagatiṃ manoratha mayī kalāṃ | vāṃcchābhogonnavya sṛṣṭi karaṇaṃ caiva dṛśyato ||
cintāmaṇiṃ kāmakalā yatpātre sarvameva ca | kāpyalinnituryasiddhiḥ kāmelasiddhi (* * *?) ||
(Folio 68-72 not found)
<73a>
ekapātraṃ samānīya khaṇḍatritaya bhedataḥ | uttamaṃ madhyamaṃ hīnaṃ viprā hīnāṃ prakīrtitā ||
laṃ nāti sūkṣmaṃ cchivaṃ bhinnaṃ vivarjayet | tāmraṃ kāsyādibhisohaiḥ pātraṃ naivantu (* * *?) ||
sarvasiddhiḥ suvarṇasyādudyamastāla pātrataḥ | śāṃtaḥ śilāyāṃstaṃbhastu śaive śaṃkha varāharau ||
mahāśaṃṣo vāmamārge sphaṭikaṃ graha nāyāke | viśvāmitra kapālaṃ tu sarvapātrottamottamaṃ ||
brahmahatyādi pāpāni tathā viśva sa ghātakaṃ | dṛṣṭvā pātraṃ nālikelaṃ sarvameva praṇasyati ||
kanyākoṭi pradānāni tathā hema śatāni coyodavāti heśānirāhugraste divākare ||
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ nālikelarpapātrataḥ | ālābhe kaulikai śakti śahitai taducchiṣṭaṃ capyevayet ||
svaśaktiṃ vīraśaktiṃ vā dīkṣitāṃ gururūpiṇaṃ | pāyayitvā pibenmadyaṃ mitisāstrasya niścayaḥ ||
tataḥ śrīgururūpāya sākṣāt paraśivātmane | karotyāṃ pātramuddhṛtya sadviyaṃ nivedayet ||
gurorabhāve tatpātraṃ jalamadhye ca niḥkṣipet | pūjyaśaktiṃ śaktipātraṃ vīretyā vīrapātrakaṃ ||
anyasyā yoginī pātraṃ svārthe syāt bhogapātrakaṃ | kuṇḍalī tarpaṇārthañca bhogapātraṃ samācaret ||
antaśaktimanusmṛtya tarpayed deha devatāṃ | atha yena prakāreta svīkuryā pātramuttamaṃ ||
(Folio 74-83 not found)
<84a>
taddehaṃvyāhaviṣyāmi yathārudreṇa bhāṣitaṃ | prāṇāyāma vidhāyāntu tattanmantra ṣaḍaṅgakaṃ ||
kurvīta bhakti bhāvena śaktyā vṛkṣādikaṃ tathā | tatra ghrayetattatpātraṃ dakṣahaste niveśayet ||
vāmahaste nāmikāyā aṅguṣṭhamabhiyojayet | idaṃ hitārpaṇī mudrā śūdrūpāparikīrtitā ||
etayā mudrayā devi saṃhārakramatokhilān | pātre tu dravyamādāya tarpayedurita kramaiḥ ||
aṃguṣṭhāsyānāmikāyā nakhai yāvan pralimyataḥ | tāvan niveśayānīha mudrā vai kaulika drave ||
nimīlya cakṣuṣīyā |
<84b>
yathā vidhi dvitīyena gṛhnīyā mantramuccaran | piśitaṃ māṣamātraṃ tu madyaṃ cūlūka saṃmita ||
svīkāryamādau guruṇā śiṣyatyaḥ śeṣado bhavet | nissaṅko nirmalo dhīro nirlajjo nikūtūharaḥ ||
nirṇīta vedaśāstrārtho varadāmvāruṇīssivet | devan pitṛsamatyarcya devīśāstrokta vartmanā ||
guruṃ smare piben madyaṃ ṣādanmāṃsaṃ nabhoṣabhāk | guru daivatamantrāṇomaikyaṃ saṃbhāvayandhiyā ||
āgalāntaṃ pibed dravyaṃ tata carvaṇamācaret | māṃsaṃ matsyaṃ ca mudrāṃ ca maithunaṃ vai kramārcayet ||
svasaṃprādāyasaṃyuktaṃ vīraiśca saha pūjayet | citta svāgatantya sāratvāt tasyā nandaye tvataḥ ||
tanmayetvārca bhāvānāṃ
(folio 85 not found)
<86a>
bhāvaścāntarhite rase |
svasvātantrya vikāsāya surāsastena pīyate | tasmādimāsurādevī pūrṇāhanto juhomyahaṃ ||
mantreṇānena deveśi mūlamantreṇa mantravit | anākulamanāḥ kuryān madhupānaṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
yāvadullāsaparyantamapadaṃśaiḥ piben madhu | tataḥ pātra gataṃ hālā binduṃ bhaumau prapātayet ||
ucchiṣṭaṃ bhairavāyeha dadyān mantraṃ manuṃ paṭhen | maidhamāyāramābīje mehyakmucchiṣṭabhairava ||
visandhi ca valiṃ gṛhna yugaṃ svāhā ca paścimo | nighṛṣyatadbhūmi tale pūrvavaccitraṃ kaṃcaret ||
yenyepi pātraṃ svīkuryusteṣāmapyeṣa hi kramaḥ | pānabhedahalollāsa pramānsthiti lakṣaṇaṃ ||
<86b>
avijñāya cared yastu sa bhavedā padāṃ padaṃ | pānapaṃca vidhaṃ proktaṃ māhādivyādi bhedanaḥ ||
mahādivyaṃ tathā divyaṃ viraścaiva mahāpaśu | paśuḥ vaṃdyaḥ paśuśceti paṃcadhā parikīrtitaḥ ||
prāṇāpāṇau samāhārau pratyāhāra manaḥsthiraṃ | bhānumaṇḍalakaṃ bhītvā indumaṇḍalamadhyagaṃ ||
suṣumnāvatmaṇā nityaṃ sudhādārā pravīttīnī | mahādivyamidaṃ proktaṃ śṛṇu divyaṃ maheśvari ||
divyadevyagrataḥ pālaṃ vīramṛdvāsanottaraṃ | tyaktaḥ sarvapāsamūle (* *) nāmalasaṃcayaḥ ||
kaulikācāra yogena paṃcatatva na tarpayet | ṣaṭcakrakramabhedena huneta dravyaṃ samantrakaṃ ||
<87a>
paṃcatatva na tarpayet ||
dhyānārcana parāvasthā vīrapānamanuttamaṃ | udvāsanottara devi paśupānaṃ śṛṇu priye ||
vīrapāne pūrvadhīro parastu paśurityapi | āsaktalolupādaṃ bhomaṃtrārthe cāprasaṃgakaḥ ||
kāmukaḥ kārya nirdeśe paśupānaṃ taducyate | sarvaiḥ kūlīṇaiḥ sthitvā tu vināpūjāṃ sarvitaiḥ ||
yatpānaṃ krīyate devi paśupāna kramaḥ śive | ekākī madyapāyīya ekākī śaktibhuk priye ||
maherasya saṃsargaṃ na kapi karoti cet | paśupānamidaṃ proktaṃ mahādāridryadāyakaṃ ||
vināmantraṃ vinā dīkṣāṃ vinā guru mukhāt priyet | yatpānaṃ na kriyete mūrkhaiḥ paśupānaṃ viduvurdhāḥ ||
<87b>
mahāpaśuriti proktaḥ kaulavāmo śṛṇu priye | vāmarāmā manohārī cālipātraṃ tu dakṣiṇe ||
pānapātraṃ maheśāni vāmahastena tarpakaḥ | mahākaulā maheśāni bhūmau sthāpya pratarpayet ||
hasta dvayena caddevi kaula ityabhidhīyate | vāmadakṣa vātyayena vīlakaulaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
alipātraṃ vāmapāṇau dakṣahastena tarpayet | kāmagauḍastu saṃprokta caitatpākhya caitatpākhya sa eva tu ||
bhūmau sthāpya maheśāni hastayugmena tarpayet | ānandākhya susaṃproktaḥ vāma ityavidhīyate ||
atha phalantu ||
mantraṃ saṃskare saṃśuddho'mṛtanena pārvati |
<88a>
jāyate devagābhāvau bhavavaṃdhavimocaka ||
ānanda brahmaṇo rūpaṃ tacca mokṣa vyavasthitaṃ | tasyābhivyaṃjakaṃ dravyaṃ yogibhistena bhīyate ||
divyapāṇarato vīrā devī sāyujyamāpnuyāt | deveśi vīrapāṇena devīlokaṃ hi vācchati ||
sādhaka paśupānena devīlokaṃ hi gacchati | sādhaka paśupānena rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
ārambhastaruta?ścaiva yauvanaprauḍha eva ca | tadantre cottamasthānāvasthāścaiva saptamaḥ ||
athaiṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ||
pātra trayaṃ syādāraṃbhaḥ kathitaḥ kulanāyikāḥ | tadante taruṇaścaiva taruṇaṃ sukhadaṃ priye ||
<88b>
yauvanaṃ manasamyak gullāsa kathitaḥ priye | skhalanaṃ dṛṅmano vācā prauḍhamityabhidhīyate ||
svabhīṣṭavaṣṭā caraṇaṃ prauḍhāntaḥ parikīrtitāḥ | unmanāḥ patanotthānamucchānācca muhumuhuḥ ||
dehendriyā nāma ca vaśaśvā navasthā nigadyate | bhojanānte viṣaṃ madyaṃ madyante bhojanaṃ viṣaṃ ||
amṛtataṃtadvijānīyādyadannaṃ surayā saha | carvaṇena yutaṃ madyaṃ mamṛtaṃ kathitaṃ sadā ||
carvaṇena vināpānaṃ kevalaṃ viṣabhakṣaṇaṃ | tata stutvā namaskṛtya kuryāsaṃbhogamelanaṃ ||
devatā tu saṃbhoge devatā prīṇatāṃ bhavet | etāsukāṃcidānīya tataśca yoni maṇḍale ||
<89a>
pūjayitvā mahādevī tato maithunamācaret | dharmādharma havirdīptā ātmāgnau manasā śruvā ||
suṣumnā vartmanā nityamakṣavṛrtīrjuhomyahaṃ | svāhāntoyaṃ mahāmantra āraṃbhe parikīrtitaḥ ||
tato japet priyaṃ gacchan devīntribhuvaneśvarīṃ | prakāśākaśahastābhyāṃ valamvyommanī śruvā ||
dharmādharma kalo sneha pūrṇamagno juhomyahaṃ | svāhāntoyaṃ mahāmantraḥ śukratyāge prakīrtitaḥ ||
mādādyadilupyate devatā sā prakupyati | vinā bhuktvā vinā pītvā vinā kṛtvā tu pañcamaṃ ||
sayāpiṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ vrūte kālī mantraṃ japāmyahaṃ | tasmāt sarva prayatnena sādhayet paṃcamaṃ priye ||
yadi cet kriyate naiva tasya duḥkhaṃ pade pade |
<89b>
yadviyoṣinna saṃgasyāt tadānukalpayogataḥ | kartavyaṃ karmasāṃgāthaṃ nācet viphalamīritaṃ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya saptadaśamapaṭalaḥ] || 17 ||
atha nīlakramaḥ ||
khaḍgahastaśironyasta sarvadāmukta kuntalaḥ | sadāmāṃsāsavollāsa vijayāghūrṇalocanaḥ ||
siṃdūlatilakaṃ bhāle pāṇau tu madirārasaṃ | na karoti naroyastu kathaṃ mama pūjakaḥ ||
rātrau paryaṭanaṃ caiva rātrau śaktya prapūjanaṃ | na karoti naro yastu sa kathaṃ mama pūjakaḥ ||
yoni cūmbanakaṃ karma śakterāliṃganaṃ tathā | na karoti naroyastu sa kathaṃ mama pūjakaḥ ||
tāmbūraṃ yoni cakraṃ ca muṇḍamālāśavāsanaṃ |
<90a>
siṃdūlaṃkhaḍgakaṃ caiva saṃvidāsava yorasaṃ | etā vihāya kaścit kāliṃ sādhi tu mudyataḥ ||
ihakṣobhamavāpnoti paratra narakaṃ vrajet |
atha śāladī viṣaya devī vākyaṃ ||
bhagaliṃga kriyāśabdairvaśa ceṣṭābhiruktibhiḥ | visarjanasyāvasare krīḍitavyaṃ nijecchayā ||
kāryaṃjavadbhirapye tad devī saṃtoṣa hetave | parairnākṣipyate yastu yaḥ parānnākṣipetyapi ||
tasya krūddhā bhagavatī śāpaṃ dadyāt sudāruṇaṃ | etat prāsaṅgikī devyā uktisamararadhāraya ||
mamānande sadānaṃdaḥ sadānando bhaviṣyati | mamānande nirānando nirānando bhaviṣyati ||
yathā yathā mamānande bhagavatyūnmattavarjanaḥ | tathā tathāhaṃtuṣyāmi tatkṛtārcā suvallabhā ||
khyātaṃ mama bhagaṃ cihnaṃ liṃgacihnaṃ tava prabho | liṃgāṅgatvā bhagāṅgatvādiyaṃ māheśvarī prajā ||
tvāṃ māṃ vihāya naivānyat kiṃcit tribhuvanodare | tasmāt matpūjana syānte tvamuccihnoktibhirjanaḥ ||
yaḥ krīḍati mahābhāga same manasi tiṣṭhati | anurvāṇopi sūrataṃ bhagaṃ bhagamiti bruvan ||
liṅgaṃ liṃgamiti procyamāṃṣayati takṣaṇāt | retaḥ siktaṃ bhave ghādṛghādṛktā(?) dṛśyatra jāyate ||
bhagaṃ trijagatāṃmuṣṭrakavininditu marhati | ityādi vacanairdevyā yatheṣṭaṃ viharerjanaḥ ||
atha daśavidyā bhairava mantra dhyānaṃ yathā |
tatrādau akṣobhya ||
anuttaraṃ samuddhṛtya papañcamavibhūṣitaṃ |
<91a>
akṣobhyeti ca svāheti ramāyantaṃ mahāmanuḥ | atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvasaubhāgyadāyakaṃ ||
sahasrādityasaṃkāśaṃ nāgarūpadharaṃ śubhaṃ | vidyutkoṭi samaṃ vaktraṃ vahnibhāsvara locanaṃ ||
sārddha trivalai yopetaṃ japākādyagrasaṃsthitaṃ | mahālāvaṇyasaṃyuktaṃ surāsura namaskṛtaṃ ||
sūryavidyutsamaṃ bhāsvan mahāmaṇi śiropari | etadrūpaṃ mahākāyaṃ daivairapi supūjitaṃ ||
atha krodhabhairavasya mantramāha ||
atha krodhamanuṃ vakṣye asādhyaṃ yena sidhyati | bījaṃ hālāhalaṃ gṛhya krodhabījamataḥ paraṃ ||
bhayaṃ karārṇamābhāṣyāśitāṃgakṣataja sthitaṃ | pralayāgni mahājvālāmābhāṣyamanūmūddharet ||
evamūccāritaḥ krodhaḥ svayameva prasiddhati |
<91b>
atha dhyānamāha ||
tatra madhyenesedbhīmaṃ tapta jvālā samākulaṃ | sāṭṭahāsaṃ mahāraudraṃ bhinnāṃjana ca yopamaṃ ||
pratyālīḍhaṃ caturvāhuṃ dakṣiṇe cakra dhāriṇaṃ | tarjanaṃ vāmahastena tīkṣṇādaṃṣṭrā karālinaṃ ||
kapālaratnamūkūṭaṃ trailokyasya vināyakaṃ | āditya koṭi saṃkāsaṃ aṣṭanāga vibhūṣitaṃ ||
aparājita padākrāntamudrāvānvalaviṣṭitaṃ | anāmikā dvayaṃ vadhvā ākūñca tarjanī dvayaṃ ||
kaniṣṭhāṃ madhyamāṃ caiva jyeṣṭhaguṣṭhena cakramāt | evamudrādharādbhīmāṃ trailokyā sādhyasādhakaḥ ||
atha tripūrabhairavasya mantramāha ||
māyālakṣmīstathā haṃsaḥ prāsāda bījameva ca | vahni jāyāntako mantro bhavet tripura bhairava ||
<92a>
ṣaḍaṃgaṃ mūlamantreṇa valipūjādikaṃ tathā |
atha dhyānaṃ ||
ekavaktraṃ trinayanaṃ caturvāhu samanvitaṃ | dakṣiṇe cāṅkuśaṃ khaḍgaṃ vāme kheṭakapāśakau ||
dhārayanta raktavarṇa vṛṣāsana gataṃ vibhuṃ | urddhakeśaṃ hāḍahāraṃ kapālamālayānvitaṃ ||
evaṃ vidhaṃ sadā devi dhyāyet tripura bhairavaṃ ||
atha catukasya ||
māyā ca vaṭukaṃ ṅente māyabūddhyāraṇāya ca | kurudvayaṃ vahukāya hrīṁ prakṛti varṇakaḥ ||
vṛhadāraṇyakamuniścchando nūṣṭup devatā | bhairavo hrīṃ bījaśakti āḥ kīlakamudāhṛtaṃ ||
evaṃ nyasta tanudhyāye cchurddha sphaṭikasaṃnibhaṃ | dīptaśubhrāmvarā bhītaṃ kikiṇī jālanūpuraiḥ ||
yutaṃ ratna mayai dhānamabhayaṃ pare |
<92b>
suprasannamukhāmbhojaṃ niviṣṭaṃ kuśa viṣṭare ||
brahmaviṣṇu maheśādyai stutaṃ bhaktyāsurāsuraiḥ | viśvādyaṃ viśvavapuṣaṃ bhavabhīti haraṃ bhavaṃ ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi cāghorāstrāhvayaṃ manuṃ | māyāṃ sphura dvayaṃ caiva prasphura dvitayaṃ vadet ||
paścādvade turuturu rūpānte ca ca tadvayaṃ | pracaṭa dvitayaṃ paścāt kaha dvayaṃ vamadvayaṃ ||
vandha dvayaṃ ghātayadvi hūṁ phaṭ śaravarṇakaḥ |
dhyāna ||
dhyāyet tato megha kālaṃ bhīma draṣṭaṃ trilocanaṃ | bhujaṃga bhūṣaṇaṃ rakta vasanālepa śobhitaṃ ||
paraśuṃ karavālaṃ ca vāṇaṃstriśikhameva ca | dadhānāṃ dakṣiṇairhastairuddhādi kramataḥ paraiḥ ||
ḍamarūṃ kheṭakaṃ cāpaṃ nṛkapālaṃ ca vibhramaṃ |
(folio 93 not found)
<94a>
atha tryayaṃvakasya ||
bhujaṃgeṇa samārūḍhā pūtanāvasudhe duyuk | vakaṃ yajāmahe proktvā sugaṃdhi puṣṭivarddhanaṃ ||
rurvārukamiva proktāraṃdhanān mṛpadaṃ vadet | bhyāmukṣīya padaṃ vruyāt māmṛtādi bhyūdīrayet ||
triyaṃvakaṃ manuḥ prokta bhajatāṃ mṛtyu nāśanaṃ |
dhyāna ||
hastābhyāṃ kalaśa dvayo mṛtaraserāplāvayaṃtaṃ śirādvābhyāṃtau dadhataṃ mṛgākta valayedvālyāṃ vahataṃ paraṃ | aṃkanyastakara dvayāmṛta ghaṭaṃ kailāsakāṃtaṃ śivaṃ svacchāṃ bhojagataṃ navendu mukuṭaṃ devaṃ trinetraṃ bhajet ||
atha mahākālasya ||
hūṁ kṣāṁ yāṁ lāṁ āṁ kroṁ mahākāla bhairava sa vighnānnāśaye (2) hrīṁ śrīṁ phaṭ svāhā ||
dhyāna ||
<94b>
oṃ śikhānāthaṃ mahādevaṃ karṇikāpalisaṃsthitaṃ | pretāsavagatā devaṃ svetavvarna sūsobhitaṃ ||
dakṣiṇe raktavarṇa ca pītamūttara sobhitaṃ | uttare nīlajīmūlaṃ catuvaktre maheśvaraṃ ||
dvādaśānayanasaṃyuktaṃ īṣaddraṣṭānanā śubhā | piṅgabhrūsmaśrukesaṃ ca mahā ugrā bhaya prabhā ||
raktākalatalā caiva ṣarvolambodarāṅgikaṃ | vajrajvālā gatā jvālā mahājvālā sajājvalaṃ ||
jvalaṃtilā yudhāsarve jvalajvālā virājita | daśarvāhu mahādevaṃ khaḍga pheṭakadhārakaṃ ||
śaraṃdhanudharañcaiva aṃkulaṃ pāśadhārakaṃ | varābhaya pradādevaṃ pātra khaṭvāṅgadhāranaṃ ||
evaṃ ḍamarū bhujādaśa yojanavistaraṃ | śarīlaṃ vyāpya rūpāṇi sarvaśāntika kālakaṃ ||
<95a>
iti daśavidyā bhairavaṃ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya aṣṭādaśapaṭalaḥ] || 18 ||
atha kaulikārcanaṃ ||
maheśvaraṃ samālokya pūjayed vidhi pūrvakaṃ | yathāvibhavarūpeṇa paṃcatatvaṃ nivedya ca ||
sadā tuṣṭā bhaved devī sarvān kāmān labhedapi | anyathā naiva siddhiḥ syāt kruddhā bhavati yoginī ||
medinīṃ yastu pūrṇāñca brahmaṇe veda pārage | datvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kaulikārcane ||
aśvamedha sahasrāṇi vājapeya śatāni ca | dṛṣṭvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kaulircanāt ||
vāpī kūpa taḍāgādi kṛtvā yatphalamāpnuyāt | tatphalāllakṣaguṇitaṃ kaulikānāṃ prapūjanāt ||
kapilā caivagāṃ datvā yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ |
<95b>
tatphalaṃ koṭi guṇitaṃ kaulikānāṃ prapūjanāt |
atha dūtīyāgaḥ ||
puruṣeṇa vinā kiṃcit prakṛtyā kriyatena hi | tathā śaktiṃ vinā devo phalaṃ dātuṃ kramoṇa hi ||
tasmāt puṃśakti śaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā mantraṃ prasādhayet | kaulikai vāmamārge ca pumāndevo na siddhyati ||
ātmānantu śivaṃ dhyāyaḥddevatāṃ śaktirūpiṇīṃ | krīḍet paṃcamakāraistu suprītā tasya devatā ||
dakṣamārge mātṛbuddhiḥ strībuddhiḥ kaulike pathi | yasya jātā dṛḍhatarā tasya tuṣṭā tu devatā ||
etad rahasyamākhyātaṃ gopyaṃ mātari jāravat | śaivāḥ smārtā yājñikāśca tāṃ na kurvanti pārvati ||
kaulānāmāgamajñānāṃ tāntrikācāra vartināṃ |
<96a>
anukalpa pradātṛṇāṃ madhyasthānāṃ tathaiva ca | devīṃtibuddhiryoṣit suyaṣāmatiracaśvalā ||
teṣāṃ kālī subhaktānāṃ sarvadāniścitātmanāṃ | āvaśyakī śakti pūjā pīṭhapūjā vadīśvari ||
kālī buddhyaiva saṃpūjyā na kāmākulayādhiyā | caturthā śramiṇe muktvā ye kālyarcana tatparāḥ ||
kaulāli vāpyakaulāvā ye caitanmata vartitaḥ | teṣāṃ nityāśakti pūjā prāhaivaṃ māṃ pūradviṣaḥ ||
sā śakti dvividhā jñeyā svakīyāṃ ca parāṃganā | svajāti saṃbhāyā yātu pariṇītā bhavet priyet ||
sā svakīyo samuddiṣṭā tathā neyaṃ praśasyate | parakīyā paṃcavidhātāḥ krameṇa vravīmyahaṃ ||
saṃjīdbhratṛkā'nyekā tādṛgevevamṛta priyā |
<96b>
dāsī veśyā tathā'rūḍhā praśastācottarottaraṃ | ajātavatsā yuvatī tāsvādyai ca praśasyate ||
kadācijjātavatsāpi sā sarva sadṛśā matā | abhāve pūrvapūrvāyāḥ parāgrāhyā hi sādhakaiḥ ||
sādhikāyāstu kaulāyā evameva pumānapi | na sādhakaṃ vinānāryo napuṃsaḥ sādhikā mṛta ||
mantrāḥ siddhyanti deveśi kalpakoṭi śatairapi | parastrī saṃgamo sadyopasūvā prāṇimāraṇaṃ ||
svārthaṃ cennarakāyai vavyarthaṃ sukṛtāya hi | ko heturna vijānāmi devī prīkarā ime ||
na pāpa janakaṃ yadvatadyarthaṃ paśughātanaṃ | na kilkiṣastadvat parastrī saṃgamādikaḥ ||
arśathaktīnāṃ jāti viśeṣaḥ ||
<97a>
naṭīkāpālinī veśyā rajakīnāṃ pitāṃganā | brāhmaṇī śūdrakanyā ca tathā gopāla kanyakā ||
mālākārasya kanyā ca navakanyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | nānyūnāṃgyonādhikāṃgyo na sthūlānādhikaṃ kṛśā ||
ra cchinnanāsāṃgulikā na dīrghā na ca vāmanā | na muṇḍitā na kubjāñca mūḍhāndhavadhirā na ca ||
na kekarā nakhaṃjāśca bhinna yonigaṃlatkucā | vālāpatyāśca vityatyo na kāryāḥ śaktayastvimāḥ ||
vadāmi yogyāṃ sādhikyāṃ yābhistuṣpatikālikā | gaurāṃgī yuvatī ramyā smerāssa cāruvigrahā ||
viśālalolanayanā pīnonnata payodharā | viśālajaghanā bhogā valitraya virājitā ||
supāśvetanu madhyā ca susvarākuṃcitā latā |
<97b>
vicitra veśābharaṇā vicitrāmvara dhāriṇī | vicitramrakasamākīrṇa vicitra rati dāyikā ||
sadā prasannavadanā devyā bhakti parāyaṇā | kaulikācaraṇajñā ca sādhake bhakti tatparā ||
bhayahīnāsmeramukhī sarvadā priye vādinī | samayācāra saṃpannā mantrajñā bhayavarjitā ||
vidagdhyā coprasutācca dhairyasvātantryasaṃyutā | evaṃ guṇasamāyuktāḥ pūjayet sarvayoṣitaḥ ||
atha vidyā viśeṣa śakti viśeṣamāha ||
gandharūpā jāti bhedairmahāvidyā prakīrtitāḥ | tatkramāṃ devadeveśi śṛṇu yatnena sāmprataṃ ||
rūpa gandha krameṇaiva nāmadadyān maheśvari | mātṛpitṛ kṛtaṃ nāma tyaktvāyajñānapārvati ||
<98a>
svayaṃ nāma pradadyāvvai yathā yogena pārvapi | yā kṛṣṇā nīlakṛṣṇā bhāmadhupiṃgala locanā ||
sādhakā kāṃkṣi hṛdayā puṃgandhā niṃdya gandhikā | tasyāṃ kālī samāyojyā sā kālī parikīrtitā || 1 ||
madyagandhā tu yā nārī rakta netrāti niṣṭurā | mahogratārā sā proktā mahāpāpa vināśinī || 2 ||
sarvadā bhojanā śaktā vahubhojyāti caṃcalā | trailokyā mohanākārā cchinnā vidyā prakīrtitā || 3 ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktā nānāgandhasamākulā | sundarī cārukeśī ca dīrghanetrā manoharā ||
nānā vilāśa kuśalā kulaśāstra vicāraṇī | guruvaktraḥ sthalā krāntā madhyāvinaladarśinī ||
sundarī sā bhavedgaurī sarvakāryā pravartinī || 4 ||
<98b>
yāsā tṛtīyā gaurāṃgī madhugandhānulepanā | tripurā nāma sā devī svapuṣpa kramasādhinī || 5 ||
cārvagī cāruṇetrā ca kaṃja padmāsana sthitā | pītābharaṇabhūṣāṃgī kamalā parikīrtitā || 6 ||
guṃjāhāra vibhūṣāḍhyā śyāmā caṃcala locana | cāruhāsā tu mātaṃgī vidyā khyātā maheśvari || 7 ||
divyavarṇāṃ kṛśāṃgī ca divyagandhānulepanā | bhuvaneśī mayā proktā nānābharaṇabhūṣitā || 8 ||
piṃganetrā piṃgakeśā kiściduccāti hāsinī | dhūmāvatī ca sā proktā siddhi vidyāṃ śṛṇu priyet || 9 ||
lambavaktrā ca lamboṣṭhī pītavarṇati niścalā | vagalā yā maheśāni kīrtitā tava suvrate ||
<99a>
daśavidyādumākhyātā śaktirūpeṇa pārvati | daśavidyā maheśāni mātṛstrī bhaginī kramāt ||
krīḍanti śatataṃ devi vidyā eva na saṃśayaḥ | daśa kramo maheśāni daśavidyā suyatnataḥ ||
sarvathā kārayed devi nānyathā yugakoṭibhiḥ | na hi siddyanti deveśi daśapadma japena vai ||
tasmāt sarva prayatnena svasvavidyā kramaṃ caret | ātmīyā ca parā caiva śaktimātraṃ maheśvari ||
mantrādhi devatā buddhyā pūjā sarvopacārakaiḥ | vividhaiḥ phalatāmbūlairvastrālaṃkālahemabhiḥ ||
saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā vahu hetuṃ pradāpayet | saṃbhoga vāsanāṃ dhṛtvā yaḥ kuryācchakti pūjanaṃ ||
sadāridryamavāpnoti nārakī ca bhaveddhruvaṃ |
<99b>
vahubhiḥ kiṃ varojālaiḥ samāsāt samapyaṃ śṛṇu | nirdiśyate śakti pūjā kaulikānāṃ dine dine ||
pratyehaṃ ca sūrādānaṃ tatsvīkārotvahaṃ tathā | nityatoktastayoddevi kulamārgārateṣu ca ||
heyā heya vivahe (ro hi) tathā | viralaḥ śaktiṣu priye | anukalpa pradātṛṇāmapi nityanvameva hi ||
vihāya garhitāḥ śakti yogyā eva hi gṛhyate | itareṣāṃ śakti pūjā kāmyā naimittikī tathā ||
samādhiṣṭhita cittānāmitarāsāṃ nirākṛtiḥ | vidhānaikaṃlayedānīṃ mantrānapi ca pārvati ||
snātāṃ divyāṃvara dharāṃ nānāraṃkāramaṇḍitāṃ | yuvatīṃ pīnavakṣojāṃ tathā cākṛti bhojanāṃ ||
haste gṛhītvā vāmaurau sthāpayecchaktimuttamaṃ |
<100a>
aśakta vāmovoḍhuttāṃ devyāvāmethavāsane | vāmabhāge samālikhya trikoṇaṃ padmavartulaṃ ||
śvetaraktasamāyuktaṃ nālaṃ siṃdūla carcitaṃ | sādhakaḥ prāṅmukho bhūtvā devīṃ pratyaṅmupūjayet ||
uḍḍiyānaṃ tu tretāyāṃ kṛte pūrṇagiriṃ yajet | jālandharaṃ dvāpareṣu kāmapīṭhaṃ kalauyuge ||
tāni catvāri vakṣyāmi guhyādguhya tarāni ca | śakteḥ sarva śarīraṃ yat pīṭhaṃ pūrṇagiraṃ mataṃ ||
tasyāḥ śiraścandrabhāge udyānaṃ kīrtitaṃ mayā | stanau jālaṃdharaṃ proktaṃ kāmapīṭhaṃ bhagaṃ smṛtaṃ ||
prāṇāyāma trayaṃ kṛtvā ṛṣyādi nyāsamācaret | ṛṣyādiṃ ca caredādau tataḥ śodhanamācaret ||
ṛṣyādi kaṇṭhaścidāniṃ etasya suravandinī |
<100b>
śrīśaktipūjanasyāsyagonarddha ṛṣirīritaḥ | vikṛtiścchanda ākhyātaṃ śaktirūpāpadādanu ||
mahākālī devatā ca kāmo bījamudāhṛtaṃ | śaktirvadhū bhauvaṇeśī kīlakaṃ samudāhṛtaṃ ||
śivaśaktisāmarasya prakāśe viniyogatā | saṃsargā paṃcadīrghāḍhyairvadhūbījaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgakaṃ ||
vidhāyātmani śaktyaṃge nyāsaṃ vācyamathācaret | strīvecchakti padasthāne bhairaveti padaṃ vadet ||
yoṣidyoni padasthāne syālliṃga padakalpanā | gurupadeśataścāpi svabuddhyā cāsureśvari ||
ūhaḥ sarvatra kartavyo liṃge tat tat padepi ca | samānaḥ kintu gāyatryāṃ sāsamāno bhayatra hi ||
<101a>
nyāsoddhāramidānityaṃ sāvadhānā niśāmaya | trayākāmoramārāvo yoginī roṣayoṣitau ||
ḍākinī pralayohāraḥ phetkārī karṇikāpi ca | preto nṛsiṃhakulikaṃ cicchuktiḥ sarvaśeṣagā ||
ekaikaṃ parato dadyād bījaṃ nāmnāṃ surārcite | tānpathādaulikī ca bhagamālinyanantaraṃ ||
rati priyātathānaṃgo'kulā samaya pālinī | madanotmādinī kāmā veśinī tadanantaraṃ ||
cintonmāthinyapi tato mohanyā karṣaṇī tathā | smarā tarānaṃga bhūpā hṛtpramo divyanantaraṃ ||
santāpinī tataḥ saṃkṣobhinī ca tridaśārcito | sarvaśeṣe parijñeyā sāmarasya svarūpiṇī ||
etāḥ ṣoḍaśa vai kāryā ṅentāḥ pūrvāṇasaṃyutāḥ |
<101b>
strīkatve puliṃgā bhairavārcana karmaṇi | namaḥ śeṣeṣu sarveṣu sthānāni kalayādhunā ||
śiraḥ kapolyai ca galaḥ skandhau vakṣaḥ kucau tathā | pārśve kukṣi ca nābhiśca vastirvakṣuṇa eva ca ||
ūrūjānū ca jaṃghe ca pādau yoniśca śeṣagā | jīva nyāsa vade tasyāḥ sāmarasya mathācaret ||
ete deveti saṃproktaṃ śaktiśodhanamīśvari | kṛtvā prahastantu karaṃ datvā tu hṛdanojayoḥ ||
kāmapīṭhethavā devi nābhau maulīyakī mate | manuṃ gṛṇanvakṣyamānaṃ vāraikaṃ vā trivārakaṃ ||
jīvanyāsātmakamidaṃ śakti śodhanamācaret | anena śuddhyate śaktirnānyathā mantra koṭibhiḥ ||
māyākāmovadhūrlakṣmīḥ kūrca prāsāda eva ca |
<102a>
śākinī ḍākinī cāpi bījābhānyaṣṭau puraḥ smaret | bhogānanda kalādokti jīvātma paramātmakaḥ ||
pratibimbā dvaita saṃjñā kātmyanālayā'bhidhān | daśakūṭākanmān procya brahma tadviparītakaṃ ||
dvayaṃ daśānta uccāryamevamaddhārddha sammitaṃ | tato mamānu hṛdaya tavānu hṛdayaṃ vadet ||
dadhā tu mama vācyuktvā te vācaṃ samūdīrayet | matendriyeṣu tadanu pravadekamalānane ||
tendriyāṇi ca saṃbhāṣya mama vācaṃ juhusva ca | tataḥ siddhikarālīti tvāṃ mahyaṃ nipunakuca ||
yevatvaṃca sa evāhaṃ ya evāhamitīrayet | saivatvaṃ sandhināyuktamubhau tadanukīrtayet ||
śivaśakti samārabhyamāpannau tadanantaraṃ |
<102b>
tadaikyamiti saṃkīrtya sādhayā ca itīrayet | sa sandhistāra hṛcchīrṣa mantrastadanu sundari ||
ayaṃ mantraḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ śaktiśodhanakarmaṇi | aṣṭottara śatārṇaḍhyo nanyūnonāpi cādhikaḥ ||
dhyānaṃ pūrvoditaṃ yat te bhagavatyā mayā tava | śaktiṃ tādṛśākārāṃ dhyāyedvīkṣyāṃgasaṃcayaṃ ||
bhairava dhyānasadṛśamātmānaṃ ca vibhāvayet | tataḥ āvāhayed devīṃ śaktyaṃgapīṭhasaṃnibhe ||
vakṣyamānena mantreṇa sādhakoṃjali mudrayā | māyākāmavadhūrāva kamalāyoginīruṣaḥ ||
ḍākinī cāpi phetkārī navaitānyādigāna hi | ehyehi bhagavatyuktvā mahākāli samīrayet ||
śaktipīṭhenusānnidhyāmāveśayasamuddharet |
<103a>
tatastvamahamūllikhyā vāhayāmi ca kīrtayet | sarvaśakti samābhāṣya svarūpiṇi tato vadet ||
tāraṃ pratiṣṭa śīrṣaṃ ca śaktimūla manuṃ śṛṇu | māyārāvaḥ smaro nārī śaktaye hṛdayet tataḥ ||
mantro navākṣaraḥ proktaḥ śaktipūjana karmaṇi | ṛṣyādi nāsti caitasya na chando bījaśaktayaḥ ||
bindupādyādi naivedya sarvopacārāgharpaṇa hetukaḥ | japtavyo naiva cāyaṃ hi tripuraghna vacodyathā ||
sarvopacārānye tena pradadyāt kintu śaktayet | pādyadānāni naivedya dānanta yadyadiṣyate ||
na cānya mantro bhinnosti manmateja gadīśvari | kūrcate yat tu mauleyā tadamūlaṃ vibhāvyatāṃ ||
<103b>
śakti pūjā vaśiṣṭaṃ yat puṣpasraganulepanaṃ | yadātmane dīyatematmāmarasyārcanaṃ bhavet ||
tadamantraṃ prakartavyamevamīśānaśāśanaṃ | tato datvā karaṃśakti yoni pīṭhe japaṃ caret ||
sādhakaḥ śakti gāyatryā śatamarddhārddhameva ca | yonipīṭha japaprakhyo na japa kvāpi vidyate ||
satyaprabhāvajanako mantrāṇāṃ pīṭha uttamaḥ | mantrāṇāṃ valahīnānāṃ prayogakṣīṇa cetasāṃ ||
anuddhṛtānāṃ sāpebhyo nyūnādhikyārṇatā juṣāṃ | gurumiṣṭānāmapi ce pradāno naujasāntathā ||
ajñānavidhi pūjānāma pātrārpaṇabhāgināṃ | tyaktānāṃ vismitānāṃ ca tathā caivā prabhāvināṃ ||
sandhūkṣaṇārthamubhayaṃ proktaṃ tripura vairiṇāṃ | ekaṃ nirvāṇamantreṇa saṃpuṭīkṛtya tajjapaṃ ||
<104a>
kaulāsanenāparaṃ ca yoni pīṭhe japa kriyā | kaulāsanaṃ yoni pīṭhejaḥ strībhyo manugrahaḥ ||
gurustrī śaktitā cāpi miśrībhūpa japed dvayoḥ | anyaiḥ samindhanaṃ mantrairvajādhikyakaraṃ paraṃ ||
athāta śakti gāyatrī śṛṇu devi mahāphalaṃ | kāmabījodbhagavatīṃ ṅentāṃ purata īrayet ||
vidmahe yoni mālinyai dhīmahīti tataḥ paraṃ | tannaḥ śaktiriti procya sarvaśeṣe pracodayāt ||
eṣā hi śakti gāyatrī sarvāgama sugopitā | etānvinā naśaktyāccāna śaktyaccīṃgiko japaḥ ||
yathāśakti yapitvaināṃ tatsamarpya ca śaktaye | vāmorāvupaveśyaiva kuryān mūla japaṃ priyet ||
<104b>
pūjayen madanāgāraṃ raktacandana carcite | bhāgatadīye vijñeyā nāḍyastisraḥ pravāhikāḥ ||
ekottarā hi kā cāndrī saurī cānyātu vāhikā | āgneyī cāparā jñeyā pūjayet tastu sādhakaḥ ||
astra śravati cāndrī sā puṣpaṃ śravati bhānavī | bījaṃ śravati cāgneyī tāstu nāmabhirarcayet ||
vāgbhavādyairnamo yuktaiḥ pūjayet suprasannadhīḥ | dhyānaṃ kuryān maheśāni gahva cekā karānane ||
tāmracūḍāśisvāraṃ gajavaktrasamaprabhaṃ | tatrasthāṃ cintayed devi vidyāṃ bhuvanamohinīṃ ||
bhagamālāmantrastu ||
vāgbhavaṃgaśadvānte bhage bhagini cālikhet | bhagodarī bhagāketu bhagamāle bhagāvahe ||
bhagaguhye bhagaprānte yoniprānte bhagāntake |
<105a>
niprātini ca sarvānte tato bhagavatiśari ||
bhagarūpe tato lekhyaṃ nīrajāyatalocane | nitya klinne bhagaprānte sarūpe sarva cālikhet ||
bhagāvimehyā namonte varadetha samālikhet | ratesvarate bhagavat klinne klinne drave tataḥ ||
kredaya drāvaya cātha sarvasatvān bhageśvarī | amoghe bhagavicce cakṣubhaḥ kṣobhaya sarva ca ||
satvān bhageśvarī brūyād vāgbhavaṃ brūjamādikaṃ | bhaṃ vluṃ mauṁ vlūṁ ca haiṁ krinne ca tataḥ paraṃ ||
sarvāṇi ca bhagānyante meva śaṃcānayeti ca | strībījañca hare prānte valamātmakamakṣaraṃ ||
bhuvanaśīṃ samālikhya vidyayaṃ bhagamālinī | caturthyante yajed devi bhage puṣpaṃ viniḥkṣipet ||
<105b>
prakṣālyakuladravyeṇa gandhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet | dhūpadīpādikaṃ kṛtvā paścādāvaraṇaṃ yajet ||
ihāpyāvāhanaṃ nāsti jīva nyāso maheśvari | athaivaṃ ca vidhānena tāḥ ṣoḍaśopacārakaiḥ ||
iṣṭadevīṃ prapūjyātha sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | arcayed gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ svaśivantadanantaraṃ ||
atha nyāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi śivātmānaṃ vibhāvayet | paṃcavaktraṃ mahādevaṃ kalāyuktaṃ nyet kramāt ||
īśānassarvavidyānāṃ śaśinī prathamā kalā | īśvarassarvabhūtānāṃ maṃgadā tadanantaraṃ ||
brahmādhipati śabdānte brahmaṇodhipatiḥ punaḥ | brahmeṣṭadāśivomastu marīci saṃpuṭaṃ nyaset ||
sadāśivoṃ samurccārya muṃṇḍamālinyathā parā |
<106a>
tatpuruṣāya vidmahe kalāntiritiritā | mahādeya dhīmahī kalāvidyā tathaiva ca ||
tannorudraḥ padaṃ paścāt pratiṣṭhā kathitā kalāḥ | pracodayāt samuccārya nivṛrti syāt tataḥ paraṃ ||
pūrvapaścima yāmyeṣu uttareṣvapyanukramāt | hṛdaye vinyased devi aghorebhyaḥ stamaḥ kalā ||
atha ghorebhyo mohāṃ ca grīvāyāṃ vināset tataḥ | ghorānte syāt kriyā paścād dakṣiṇaṃśe pravinyaset tataḥ ||
ghorānte syāt kriyā paścād dakṣiṇāṃśa pravinyaset | namastestu kṣudhāṃ paścā kalāṃ pṛṣṭhe nyase kramāt ||
bhudrarūpebhya ityante tṛṣāntāra namontakāḥ | vāmadevāya namonterajā syādguhya deśake ||
<106b>
mukhasavye pravinyasya rakṣyā jyeṣṭhāya vai namaḥ | rudrāya namoratiṃ paścād vāmamuṣakalāmimāṃ ||
kālāya nama ityante pālinī uru dakṣiṇe | kalakāmā ca deveśi vāme vikaraṇāya ca ||
namaḥ padaṃ samuccārya saṃyamanīndakṣajānuni | valakriyā samuddiṣṭā vāme vikaraṇāya ca ||
namonte vṛddhimuccārya dakṣiṇe sphitri vinyaset | valapramathanāya namo rātriṃ vāme pravinyaset ||
sarvabhūtadamanāya namo'nte brahmaṇā kalā | kaṭi deśa pravinyasya manānte mohinī kalāṃ ||
dakṣiṇe pārśvake nyasya unmanāya namo jvalāṃ | pādayostananāsāsumūrddhninivāhu yuge nyaset ||
<107a>
sadyojātodbhavā samyagaṣṭau mantrī kalā kramāt | sadyojātaṃ pravakṣyāmi siddhiḥ syāt prathamo kalā ||
sadyojātoye vai bhūyo namaḥ syādṛddhirīritā | bhavedyutistṛtīyāsmādabhavetadanantaraṃ ||
lakṣmīścaturthī kathitā tato nāti bhavai padaṃ | medhākhyā paṃcamī proktā kalā bhūyo bhavasvatāṃ ||
prajñāsamīritā ṣaṣṭhī bhavāntya syāt prabhā kalā | udbhavāya namaḥ paścāt suddhā syādaṣṭamī kalā ||
praṇavādyāścaturthyantā namontāśca pravinyaset | evaṃ nyāsavidhiṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ śaivaṃ vibhāvayet ||
paṃcākṣaraṃ puraskṛtya rudradhyāna parāyaṇaḥ | sāmarasya mayaṃ kṛtvā rakṣārthaṃ kavacaṃ pathet ||
vadhvā tu kṣobhinīṃ mudryaṃ na kālikāntarpayet sadā |
<107b>
sānnidhyāntatkṣaṇādvāpi (* * * * * * * *?) | (* * * * * *?) nāśca tarpaṇaṃ caṇadāmṛtaiḥ ||
gurūṇāṃ sādhakānāñca sarveṣāṃ tarpaṇaṃ caret | tenāmṛta na divyena sarve tuṣṭā bhavanti ca ||
yatkāmaṃ kurute mantrī tatkṣaṇādeva siddhyati | kulāmṛtaṃ samādāya tatrārgha niḥkṣiped budhaḥ ||
tataḥ somakalāḥ pūjyāḥ sādhakainirmalāśayaḥ | madhubhāṇḍasahasraistu māṃśabhāraśatairapi ||
naiva tuṣṭā bhaved devi bhagaliṃgāmṛtādṛte | kuladravyañca saṃśodhya śivaśakti mayaṃ priye ||
jīvāmṛtaṃ paraṃ brahma rūpaṃ nikṣipya sundarī | arghapātrāmṛtaiyuṣṇā nirvikalpaḥ sadānaghaḥ ||
argha dravyaśca deveśi yonau devīṃ prapūjayet |

<109a>
yoni pūjāṃ vinā pūjyā kṛtā cāpya kṛtā bhavet | dūtī yoge kṛte mantrī sarvajñā jāyate dhruvaṃ ||
na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭi śatairapi | yaiḥ kṛtaṃ yajanaṃ dūtyāsteriṣṭāḥ kratavokhilāḥ ||
sarvatīrtha mayoḥ proktaḥ sarvadeva mayo bhavet | puraścaryādi sakalaṃ kṛtaṃ tena saṃśayaḥ ||
aśvamedha sahasrāṇi vājapeya śatāni ca | āsamudrāśca dharaṇī tata tena sa dakṣiṇāḥ ||
merumandara tulyāṇi suvarṇanyarpitāni vaiḥ | go koṭidānādyat puṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ jāyate priye ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dūtīyāgaṃ samācaret | pūjāsaṃpūrṇadaṃ bhadre sarvāriṣṭa prakāśakaṃ ||
yoni pūjā yutā pūjā kṛtāmapyakṣayā bhavet |
<109b>
āyurārogyavibhavā namitān labhate naraḥ | anenaiva vidhānena viṣārtonnirviṣo bhavet ||
putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanaṃ | mātaṃgī śaktimatyarcyataṃpāsākaṃ samarcayet ||
mātaṃgī manmathopetāṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye | śaktyā sākaṃ sadā pūjyā mātaṃgī mantra devatā ||
sā devī śakti hīnā tu na dadāti manorathaṃ | pūrṇābhiṣeka rahito ya śaktiṃ sādhayen naraḥ ||
sodhamaḥ patito rogī paṃcatvaṃ labhate dhruvaṃ | indriyāṇāmadhṛṣyatvāt kāmalobhā sambhavāt ||
prāyaḥ kalo kaulikoyaṃ paṃthānaraka hetave | uttamā nitya pūjā syān madhyamaṃ parvapūjanaṃ ||
māsapūjādhamāproktā māsādūrddhapaśurbhavet |
<110a>
māse vātha trimāse vā ṣaṇmāse vatsaret pivā | śrīguruṃ pūjayed bhaktyā prāpnotatstrī sutādikān ||
tadabhāve tatkulīnaṃ tacchiṣyaṃ vā yoginaṃ | saṃtoṣayet kuladravyaiścakra pūjā puraḥsaraṃ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgama ekonaviṃśatitama paṭalaḥ] || 19 ||
atha cakrasya viśeṣācāramāha ||
ucchiṣṭo na spṛśeccakraṃ kulaṃ dravya tathā guruṃ | vahi pakṣālpa ca karau kuladravyāṇi dāpayet ||
madyabhāṇḍaṃ samuddhṛtya na pātraṃ paripūrayet | bhogapātraṃ surākumbhaṃ niḥkṣipenna kadācana ||
cakramadhye śuci dhiyā karāsyakṣāladikaṃ | yaḥ karoti hi mūḍhātmā sa bhavedāpadāṃ padaṃ ||
niṣṭhīvanaṃ malaṃ mūtramadhovāyavisarjanaṃ | śrīcakramadhye yaḥ kuryāt sa bhaved yoginī paśuḥ ||
<110b>
cakra madhyedyatebhiṇya pātre vāsuvalite tathā | dīpanāśe rājapīḍā tacchāntyai cakrapūjanaṃ ||
parihāsaṃ pralāpaṃ ca viḍaṃvaṃ vahubhāṣaṇaṃ | kṣaudāsīnyaṃ bhayaṃ krodhaṃ cakramadhye vivarjayet ||
pātra hastaścakramadhye na bhramet pūrṇa pātrakaṃ | viraṃ na sthāpayeddhaste nālayet pātrapāṇikaḥ ||
pādābhyāṃ na spṛśet pātraṃ na casbhaṃ?dyāt kadācana | naiva hastena dātavyaṃ na binduṃ pātayedadhaḥ ||
pātraṃ na cālaye sthānānna mudrā varjite pibet | sa śabdena pibet madyaṃ na kuryāt pātrasaṃkaraṃ ||
pātrasyāṃ śabdayaṃ madya pūrṇaṃ tryaśaṃturīyakaṃ | nānā nyānyaṃ tāḍayet pātraṃ na pātraṃ tāḍayedadhaḥ ||
sādhāre noddhi pradaṃ || 1 ||

<112a>
sarvāmnāya kalākalāpakalitaṃ kautuhala dyotakaṃ candropendraśambhuvaruṇa brahmādibhi sevitaṃ | dhyātaṃ deva gaṇai mokṣārthibhiḥ sarvadā lokānāmati varddhanaṃ sukhakaraṃ pātraṃ dvitīyaṃ namaḥ || 2 ||
madyaṃ māṃsakamatsyakaṃ harihara brahmādibhiḥ pūritaṃ mudrāmaithuna dharmasukhadaṃ kṣārāmlatiktāśrayaṃ | ācāryārcitamaṣṭabhairava kalānyāsena saṃsodhipāyāt pañcamakārasaṃyutamidaṃ pātraṃ tṛtīyaṃ namaḥ || 3 ||
āvirbhūta sa golakuṇḍasukhadaṃ brahmādi rudrārcitaṃ nīrājyaṃ prathamo gajāta kusumaṃ divyādhi kūṭaṃ paraiḥ | macchocchāmamuttamottamarasaṃsaṃsyavyādivyāmṛtaṃ bhūyaḥ paṃcakamukti kāmakamidaṃpācaturthaṃ mude || 4 ||
<112b>
ādhāre bhujagādhirājavalaye pātraṃ mahī maṇḍalaṃ madyaṃ saptasamudravāri piśitaṃ cāṣṭau ca digdantinaḥ | sohaṃ bhairavamarcayan pratidinaṃ tārāgaṇairakṣitaṃ āditya pramukhaiḥ surāsuragaṇairājñā karaiḥ kiṃ karaiḥ || 5 ||
cchatraṃ cāmara bhadrapīṭha paramānandāyitaṃ dāyinaṃ rāmārājya manoharasukharaṃsāyujya sāmājyadaṃ | nānāvyādhi bhavāndhakāra haraṇaṃ janmāntaraṃ nāśanaṃ śrīmatsundari tarpaṇendra varadaṃ pātraṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhajet || 6 ||
jāgrat svapna suṣupti turyapurato caitanya sākṣāt pradaṃ vidyudbhāskara vahni candra dhanuṣajātiḥ kathābhāṣitaṃ | iḍāpiṃgalamadhye gātrivalayā satkuṇḍalī corddha pātraṃ saptamapūraṇena tanunānandodhikaḥ pātumāṃ || 7 ||
<113a>
khaḍgaṃ pādukamaṃjanaṃ ca guṭikaṃ sārasvataṃ sāsvataṃ satpadaṃ mṛtyorvaṃcanamugrakārya grahanaṃ deha sthiraḥ kāraṇaṃ | pāyāt siddhikaraṃ manaḥ sthirakaraṃ vaśyaṃ jagaghoṣitāṃ pātraṃ cāṣṭa mamaṣṭasiddhikaraṇaṃ prauḍha prasannaṃ sadā || 8 ||
sarvānanda karaṃ sadā śivapade dvadvaika muktipradaṃ sāmrājyaṃ sukhadaṃ manoratha karaṃtva jñānavidhvaṃsanaṃ | āyuḥ kīrtiyaśovivarddhanakaraṃ saṃsāramohacchidaṃ pātraṃ śrī navanāthaśakti navakaṃ prauḍha pratīpāditaṃ || 9 ||
tripātraṃ paṃca pātraṃ vā sapta pātramathāpi vā | nava pātraṃ pibed vāpi ṣoḍaśārddhaṃ pibena hi ||
yāvanna carate dṛṣṭiryāvanna carate manaḥ |
<113b>
tāvatpānaṃ prakūrvīta paśupānamataḥ paraṃ ||
pūrṇābhiṣeka yuktānāṃ pānande vinigadyate | karābhyāṃ pātramuddhṛtya smaranmūlañca pādukāṃ ||
āgalāntaṃ pibenmadyaṃ samuktāṃ nātrasaṃśayaḥ | pītvā pītvā punaḥ pītvā yāvat patati bhūtale ||
utthāya ca punaḥ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate | ānandā bhṛyyate devīmūcchayā bhairavaḥ svayaṃ ||
vamanāḥtsarvadevāsu tasmāntritayamācaret | brahmajñānī kulācāre surāpītvā skhalanmuhuḥ ||
bhūmau patati tasyāṃge khaganti yadi reṇuvaḥ | tāvat kāraṃ reṇu saṃkhyaṃ brahmaloke samodate ||
pītvā pītvā japitvā ca muktaḥ koṭi kulaiḥ saha | brahmaloke vased devi satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
<114a>
tatraiva vyāptim āpnoti na punaḥ prapatedviha | pītvā ca pūjayitvaiśāmīśatvaṃ labhate dhruvaṃ ||
tatraiva layamāpnoti punarnaiva nivartate | tatra matteṣu vīreṣu kāryākāryaṃ na vidyate ||
tatra yadyat kṛtaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā śubhaṃ | tatsarvaṃ devatā prītyai jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
jalpojapaphalaṃ tandrā samādhirabhidhīyate | vikriyā pūjanaṃ proktaṃ ccharddigaṃ bhairavo valiḥ ||
muktiḥ smācchaktisaṃyoga stotraṃ tatkārabhāṣaṇaṃ | nyāso vayava saṃsparśo bhojanaṃ havana kriyā ||
dhyānaṃ tu vīkṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ śayanaṃ vaṃdanaṃ bhavet | tadullāsakṛtānāṃ ca yā ceṣṭā sā ca satkriyā ||
kāryā kārya vicārantu yaḥ karoti sa pātakī |
<114b>
etaccakra gatā vīrā vijñayāḥ parayoginaḥ ||
yenāpnuvanti manujāḥ sākṣād bhairavarūpatāṃ | saṃmodakopaśamanaṃ patanoṭtāna nartanaṃ ||
veṇuvīṇādi vādyaṃ ca kavitā racanādikaṃ | nodanaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ pātaḥ samutthānaṃ vijṛmbhavaṃ ||
gamanaṃ vikriyā devi yoga ityabhidhīyate | vikṛtiṃ manaso hitvā ye pāllāsaḥ pravartate ||
tadā tu devatā bhāvaṃ bhajante yogi puṃgavāḥ | kaulikāmbhairavā vaiśānyā cānindaṃti mūḍhadhīḥ ||
tannāśayaṃbhyasaṃdeho yoginyo nātrasaṃśayaḥ | yadyadvaktimadāveśādūdbhutaṃ kaulikaujanaḥ ||
tattadbhavasyasaṃdigdhaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā śubhaṃ | tāro namo bhagavati madyamāṃsavihāriṇi ||
<115a>
rati priye cakra devi vada kaulika vallabhe | satyaṃ mano gataṃ madya tyuktvā madyaṃ palānvitaṃ ||
pradadyāt kaulike bhyastastanmatāḥ pravruvantite | tatra kaścida kaulañcannasāsphuraṃti bhāratī ||
nandindenna haset kupyeccakre madhu madākulān | etaccakra gatāṃ vartā vahirnaiva prakāśayet ||
tebhyo drohaṃ na kurvīta nāhitaṃ ca samācaret | bhaktyā saṃkṣayet tānvai gopayecca prayatnataḥ ||
cakre ca pramadāṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayed devatādhiyā | modate vandate bhaktyā sa gacchedyoginī padaṃ ||
pravṛtte bhairavī cakre sarvavarṇā pṛthak pṛthak | striyotha puruṣaḥ ṣaṇḍāścāṇḍālo cādvijottamaḥ ||
cakra madhye na bhedosti sarve deva samāḥ smṛtāḥ |
<115b>
cakramadhye gatāḥ sarve puruṣā śivarūpiṇaḥ | striyaḥ sarvāśca pārvatyastasmād bhedaṃ na kārayet ||
kāmuko na striyaṃ gacchedanichantīmadīkṣitāṃ | sadyaḥ saṃskārasaṃśuddhāṃ vihitatvādvrajet striyaṃ ||
sahasra cakra pūjātorājya bhraṣṭo nṛpo bhavet | paṃcāśadbhiśca putraptirnirogo daśabhirbhavet ||
yasya cakrasya pūjāyāṃ ratāskhālati cāṃganā | avaśyaṃ sārvabhaumosau varṣamadhye bhaviṣyati ||
yathepsita priyā prāptyai paṃcadhā pūjanaṃ caret | saptabhiḥ syāddhana prāptiścakra pūjā vidhistvayaṃ ||
bhaginī vā sutāṃ bhāryāṃ yo dadyāt kulayogine | madhumattāya cakrānte tasya puṇyaṃ na gaṇyate ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgame viṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 20 ||
<116a>
atha naimittikamāha ||
śrīmahākāla uvāca ||
etāvānnitya pūjāyā vidhirukto mayā tava | naimittikāni kāmyāni sāṃpratatvaṃ niśāmaya ||
nimittaṃ kiṃciduddiśya yadā yāti sureśvari | tannaimittikamuddiṣṭaṃ nityavat tadapi priyaṃ ||
kāmanāṃ kāmapi svīyāṃ citte kṛtvā pravartate | tatkāmyamiti niddiṣṭaṃ kāmanāphala sādhakaṃ ||
tatrāpi prathamaṃ vakṣye karmanaimittikaṃ śive | naimittikā śrapi prāyo vijñeyaṃ nityavadbudhaiḥ ||
yastu naimirtikīṃ pūjāṃ nimittatvairūpasthitāṃ | kurute nitya pūjā ca dajñānaparivṛṃhita ||
tasmāt pāpataraiḥ ko vā kālikā dveṣa bhājanaṃ |
<116b>
aṃgahānyāpi nityasya na hāni rūpakalpyate | naimittikasyādgahā niḥphalahāniḥ prajāyate ||
tasmāt sāṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ śrāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā gurukramaiḥ | aṃgānikāni viccāsyāḥ pātrādhikyaṃ śivāvaliḥ ||
paṃcāyatenarītiśca mantrapārthakyameva ca | pūjā valiḥ paśu valiḥ pūjāyā kramameva ca ||
dhūpadīpādi saṃbhāraṃḥ śaktipūjā japodaśaḥ | nitya pūjāsusaṃtyeva yadyapyeteṣu kecanaḥ ||
syānnitsa naimittikayo bhirnnārībhistathāpi hi | saradvāsantikī pūjā tathā caivoparāgikī ||
nimittatvenābhyūpetā tena naimittikī matā | etayoraṇanuṣṭānājjāyatena ca nityatā ||
nānā taṃtroditāḥ santi pradhānaṃntatra tanmatāṃ |
<117a>
evaṃ sarvatra boddhavyaṃ sarveśvevanittiṣu | śuddhā naimittikā pūjā proktā viṃśati bhedikā ||
parvāni ca mahāpretā vyatīpātaḥ sa vaidhṛtaḥ | manvādayo yugādyāśca vedāṃgaṃ devatā bhavaṃ ||
