puṣpāñcara vivārāñca trigurūṇāṃ svakīyakaṃ | janmāhaścāpi dīkṣāyā divasaṃ navarātrake ||
candrasūryo parāgau ca sūtasaṃskāra eva ca | tīrthayātrābhigamanaṃ tathā cāgamanantaraṃ ||
pīṭhe pīṭhagame puṇya lābhe home vratotsave | utpātānāṃ darśanaṃ ca bandhamokṣo ripūnnatiḥ ||
rogeṣvāpatsūdoṣeṣu duḥsaṃge durnimittake | grahapīḍārājabhayaṃ śāntiratyudayaṃttathā ||
evaṃ nānā prakāreṇa nimittānīritāni te |
<117b>
damanāropanaṃ nāma pavitrārohaṇantathā | antarbhavanti kṛtyeṣu tithī nāme ca pārvati ||
tithi parvāṇi kathyante yeṣu naimittikārcanaṃ |
atha kulavārādi nirṇayaḥ ||
kulavāle kulāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | yoginī pūjanaṃ tatra pradhānaṃ kulapūjanaṃ ||
raviścaṃdro guruḥ sauriścatvārastva kulā matāḥ | bhaumaśukrau kulākhyau tu budhavāraḥ kulākulaḥ ||
dvitīyā daśamī ṣaṣṭhī kulākulamudāhṛtaṃ | kulānisamadhicchyāni taccheṣānya kulāni tu ||
aṣṭamī navamī caiva tathā caiva caturdaśī | ubhayoḥ pakṣayoretā pūrṇimā darśa eva ca ||
saṃkrāmādvādaśa tathā catvārasteṣvapīritāḥ |
<118a>
ayane dve dve viṣuve ṣaḍaśīti catuṣṭayaṃ ||
catuṣkaṃ viṣuvatyāśca naite pūrva samā priye | ścādyeścarāṇāṃ catvāro dvibhūpāṇāntataḥ paraṃ ||
tataḥ sthirāṇāṃ tāvanto yeṣāṃ puṇyodayaḥ śubhaḥ | vyatīpāto vaidhṛtī ca tithīnāṃ kṣaya eva ca ||
catasropi yugādyāstāmahāpuṇyaphalapradāḥ | śuklā tṛtīyārādhī pātādṛgūrjanavamyati ||
bhrādrī trayodaśī kṛṣṇā tāpasā darśa eva ca | śuklā saptamī kṛṣṇā ravivāreṇa saṃyutā ||
aṣṭamī saumyasahitā daśamī guruṇāpi ca | ṣaṣṭhī bhārgavasaṃyuktā śaninā ca trayodaśī ||
vaiśākhī saptamī śuklā jyeṣṭhī yā ca caturthyapi | jyeṣṭhasya śuklā ṣaṣṭhī ca daśamī gurunāpi ca ||
<118b>
śrāvaṇī pañcamī kṛṣṇā śuklāpaṃcamyapi priye | dvitīyā tithimārabhya tithi syād yāvadaṣṭamī ||
śuklapakṣe tu bhādrasya tithayaḥ saptapuṇyadāḥ | sāmānyetāṣṭamītvena parvatve pratyupasthito ||
durgāṣṭamī viśeṣeṇa durgāprīti pradā tithiḥ | durvāṅkurāropaṇākhyaṃ mauleyā atra kurvate ||
arabhyevāṣṭamī kṛṣṇāṃ yāvat syād daśamīsitā | aṣṭādaśemāstithayo devī prītikarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
tisro viśeṣataḥ puṇyāḥ saptamādyāvarānane | sarvai nivartyate yāsuśāradīyo mahotsavaḥ ||
trayodaśyādayastiprastithayaḥ kārtikasya tu | kṛṣṇapakṣe varārohe syuranantaphala pradāḥ ||
<119a>
phale trayodaśī nāmnā'ghorākhyā caturdaśī | darśe tu sukharātryākhyā athavā dīpamālikā ||
pratipradvāhule yā ca sitātasyāṃ yajecchivāṃ | śuklāṣṭamī tu goṣṭhākhyā sā bhūrimukṛta pradā ||
yugādyā navamī proktā tasyāṃ jāgarti kālikā | atastu pūjāvistāraḥ kāryāstasyāmviśeṣataḥ ||
atha tithinirṇayaḥ ||
tithīnāṃ nirṇayaṃ vacmi sukṣmāṃtāṃ na tu vistarāt | naimirtikīṣu pūjāsu tithayo yānirūpitāḥ ||
grāhyāniśītha vyāpinyaḥ pakṣayorubhayorapi | praśastamarddharātraṃ hi bhagavatyarcyane mudā ||
yogoniśīthena yadā tithīnāṃ naiva jāyate | tadā vivekaḥ kartartho dvayoreva hi pakṣayoḥ ||
<119b>
yāsūdito raviḥ śukle tithaya vihitāṃ | kṛṣṇayā svastamāyāti sāmānyoyanvidhirmataḥ ||
muhurtamātrādadhikāyā tithiḥ śuklayokṣikī | sā snāna dāna pūjādau vihitatvena gṛhyate ||
nyūnāmuhurta mātrādvā muhurtenamitāpitā | tithiḥ kālamatatyena sā na grāhyā kadācana ||
yāvatī yā tithistiṣṭettāvatyāṃ tadurīritā | kriyāratya samāptavyā tattatkarmopayoginī ||
kṛṣṇapyevaṃ yadā sā tu tithiḥ kālena yujyate | tadā tadvihitaṃ karma kāryaṃ rātrau dinepi vā ||
niśītha yogā bhāve tu pakṣayorubhayorapi | pūjādikaṃ tu kartavyāṃ pūrvāhnenāparāhnataḥ ||
devānāmiha pūrvāhne madhyāhne tu tṛṇāṃ bhavet |
<120a>
aparāhnaḥ pitṛṇāṃ syāḥ devaṃ dharmavinirṇayaḥ | tithi dvedha vicārāya madhunā vai virupyate ||
ditadvayopi cellanyā pūrvāhna vyāpinī tithiḥ | parāviddhye pūrvaviddho tithyā naivādyatā kvacit ||
caturthī sahitā kāryā tṛtīyāṃtadvitīya yā | caturthī pūrvaviddhai ca kartarvyārcana vāsare ||
paṃcamyāṃ sahitāṃ kurvana sadyo naśru sānvayaḥ | caturthyā sahitā kāryā sarvadā kālikārcane ||
saptamyā sahitā ṣaṣṭhī prasastā sarvakarmasu | ṣaṣṭhī viddho prakartavyā saptammanmatra vāsare ||
natvāśvine tu śāradyāṃ pūjāyāṃ jagadīśvariḥ | pakṣadvayopyaṣṭhamī tu vidhātavyā parānvitā ||
<120b>
aṣṭamyā sahitā kāryā navamī puṇyadā tithi | navamyā daśamī viddhā sarvasaukhya karī matā ||
naikādaśī daśā viddhā kartavyā bhūtimicchatā | naikādaśī dvādaśī ca na dvādaśyāṃ trayodasī ||
caturdaśī prakartavyā trayodaśyā samanvitā | amāparayutā kāryā caturdaśyā na yojitā ||
iti devyarcana vidhau tithi kartavyateritā ||
atha vīrarātryādi nirṇayaḥ ||
devyuvāca ||
deveśa śrotumicchāmi vīrarātryādi nirṇayaṃ | vīrarātri mahārātriḥ kālalātristathaiva ca ||
moharātrirghorarātriḥ krodharātristathaiva ca | śivarātri divyarātri dāruṇā ca yathā kramāt ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
kathyate parameśāni śṛṇu sā vahitodbhava |
<121a>
caturdaśī saṃkramaśca kulakuṃkulāvāsaraḥ | arddharātrau yathāyogā vīrarātriḥ prakīrtitā ||
śuklāṣṭamī cāśvinasya navarātraṃ tu tasya vai | mahārātrirmaheśāni kālarātri śṛṇu priye ||
dīpotsava caturdaśyāṃ tvamāyā yoga eva ca | kālarātrirmaheśāni tārākālī priyaṃkarī ||
janmāṣṭamī maheśāni moharātriḥ prakīrtitā | māsi mārga śire prāpte kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ maheśvari ||
mahākālaḥ svarūpāya ghorarātriḥ prakīrtitāḥ | caitramāsi navamyāṃ ca śuklapakṣe ca bhūsute ||
krodharātri maheśāni tārā rūpā bhaviṣyati | prāpte phālguṇake māsi kṛṣṇaikādaśikā tu yā ||
bhṛgubhaumayutā cet syādavalārātrirīritā |
<121b>
jyeṣṭhīyā daśamī śuklā daśayogasamanvitā ||
amā bhaumasamāyuktā saṃkrameṇa samanvitā | kula ṛkṣasamāyuktā grahaṇaṃ yadi cedbhavet ||
tārā tristusaṃproktaṃ bhāgyādeva tu labhyate | phālguṇe kṛṣṇapakṣe tu tyarddharātrau bhṛgau śiva ||
śivarātristu saṃjātā sarvasiddhi pradāyinī | jyeṣṭhī yā daśamye śuklā bhṛguvāsurasaṃyutā ||
daśayogasamāyuktā rātrāvekādaśī yadi | sā tithirdivyarātriśca kīrtitā parameśvari ||
tṛtīyā mādhave śuklā kulacālakṣasaṃyutā | dārūṇā kīrtitā devi sarvasiddhiśvarī parā ||
atha cāndrādi māsaḥ parigrāhyā śaucādauvasureśvari | rāśikrameṇa yā māsau vivāhādau sahi smṛtaḥ ||
<122a>
ṛṇādāna prayogena śrāvanaśyādhvanādiṣu | śāntike pauṣṭike vāpi nākṣatro māsa īṣyate ||
indrāgnyerāhutiryatra dīyate suravandite | māsasyādiḥ sa vijñeyo vratāraṃbhādi karmaṇi ||
bhomāgnīṣo mayoryatra māsamadhyaka ucyate | pitṛṇāmāṅka karma yadā nirvahati priye ||
anto māsasya vijñeyaḥ pratimāsamiyaṃ kriyā | naimirtikārcane kālāḥ prātarmadhyāhnasaṃgavāḥ ||
pradoṣarātrī vigheśara viviktīśaśaktijāḥ | vihitaṃ kālamūlaṃghya yā kāci kriyate kriyā ||
tayā kiṃcit phalamapi jāyate suravandite | vittarāśastathā yāsau bhavatītyāhurāgamāḥ ||
<122b>
tasmāt kāle prakartavyaṃ karmasvargā phalārthibhiḥ | yathākālaṃ yathāśraddhā yathādravyaṃ yathocitaṃ ||
yathāvalaṃ yathā deśaṃ tathā pūjāṃ samācaret | naimittika mahākṛtyaścaḥ kartavye sureśvari ||
ekavāraṃ haviṣyānnaṃ bhuṃjīta vijitendriyaḥ | malīmaśāṃśubhyāsaṃkṣaura karmadharoṣitāṃ ||
mūrtipīṭhādi saṃsṛṣṭiṃ tat prāsāde vilepanaṃ | pūjāpātrā hi saṃśuddhintatoddravyairviśeṣataḥ ||
naimittika kriyāyāṃ hi ṣaḍetāni samācaret | dhūmoṅgāre dantarakte sūtake ca galadvaṇe ||
pūjāpūrvaṃ maithunaṃ ca strīdvijā krośane tathā | naimittikaṃ na kurvīta kurvannaivāpnuyāt phalaṃ ||
kaulācārarataḥ sarvān yoṣitaścā kulādhvagāḥ |
<123a>
nimantrayīta yatnena sarvaiṣāṃ prathamaṃ guruṃ ||
naivedya dhūpadīpānāṃ kuryād yatnena saṃbhṛtiṃ | viśeṣataśca puṣpānāṃ mālyānāṃ ca varānane ||
rajanyāṃ divase vāpi vihitārcana saṃbhutiḥ | kata nitya kriyodarbha pāṇiḥ śrutiranyadhīḥ ||
apanīya sunādīna gandhādīn sthāpayet punaḥ | pūrvavat sarvapātrāṇi prakṣālya ca sureśvari ||
mṛdvāsane sukhāsīno yathā vibhava kalpite | prācuryaṃ vakulānāṃ ca vaiśākhe māsi kārayet ||
nāgakeśarapuṣpānāṃ jyeṣṭhamāsi samācaret | bhūrīṣṭatā vidhātavyā vaṃdhūkasyāśvine punaḥ ||
agastya kusumānāṃ hi bhūritāmūrja ācaret | ādhikya viśvapatrāṇāṃ mārgaśīrṣe samācaret ||
pauṣe durvāṅkurāṇāṃ hi saṃdohoti phala pradaḥ |
<123b>
kaundastomau maghamāse sarvakalyāṇadāyakaḥ | phālguṇe mādhavī puṣpaṃ sarvasiddhi pradāyakaṃ ||
caitre'śokasya kalikā kalikāra vināśinī | mālatī yūthikā caiva damanaṃ karṇikārakaṃ ||
kuruṇṭhakaṃ kuruvakamamlānaṃ pātalāntathā | navamālirka puṣpaṃ (*) tathā caivāti muktidaṃ ||
ekādaśaitāni sadā kusumāni varānane | māghasya vātha pauṣasya kaśorkeṇa yuto yadi ||
vyatī pātaśravaṇa bhayoṣādarddho vayo bhavet | yugādyā koṭibhistulyā vijñeyā sā mahātithiḥ ||
antaphala pradantatra ca valiṃ datvā vidhānataḥ | dhanadhānya sutān prāpya dehānte mokṣamāpnuyāt ||
māgha śuklā tṛtīyā ca varanāmnābhidhīyate |
<124a>
atrārcitā kālikā hi kanyābhyo varamṛcchalā ||
kārasya kanyā ca kuṃbhakārasya kanyathā | kanyāṣṭakamidaṃ proktaṃ kulāṣṭamathā śṛṇu ||
rājaveśyā guptaveśyā devadeśyā vilāsinī | nṛtyapātrī tīrthaveśyā kuṭinīvyabhicāriṇī ||
paṃcaliṃga hatāveśyā daśaliṃgā bhageśvarī | pañcaviṃśati liṃgā ca liṃgaṃ tuṣṭāḥ prakīrtitā ||
paṃcāśaliṃgasaṃyuktā liṃgasiddhāḥ prakīrtitā | śataliṃgā bhagānandā sahasrābhagasundarī ||
asaṃkhyā liṃgasaṃyuktā bhagabrahma parāmatā | kulāṣṭakamathedānīṃ śṛṇu pārvati tatvataḥ ||
madhye liṃgā maheśāni bhagamājā mahottamā |
viśvaliṃgā sarvayoni sarvasmādapi cottamā |
<124b>
kulākulāṣṭake devi dvividha parikīrtite | rājaveśyādikā yugmaṃ gopayaśca yathādikaṃ ||
mātrā pūtrī tathā pautrī svasāravaistuṣātuyā | kālike keli kuṃcī ca bhātṛjā tathāṣṭamī ||
kulāṣṭakamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ pradāyakaṃ | taruṇīṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ caṃcalāṃ kāmalolupāṃ ||
guru bhaktā mantrayuktāṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāṃ | īdṛgvidhāṃ samānīya prasūna tulikopari ||
kucau tu kalaśau proktaṃ sāmānyārghyantu nābhikā | bhagadhvajai viṣaiśāghyau trikoṇaṃ yantramīritaṃ ||
gamāgamā vṛttiruktā puṣpaprahasitaṃ smṛtaṃ | ālāyastu tapaḥ proktaṃ nvavalokavaraḥ smṛtaḥ ||
krodhastu nigrahaḥ prokte karagrāho bhayaṃ bhavet |
<125a>
tasyāḥ pādapramārastu pṛthivyāstu pradakṣiṇā ||
cuṃvanaṃ stotra pāṭhotra kucadhārastu sat kriyāḥ | galapādasya nikṣepaḥ siṃhāsanamitīritaṃ ||
viparītaṃ dolikākhyā pūjā proktā maheśvari | visarjanaṃ vījapāto mudrātvā liṃganaṃ bhavet ||
kṣauṣṭasaṃcuṃvanaṃ devi khecarī yoga īritāḥ | kapolacuṃvanaṃ devi guṭikā parikīrtitā ||
lalāṭe cumvanaṃ devi pādukāparikīrtitā | netrasaṃcumvanaṃ devi aṃjanaṃ parikīrtitaṃ ||
karasaṃcuṃvanaṃ devi khaḍgasiddhiḥ prakīrtitā | yonisaṃcuvanaṃ devi manoratha mayī śatiḥ ||
jihvā pradānaṃ deveśi kālavaṃcanamīritaṃ |
<125b>
rasasaṃlelinaṃ devi brahmarūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
ālocane pṛthivyāstu devatā darśanaṃ bhavet | tatsaṃginā sadābhāvyaṃ tāmālokya japet sadā ||
koṭi brahmāṇḍadānādi ekataṃ parikīrtitaṃ | tasyāśvalokanaṃ devi sarvaśreṣṭataraṃ bhavet ||
tapaḥ syāt koṭitīrtheṣu yogānāmapi koṭayaḥ | devālayānāmabhyaṃ kṛtaṃ yena niraṃtaraṃ ||
tenedaṃ prāpyate devi darśanaṃ viṃdurūpiṇaḥ | brahmaṇo darśanaṃ devi śabdabrahma mahattaraṃ ||
caṃdrāmṛtaṃrāhu bhītyā tathā svargāmṛtaṃ piyat | rākṣasānāṃ tu saṃbhītyā kṣoṣṭe yonau virājite ||
caṃdrāmṛtaṃ cādharoṣṭhe yonau svargāmṛtaṃ priye | sadā tiṣṭhati deveśi jñānāssidhyati nānyathā ||
ajñārādviṣarūpaṃ syānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
<126a>
mukhe hālākare mālā yoniśālā ca cakṣuṣi | hudayestrī karālātu dīpamālā gṛhāṃgaṇe ||
na karoti paraṃ yastu sa kathaṃ mama pūjakaḥ | saṃyogo gṛhenaṃ devi mahākalpāṃtatopi ca ||
sūryagraho yathā yoge viparīte niśākare | tayāyeducyate vākyaṃ tad deva kāraye priye ||
tadā yoge samālabdhe yoge yadācana | puruṣasya na jāto hi tena saḥ krīḍate muhuḥ ||
grastāsta sa tu vijñeya sarvaścottamottamaḥ | svayaṃ yoge samālabdhe svasya pūrvaṃ tu sa cyutiḥ ||
tayā kāryaṃ samācaryaṃ tasyāḥ pāto na jāyate | grastodayaḥ sa vijñeyāḥ sarvasiddhi pradāyakaḥ ||
<126b>
idaṃ rahasyaṃ yatproktaṃ divāyogaṃ śṛṇu priye | svastha krameṇaiva tasya tasyāsnārddho dayodbha mataḥ ||
mahodayaḥ svayoge syādvārtādaśaharaḥ smṛtaḥ | tadvārtākṣapyarūpākhyāstṛtīyaḥ parīkīrtitaḥ ||
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu pārvati | māsa dvādasakaṃ devi krameṇa parikīrtitaṃ ||
śatayoge maheśāni mahāsāmrājyamīritaṃ | divyādīnāmiti proktaṃ daśūnā śṛṇu cāparaṃ ||
rājyaṃ śṛṇu maheśāni sūryacandra kramādvicā | darśavā pūrṇimāyāmvā rāhusūryaniśā karau ||
saṃcchrādayati deveśi brahmaṇo varadānataḥ | bhūmicchāyānugaścandraḥ candraśorka kadācana ||
ekarāsāvekabhecāyadātobhyāṃ nilasvayaṃ |
<127a>
sati yoge saptame vārākādarśāvasānataḥ | tato parāpago bhavati koṭi puṇyaphalapradaḥ ||
sūrya bhedatrayaṃ devi candre bheda trayaṃ tathā | sūryoparāgograttāstastathāgrastodayaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
caṃdrepi bheda tritayaṃ śāktovapi tridhā tridhā | sārddha dvayaṃ gurottaraṃ grastatvaṃ parikīrtite ||
snāne jape tathā home dāne śrāddhoṃvikārcane | samahān puṇyakālo hi vijñātavyaḥ sureśvari ||
ahorātropitaḥ pūrvaṃ grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | japitvābhyarcya vā devī dānadatvā tathaiva ca ||
kṛtvā śrārddhaṃ vidhānena sarvapāpai pramucyate | yadyat karotitate kāle tasyā dakṣayaṃ hi tat ||
dhanadopyatra puṇyena modane brahmaṇā saha | bhāskarasya ca caṃdrasya grahaṇe pratyūpasthite ||
<127b>
āpaḥ kaupyāpi deveśi gaṃgājalasamāḥ smṛtāḥ | tasyācchataguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ sārasaṃ salilaṃ śuci ||
tasmāt sahasasraguṇitaṃ nādeyaṃ parikīrtitaṃ | tasmāt koṭi guṇaṃ jñeyaṃ gāṃgeyaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat ||
snānāt sahasraguṇito homo jñeyo vicakṣaṇaiḥ | homācchataguṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ śrāddhācchataguṇā japaḥ ||
japāt sahasraguṇitaṃ dānamāhurmaṇīṣiṇaḥ | dānātkoṭiguṇā pūjā bhagavatyā viśiṣyate ||
tatra naimirtikī pūjā kāryātityā kadāpi na | pūrvedyurupavāse tu pūjākoṭi guṇā bhavet ||
upoṣaṇasyā sāmarthye pūjā lakṣaguṇā matāṃ | caṃdrākkau tamasāgrastau dṛddhaivārcāṃsamārabhet ||
adṛṣṭe tu grahe devi sarvaviphalamīritaṃ |
<128a>
na tatra pratyayāt svasya pratyayo devakarmaṇi | snāne dāne jape home śrāddhercāryāṃ pratigrahaṃ ||
darśanā nantaraṃ dṛṇāṃmadhikāro na cānyathā | antardṛṣṭe tu grahe devi madhyagrāse maheśvari ||
meghācchanne muktihīne snānadānādikaṃ caret | japamātraṃ vidhātavyaṃ madhyagrāse tu sūryake ||
grastodayaṃ samārabhya grastāste parameśvari | śāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā samālokya snānadānādikaṃ caret ||
kadālagnaṃ kadāmukti sarvajñātvā prayatnataḥ | snānadānādikaṃ kāryaṃ nānyathā śāṃkaraṃ vaca ||
svarāśito varārohe triṣaṣṭhyaikādaśe grahe | sadoṣe paśyatorāhumiti tatrāpadoṣatā ||
yataḥ phalānāṃ vāhulyaṃ doṣāṇamalpanā tathā |
<128b>
jāyate taḥ prakartavyamavaśyaṃ rāhu darśanaṃ | nāḍībhāṣṭamacandrādi doṣāṇāmapanuttaye ||
kiṃcid dānaṃ prakartavyaṃ tat tad vighnopaśāntaye | uddhṛttāye mayā proktāḥ kālī mantrāḥ śucistite ||
teṣāmekopyakavāraṃ japtaśvedrāhu darśane | pāpāni nāśayetyevaṃ koṭi janmakṛtānyapi ||
ṣoḍaśārṇaṃ saptadaśīmekavāraṃ ya uccaret | saptadvīpāvatī pṛthvī dānasya phalamaśrute ||
tasmād viśeṣataḥ kāryo japaḥ pūjā samanvitaḥ | puraścaraṇa mantraiva gauṇaṃ kurvi kecana ||
karmaikaṃ kāryametasmāntate pūjādhikāriṇaḥ | āvaśyakatayātaistu prakartavyamupoṣaṇaṃ ||
pūjākartanamukhyantatkṛte tu phalabhūritā | yāmatrayaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ candra (*) haṇapūrvataḥ ||
<129a>
sūryagrahaṇataḥ pūrvaṃ praharāṇāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ | rāhunirmuktamarūṇaṃ tathaiva rajanī karaṃ ||
dṛṣṭvaiva bhojanaṃ kuryādanyathā nārakī bhavet | grastāstau ca dubhausmātāmathavācanimīlitai ||
divārātramupoṣaiva tato'gnīyādyathā kramaṃ | atra kecidapīcchaṃti bhavaśāstra vimohitāḥ ||
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta grastāste parameśvari | śāstra darśastu saṃdarśaḥ pratyakṣe pūrṇarūpatā ||
divyānāmapi deveśi aṃgula dvayato bhavet | upavāsaṃ trirātraṃ tu śaivānīṃ parikīrtitaṃ ||
viṣṇugāṇapasaurāṇāṃ dvirātraṃ parikīrtitaṃ | śāktānāṃ pūrvarātraṃ tu puraścaryā yuto bhavet ||
puraścaṇa hīnānāṃ pūrvametatanmayā tava |
<129b>
cāṃdre svāyaṃbhuve devi dvirātraṃ parikīrtitaṃ | nopavāsaṃ prakurvīta jīvaputro hi kacihite ||
naimittikaṃ dvayaṃ yatra tatrālpaṃ kāmyavācakaṃ | avidhāya naroyastu vimuktasnānamīśvari ||
bhukte sa kevalaṃ madyaṃ bhukte viśva sa kevalaṃ | śrāddhakṛddhoma kṛdvāsi dānakṛjjapakṛcca vā ||
nivartita prātyaṣikaḥ kalākāṃkṣī sthito bhavet | grahaṃ dṛṣṭvāśu ca snātvā martatkama samācaret ||
āśaucaṃ janmamaraṇaṃ janitaṃ cet prajāyate | na kāmyāśrārddha dānārcāḥ kevalaṃ snānamācaret ||
sūtakadvaya yuktopi yo mūrkho vā snāti na grahe | sadyaḥ samṛtyumāpnoti snāyī pāpānna viṃdati ||
japedāna tathā home śrāddha caiva surārcane |
<130a>
asau ca doṣaḥ sarvatra na tu snāne sureśvari | māsayorbhādra nabhasoḥ saritaḥ syurajasvarāḥ ||
candrasūryagrahe prāpte rajo doṣo na vidyate | snātvā puṇyedake tīrthe śuciḥ pūrvemapoṣita ||
sparśādvimukti paryantaṃ japenmantramananyadhī | anantaraṃ daśāṃśena kramāddhomādikaṃ caret ||
atha vāmahatīṃ pūjāṃ kuryād dānaṃ tathaiva ca | mūlamantrasya siddhyarthaṃ gurū yatnena toṣayet ||
evaṃ ca mantrasiddhiḥ syāta devatā ca prasīdati | tat tirthe viśeṣasyāta tathaiva ca phaleṣvapi ||
snānādau tena kartavyaṃ tīrthābhigamanaṃ priye | gaṃgā phalasamānyusyuḥ sarvāṇyamasibhūtale ||
tathāpi tat tat tithānāṃ viśeṣaḥ kopi kathyate |
<130b>
daśajanma kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gaṃgāsnānena naśyati | triṃśajjanma kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gaṃgāyamunāsaṃgame ||
śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame | janmanāṃ tu sahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ samupārjitaṃ ||
kṛtvā sūryagrahe snānaṃ tanmuṃrati mahodadhau | janmanāṃti yute naiva yatkiṃcinnṛbhirarjitaṃ ||
vārāṇasyāṃ grahe nāmnāttadāścaiva vyapohati | naraikhyāpaṃ kṛtaṃ yadyajjanmanāṃ koṭikoṭibhiḥ ||
tatsarvaṃ sannihatyāyāṃ rāhugraste niśācare | nāśayet snānamātreṇa satyaṃ satyaṃ sureśvari ||
sūryagrahaḥ sūryavāre some somagrahastathā | cūḍāmaṇiriti khyātastadā yogo mahāphalaḥ ||
sarvebhyo devi dānabhyo dvedāneti mahatphale | bhūmerathasuvarṇasya varṇādbhūmiḥ praśasyate ||
<131a>
pūjāyāmapi deveśi parivāragaṇārcanāt | ṣoḍaśadvādaśāṣṭāṃbdā kulapūjā prasasyate ||
tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ niścitaṃ bindu pūjanaṃ | candrasūryagrahe vāpi yantrasthāpanamācaret ||
yaṃtrasaṃsthāpanaṃ karmaṃ candrasūrya grahe śive | tadyantrasthā devatā tu sadgrasrāvaradāyinī ||
candrasūrya grahe devi yadyatkarma karoti ca | tattadakṣayamāyāti vidyārājñā prasādataḥ ||
candrasūryoparāge tu merusādhanamācaret | duṣṭamantropi deveśi krameṇa sidhyati dhruvaṃ ||
tārāpiṃḍa grahe prāpte tathā sūrya grahepi ca | japādikaṃ vidhātavyaṃ śakti pūjāṃ tataścaret ||
sarvasiddhiśvaro bhūyān nātrakāryā vicāraṇā | ṛtu snātāṃ striyaṃ jñātvā sūryacandragrahāntare ||
<131b>
patipārvaṇamāsādya piṃḍaṃ tasmai pradāpayet | vaṃdhyā putra prado yogaḥ sarvasiddhi pradāyakaḥ ||
sūryoparāge deveśi snātvā pūjāṃ samācaret | sāṃgāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ pūjya savalyantaṃ maheśvari ||
kumārī pūjanaṃ kṛtvā sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet | candrarpya grahe devi śatasaṃkhyāṃ kumārikāṃ ||
pūjyasiddhiśvaro bhūyān nātrakāryā vicāraṇā | sūryagrahe maheśāni kāmyahomaṃ caran śivaḥ ||
tarpaṇaṃ kurute yastu tasya śrīsarvato mukhī | mārjanaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ sarvaduḥkha praśāntaye ||
sūryagrahe samāyāte paradhiryadi vai bhavet | parabhṛdvābhidho yogaḥ sarvasāmrājyadāyakaḥ ||
tārāpiṃḍe parāge tu guruṃ saṃpūjya devatāṃ |
<132a>
saṃtoṣya tadvaro grāhyaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet ||
tārāpiṃḍāgrahe prokte śavamānīyasādhakaḥ | śavāsane japed devi grāsādudgrāsataḥ śive ||
sarvasiddhiśvaro bhūyāt tadvante śivatāṃ vrajet | sūryoparāge deveśi śuddhāṃtaḥ karaṇo yadi ||
snātvā yathokta vidhinā saṃpūjya jagadaṃvikāṃ | śiraḥ puṣpaḥ kartayitvā devatāyai nivedayet ||
devatā paśyati śive varadāna parādhruvaṃ | sūryoparāge saṃprāpte snātvā proktena vartmanāṃ ||
śaktimānīya tadgrātre nyāsajālaṃ pravinyaset | madyaimāṃsaistathā matsyai bhagaliṃgāmṛtairapi ||
devatāṃ tatra saṃpūjya sāṃgāṃsāvaṇāṃ śive | tatra jihvāṃ pradatvā tu japāt traikālyaccidbhavet ||
<132b>
atītā nāgatajñāne vartamānaṃ ca paśyati | sūryagrahe maheśāni veśyāmānīya sādaraṃ ||
śaktiṃ liṃgoparisthāpya japed yatnena pārvati | trailokya vijayī bhūtvā nātrakāryāvicāraṇā ||
anukalpa pradātṛṇāṃ dvijānāṃ śrāddhameva ca | kaulānāmapi sarveṣāṃ vimuktānāṃ maheśvari ||
pātrāṇāṃ svagrahaṇaṃ sastaṃ grahaṃ madhye kadācana | iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaḥ grahaṇasya vinirṇayaḥ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgame ekaviṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 21 ||
atha yantrabheda ||
jāvajjīvaṃ suvarṇe syād raupya dvāviṃśati priye | tāmre dvādaśakaṃ varṣaṃ tadarddhaṃ bhūrja patrake ||
tāmre dvādaśa varṣāṇi dhāraṇena tu pūjane | tāmrārghye tāmra yantre ca devatā sarvadā sthitā ||
saṃskṛtya pūjayed devi sphaṭikādau tu sarvadā |
<133a>
tāmre lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ raupya koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet | sauvarṇe'nanta phalakaṃ maṇyādau kiṃ vadāmi te ||
atha yantrā dhyānamāha ||
devyuvāca ||
pūrvasaṃsūcitaṃ nātha yantradhyānaṃ tvayā prabho | kathaṃ dhyeyaṃ kiṃ viśiṣṭaṃ kiṃ dhyeyādhyayameva hi ||
vṛttaṃ mūrti svarūpaṃ vā mekhalāvasvarūpakaṃ | kiṃ vārekhā mayaṃ dhyāyaṃ kiṃ vā vai bhūsvarūpakaṃ ||
viśvarūpaṃ smaredvāpi tatsarvamapi kathyatāṃ |
īśvara uvāca ||
dhyānantu trividhaṃ proktaṃ yantre mātre maheśvari | ādau virādviśvarūpaṃdviśvacandra svarūpiṇaṃ ||
yantraṃ saṃbhāvayed devi sarvatra kathitaṃ svidaṃ | śrīcakrādau mahādevi viradrūpe tu sāmyatā ||
dvitīyaṃ ca kathaṃ dhyāyaṃ tanme vada maheśvari |
<133b>
rajaḥ puṃjanibhārekhā sarvacaitanya rūpiṇī | sarvadarpaṇavadbhāvyaṃ svaprakāśasvarūpiṇaṃ ||
caitanyaṃ bhāvavayatsarvaṃ viṃdvādiṃ bhūpurāttakaṃ | mūlatejaḥ prakāśena abhinnaṃ bhāvayet priye ||
tṛtīyaṃ śṛṇu deveśi meru rūpaṃ samātanaṃ | uttarottaramuccaṃ syāt vidvārabhyavibhāvayet ||
dviṃdvadho bhāvayed devi ekaikottarata śive | na cottarakrameṇaiva bhāvayed vā maheśvari ||
kālī vidyā vidhau devi navaratna svarūpiṇīṃ | rekhāṃ saṃbhāvayed devi meru prastāra vacca vā ||
śrīcakraṃ vījasaṃyuktaṃ niḥphalaṃ parameśvari | bījahīnantu yaccakraṃ nirbījaṃ siddhidaṃ na hi ||
sṛṣṭi cakraṃ bhavedādau sthiti cakraṃ dvitīyakaṃ | laya cakraṃ tṛtīyasyā tridhā cakraṃ vibheditaṃ ||
<134a>
bījasaṃlekharaṃ devi tridhātra gaditaṃ mayā | bījaṃ vinā tu nirjīvaṃ śavavat parikīrtitaṃ ||
bījayuktaṃ bhaved yantraṃ niḥśapta siddhidāyakaṃ | bījābhāve mātṛkārṇat saṃlikhe bindu bhūṣitān ||
yantra madhye tu saṃlikhya tadyantraṃ pūjaye cchive | dalākārantu yad yantraṃ tadyantraṃ siddhidāyakaṃ ||
dalākāraṃ kalau pūjyanānyathā siddhidaṃ śive | mantracaitanyakaṃ devi yaṃtra caitanyakaṃ devi svasmin tritaya bhāvanā ||
na tatra dhyānarūpādi tejo yantraṃ vibhāvanā | saprapaṃce tu saṃsāre dūrācārā vṛta śive ||
bhāvenaiva tu saṃproktā bhāvanā siddhidā matā |
atha kaulikā deviśeṣamāha ||
devyuvāca ||
deveśa śrotumicchāmi rahasyāti rahasyakaṃ | vāmināṃ caiva kaurānāṃ yantrasaṃskāra karmā ca ||
<134b>
śiva uvāca ||
athocyate mahāyantra saṃskāraḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ | śubhehnisnānamācarya śubhe lagne śubhakṣaṇe ||
kṛta nitya kṛto mantrī prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ | pūrvokta dhātu dravyaiśca sundaraṃ sumanoharaṃ ||
surekhaṃ śubhadaṃ yantraṃ lekhayitvā vidhānataḥ | pratiṣṭhāṃ ca tataḥ kuryād yathāśāstra pramānataḥ ||
śubhe lagne puṇyakāle śailādi vihita sthale | maṃtrī kalpānusāre tu pūrvadyuradhivāsayet ||
sāyaṃ saṃkalpa vidhivat ghatasthāpanaḥ pūrvakaṃ | gaṇeśādīn samabhyarca dikpālāṃ paripūjayet ||
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā matsyaṃ mudrāmaithunameva ca | yantrasaṃskāra karmādau dravyametanmayeritaṃ ||
yathāśaktyāpacārādyai pūjanaṃ mūla devatāṃ |
<135a>
sugaṃdhatailagandhādyai dravyaistamadhivāsayet ||
candretyādi ca mantreṇa japaghoṣapurasmaraṃ | ityādidhivāsitaṃ kṛtvā saṃyato vijitendriyaḥ ||
prātarnityaṃ vidhāyādau tato yāgasthale viśet | patakādhvajasaṃkīrṇaṃ divyamaṇḍalamaṇḍite ||
vitānacāmaracchatra puṣpamālā virājite | maṃgalāṃkura patrādyai kalaśaiparibhūṣite ||
maṇḍalaṃ sarvato bhadre rekhā sāhasrasaṃyutaṃ | sāmānya bhadraṃ vā devi vedyāścoparito likhet ||
athavā dakṣiṇe vāme vakṣye vāruṇamaṇḍalaṃ | caturasraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭhikoṣṭhaṃ vidyāṃ niveśayet ||
antyo yānti mahatyāstu dikṣu koṣṭhānimārjayet | madhyestha caturakṣīṇi tadvārākhyāni pūrvavat ||
<135b>
pītaśyāmaśvetaharidrajobhiḥ paripūjayet | koṇakoṣṭhaṃ vihāyaika paṃcāśat pādasaṃgitā ||
pīṭhasya pāṇḍurārakta pītakṛṣṇaḥ prapūjayet | āgne pītaḥ koṇakoṣṭhānyā raktaharimāsitaiḥ ||
śvetavarṇena catvāri madhye vṛttārikārayet | pūjayedatha tasyārdhaṃ vitānaṃ vandhayed yathā ||
ṣaṭtriṃśa śadaśavyā sārddha vṛttamādyaṃ tu pītataḥ | tatpītaṃ karṇikākāraṃ sitarekhā vṛtaṃ tataḥ ||
dvitīyaṃ dviguṇavyāsabhūpakeśarasaṃyutāṃ | pītaraktaśvetavarṇamūlamadhyagrakeśaraṃ ||
dvisaptatyaṃśikāścetāṃ tasyāgre kuru rekhikāṃ | tṛtīyaṃ tu tṛtīyāṃśaṃ tulyāvyāsaṃ tu vartulaṃ ||
śvetamaṣṭadalaṃ tatra raktāgraṃ taddalāṃtale |
<136a>
śvetaṃ vahiḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā prāgavad rekhāṃsitāṃ kuru | tadvahirvṛttasaṃlagnān ṣoḍaśāran prakalpayet ||
śyāmapītāruṇaścaitaistadantastu yavākṛtī | sitapītāruṇaśyāmaharitāḥ paṃcamekhikāḥ ||
kāryāḥ surūcirāṃ paṃca syāntarevaṃ prapūrayet | vajraśakti daṇḍakhaḍgapāśadhvajagadāṃ likhet ||
pūrvatastu tathaiśānyaṃ śūlacakrāṃ vrajānvitaṃ | vāmadakṣiṇayoreta maṇḍalaṃ vāruṇā dvayaṃ ||
prāṅmukho vāgyato bhūtvā saṃkalpyābhīṣṭasiddhaye | paṃcaśuddhiṃ samācarya hurvantakṣata saṃyutaṃ ||
saṃsthāpyamaṇḍale tatra yajedādhāraśaktitaḥ | pīṭhamantraṃ samāstīrya sthāpaye kalaśaṃ budhaḥ ||
dīkṣākramokta vidhinābhiṣeka kalasaṃ tathā | paṃcagavyaṃ tataḥ kuryācchivamantravivodhitaṃ ||
<136b>
tena susnāpayenmantrī yantraṃ ca praṇavaṃ japan | paṃcāmṛtena haviṣā daghnā (?) ca payasā kramāt ||
tata uddhṛttanaṃ kṛtvā jalena snāpayedapi | paṃcagavyaṃ samānīya tatra yantraṃ samāhitaḥ ||
japan kṣipet suvarṇādau vedasūtraṃ purassaraṃ | tata uddhṛtyasvarṇādi pātre saṃsthāpya mantravit ||
paṃcāmṛtena tīrthena śītalena jalena ca | sahasraśirṣāmantreṇa mūlamantrapurassaraṃ ||
susnāpya pāvanena karpūrāṃ gurunīrataḥ | sarvoṣadhi jalairgaṃdha jalairyatnena mārjanaṃ ||
tataḥ suddhadukulena jalamutsāryasādhakaḥ | paridhāyaha kulehe svarṇanirmitadolayā ||
maṇḍale taṃ sanyānīya nṛtyagītaijayasvanaiḥ |
<137a>
kuṃkumādyairvilipyāṃtha pūjyasarvopacārakaiḥ | pīṭhapūjāṃ tataḥ kuryāt svasvakalpoktamāmataḥ ||
kuśaiḥ kulīnairvā devi śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet | pūrvoktāṃ yantra gāyatrīṃ japtvā devatvamāpnuyāt ||
atheṣṭa devatāṃ dhyātvā mudrayā vāhayet tataḥ | jīva nyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāt pūjayed diṣṭa daivatā ||
nṛtyagītaiśvavāditraiḥ paṃcaghoṣa puraḥsaraṃ | tato japediṣṭamantramaṣṭottara sahasrakaṃ ||
kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile mantrī haviṣā saṃskṛtele | yathāvidhividhānena śrucāhomaṃ samācaret ||
grāsapramānaṃ ca caruṃ mūle nākṛkṣamantravit | ghṛtaśrāvaṃ tato datvā juhuyādagnisaṃmukhe ||
paṃcaviṃśati tatvaiśca tatvena tarpaṇaṃ caret |
<137b>
indrādi dikpatityaśca dadyān pūrvoditaṃ vali | tata āvṛtti devebhyo ghṛtenāhuti mācaret ||
tadaṃte devi mantreṇa hunedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | mātṛkā yukta mantre tu japaṃ jaya jayasvanaiḥ ||
gatvā homasamāṃpetu datvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ | iṣṭasiddhyai vali datvā praṇameccakramuttamaṃ ||
toṣayet svarṇavastrādyaiḥ pradadyād dakṣiṇāmapi | makāraiḥ paṃcabhīddevi vīrapūjā samācaret ||
śaktiṃ kumārikāṃ vālāṃ pūjayet paṃcapaṃcakaṃ | kuryād daśāṣṭakaṃ vāpi kuladravyaiḥ samastakaiḥ ||
trailokya nātho bhavati mantrapūjana yogataḥ | bhutaśudhyādi kṛtvā ca kalpokta nyāsamācaret ||
niśāyāṃ śaktipūjāṃ ca dūtīyāgaśca kaulikā |
<138a>
makāraiḥ paṃcabhiyuktai carvāreyuminorcanaṃ ||
evandinatrayaṃ kṛtvā tato nitya kramaṃ bhavet | sṛṣṭisthiti layetvena sundarī yantra pūjanaṃ ||
sṛṣṭisaṃhāramārgeṇa kālikāyantra pūjanaṃ | sṛṣṭisaṃhāramārgeṇa tārācchinnā ca pījabhā ||
evaṃ devī pratiṣṭhāyāṃ krama sānnidhyakārakaḥ | strīśūdrānāṃ vāmināṃ ca kaulikānāmayaṃ vidhiḥ ||
vidhi yuktaṃ prakartavyaṃ vidhihīnaṃ na kārayet | vidhihīnāsya vighnāni yānite kathayāmyahaṃ ||
kalaho dvegadvaṃdvaśca vyādhiśūlaṃ jvalaṃ tathā | rājopadravahāniśca dravyanāśaṃ rujaṃ tathā ||
cihlākākāśca kākulyo śivāphetkāra dāruṇā | kapotāśca gṛhe tasya āruhanti viśanti ca ||
<138b>
vighnaṃ kurvanti vai tasya vidhānaṃ guptasaṃsthitā | cchidranti tasya yoginyo nānā vighnaiḥ prabādhyate ||
sarpavṛścikulūtāśca kītoścaiva tu dāruṇāḥ | daśakti ca mahā ugrā preritāste marīcibhiḥ ||
vṛṣaiścāścairgajendraśca meghaircakra samanistathā | upadravaṃti duṣṭāśca jvarābhūtā dayastathā ||
lūtāgaddasāpaṃsmārā abhibhavanti nānyathā | atha mālāṃ pravakṣyāmi dvividhā sā sthira calā ||
sthirā tu sthira cittānāṃ caṃcalā calate tasāṃ | tat sādhanaṃ tridhā proktaṃ prathamāvarṇamālikā ||
dvitīyā japamālā syātṛtīyāṃguli mālikā ||
athaḥ varṇamālāmāha ||
akārādikṣakārāntairvindumanmātṛkākṣaraiḥ ||
<139a>
anuloma vilomasthaiḥ kḷptayāvarṇamālikā | ekaikaṃ varṇamuccārya varṇenāntaritaṃ manuṃ ||
sudhīre valakārāntaṃ tata āntaṃ samānayet | akārammeru rūpantu laṃghayenna kadācana ||
sakṛdevoccaret kṣantu tadante noccarenmanuṃ | meru hīnā ca yā mālā meru laṃghyā ca yā bhavet ||
aśuddhā tu bhavedatra sāmālā niḥphalā bhavet | citrīṇī visataṃ tvābhā brahmaṇādī gatā tu yā ||
tathā saṃgrathitā dhyeyā sarvakāmaphalapradā | aṣṭottaraśate japte tvādau klīvaṃ samuccaret ||
ṛ ṛ ḷ ḹ varṇe catuṣṭatya klīve pracakṣate | vargāṇāmaṣṭakaṃ vāpi kāmabheda kramena tu ||
akacaṭata payasā ityevaṃ cāṣṭavargakaṃ |
kiṃ vāmṛtatraityajaiḥ ||
<139b>
pravālaiḥmmauktikaiddevi paścimāmnāya daivatai | uttarāmnāya devānāṃ mahāśaṃkhākhyamālikā ||
urddhāmnāya svayaṃbhūsthā pātāle ratnasaṃbhavā | pravālaiḥ sūryamantrai ca mauktikai śaktimātrake ||
śivaśakti mayī mālā rudrākṣasphaṭikai yutā | rudrākṣa svarṇasaṃyuktā mālā vidhi śivātmikā ||
sarvamantreṣu rudrākṣā śaktimantre divā na hi |
tathā ca ||
śivaśaktiviyogatvānnarudrākṣairdivā japaḥ | vijoga pūjitā kālī sahisāna prasīdatī ||
rudrākṣaiḥ śakti mantraṃ tu divāyo japati priye | sa durgati mavāpnoti japantasya nirarthakaḥ ||
iti śāpaḥ purādattestatkathā kathyate śṛṇu | kadācit samaye devi dakṣayajñoparāyaṇaḥ ||
(Folio 140 not found)
<141a>
sakalāṃ ṛṣayo devā yakṣavidyādharoragāḥ | putrījāmātṛ saṃbaṃdhād gṛhenākāritā ca tā ||
mahādevaḥ satyavatī tena nākāritā vrutau | satī ca bhartṛniko uktā tatra pragamyate ||
śiva uvāca ||
mamaivakāranaṃ tena na kṛtaṃ prāṇavallabhe | tava lajjā kathaṃ nāsti tvayā tatra pragamyate ||
priyo devaḥ priyaḥ prāṇa priya eva hi bhūṣaṇaṃ | māṃ vihāya kathaṃ devi tvayā tatra pragamyate ||
pātivrattāmidaṃ kvāsti pratiyogī vihīnataḥ | tathāpi tava vāṃcchā ccheta śrīghraṃ gantu kṛpāṃ kuru ||
bharturājñāṃ gṛhītvā ca prasthitaṃ yāgamaṇḍapet | tasmiṃ he nakṣaṇānnītaṃ brahmaṇo yāgamaṃṇḍapaṃ ||
tena nādaritā kanyā duḥkhitā dīnamānasā |
<141b>
adhomukhī sthitā tatra pārvatī rūpamāvahan | sarvadevā (*?) tra santi madbhartānā ca dṛśyata ||
mahaduḥkhaṃ mama kṛte metāvṛddhṛdaya sthitaṃ | etasminantare devi dakṣa prajāpatiḥ svayaṃ ||
śivanindāparo bhūtvā punarnindārthamudyataḥ | anācāritarūpo bhūt viṣṇunā vātritopi ca ||
mahurnnindāparo bhūtvā bhṛṃgīvṛṣabhavāhanaḥ | śmaśānavāsī māṃsāśī nagnodhāratarāvirāṭ ||
kapālī ca triśūlī ca muṇḍamālā vibhūṣitaḥ | bhasmoddhūlita sarvāgo vyāghrajina samāsthitaḥ ||
lampaṭololapāśceti vahunindāparo bhavet | duḥkhitā nindayā tvāhi maṇḍapādvahirā gatā ||
dūre netrāntare gatvā vahni kuṇḍaṃ vidhāya ca |
<142a>
satītyaktvā tatra dehaṃ vahni rūpatvatāṃ gatā | śivohaṃ krodharūpeṇa jvālābhāsvaramaṇḍalaḥ ||
matkrodhena maheśāni bhasmībhūtaṃ jagatrayaṃ | marjvālayā satpanno vīrabhadro mahāvibhuḥ ||
koṭikālānta dahano duḥsahaḥ sarvajastuṣu | dakṣaprajāpateryajña dhvaṃsanārthasamudyataḥ ||
triśūla hastrī krūraśca yajñadhvaṃsa parāyaṇaḥ | śavarūpāṃ śivāṃ devi gṛhītvā skandha gocarāṃ ||
rodanaṃ cakra tustasmāt patitāścāśruvi vindavaḥ | tatra śruvindavājātā mahārudrākṣavṛkṣakāḥ ||
sthāvaratva manuprāvartyānugrahakāraṇāt | phalaṃti sarvakānetrā moraṅgīyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
madhya netrāt samutpanno mālāntī parikīrtitaḥ |
<142b>
dhunāśrīkoṣṭa daśa ca pārvatīya manurbhavet | ekaviṃśati vaktrāṃtaṃ malākī parikīrtitaḥ ||
evaṃ vaktrāṇi jānāni rudrarodanasaṃbhavāt | sphaṭavaktre pārvatīye pratiṣṭhā sphuṭameva ca ||
dhanāśīkeśarī kānti rekhāyī jāyate prabho | malākīye vahnināśastatkālaṃ jalamadhyataḥ ||
jalopari samāyāti samalākī prakīrtitaḥ | tena yat kriyate karma tadanantabharaṃ bhavet ||
anya mantre siddhirūpā śaktimantre divā na hi | iti kāraṇato devi rātrāveva japaḥ smṛtaḥ ||
rātriḥ saṃyogarūpā syāt vidyātvaṃ ca maheśvari | viyogarūpo deśo mantraśāstre prakīrtitaḥ ||
mahāmālāmāha ||
<143a>
ataḥ paraṃ pṛthak rūpo mālāsaṃskāra mācaret | mālārātri vidhaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu sā vahitā bhava ||
sudine śubha ṛktādi dine śuddha dine śive | mahāmālāṃ samādāya vīrapātraṃ samānayet ||
vīrayantraṃ samāsādya vīramālāṃ ca śodhayet | devīṃ sāvaraṇāṃ pūjya savalyāntaṃ maheśvari ||
daśaviśat paṃcaviṃśad dīpāṃ datvā valiṃ caret | evaṃ mālāṃśabhāṃ kṛtvā mahāsaṃskāramācaret ||
śubhe muhurtasaṃlagne mālāṃ vā paṃcagavyake | nimantro paṃcagavyaṃ ca gomutraṃ gomayaṃ punaḥ ||
dadhisarpiḥ krame naiva paṃcagavyaṃ prakīrtitaṃ | tadurtārya śuddhajalaiḥ śaṃkṣālyasaṃvidāśavaiḥ ||
mūlamantrena saṃkṣālya tad dravye sthāpayed dinaṃ |
<143b>
tṛtiye divasa devi yakṣakardamakairyajet | sarvagandhairaṣṭagandhaire nimādyaṣṭakairyajet ||
aṣṭanīlāśvatārāyāstārāṣṭā rocinī manau | caturtha divase devi tryaśān sthāpya yajet kramāt ||
rahasya mālā mantrasyāsya ṛṣiḥ parameśvaraḥ | śrīmahātāriṇī devi uṣṇik cchanda prakīrtitaḥ ||
krīṁ bījaṃ strīṁ tathā śakti hūṁ mantra kīlakaṃ smṛtaṃ | mahāmahālādantamālā śodhane viniyojane ||
triśaktyā tu ṣavyaṃgāni dhyānaṃ mantra vadācaret | dhyātvā saṃkalpayatnena mantre nānena pārvati ||
praṇavaṃ ca tathā lajjā śrīlajjā kāmakurcakaḥ | phaṭ svāheti mantreṇa ca sakamālikīkṣipet ||
<144a>
tatra vāhanamantrādyaiḥ kālikālasāradāṃ | sādhudhāṃ parivārīśca pūjayet parameśvari ||
mūlamāvṛtyatāttīyaṃ saṃsmaran dhenu mudrayā | amṛtī kṛtya kavace nāvaguṃṭhya maheśvari ||
mahāmudrā samācādya devī rūpī vibhāvayet | dhyāyet tatra kṣiped binduṃ tatra mantrāt śṛṇu priyet ||
praṇavaṃ kurcayugma yugmaṃ ca svāhā praṇava kūrcakai | vahnijāyā ca tārāstre vahnijāyā viṣaṃ tathā ||
tārāṃ ca vahnijāyāṃ ca tāralajjā sakuccakaiḥ | vahnijāyā tatastāraṃ lajjākaṭuvahnijāyayā ||
dvi tri sṛkhalikācya samastamantra mālayā | śatadhānena mantreṇa binduprakṣepamācaret ||
vahnijāvastunikākeśaraṃ ca candrā guru pradhūpakai |
<144b>
puṣpamālāṃ samuttārya vidyayā cābhi mantrayet | praṇavaṃ ca tathā māyā śrīmahāvajriṇāti ca ||
tato mahāghorana prākarkaṇeti padaṃ vadet | mahāsthi maṇḍale procya praviśati padaṃ tathā ||
sarvasiddhiṃ prayeccheti praṇavaṃ kūrcabījakaṃ | māyābījaṃ vahnijāyā mahā kapālinīti ca ||
tato mahāghorarūpe svāhā praṇavamāyayā | māyā kūrcastri svāhāntā vidyoktā cābhi mantraṇe ||
dūrvākṣataiḥ samabhyarcya kāmeno dīpanaṃ caret | upacāraiḥ samabhyarcya mātṛkāṃ mūlamantrataḥ ||
uddīpanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā haṃkāreṇa tu veṣṭayet | valiṃ dadyādane naiva tāraṃ māyā dvayaṃ vadet ||
vāsudevaṃ binduyutaṃ kūrcaṃ na puṭitaṃ vadet |
<145a>
vāsudevaṃ binduyutaṃ kūrcaṃ na puṭitaṃ vadet | kūrcatāre phaṭ carcaṃ praṇavadvayamurccaret ||
kūrcabījaṃ vahnijāyā praṇavaṃ kūrca bījakaiḥ | mahāyogini śabdānte tatastribhuvanamāriṇi ||
mahāsaṃkhāsthitālā ca madhye nivāsa kūrcati | kuruśabdaṃ sarvasiddhiṃ dehi yukūrcasurāpadaṃ ||
māṃso prahāreṇa gṛhneti yuku gṛhnāpaya dvayaṃ | kullukā phaṭ tataḥ svāhā mantreṇānena pārvati ||
yathocitena dravyena valiṃ datvā vidhānataḥ | paṃcadravyaiḥ paṃcadinaṃ mālāsthāpya came came ||
mālārātri vidhiṃ kuryāt tena siddhyati mālikā | nibhṛte sthāpayen mālāṃ rahasya mālikā vidhi ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgame dvāviṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 22 ||
<145b>
atha strīsūdrārthaṃ mālāsaṃskāramāha ||
śūdrārthaṃ cāstriyāmarthe mālāsaṃskāra ucyate | gaṇeśa sūryaviṣṇīśa durgāḥ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ ||
mālāyāmathatāṃ mālāṃ hvauṁ bīje nābhi maṃtritāṃ | aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ paṃca gavyetāṃ sthāpayetryahaṃ ||
caturthe tu samuddhṛtya kṣālayedastra mantrataḥ | hṛnmantreṇa graṃthayitvā sthaṃḍile tāṃ nidhāpayet ||
tatastu tolyatāṃ mālāṃ sthāpayedvemapātrake | paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya śītalena jalena ca ||
candanena sugaṃdhena kasturī kuṃkumādibhiḥ | abhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryā hasauṁ mantreṇa sādhakaḥ ||
navagrahāt pūjayitvā dikpālāścāṃpi pūjayet | tilenāmṛta yuktena śaktito homayet tataḥ ||
svarṇantu dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād guruve manisaṃkhyākān |
<146a>
tanmantra jāpino viprān bhojayed vātha vaidikān ||
abhāve svarṇapātrasya grahyemasvattha patrakaṃ | mālāsaṃskāra ityukto japaḥ syāt siddhidāyakaḥ ||
grathana prakālamantra ||
śaktimantreṇa saṃgraṃthya śivamantraṃ japecchive | śivamantreṇa saṃgathya śaktimantraṃ jape cchive ||
śivaśaktyorabhedena mālākāryakarī parā | ye naiva graṃthyate devi tameva prajapenmanuṃ ||
ityādyuktaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ kiṃ tvayā vismṛtaṃ prabho | idānīmanyathā proktaṃ saṃśayosti mama prabho ||
mātṛkātārabhinnāni śivaśakti vihīnake | mātṛkāyāmidaṃ noktaṃmanyamālāvidhau mataṃ ||
anyaprakāragrathane ye naiva grathanaṃ caret | tameva prajapen mantraṃ japecchive ||
<146b>
mātṛkādāvapi śive (*?) lākrantu rūpiṇī |
grathitāsūtra ||
grathitāpaṭṭasūtreṇa devyāḥ prītyai tu mālikā | kārpāsa vaiṣṇavī mālā padmasūtrerathāpi vā ||
ūrṇabhirvāvalkallairvā sautrikāryāsasūtrajāḥ | kārpāsaṃdharmakarmādi sādhanaṃ sarvasiddhidaṃ ||
prāyaśaḥ sarvadevānāṃ sūtrotparti vidhiṃ śṛṇu | sūtraṃ dvijendra punyastrī nirmitaṃ granthi varjitaṃ ||
yā jīvavatsakānārī sundarī pativallabhā | tayā kartitasūtraṃ ca kumārī kartitaṃ ca vā ||
śvetarakta suvarṇābha kṛṣṇavarṇā dvijā dinaḥ | sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ raktaṃ sarvepsita pradaṃ ||
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya grāhyaṃ prakṣālyajattataḥ | meru sūtreṇa paṭṭena trasareṇa vinirmitā ||
<147a>
nirmitā svarṇarajataiḥ svarṇenāpi śubhā matā | hāridraṃ sarvathā sūtraṃ grāmakārpāsasaṃbhavaṃ ||
caitrakārpāsajaṃ cātha tyajed grathana karmaṇi | guruṇā grathitā śreṣṭhā svayaṃ kḷptā tapato'varā ||
śaktyā ca grathitā śreṣṭhā na śūdrādibhirīśvari | eteṣu brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭo japamālākṛte bhṛśaṃ ||
alābhe tu dvijātīnāmapi vā svajātayaḥ | kalau tu durlabhā viprā yathāviprā svadharmagāḥ ||
atha syāḥ śodhanaṃ vakṣye samāsāt parameśvari | kulamārgānusāreṇa smṛtyukta vidhināpi vā ||
kṛtanitya kriyā śuddhe ukte vyakteṣvatandrita | upavāsaṃ haviṣyaṃ vā tathaika bhakṣameva vā ||
vidhāya paṭṭakārpāsaḥ śanaiḥ sūtraṃ vinirmamet |
<147b>
upavāsa dine devi tāni sarvāṇi pūjayet | dviguṇāṃ triguṇāṃ vāpi tacca triguṇamācaret ||
candanākṣatadhūpādyaiḥ kusumairvalidīpakaiḥ | kartavyāni samāsāni na sthūlāni kṛśāni ca ||
prātastatsūtramādāya kāmanā kārya bhedataḥ | śvetaṃ nīlaṃ tathā pītaṃ raktavarṇa ca kārayet ||
atha pavitrārohanaṃ ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
kulajānāṃ maheśāni pavitrāṃ rohaṇaṃ kathaṃ | kasmin kāle kathaṃ kāryāṃ kimarthaṃ vada me prabho ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
purādevāsurairdevi kṣīrodadhsumatthitaḥ | tatra netre mahābhāge kaśyapasya suto valī ||
manthāne yojite bhadre viṣanidrīvimūrcchidaḥ | na śaknoti talasyānte varṣāsuvasituṃntadā ||
ārādhitastute nāhaṃ pavitreṇa mahānmanā |
<148a>
dravyavarṣasahasrantu vāyubhakṣo mahāvalaḥ | tuṣṭohaṃ tena deveśi kiṃ kartavyaṃ puroditaṃ ||
tatosau daṇḍavad bhūmau papātamabhyadāgramaḥ | prāvṛtkālena śaknomi talānte vasituṃ haraḥ ||
tataḥ sopi mayā devi karābhyāṃ gṛhyabhūtalāt | śirasā dhārito devi jaṭājūṭe varānane ||
tataḥ sarvaistu devaiśca śirasādhāritaḥ śuciḥ | punaḥ pavitra nāgāya varo dantā mayā śive ||
pavitra ropaṇaṃ yastu kriyate na phalaṃ tava | daśakoṭyāstu pūjāyāsteṣāmeva pavitrakaḥ ||
tasmāt sarveṣu deveṣu pavitrāropaṇaṃ kramāt | pratipat paurṇamāsyā tu yasya yā tithirucyate ||
dvādaśyāṃ vaiṣṇave kāryaṃ śukle kṛṣṇathavā hareḥ |
<148b>
vyatīpāte'yane caiva candrasūrya grahe śiva | viṣuve vṛddhikāle ca gurorāgamane tathā ||
nityaṃ pavitramuddiṣṭaṃ prāvṛtkāle svavaśyakaṃ | kuryān mithuna saṃkrānte tulvāsaṃkramaṇāvadhi ||
āṣāḍha uttamo māsaḥ śrāvaṇe madhyamo bhavet | hīno bhādrapadaḥ pakṣaḥ śvetaḥ sanmadhyamositaḥ ||
paṃcamī cāṣṭamī caiva navamī daśamī tithau | dvādaśyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmathāpi vā ||
kālo grīṣmaḥ śaradvarṣā evamukhyatamaḥ priye | kecidvasantamicchanti kālaṃ mādhyamikaṃ vudhāḥ ||
naiva hemantaśiśirau praśastautau kadācana | ekaṃ vijñāya deveśi kṛtādiṣu yathākramaṃ ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kalau kārpāsajaṃ śubhaṃ | kauṇeya paṭṭakaṃrājñāṃ vanasthānāṃ tu kalkalaṃ ||
<149a>
padmajātaṃ saugatānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ kṣaumapiṣyate | vaṭunādarbhasaṃjātaṃ vaiśyānāṃ tuśāśādbhavaṃ ||
muṃjajātaṃ vratasthānāmāvikaṃ samaraikṣaṇāṃ | kārpāsikaṃ padmajaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sastamīśvari ||
amnāya bhedādbhidyante sūtravarṇaḥ sureśvari | pūrvārddhayosmitaṃ sūtraṃ raktasūtraṃ tathottare ||
paścimepyatha pītaṃ hi athodakṣiṇayormataṃ | nilenāktaṃ bhavet sūtraṃ ṣaḍāmnāyeṣu karhicit ||
āmnāyepyatha sarvaṣu praśastaṃ sitameva vā |
atha damanāropaṇaṃ ||
damanāropanākhyaikāpavitrāropaṇī parā | pratisamvatsaraśvaite yona kurvīta sādhakāḥ ||
tasya varṣa kṛtā pūjā vyarthābhāveti bhāvini | kṛtāmapi vilupyamni bhūtapretādayo gaṇāḥ ||
<149b>
pratisavatsaraṃ tasmāt kuryād yatnena sādhakaḥ | damanāropaṇaṃ karma pavitrāropaṇantathā ||
damanena ca yo devaṃ varṣamadhyena pūjayet | tasya varṣa kṛtaṃ pūjā phalaṃ gṛhnāti kāmarāt ||
athā syātpartibījamāha ||
pārvatyuvāca ||
ekavijñepnumicchāmi prāṇanātha maheśvari | asthāya paramaṃ yogaṃ yogindreṇa tvayā prabhā ||
āvāṃyuyukṣu dharmadatodāgdhānayana vahninā | kimarthaṃ pariṇītāhamathabhogaṃ samujjatā ||
āvayoḥ kiṃ sukhaṃ tasmin mṛterati vivarddhane | yadyasitvaṃ mayāsārddhaṃ cikīrṣukeli muttamāṃ ||
saṃjīva yadā kāmaṃ prīyate mama dhūrjata | śrutvetthaṃ girijā vākyaṃ ratilīlāsukhāvahaṃ ||
smidaṃ vidhāya provāca mānayat preyaso bhavaḥ |
<150a>
śrīmahādeva uvāca ||
īdṛśī yadi te śraddhā kāmasaṃjīvine priye | na dāsya sirasiścāpi te vicemirīndraje ||
eṣamaṃ jīvayāmyenaṃ prīyate tava pārvati | khyātiṃ prakhyāpayiṣyāmi tavānena ca karmaṇā ||
vidhāsyāmi tathā cānyaṃ vyavasthāṃ bhuvana traye | aghottarā phalguṇībhaṃ tithiścāpi trayodaśī ||
śuklaḥ pakṣaścaitra māso yogo vṛddhistathaiva ca | pūjāmṛtamayepyanaṃ mudetavamamāpi ca ||
puṣpadhanveti nāmāsya puṣpairevāsyapi grahaṃ | saṃkalpyāracayiṣyāmi paśyantyāstava pārvati ||
ityuktvā jñāpyagaṇapānā lepya kusumāni ca | kāmasaṃjīvayāmāsa tattadaṅga prakalpyasaḥ ||
sarvaṃ śarīraṃ damanairvadanaṃ kamalena ca |
<150b>
nāsīcampaka puṣpaiṇa dṛśo kuvalayena ca | mallikābhiḥ kapolau dvau yūthibhiralakaṃ tathā ||
dvau karṇo karavīraiśca pāṭalābhirhamudvayaṃ | mādhavībhirjatruṇā dveśirīṣai guṇuyāyugaṃ ||
nāsāpuṭe dvevakulaiḥ karṇikārairgalastathā | cūtāṃkurairvāhu yugaṃ keśapāśaḥ kuruṇṭhakaiḥ ||
kāñcanārairaśayugaṃ kundaiḥ kukṣiyugaṃ tathā | vakṣaḥsthalamaśokaiśca jaṭharaṃ ketakīdakaiḥ ||
pārśva hṛyaṃ jātibhiśca vakṣaṇaṃ kiṃśukairapi | tavargorūruyugaṃ dhvajaṃ pyejavayā tathā ||
pārijātairmaruvakaiḥ kadambairvandhajīvakaiḥ | aṃgapādāni sarvāṇi pratyeka kusumai bhavet ||
cakāra kāmadevasya samagrantu kalevaraṃ | damanaiḥ kalpayā māsa śarāṃścāpi śarosanaṃ ||
<151a>
vasantaṃ kākilāṃ bhṛṃgāṃ malayānilameva ca | ratiñca vāmadigbhāge prītiṃ dakṣiṇatastathā ||
prakalpa bhagavānīśo mṛtasuñjīvanī manuṃ | gṛṇan sañjīvayā māsa svaśaktyā pramathādhipaḥ ||
sa jīvitaḥ samutthāya'vasahāya samanvitaḥ | umāmaheśvarau bhaktyā namāmanu vidaṇḍavat ||
vijñāpayā māsa tathā prāpte dehaḥ smaroharaṃ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā deve tadanujñā tu marhasi ||
uvāca tamatheśāno bhakti praṇata kandharaṃ | trijagan mohayan nityaṃ pauṣpeṇa dhanuṣā smara ||
vicaret svaccheyai tābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ parivāritaiḥ | mitrī bhūta sahāyaiśca tathā'mībhireṣi dhruvaṃ ||
mohayan yuvatī yūnaḥ śaraiḥ pañcavidhauḥ sadā | sadāmattaḥ kalevaraṃ labdhaṃ tvayā devyāḥ prasādataḥ ||
<151b>
iyaṃ tithiraraṃgāṣyā tavanāmnā bhaviṣyati | tvamasyāṃ ye'rcayiṣyanti gandhapuṣpādi vistaraiḥ ||
naivedyadhūpadīpādyairgītavādyādinattanaiḥ | aślīlavacanākṣepairgītavādyādinarmādakadravyabhojanaiḥ ||
yoni liṃgādi śa (* * * * *) hāsyakārakaiḥ | tat tadākāra vacanairmahātsava samānvataiḥ ||
laṃvārāṇipsitāṃ dadyāsteṣāṃ madvacanāt smara | tatpare'hanimatpūjā vistāryāmakatra dhvaja ||
ityuktvā saṃvisarpyāmuṃsavasantarati hareḥ | umāmuvāca pārśvasthāṃ vihasanmānayaṃśvatāṃ ||
devitvadvākyamātreṇa mayāsaṃjīvitaḥ smaraḥ | tavāpi nāma bhuvanakhyāpayiṣyāmi sundari ||
kāmadevaśarīrākhyairdamanairadhivāsitaiḥ |
<152a>
paṅkaropitamūlaiśca tvāmarciṣyanti ye narāḥ | teṣāṃ tvayi kṛtā pūjā vārṣikī saphalā bhavet ||
damanāropanaṃ karma na kṛtaṃ yaiḥ pramādataḥ | śubhāni nāśayitvaiṣā maṇḍabhāni pradīsyati ||
tvadīyāśca gaṇāḥ sarve hariṣyabhyobdikārcanaṃ | yathāte śāradīyārcā nityākṣema pradāyinī ||
damanāropanaṃ (*) da sudhā bhavatu bhūtale | damaropanaṃ karma tataḥ prabhṛti sundari ||
damanāropanaṃ karma tataḥ prabhṛti sundari | sthitamāvaśyaka tayā kartavye tvena cā priye ||
atha daśamahāvidyāyāḥ ṣaḍamnāyaṃ nirṇaya māha ||
bhuvaneśī mahālakṣmīḥ sarvāmnāya pragocarā | tripurā tripuṭā vālā viśālākṣenna pūrṇikā ||
<152b>
dakṣavaktreṇa deveśi mayādyāpi prajāpyate | vagalā caiva mātaṃgī siddhalakṣmīrarudhatī ||
āmnāyāḥ paścimākhyā tu tadvavaktreṇa prajapyate | tārācchinnāpiśācī ca dhūmrā cottaragocarā ||
kālikā bheda sahitā urdhvamnāya pragocarā | upavidyāśca pātāle vidyāmnāyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
atha daśavidyāsūtra ||
kālī tārā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvari | bhairavī cchinnamastā ca vidyādhūmāvatī tathā ||
vagalā siddhi vidyā ca mātaṃgī kamalāmvike | etādaśa mahāvidyā siddhividyā prakīrtitā ||
atha daśavidyā puraścaraṇamāha ||
dīkṣāṃ prāpya puraścaryā ṣaṇmāsāt parato yadi | bhraṣṭatāṃ yāti pāpātmā abdalakṣaṃ ca rauravaṃ ||
<153a>
dīkṣāṃ prāpya puraścaryāṃ akṛtvā mṛyate yadi | pacyata raurave ghore yāvacandrārka medinī ||
puraścaraṇakaṃ devi trayodaśa prakārakaṃ | ātmavittānusāreṇa kṛtvā śraddhā samanvitaḥ ||
guruṃ saṃtoṣya yatnena prayogaṃ kārayed budhaḥ | puraścaraṇakaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭottaraśataṃ dine ||
anantaraṃ ca prayo nāgā kṛyate sadurātmavān | bhakṣanti tasya māṃsāni indrākṣī pramukhā gaṇāṃ ||
ḍākinyādyā mahākrodhā tarjayanti muhurmuhuḥ | mṛte narake pacyanti kumbhi pāke'ti dāruṇe ||
prayogeṣu ca kāryeṣu dīkṣāsu ca vidhānataḥ | puraścaraṇake devi antaraṃ naiva kārayet ||
dīkṣā puraścaraṇakaṃ prayogesti vidhāmataḥ | yathoktaṃ kriyamāṇasya mantrasiddhirna saṃśayaḥ ||
<153b>
pārvatyuvāca ||
puraścaraṇaśabdasya bruhyartha ca vidhiṃ tataḥ | vaidikādyāḥ sarvā mantrā na siddhyan nicayaṃ vinā ||
śrī(-)īśvara uvāca ||
dharmārthakāma mokṣāṇāṃ sādhako mantra ucyate | tatsiddhaye puroyaca caryate tat prakīrtitaṃ ||
puraścaraṇa karmākhyaṃ vedādau śāvarāntake | mantre yantre tathā vaśyaṃ tat prakārān vravīmyahaṃ ||
japahomastarpagaṃ ca mārjanaṃ vipra bhojanaṃ | paṃcāṃga karma rūpaṃ tadāhuḥ kecana tatra tu ||
caturaṃgāstathā tryaṃgādvyaṃgā ekāgināṃpi ca | mantrāstiṣṭhanti vedeṣu tathā tantre piśācaret ||
kecit ṣaḍaṃgā mantrāspastadaṃgānāṃ japāditi | arghamarṣaśasūryārgha jalapāna praṇāmakaiḥ ||
devārcayā paṃcabhiśca tairevaṃ syurdaśāṃgakāḥ | dūtīyāgāttathocconni karmataścakra pūjanāt ||
<154a>
dhvajaliṃgasamāyoga japācca validānataḥ | mahāvali pradānācca bhavaṃtyekā daśāṃgataḥ ||
ṣoḍaśāṃgā kaulikānāṃ vāmakānāṃ dvikeritaṃ | anyaryaśmari sevātoṣṭā daśāṃgāsvaghoriṇāṃ ||
sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kuryād anyathā siddhivandha kṛt | yāvat pāpaṃ tasya nāśaṃ kṛtvā kuryāt puraskṛtiṃ ||
yathā proktena mārgeṇa tasya siddhirahurataḥ | sarvapāpakṣayastatra bhaved vaidika vartmanā ||
kalpoktaivakṛtaṃ saṃkhyā tretāyāṃ dviguṇāṃ bhavet | dvāpare triguṇā proktā kalausaṃkhyā caturguṇa ||
athāsitāyāḥ puraścaraṇamāha ||
divālakṣaṃ śuci bhutvā haviṣyāśī japed budhaḥ | tatastasya daśāṃśena homayadvraviṣā priye ||
<154b>
tarpaye tīrthatoyena payasā sarpiṣāpi vā | madhunāvāsimāmiśra toyana parameśvariṃ ||
devīṃ cābhiṣiṃcartoyaṃstarpaṇasya daśāṃśataḥ | tardaśāṃśaihavidravyairbhojayedbhaktitaḥ priye ||
kāli mantra vido viprān dakṣiṇāṃ guruvadadet | pāśavaṃ kathitaṃ kalpaṃ śṛṇu caivaṃḥ tataḥ priye ||
rātrau māṃsasarvadevīṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | tatoṇagnaṃstriyaṃ nagno ramakleda yutopi vā ||
japa lakṣaṃ tato devi homaya jvalite'nala | yonikuṇḍe sthite sarpi māṃsadyuyutaṃ tathā ||
daśāṃśaṃ tarpayenmadyai māṃsamiśraisusādhakaḥ | tarpaṇasya daśāṃśena abhiṣiṃcya jaganmayīṃ ||
daśāṃśaṃ bhojayet sādhu sādhakaṃ kālikā priyaṃ |
<155a>
madyaṃ māsaṃ ca matsyaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ ca pradāpayet | tatastu toṣaye bhaktyā guruṃ svarṇādibhiḥ priye ||
etat katvadvayād devi mantraḥ siddhyati vai dhruvaṃ | dvijātīnāṃ ca sarveṣā divāvidhirihocyate ||
śūdrāṇāṃ ca tathā proktaṃ rātro viṣṭaṃ mahāphalaṃ |
atha tārāyāḥ ||
naktabhojī haviṣyāśi japallakṣe catuṣṭayaṃ | rahasya mālāmādāya japedvā rakṣameva caḥ ||
lakṣamātraṃ japenmantraṃ daśāṃmasitotpalaiḥ | ādyāktairjuhuyānmantrī taddaśāṃśena tarpayet ḥ ||
kāṇḍāgurudravopataimimarlargandhavāribhiḥ | tarpayecca parāṃ devīṃ tatprakāramihocyate ||
jalecāvāddhya vidhivat pādyaṃ rupacārakaiḥ | santarpavidhivaddevī parivārān sakṛt ||
devīvurddhyāsvamānmānaṃ saṃpūjyādhakāttamaḥ |
<155b>
tāliṇīsiñcayāmīti jalaṃ mūddhni nivikṣipe ||
kumbhākhya mudrā devi namostenābhisevalaṃ ||
atha niśākramamāha ||
evaṃ kurvannadanbhakṣye manakaṃ dadhimadhyapi | madhumāṃsaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ japellakṣaṃ catuṣṭayaṃ ||
daśāṃṇaṃ juhuyādrakta padmaiḥ kṣīrājya lolitaiḥ | śavamuṇḍaṃ pūrayitvā japasthāne japaṃ caret ||
nārī paśya smṛśan gacchan mahāniśi valiṃ dadet | na kāryaḥ subhruvāṃ dveṣāṃ yatnataḥ paripūjayet ||
japena kālaniyamo na sthitau sarvadā japet ||
atha cchinnāyāḥ ||
ādau pūjā prakartavyā japellakṣa catuṣṭayaṃ | pātālairvilvajairvāpi jukṣuyāt kusumaiḥ phalaiḥ ||
tarpaṇādiṃ tataḥ kuryādevaṃ siddho bhaven manuḥ |
<156a>
atha ṣoḍaśī vidyāyāḥ ||
tatra sthitvā japellakṣaṃ sākṣo devīṃ svarūpa dhṛk | kiṃśukai havanaṃ kuryādaśāṃśena maheśvariḥ ||
kusumairvāpi dhuratrayamiti smṛtaiḥ ||
atha trira bhaivyāḥ ||
dīkṣāṃ prāpya japenmantraṃ tasvalakṣajitendriya | puṣpaibhānu sahasrāṇi juhuyādbrahmavṛkṣajaiḥ ||
trimadhyaktaiḥ prasūtairvā karavīrasamudbhavaiḥ ||
atha mahālakṣmāḥ ||
japed bhāskara lakṣaṃ ca niyatāśīyata vrataḥ | taddaśāṃśaṃ prajjuhuyāghṛtaistrisvādusaṃyutaiḥ ||
padmairamādruma phalaiḥ prabhyakamayutai hunet | sudhītaiḥ śucibhistāyaistarpayedacatatadvayaṃ ||
atha mātaṃgyāḥ ||
puraścaraṇa kāle tu ṣaṭ sahasraṃ japenmanuṃ |
<156b>
taddaśāṃśaṃ hunedājyaiḥ śarkarā madhubhiḥ sahaḥ | brahmatarudbhavaiḥ kāṣṭaiḥ sādhakaiḥ śaktibhiḥ saha ||
evaṃ purakriyāṃ kṛtvā prayogavidhimācaret ||
atha bhuvaneśvaryāḥ ||
ravilakṣyaṃ japen mantraṃ pāyasai madhurānvitaiḥ | daśāṃ juhuyā mantrī śatarddaśāṃśaṃ yathākramaṃ ||
tarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ kuryāstathā brahmaṇa bhojanaṃ ||
atha dhūmāvatyāḥ ||
japaṃ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ śūnyāgāre divāniśaṃ | upavāsa paraścaiva mekāhāt siddhimāpnuyāt ||
yasyā śmaśāne vipine japaṃllakṣaṃ tu vāśyate | sauṣṭraṣa ādravāsaśvatena mantraḥ prasiddhyati ||
homacātraghṛte naiva tarpaṇādiṃ tataścaret | athavā prajape lakṣaṃ śmaśāne vigatāmvare ||
<157a>
niśābhojī daśāṃśena tilairhavanamācaret |
atha vagalāmukhyaṃ ||
pītāmbaladharo bhūtvā (*?) rvā śābhimukha sthitaḥ | lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ halidrā pradhimālayā ||
brahmacāryarato nityaṃ prakhe yāto dhyāna tatparāḥ | priyaṃgu pāyase nāpi pītapuṣpaiśca pūjayet ||
[iti kaularahasya sarvāgamasāre trayaviṃśa paṭalaḥ] || 23 ||
atha japarahasyamāha ||
svasvadhvani proccarito prabhutvaṃ prāpnuvanti te | mantrārakṣa (* * *?) nsūtre protāriparibhāvayet ||
tāmeva parame vyāni paramāmṛtasaṃjñake | darśayedānmasadbhāva pūjāhomādibhirvinā ||
atha mantrāṇāṃ sūtakādinirṇayamāha ||
<157b>
jātasutakamādau syāt mṛtasutakamantakaṃ | sutakadvayasaṃyukto yo mantrasmarasiddhyati ||
gurukuṇḍalinī dhyānaṃ vivāhaḥ parikirtitāḥ | dvirāgamo bhavet sānaṃ saṃyogaḥ saṃdhyayā bhavet ||
arghadānaṃ bhaved garbhā gāyatrī tvaṣṭa mānikaṃ | bhutaśuddhyādi prāṇāntaṃ gatrā vayavakalpanaṃ ||
dehī cāpi mātṛkāyā prāṇāyāmastu saṃskriyāḥ | dhyānoccāre maheśāni vālaktātpartirīrītā ||
mantrāccāraṇato devi jātasūtakamīrītaṃ | jātasūtasya doṣasya śamanārthaṃ maheśvariḥ ||
daśaviṃśati paṃcāśad yathāśaktyā japecchive | daśāṃgādi puraścaryā saṃskārā daśavai śive ||
idamādi samādiṣṭaṃ mṛti saṃśṛṇu sādaraṃ ||
saṃskārāt prāśavāṃstānatha japtvā hṛdimaṃ śive | prasannāṃ tatkrameṇaiva tasiddhi sādhanaṃ tathā ||
sāhaṃ bhāve mātṛkāptiṣyaracaitanya melanaṃ | aṃgājñānaṃ ca tādātyaṃ tadanantaramīritaṃḥ ||
<158a>
visarjanaṃ maheśāni mṛtasūtakamīrītaṃ | mṛtasūtakaśāṃtyarthaṃ daśaviṃśati vā japet ||
tena tasya nivṛrtti hi bhavatyeva na śaṃsayaḥ ||
athavāḥ ||
brahmabījaṃ manoddatvā adyanta parameśvaraḥ | saptavāraṃ japenmantraṃ sūtakadvaya muktaye ||
evaṃ japaṃ purā kṛtvā tejo rūpaṃ samarpyayeḥ ||
athāraktaṃ karmasūtakānna tyājyaṃ ||
yajñavratavivāheṣu addhehomoccane vidhi ||
ārabdhe sūtakaṃ nasyādanāraṃbhe ca sūtakaṃ | yoraṃbho varaṇaṃ yajña saṃkalpo vrata jāpayet ||
nādimukhaṃ vināhādau ārddhapāka pariskriyā | japādīkṣārcana vidhiḥ kāryā dīkṣānvitairnaraiḥ ||
māstipāpaṃ yatasteṣāṃ sūtakaṃ vāyatātmanāṃ | sūtake mṛtake caiva dhūmājñārādike tathāḥ ||
japaṃ cārghaṃ tathā kuryān mantra nyāse puraḥsaraṃ ||
<158b>
atha mantravidyāyā bhedamāhaḥ ||
mantravidyā vibhāge tu dvidhā mantra jātayaḥ | mantrāḥ pundrevatā proktā vidyā strī devatā matā ||
punmantrāḥ phet uktāsyu dvitāntāsyustriyo matāḥ | napuṃsakā namontāsyūrityuktā manavastridhā ||
etat sūnyā mahāvidyā mahāmantrastu gīyate | candrātmikā smṛtā vidyā mantrā devī prasīpakāḥ ||
āgneyāsaṃpravuddhyante prāṇe carati dakṣiṇe | bhāge nyasmin gate prāṇe saumyā bodhaṃ prayānti hi ||
nāḍīrddhaye gate prāṇe sarvavāḍhaṃ payārtite | prayacchanti phalaṃ sarva prabuddhyā mantriṇāṃ drutaṃ ||
atha mantraśikhāmāhaḥ ||
śṛṇu devi paraṃ tatvaṃ sarvajñānottamottamaṃ | yena vijñāna mātreṇa kṣipraṃ vidyā prasīdasi ||
<159a>
mūlakuṇḍe tu yā śakti bhujaṃgākāra rūpiṇi | tata bhramāvattavātoyaṃ prāṇa ityabhidhiyate ||
taṃ tyaktvā vyakta madhurāṃ kujantī sahasā sthitāḥ | gacchantī brahmaraṃdhreṇa vraṇiśantī purastanuṃḥ ||
yātāyāta krameṇaiva tata kuryān mamolayaṃ | tena mantra śikhā jātā sarvamantrapradīpiṇīḥ ||
tamaḥ pūrṇe gṛhe yadvanna kiñcit pratibhāsate | śikhā hīnāstathā mantrā na siddhyanti kadācanaḥ ||
śikhopadeśa sarvatra gopitaḥ parameśvari | vinā yena na siddhiḥ syād varṣakoṭi śatairapi ||
tasmād yatnena kartavyaṃ śikhāyā bhāvanaṃ manoḥ |
atha caitanya mantramāha ||
mantrarūpī bhaved devo devarūpī gururbhavet | gururūpi bhavedātsmā ātmarūpī manu bhavet ||
<159b>
iti te kathitaṃ devi mantra caitanya murttamaṃ | yasya vijñānamātreṇa advaitaṃ jñānamuttamaṃḥ ||
śrīdevyuvācaḥ ||
avaitha kulukotparti kathayasvamamādhunā | kullukā kīdṛśī nātha seturvā devakī dṛśaḥ ||
kīdṛśo vā mahāsetunnirvāṇaṃ tvatha kīdṛśaṃ | anyadvā kathitaṃ yanme kīdṛśaṃ tadvada prabho ||
śrīśiva uvāca ||
rahasyamapi te devi kathyate śṛṇu sā prataṃ | vinā yena maheśāni niṣphalaṃ tu japādikaṃ ||
kullukā ca tathā seturmahāsetustathaiva ca | nirvāṇaṃ kuṇḍalī ṣaṣṭhī sarvo sarvotparti śṛṇu priye ||
vidyānāṃ kula pūjya tvāt kullukā tena kīrtitā | vidyā saṃvaṃdhi doṣāṇāṃ bhakṣayitrī yataḥ śivoḥ ||
tena yaṃ kullukānnāmnā sarvataṃtre agopitā |
<160a>
vidyāsiddhārṇave devi yena pāraṃ pragacchati | tena seturmaheśāni vidyāmārgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
mahāvidyāptiśaṃdarśī mahāseturmaheśvari | mahāvidyā navasyārtha caitanyasya pradarśakaṃ ||
mahāsetu?rmadevirmahāvidyārsvarūpardhṛk ḥ | devatāyāstu nirvāṇaṃ caitanya ye ca kīrtitaṃ ||
nirvāṇaṃ kathitaṃ bhadre vidyāvāk mātṛkārṇakaiḥ | nirvāṇaṃ parameśāni catuścaraṇa rūpadhṛk ||
nirvāṇaṃ ca maheśāni paraṃ brahmātmatātmatā | caturthaṃ kartitaṃ bhadre vidyācaraṇamīritaḥ ||
paṃcamīṃ kuṇḍalīṃ devi yathāvada vadhāraye | mūlādhārādāvilātaṃ visātantu tanīyasīṃ ||
sarvadeva svarūpāṃ ca sarvavarṇa pradīpinīṃ | mahākuṇḍalīnīṃ devi mamalī kuṇḍalī parāṃ ||
<160b>
śrīdevyuvāca ||
krameṇa daśavidyāyāḥ kullukāyā vidhiṃ vada |
śrīśiva uvāca ||
paṃcākṣarī kālīkāyāḥ kullukāpari kathyate | kālākūrca vadhū mayā phaḍaṃtā parameśvari ||
aghorākṣo ṛṣiḥ proktā virāṭ cchandraḥ prakīrtitaṃ | devatā kullukā kālī vājamāyābhidhaṃ mataṃ ||
kāmaḥ śaktistathā kūrcaṃ kīlakaṃ pari (*) rtitaṃ | ṣaṭdīrghadyena kāmena ṣaḍaṃganyāsa īritaḥ ||
dhyāna pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ kālikāvatsamāpayet | māyāvadhūvatadhvā kūrcaṃ tariṇī kullukāmatā ||
tāriṇī kullukāyāśca virupākṣe ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ | uṣṇik cchandraḥ samākhyātaṃ devatā nīlatāriṇi ||
kūrcabījaṃ tathā māyā śaktirvadhu ca kīlakaṃ |
<161a>
rmāyayārtu ṣaḍaṃgāni sarvaṃ nīlarsarasvati ||
cchinnāyāśca maheśāni kullukāṣṭākṣassi bhavet | vajravairocanīye ca ante carma prakīrtikaṃt ||
ati kālo ṛṣiḥ proktā gāyatrī cchandra īritaṃ | haṃ bīja bhū tathā śaktiḥ kīlakaṃ rācinī matā ||
śivaḥ ṣaṭ dīrghayuktena ṣaṭaṃganyāsamācaret | dhyāna pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ cchimnāvatsamupācaret ||
sundaryāḥ kullukā devi saṃproktā dvādaśākṣarī | vāgbhavaṃ kāmarājaṃ callarjā ca tripure padaṃ ||
bhagavatī padaṃ procya tadante ṭha dvayaṃ vadet | sundarī kullukāyāstu ṛṣirānanda bhairavaḥ ||
gāyatrī cchandra ādiṣṭaṃ vagbhavaṃ bījamīritaṃ | larjā śaktirmaheśāni kāmabījaṃ ca kīlakaṃ ||
<161b>
devatā tripureśī ca ṣaḍaṃgaṃ tri dvayaṃ na ca | dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ sundarī vatsamācaret ||
saṃpatpradāyāḥ prathamaṃ bījaṃ śrībhairavī manau | vikarālo ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ paṃktiḥ cchanda prakīrtitaṃ ||
devatā bhairavī nāmnā kullukā parikīrtitā | haṃ bījaṃ saṃ mahāśaktiramatra kīlakaṃ mataṃ ||
ṣaṭ dīrgha na bījena ṣaḍaṃganyāsamācaret | mātaṃgī vagalālakṣmī dhūmocchiṣṭākrame śṛṇu ||
tāraṃ kūrcaṃ nārasiṃhai paṃcānāṃ kulakāmanā | ṛṣi bhairavanāmā ca yāvat cchandāṃsi pārvatī ||
devatā savabījādi svasvadaiva kramena ca | dhyānapūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ svadaivata vadā caret ||
īyante kathitā devi saṃkṣepāt kullukā mayā | atha daśa mahāvidyā jihvāśodhanamantra ||
śrīśiva uvāca ||
aparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi jihvāśodhanamurttamaṃ |
<162a>
yatra kṛtvā mahādevi japa pūjā vṛthā bhavet | aśuddha jihvāyā devi yo japet sa tu pāpakṛt ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena jihvāśodhanamurtta caret |
devyuvāca ||
devadevaṃ mahādeva śūlapāṇepiśāka dhṛk | pṛthak pṛthak mahādeva kathayasva mayā nidhe ||
śrīśīva uvāca ||
śodhanaṃ sarvavidyāṇāṃ mukhasya śodhanaṃ śubhe | śrībījaṃ praṇavaṃ lakṣmī tāra śrīpraṇavaṃ tathā ||
iyaṃ ṣaḍakṣarī vidyā sundaryā daśadhā japet | bhairavyāḥ śṛṇu cārvagni mukhaśodhanamurttamaṃ ||
praṇavaṃ ca hsauṃ bījaṃ praṇavaṃ suravandite | idaṃ hi tryakṣalī mantraṃ daśadhā prathamaṃ japet ||
śṛṇu sundari śyāmāyā mukhaśodhanamuttamaṃ | nijabīje trayaṃ devi praṇava tritayaṃ punaḥ ||
<162b>
kāmetayaṃ vadi bindu rati bīja yutaṃ trikaṃ | eṣā navākṣarī vidyā jihvā śodhana kāriṇi ||
tārāyāḥ śṛṇu cārvaṃgi apūrva mukhaśodhanaṃḥ | jīvanī bhuvanā larjā bhuvaneśī tataḥ priye ||
tryakṣarīyaṃ mahāvidyā vijñāya mṛtavarṣiṇī | durgāyāḥ śṛṇu cārvaṃgi mukhaśodhanamuttamaṃ ||
dvādaśa svaramudhṛtvā binduyuktaṃ triyaṃ tathā | aparaikaṃ pravakṣyāmi vagalamukhaśodhanaṃ ||
vāgbhavaṃ bhuvaneśānī vāgvījaṃ suravindrite | mātaṃgyāḥ śodhanaṃ devi akusaṃ vāgbhavaṃ tathā ||
bījaṃ cākuśametaddhi vijñeyaṃ tryakṣarīyakaṃ | lakṣyāśca śodhanaṃ devi śrībījaṃ kamalānane ||
praṇavaṃ dāntamudhṛtya vāmakarṇavibhūṣitaṃ | punaḥ praṇavamuddhṛtya vidyeyaṃ tryakṣarī matā ||
<163a>
vālādīnāṃ ca śranyā sāṃpragavaṃ suśaśodhanaṃ | strīśūdrāṇāṃ maheśāni aukāreṇa tu śodhanaṃ ||
mukhaśodhanamātreṇa jihvāmṛta mayī bhavet | anyathā mantra viṭ yuktā jihvā bhavati sarvadā ||
bhakṣaṇe duṣitā jihvā mithyā vākya na dūṣitā | kalahai duṣitā jihvā tatkathaṃ jatapanmanuṃ ||
tat śodhanamanā cārya na japet yāmaraḥ kvacit | śaiva śākta vaiṣṇavānāṃ sarveṣāmapyavaśyakaṃ ||
anyathā prajapenmatraṃ mohana yadi bhavini |? sarvaṃ tasya vṛthā devi mantrasiddhirna jāyate ||
antenarakamāpnoti bhavet sāpi na cānyathā | devo yadi japen mantraṃmakṛtvā mukhaśodhanaṃ ||
patanaṃ tasya vai devi kiṃ puna karmabhya vāsināṃ |
<163b>
atha śāporddhāraḥ ||
śāporddhārot kīlena tu tatra bhedaḥ kriyāt bhavet | (*?) śma vada mahādeva yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā ||
śrīmahādeva uvāca ||
utkālanaṃ vadhaṃ vaṃdha na svācchāpastejānirodhakaḥ | kīlena tu mahādevi na gatāgatamīritaṃ ||
gatāgataṃ mahādevi śāporddhāre tu vartutaḥ | bhaktānugrahakāmatvārdevī sākṣādhakasanidhau ||
gatvādabhovaro devi samaya jāta eva hiḥ | mantra caitanya rodhatvān mṛṣājātā maheśvari ||
yathā duratare vatse dhenuḥ prītistu vartate | vaṃdhanasya yadāmukti stanapānaṃ tadaiva hi ||
kālī tārā tathā cchinnā tejāḥ puṃjanibhā matā | trayāṇāṃ tejasaṃrodhaṃ kohi katukṣamo bhavet ||
tasmācchrāpādikaṃ nāsti kālikāyā maheśvari |
<164a>
kālitāriṇī cchinā utkīlana vimocinī | dāmasaṃtroṭanaṃ kṛtvā dhenuryāti yathāsubhaṃ ||
bhaktānugraha kāmyatvānnadheyaṃ kālikā parā | tārācchināstaṃbhaveśī sarvavandhavimociṇī ||
śāpo tu prastavo nāstri kīlena prastaro nāsti kīlena prastavosti hi | kālikā yā mahādevi sarvadā prastavosti hi ||
śāporddhāraniruktistu śṛṇu yatnena sāprataṃ | vatso nikaṭavatnī syārddhe tu nikaṭavartinī ||
dugdhā bhāvavān mahādevi naikaṭyai kiṃ phalaṃ bhavet | kālī tare samāyāte punadugdhaṃ yathā bhavet ||
śāpo nirmocānā deva punastejaḥ pravartate | vatsabaṃndhana muktī tvāt phalasiddhi hi vartane ||
utkīlanavaṃndhanaṃ hi phalasiddhiḥ pradā priye | tasmādutkīlanaṃ bhinnaṃ śāpo bhinnaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
<164b>
akṣaravyatyayo devi (*?) tkīlana vidhau smṛtaḥ | mantra caitanya vyatyayona caḥ ||
caitanya vyatvayā mantrī pāpabhāgī naro bhavet | tatpāpasya nivṛtyarthaṃ prāṇāyāḥma prakirtitāḥ ||
dehavan mantrarūpatvaṃ dyakṣarevat tate śive | akṣaravyatyayordevi hīṃśāṃ gatvaṃ prajāyateḥ ||
śāpadāne mahādevi sarvāṃgaṃ siddhameva hi | vatsavaṃdhanakaṃ karma punaḥ siddhaṃ yathā bhavet ||
tatotkīlanakaṃ karma punaḥ siddhaṃ maheśvari | śāpadāna mahādevi caitanyā bhāva eva hiḥ ||
vidyamānā yathā gādo dugdhaṃ nā maheśvari | śāpadāne maheśāni caitanyaṃ nāsti śāṃbhaviḥ ||
utkīlane mahādevi caitanyaṃ siddhameva hi | ekadā samaye kopi sādhakaḥ sthiramānasaḥ ||
saṃsmāradakṣiṇāṃ devī sadā bhaktaika mānasāṃ |
<165a>
dyutakrīḍāṃ mayāsārddhaṃ pravartā ca vihāya sā | gatā sā sādhako yatra dalātasyaivaraṃtataḥ ||
nivṛttā sāmayā śaktā kruddhena manasā mune | yatomāṃ tvaṃ vihāyaiva gatāmādhaka sannidhiṃ ||
atastvaṃ śīghra phaladāna bhaviṣyasi dakṣiṇe | tato dīnamanā devi saṃtutoṣastathā vaiḥ ||
tatastuṣṭoha manayā punarenāṃ samurcivān | mahāvidyāṃ saṃpuṭitāṃ japtvā yaptvāṃ sumaṃdhyame ||
tatastvaṃ śāpanirmuktā bhaviṣyasi phalaprabhā | tataḥ prabhṛti vidyeyaṃ drutaṃ ca phaladāyinī ||
sādhakasaṃ mahābhāga jananī bandhamuktaye | ityukvāntardadheśastu bhārgavasya hi paśyateḥ ||
bhārgavā hi muniśreṣṭestapaśya vamanodadhe | śāpoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi vaśiṣṭha muninā kṛtaṃ ||
caturviṃśati lakṣāṇi japtvā kopena śaptavān |
<165b>
adya prabhṛti deveśi kālike kālarūpiṇī ||
tavamantreṣu saṃsiddhiḥ kaṣṭhe naiva bhaviṣyati | iti śrutvā mahādevi prādubhūtā prasādyataṃ ||
uccā ca putrakīmidaṃ śāpadānaṃ vṛthākṛtaṃ | evaṃ phalaṃ yathā na syāt tathā kuru munīśvara ||
jñānadartaṃ ducārādhyaṃ dullabhaṃ yatsurerapi | tataḥ prītyā vāraṃ labdhvā jñānavijñānasaṃyutaṃ ||
uvāca prīta manasā śāpāntaṃ mantra saṃkaṭe | mātaḥ krodhena kathitaṃ tatropāya mahaṃ vade ||
praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya ghorarūpe ca dakṣiṇeḥ | siddhiṃ kuru dvaya procya kāliketi padaṃ tataḥ ||
mamābhīṣṭa phalaṃ śīghraṃ devi dravaiṇa saṃpadaṃ | japādau mantramuccārya japānte ca punaṣpathet ||
<166a>
bhaviṣyati tataḥ siddhiracirāt parameśvari |
atha mantroyave jñānamāha ||
śravaṇāsya hṛdaye netra jñānanmokṣo manoḥ sadyaḥ | śrotrādīnāṃ jñānā bhāve mantrasya grahaṇa mātrāt ||
dāridrañca viparti carnaraka prāptiryaśovaṃśaḥ | dīnoti duḥkhabhāgī parājitaḥ śatru pīḍitaḥ ||
kuryādavasthita citto mantrī śotrādi vijñānaṃ | svanāti bhaktyā śrotrādināṃ gurojñānaṃ bhavati tādā kṛtabhyā lokatraya pūjito naghamantrī ||
layaśrotrā mṛgāsyādi hṛcchūnyāḥ sadṛśaḥ svarāḥ | garjini dhrumra bhairavyā ābhāveradṛśau smṛtau ||
mūlārṇamukhamādiṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ svaraśaktayaḥ | ebhiraśeṣamantrāṇāṃ hṛnnetra vadanāni ca ||
<166b>
asāvāsya parijñayaḥ sarvatantreṣu gopitā | bījarakta mukhāsarvamūlārṇa hṛdayaṃ svarāḥ ||
dakṣivāmadṛśau caṇḍī vicāre madhyasā nama | bījābhāve mano vidyū netra vamano harīḥ ||
mūlārṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ daṇḍī pāṇau ca svaraśaktayaḥ | cintāmani nṛsiṃhākhyau netrāsya praṇahṛt śrutīḥ ||
yatrī bījākṣaraṃ mantraṃ tatra sarva sa eva hi | pradhāna pūrvaparagā vikarā yatraḥ hṛśyateḥ ||
tatra netraṃ vijānīyān mukhaṃ cakṣu tajokṣitaṃ | raktavarja manomūla varṇamāsyaṃ prakalpitaṃḥ ||
mālāpūjā ||
iṣṭamantreṇa mālāyāḥ prokṣaḥṇaṃ parikīrtitaṃ | oṃ mālāmāle mahāmāle sarvaśakti svarūpiṇi ||
caturvargastvayi nyastastasmān me siddhidā bhavaḥ | vāgbhavaṃ ca tathā lakṣmī mahādimālikāntathā ||
ṅentāṃ hṛyaṃ devarṇānto mantreṇānena pūjayet |
<167a>
mantradhyānaḥ ||
cintayitvā guruṃ mūrddhna yathāvarṇādikaṃ bhavet | mantraṃ dhyāyet taṇumadhyapītāvarṇa hiṇāyaṃ ||
mahāmāyāṃ ca hṛdaye svātmānaṃ gurupādayoḥ | ājñā cakretagaḥ paścād gurommantrasya cānmanaḥ ||
devyāścāpyakatāṃ dītvā suṣamnāvanmanā tataḥ |
atha japasaṃkhyākṛtaummaha ||
nākṣataihasta parvairvānadhānyai na ca pūṣpakaiḥ | na candanairmṛtīkayā japasaṃkhyāṃ na kārayet ||
lākṣākulūśītaśindulaṃ gomayaṃ ca karīṣakaṃ | vilodya guṭikāṃ kṛtvā japasaṃkhyāṃ tu kālayet ||
[iti śrīkaula rahasya sarvāgamasāre caturviṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 24 ||
atha mantrasiddhidīpo yathā ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣāmi sarva tantreṣu gopitaṃ | mantrasiddhikaraṃ dīpaṃ na vācyaṃ yasya kasyacit ||
śaktyādyahagaṇārkepu bhaktovarṇa prajāyate |
<167b>
mantravarṇasya divase kramārddivaṃ prakalpayet ||
sāyaṃ tu kuḍavāhasya vartibhūpaṃcataṃtubhiḥ | yāvajvalati dīpo syaitāvatpaśyanmanuṃ japet ||
mantrārṇakhya dīpeṣu jvaliteṣvatha taddineḥ | punardīpe kṛsā tu dīpe saṃdṛśyate sphuṭaṃ ||
iṣṭaṃ svakīyaṃ kathayedyā ca yenmanasetpsitāṃ | dadāti devatā tuṣṭā guhya (*?) tatprakāśitaṃ ||
atha sāvaramantrapuraścaraṇaṃ ||
atha sāvaramantrāṇāṃ puraścaraṇamucyate | kāmarūpākṣa deśe tu kāmākṣā yantra devatā ||
kāmaśailostriyatrāsau kāmapīṭhaṃ taducyate | tatrāsaṃlekhya mantraṃ hi vaṃśopari yathākramaṃ ||
guruṇā vācanīyaḥ sasvayaṃ pañcātpathenmunuṃ | gurorabhāve tasyaiva mūle śailaśya parvaṇi ||
likhitvā prapaṭhenmanu ||
jvālāmukhī samīpe vā hiṃgulāyā samīpataḥ | likhitvā prapaṭhenmantraṃ nānyathaiva prasidhyati |
<168a>
mukhataḥ strīsamīpe hi kāmapīṭhe manograhaḥ | athavāsadeśeṣu mantragrahaṇamucyake ||
tālapatre manuṃlyakhya pūrṇakumbhanidhāpayet | bhāskaraṃ tu guruṃ dhyātvā vācayentri guru ravi ||
iti sāvaraṇa mantrapuraścaraṇa vidhi ||
atha ṣoḍhānyāsapuraścaraṇaṃ ||
devī bhāvasamāyuktaḥ ṣoḍhānyāsa paro bhavet | daśavidyāvidho sā ca daśadhā bhinnabhinnataḥ ||
pratyekaṃ ṣaṭ ṛṣiṃ taṃ taṃ taddhyānaṃ ca samācaret | (* * * *?) cchandādikaṃ yatra kīrtitaṃ parameśvari ||
tadeva tatra graditaṃ manukte sūladevevat | dhyānaṃ cchandādikaṃ strotraṃ devīvatsarvameva tu ||
āyutaṃ ca puraścaryā nyasana kramayorgataḥ |
<168b>
atha sahasranāmastava kavacāṇāṃ puraścaraṇaṃ |
īśvara uvāca ||
sahasranāmastotraṃṣu kavaceṣvapi pārvati | tatkovacoditā proktā sāvai kāryā puraskriyā ||
yatranoktā puraścaryā tatra kiṃ vā vidhiyate | ayutaṃ tu puraścaryā stotramātre prakirtitāḥ ||
māhākāla mate proktaṃ tatrasthaṃ cetsamācaret | viprasaṃtoṣane naiva sarvasiddhyati pārvati ||
havagartu kathaṃ kāryaṃ puraścaryādikaṃ bhavet | sahasranāmamarūpaṃ vai kīdṛśaṃ parameśvarī ||
tathā ca kavacaṃ devi kiṃ rūpaṃ parikirtitaṃ | śiva devyāstu saṃvādo brahmaraṃdhreti kīrtitaṃ ||
anya ślokākeśa tulyā ṛṣiḥ śira ītiritaṃ |
<169a>
chandro kiṃ mukhod devi devatā hṛdayaṃ bhavet | bījaṃ guhyamiti proktaṃ śaktistu paramaṃgotā ||
sarvāṃgaṃ kīlakaṃ devi hyartha vādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | strotra madhye sthitaṃ yadyattatsarvaṃ stotra rūpakaṃ ||
evaṃ ca devadeveśi stotrarūpā prakīrtitaḥ | tathaiva kavacaṃ devi jñātvā pāṭhe paṭhet priye ||
aṃgahīne bhavennāśaḥ sarvathā parameśvari | phalaṃ stutvādikaṃ devi aṃgamityabhidhīyate ||
ādyopāntaṃ vinā devi phalamarddhaṃ prakīrtitaṃḥ | atrārthe pratyayā devi ṣaḍaṅgādyā yathā smṛtā ||
havaṇaṃ kavacāṃdīnāṃ ślokānte vihitaṃ vacā | ādyopāntaṃ pāṭhītvā vā paścā tupha havanaṃ mataṃ ||
athavā deva deveśi nāmāntaṃ bhava mataṃ | kavacādavāvapi priye mantrāntre havanaṃ bhavet ||
upakramasya saṃhārī ślokānte vahaṇaṃ mataṃ |
<169b>
ādau pūrṇā tu saṃpathya tathaicānte maheśvari ||
madhya nāmāni pādyānidyāni puraścaryā prakīrtitāḥ ||
ślokānte mārjanādikaṃ ||
tatra strotrokta vidhinā puraścaryādikaṃ caret | stotramāvartya saṃpūrṇaṃ tadante gaṇanāṃ caret ||
saṃpūrṇa homayogoyaṃ kathitastu priyaṃ vadet | mārjanābhiṣekarma kuryādatra maheśvari ||
sārūpaṃ kavacākhyaṃ ca sāyujyaṃ stotramīritaṃ | sānidhyaṃ nāma sāhasra tritayaṃ parikirtitaṃ ||
kavacaṃ kavacaṃ rūpaṃ syāt stotraṃ sahacaro bhavet | saha nāmastotraṃ tu pūjāsthāne prakīrtitaṃḥ ||
pūjādūrgā svarūpā syāt validānaṃ tu māraṇaṃ | maṃtrorāja puraścaryā rājyasaṃpartirītitā ||
sapatyā tu vinārājā na śobhati meśvari |
<170a>
saṃpartimūlametaddhi sarvameva prakīrtitaṃ | homamantramiti proktaṃ parjanyāstraṃ tu tarpaṇaṃ ||
jale dūrga svarūpaṃ vai tvabhiṣekaḥ prakirtitaḥ | brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanaṃ tu duṣṭasainya prabhakṣaṇaṃ ||
devatā guruvidyaikyaṃ tvānmaikyaṃ paribhāvyane | sarvasiddhīśvaro bhūtvā trailokyā vidhipati bhavet ||
yathā ca rājarājyādau śatrusainyaṃ bhayaṃ bhavet | siddhirājyaṃ mahādevi tathaiva parikīrtitaṃ ||
dūrgādyamvādikaṃ devi deśarājya yathāmataṃ | tathaiva siddhirājyasya puraścaryādikaṃ mataṃ ||
mantrorājāgurormaṃtrī gaṇeśādvārapālakāḥ | sādhanaṃ śavamuṇḍasya sihāsanamitiritaṃ ||
<170b>
sādhakena tathā kāryaṃ yena sarvaṃ tu sidhyati | naimittikaṃ ca kāmyaṃ ca haya dviradakau matau ||
homadhūpaḥ patākā syāt tatastu siddhirājādhipe devi kinna sidhyeti bhūtale | ṣoḍhānyāsādikaṃ senā devatārādyadāyikā ||
yantraṃ tu vajradūrga tu jīvacakraṃ vibhedakaṃ | kacādi puraścaryā proktā kiṃśotu micchasi ||
athāṅkayaṃtrapuraścaraṇamāha ||
ādau yantraṃsya siddhyarthe tanmantrasya puraskṛyāṃ | kṛtvā yuta pramāṇena pañcādyantrasya vācaret ||
yathādhāre yathā dravya yantrasaṃlikhā yatnataḥ | tatrā vāhyaiva nardevaṃ saṃpūjya vidhi pūrvakaṃ ||
dhyātvā japaṃ valiṃ homaṃ kṛtvā ||
(* * * * * * *?) ||
ekaikavāramāvānya mantraṃ yantraṃ smarana budhaḥ | itthaṃ japādibhiḥ siddhe yantre nāmādhyatā kvacit ||
<171a>
dik sahasra pramāṇe yantre kārya puraskṛtāṃ ||
atha dvitripuraścaraṇairmantrāmasiddhatvemeti punastatropāyāmāha ||
tathā ca samyaga tuṣṭite mantra yadi siddhirnna jāyate | punastenaiva kartavyaṃstataḥ siddhirna jāyate ||
takopāyaṃ prakurvītadyattaṅgopya madhunocyate | anulomavilomena bindumātṛkākṣaraiḥ ||
japet saṃpuṭitaṃ mantraṃ patyahaṃ sata saṃkhyayā | ekamātatohomādikāt siddhā bhavet manuḥ ||
puraścaryāktamakhilamāhikaṃ ca sāmācaret | krūradaivata mantrantu bhūtalipyāpuṭī kuru ||
kramānkramācchatā vṛttiṃ kuryāt siddhistu māsataḥ |
acohayaravalāścāntimādi dvicaturthakaṃ | tṛtīyaṃ ca krameṇaiva vargānāmakṣaraṃ paṭhet ||
<171b>
uṣmatrayaṃ tataśvedyaṃ arcitāsu prasīdati |
śapotāvākīlitatvāttatrāpāyāṣṭakaṃ bhavet | saṃpātāthāyanaṃ drāvo vodhanaṃ vacavaśī kṛtiḥ ||
pīḍanaṃ ṣoṣaṇaṃ śaucaṃ dahanaṃ tatru kriyocyate | bhūrjapatraṃ samānīya padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet ||
aṣṭagaṃdhena devasya rocanāndanena vā | sādhakasya tu nāmārṇai mantraṃ saṃdabhilikhet ||
yāvat dvayo samāptiḥ syāt tasya cādyaṃ tayo likhet | tārādikaṃ sādhakasya nāmāthāṣṭādaleṣu tu ||
dvau dvau lekhyau svarau tacca sasyagyā yatsudhātmakaṃ | tatsaṃveṣṭo mṛdāsamyag veṣṭayadbrāhmaṇādikaṃḥ ||
śuklādi varṇayā paścāt siksvakena ca veṣṭayet |
<172a>
kṣipre trimadhuretartu mṛnmaye laghubhājanaḥ | kṣīrapūrṇenavekule tatkṣipellaghu bhojane ||
agnisaṃsthāpanaṃ kṛtvā sanidho tasya taṃ ghaṭaṃ | saṃsthāpayentrimadhurai mūlamantreṇa homayet ||
aṣṭādhika sahasraṃ tu saṃpātaṃ kalaśe kṣipet | homāṃsaṃmāthataṃ kuṃbhaṃ nikṣipecca jalāśaye ||
svaguruṃ brahmaṇāśvāntaistoṣayed dakṣiṇādibhi | saṃpātādhāya caitaścaduktaṃ siddhirna cedbhavet ||
drāvaṇaṃ tu tadā kuryāt tat prakāra ihocyate | vaṃ bījena grathayitvā bhūrjapatre likhen manuṃ ||
uśīrarocanābhyāṃ ca śikhākarpūra kumbhamaiḥ | kṣīrājya madhutoyātāṃ madhya taṃ likhitaṃ kṣipet ||
pūjanārcca japāddhomāt drāvitaḥ phalado bhavet |
<172b>
drāvitopi na siddhaśvarddhādhanaṃ tasya kārayet | vāgbhavena ca bījena saṃpūtīkṛtyaṃ taṃ japet ||
evaṃ buddhā bhavet siddho nocyat kuryād vaśo kṛtaṃ | kucaṃdanaṃ mahādāru haridrāmadanīśilāḥ ||
etaistu likhīto mantro bhūrjapatre suśobhane | kaṭhe dhṛto bhaved vaśyo nocenkuryācca pīḍanaṃ ||
anudāttasvaraśyācya mudāt tena dvitīyakaṃ | tṛtīyamadhudātte ca paṭheta bhurjamudāttataḥ ||
evaṃ pādāni sarvaṇi paṭhe mantrasya sādhakaḥ | anudāttarpadācāra devaṃ dhyāyedadhaḥ sthitaṃḥ ||
udho sthite mudāt tasyoccāreṣṭādi sahasrakaṃḥ | japen mantraṃ tato bhūrje bhānudagdhe valekhayet ||
maṃṭraṃ tamākramedvāma pādanātha ca homayet | aṣṭottaraśataṃ mantraḥ pīḍitaḥ sanprasīdati ||
<173a>
na siddhaśvettadopoṣyaḥ procyate tatkriyādhunā | sauḥ bīja pūṭitaṃ mantraṃ vilikhyedbhūrjapatrake ||
rocanākuṃkuṃmabhyāṃ ca dhārayediti | etacchokhalamityuktaṃ dahanaṃ procyatedhunā ||
pṛthak pṛthak svamantrārṇān catudikṣu samāvṛtān | raṃbījena palāśaśya veje tailena saṃlit ||
bhūrja patretha gaterddharya kaṃṭhe dāha kriyā tviyaṃ |
iti saptasaṃskāraḥ || atha mantrārtha prakaranaṃ ||
mantrārthaṃ mantra caitanyaṃ yoni mudrā na vetti yaḥ | śatakoṭi japenāpi tasya siddhirna jāyate ||
tatrādau gurumantrārtha || yathā ||
athātasaṃḥpravakṣyāmi mantrārthaṃ gurunāmataḥ | gakārājñānasaṃpartirakārāt taprakāśakaḥ ||
ukārāśivatādātmyaṃ dadyāti guruta smṛtāḥ | guru daivatayoraikyaṃ bhāvayet parameśvari ||
<173b>
iḍā nāḍī sthita candra piṅgalābhāravāhiṇī | suṣumnā bhedarūpāṇi dahanaṃ pāpanāsanaṃ ||
gurunāmā prayatneṇa paratatvaṃ ca prāpyate ||
atha śivamantrārthamāha ||
oṃkāraṃ prathamaṃ vidyānnakārāṃ tu tataḥ paraṃ | gakāraṃ tatparaṃ vidyāṃ cchikāraṃ tu tataḥ paraṃ ||
vākāraṃ paṃcamaṃ vidyāṃ dyakāraṃ tu ṣaḍakṣaraṃ | evaṃ paṃcākṣareṣu syādruta dṛṣṭistathā śive ||
praṇave brahmadṛṣṭiḥ syād brahmaivāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | mantrārthaḥ kathyate paścād yena mukti nṛṇāṃ smṛtā ||
satyajñāna parānaṃda svarūpā citkalā palā | ati vyakta tayā jñeyā śivaśabdena śāmbhavi ||
<174a>
vācakoyaṃ tataḥ śabdo brahmaṇaścitkalā manaḥ | nama śabdo namaskāra vācakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
prahvatva lakṣaṇaḥ proktā namaskāra purātanaiḥ | prahvatārāmajīvasya śivāt sasyādi lakṣaṇāt ||
bhedena bhāsamānasya māyayā sarvarūpataḥ | saṃvaṃdhaṃ nama ityāha śivatātmya lakṣaṇaṃ ||
nityaḥ śuddhiḥ śivaḥ sākṣyāt svarūpaḥ sarvadehināṃ | tasmādbubhutsorjīvaśya nopādeyaṃ hi sarvadā ||
sahoyamapi vā tadvadvastuto na prakīrtitaḥ | evaṃ vidyānnakārārthaṃ makārārthaṃ mudīyate ||
vakāro mama śabdārthā luptastveko makārakaḥ | vyavahārika dṛṣṭvāyaṃ namaskāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
<174b>
tasmācaturthī śavastu procyate nāpi vastutaḥ | oṃkālaṃ sarvaśabdārtha vācaka parikirtitaḥ ||
prayogā deva sarvatra sarvārthaḥ śiva eva hi | tasmācchivasya pūrṇata praṇavā vācaka smṛtāḥ ||
vācyavācatāvāsya lakṣalakṣaṇaṃ tāpi ca | anyathāpi ca nāstva ca paramārtha nirūpaṇeḥ ||
athavā devasarvasya śivādanyasya sarvadā | nāstīti syānmṛṣābhāgi na bhātītyādi māyayāḥ ||
kalpitaṃ cinmukhanaṃdaṃ paramārtha śivātmakaṃ | māyā tatkāryamapyasmācchivātsatyādi lakṣaṇāṃt ||
pratyakṣasiddhināstyaiva paramārthanirūpaṇe | atha kiṃ vahunoktena śivādanya na vidyate ||
śivasvarūpa me vāhuridaṃ sarvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | sarvasvarūpamajñātvā dṛśyatena tu vastuyoḥ ||
<175a>
eṣa eva hi sarvārthaṃ sevyaṃ sarvaṃ ca nānyathā | vadhyavādhakatāṃ yāti vyavahāre parakṣaṇaṃ ||
samudra iva kallolā iti mantrārtha saṃgrahaḥ ||
atha tārāyāḥ ||
svayaṃ līlayā paraṃ viṣṇumūrtirvabhaucemna caivaṃ kathaṃ candracūḍaḥ | tradaṃghri prapadmāṅgatāṃvu pravāhī jaganitya bījaṃ bhetāṃ trinetrāṃ ||
vidhātā yadāyāna cāste svayaṃ saḥ svayaṃbhuḥ kathaṃ syāt kadātoti tūrṇanunābhidhedhonajātaṅkalaukejagatyādi ||
jagatamraṣṭramasmai caturbhiḥ svahastai dadau yā carastraṃ nu vedānanobhūt | ataḥ santi varṇāyugādi vedā jagatyādi || tadaṃśaṃ samāyaṃ hi bījaṃ tatasyāt tripādetidāntinoyāṃ vadanti ||
<175b>
cidekṣaraṃ vrarṇā yugādinī vedā jāgatyādiḥ | tatostraṃ yadāsārdha paṃcākṣalī sā jagattāraṇādugraha tārāprasiddhā ||
vinātārakaṃ sāparaikā jaṭāsyājagannityādi | idaṃ ye janā strotra rājariḍanti prasiddhāśca te gadya padya prasaṃśe | jagadrūpapāṇādvimuktā hi tūrṇaṃ śarīrāntare yānti tārā sastipaṃ ||
vipartau niśārddha japānte prabhāte paṭhedyastu bhaktyā tadatadarthaṃ vicitya || bhavennīlavānyādvirephāṃghri padme sajīvastu haṃsaḥ sajīvavastu jīvaḥ ||
itī śrī(-)arddhatanirūpate mantrārthavivaraṇānmakatārā arthaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ||
atha śrīmahātripūlasundaryamantrārthamāha ||
bhairavo uvāca ||
lakārānpṛthivī devi saśailavanakānanā |
<176a>
paṃcāśatpīṭhasaṃpannā sarvatīrtha mayī parā ||
sarvagaṃgā mayī sarva kṣetrasthāna mayī śive | sakārā caṃdratārādi grahadevasvarūpiṇī || 2 ||
hakārācchīvasaṃyogādvyomaṃ maḍalasaṃsthitāḥ || 3 || ikārādviśvakartrīyaṃ māyā tūryātmikā priye || 4 ||
ekārādvaiṣṇavī śakti viśvapālana tatparā | rakārādvaiṣṇavī śakti viśvapālā na tatparā || 5 ||
rakārārejasā yuktā paraṃ jyoti svarūpiṇi || 6 ||
kakārāt kātadākāma rūpiṇi sphūravyayadā || 7 ||
arddhacaṃdre tu deveśi viśvayoniritīritā || 8 ||
biṃdunā śiva rūpeṇa sūnyarūpeṇa sākṣiṇī || 9 ||
<176b>
anayā sahavatrata vyāpi niścalatātmanā |
śrīcakramapi deveśi meru rūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 10 ||
sakalā bhuvaneśāni kāmeśī bījamuttamaṃ | anena sakalā vidyā kathayāmi viśeṣataḥ ||
śaktyaṃta sūryavaṇeyaṃ kalamadhyesurocane | vāgbhavaṃ paṃcavaṇāḍhyaṃ kāmarājamathocyate ||
mādanaṃ śivacaṃdrāḍhyaṃ śivāṃtaṃ nīla locane | kāmarājamidaṃ bhadre ṣaṭvarṇaṃ sava mohanaṃ ||
śaktibījavarāroha caṃdrādyaṃ sarvamohanaṃ | caturakṣararūpaṃ tu tryakṣarātri purāparā ||
iti sucanāmantrārtha urddhāmnāya ||
athavālaka saṃskāramantramāha ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vāṅmatvāśca manuttamaṃ | vāgbījaṃ prathamaṃ mantrānāradosya mato muniḥ cchandonuṣṭup devatā tu vāṅmatāṃ parīkīrtitāḥ ||
<177a>
bījapūrvaiśca ṣaḍdīghaiḥ ṣaḍaṃgavidhirīritaḥ | śvetāṃvarāṃśvetavarṇāṃ śvetagandhānulepanāṃ ||
sudhākuṃmbhaśca padmaṃñca vīṇāpustakameva ca | karaidadhartī mīnasyāṃ muktābharaṇabhūṣitāṃ ||
evaṃ dhyātvā kanīkāyāṃ yajed devī ṣaḍasrake | rudradhārāṃ maṇimatiṃ phalguṃ viṣṇumanīṃ tathā ||
prabhāvatī bhānumatiṃ bhūpure tu digīśvarām | lakṣa trayaṃ japenmantraṃ pañcaṣādyaistathā hunet ||
tarpaṇādi tataḥ kṛtvā siddhi mantraḥ prajāyate | sadyo jātasya vālasya jihvāyāṃ bījamālikhet ||
madhunā svaṇalaikhanyā soṣṭavarṣaḥ kavi bhavet | vāgmatyāṃ cāthagaṃgāyāṃ puraścaryā kaloti yaḥ ||
dvitīyasyā pratiṣṭhāhī bhikṣāśī vātha maunavān |
<177b>
brahmacārī bhūmiśāyī śvetāmbara dharaḥ śuciḥ | vāksiddhi labhate veśyaṃ dātā bhoktā tvayā ca kaḥ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgamasāre pañcaviṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 25 ||
atha daśavidyāyāḥ mantrasaṃkhyāmāha ||
daśalakṣa prabhedaiśca kāli vidyā kalau sthitā | daśapūrvaiḥ śaptalakṣaiḥ sundarīkāttitā bhuvi ||
trinikharvaṃ turāsyā ca cchinnāyāḥ khamātrakaṃ | paṃcāśīti sahasraśca lakṣapaṃcakasaṃyutā ||
bhuvaneśrīmahāvidyā vagalāṃ śṛṇu sāradaṃ | tatvalakṣyā tu vagalā sahasra navatīrgatā ||
dhūmāvatī mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśītistu bhairavī ||
<178a>
mātaṃgyā netralakṣā ca kamalā lakṣapaṃcakā | ete sṛṃkhalikā yogān prastārāstu vinirgatāḥ ||
atha kaumārī jāti bhedaphalaṃ ||
viprāṃ sarveṣṭasaṃsidhyai yaśasakṣatriyodbhavāṃ | veśyā prayāgaṃ deveśi koṭisiddhi pradāyakaṃ ||
svairiṇī vāṃcchitādyarthaṃ kuṭṭinī sarvakarmasū | hṛtī prīti vidhau vaśya kumārī parikīrtitā ||
vṛṣalī devatā siddhai dehasiddhyaikirātinī | pārvatīyā sarvakaryamanoratha mayī kalā ||
cāṇḍālinī rāṣṭrasiddhyairājyusiddhaikuvindajā | vidyāsiddhyairājasutā kramena parikīrtitā ||
sarvavācchā prasiddhyartha proktā śrīvālasundarī ||
na kaumarī ||
adyāśuddhā vāsikānyā tṛtīyā lalitā smṛtā |
<178b>
caturthī mālirīkhyātā pañcamī syād vasundhurā | sarasvati ramāgaurī durgā tu navamī bhavet ||
puruṣasya ||
pañcannavavaṣañca yaddedvālaṃvicakṣaṇaḥ | paṃcādhyāvaṭuka proktā na varṣā gaṇeśvaraḥ ||
atha prasaṃt vividha prāyaścittamāha ||
prayogaṃ naiva karttavyaṃ sādhakaṃḥ siddhikāṃkṣibhiḥ | prayogānnarakaḥ prāptiḥ parakonavidyate ||
prayogāṃ śrīpamāpnoti prāyaścirttī tu sādhakaḥ | prayogadoṣaśāttyarthaṃ lakṣamātraṃ japet manu ||
māraṇerccāṭane dveṣa lakṣamātrāt suci bhavet | vaśyākaraṇastathā bhādau lakṣavāpya yutaṃ japet ||
īśvara uvāca ||
<179a>
śṛṇu devi pravakṣāmi prāyaścitta vidhinnavaḥ | gurutyāgakaraḥ śiṣyaḥ prāyaścirttī bhadhruvaṃ ||
lakṣaṃ śritodrakaṃ japtvā tasmāt pādviśuddhyati | mantrātyāgakaro yastu tatsaṃṅgaṃ varjayet priye ||
lakṣamekaṃ japenmantraṃ homatarpaṇataḥ śuciḥ | sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ śaṃkare samupasthite ||
prāyaścittaṃ vijānīyādayutaṃ mantrajāpataḥ | nityādi kramadomānāṃ śāntyai vidyāśataṃ japet ||
naimirtikāti kramaṇe sahasraṃ japamenmanuṃ | yadi daivāt paśorvidyā labhate kulajainnaraiḥ ||
dvijantu kaulikaṃ prāpye punarvidyāmupālabhet | śakalobījahīnastu sandigdho ninditastathāḥ ||
<179b>
manavastu na siddhyaṃti guruḥ syādbrahmaghātakaḥ | tadā taṃ sahasā jñātvā mantradevaṃ guruṃ tyajet ||
lakṣa trayaṃ japellīpīṃ lakṣamvāpya japājapet | homayeddha vipāntena niṣyā paśyāt tathā dhruvaṃ ||
ekapātre pibed dravyaṃ vīrīmaheśvaro yadi | śvārocchiṣṭaṃ bhavet pānaṃ prāyaścittaṃ sa kaulikaḥ ||
gāyatryāstu sahasreṇa upavāsa trayena ca | samyak śothita cittastu suvarṇaṃ guru devadet ||
valātta svarato vāpi yoramenmantramātaraṃ | śadalakṣaṃ manuṃ japtvā tuṣānalaṃ samācaret ||
mantraputryāḥ svapuṃtryaśca bhaginyāśca kulastriye | ramanā lakṣajāpena pūto bhavati kaulikaḥ ||
kṛtvā vīre vadhaṃ mantrī vṛthāpānaṃ guroḥstuṣāṃ |
<180a>
mantrapūrtrīmvīrapatnīṃ ramitvā rakṣamo japet ||
asthi prāṇisaṃghāte hatvā vanarakaṃ vrajet | hatvā ca pakṣiṇasyarvān striyaṃ caikādaśaṃ japet ||
sarpamārjāranakulamukhamuṣṭrakharaṃ hayaṃ | gajātvātha mṛgān sarvān hatvā cāṣṭa śataṃ japet ||
japedaṣṭaṃ sahasrastu kṣudrajantu kṣudrajantu vadhe kṛte |
validānamvinā mantrī pātayenna paśūn kvacit | anyathā smārtu muditaṃ prāyaścitta maniṣibhiḥ ||
govadhe daśabhilakṣaimmucyatenarakāṇavāt | lakṣairdvādaśabhimantrī vṛṣaṃ hatvā vimūcyate ||
guruṃ hatvā pramādena pañcalakṣaibbhavecchuci | daśabhiḥ koṭirmantrī strīvadhāt pravimucyate ||
<180b>
pramādāt patite vipre lakṣairviṃśatibhiśuciḥ | kṣatrādayo yathoktena mucyate kilviṣāditaḥ ||
brahmaṇāsya vadhe lakṣaṃ kṣetriye dviṇāṃ smṛtaṃ | vaiśyāṃ triguṇaddiṣṭaṃ pādaye ca caturguṇaṃḥ ||
aharddhā dvāvadhe mantrī khābdhilamunuṃ japet | vabhrośyaśūkalāṇāñca vadhe pañca sahasrakaṃ ||
kṣiṇāṃ hanane mantrī dvisahasreṇa śuddhyati | sarpamārjāramatsyānāṃ vadhe vedasahasrakaṃ ||
devedrohādgurudrohāntriṃśatkoṭimmanu japet | devadravyaṃ gurudravyaṃ bhuktvā tāvanmanuṃ japet ||
nindane samayānāñca yoginī vīrayo śiva | śāstrāṇāṃ mantriṇāṃ striṇāṃ sahasraṃ japa mācaret ||
vā dakṣiṇasiddhyānte śaivavratadhare hareḥ |
<181a>
catuḥkoṭimitaṃ mantrī japaśuddhyati kilviṣāt ||
arghyādi nindane mantrī daśāvattanaśudhyati | arghāmṛtaṃ piben pūrvaṃ devīmutthāpayet tataḥ ||
paśupānaṃ bhavet tasya tatkṣoyo lakṣayo bhavet | anivedya tu bhukte prāyapet satatāṣṭakaṃ ||
vīrapatnī vṛthā ||
prāyaścittaṃ caren mantrī divyavīrārcanādikaṃ | dīpanāśe pātranāśe pātraskhalanaṃ tathā ||
pūjayitvā mahādevīṃ japedaṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ | ājñānāte taducchiṣṭaṃ jñānato dviguṇaṃ bhavet ||
