dagdhaṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ yantraṃ hṛtañcaiveṇa vā priyet | vidirṇaṃ ghṛṣṭavīṃ khecadupāyaṃ ca śṛṇu priye ||
lakṣamātraṃ japed vidyā homatarpaṇa pūrvikāṃ |
<181b>
sadbhaktyā caluṃtoṣya brāhmaṇānapi bhojayet | śaktipūjā tataḥ kāryā kuryādaṣṭāṣṭakaṃ vudhaḥ ||
paṃcapaṃcakakaṃ vāpi kāli tārā tu sārataḥ | kadācilluptacihnamvā sphaṭito vibhūṣaṇaṃ ||
bhagnaṃ naṣṭakaro martyā mṛtyustasya bhaveddhruvaṃ | tasmāt sa tīrtharāje vā gaṃgādi saritāmvare ||
samundre vā kṣiped devi anyathā duḥkhamāpnuyāt | vidyāmātre tvidaṃ kārya viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sādaraṃ ||
lige vāṇe narmadotthaya ca yugmena duṣyati | śalāka cādino bhadino bhagnā tadā liṃgaṃ na duṣyati ||
śālagrāmanilāmātre bhaṃge mṛtyuka bhavet | bhūmau pādakalo ghāte nedi mastake śive ||
<182a>
hṛdayā cātame yatra sarvanaśyāti pārvati | tāṃ mūrtiṃ visṛje devi punamūrti samācaret ||
mahāvidyā vidhau devi viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sādaraṃ | yatra devo gato devi tad deśatasthalaṃ tyajet ||
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sukhamāpnoti sādhaka | vālāmanīyakaumārīṃ carvagiṃ cārucarcitāṃ ||
prasūnamaṃce saṃsthāpya sāṃgaṃ sāvaraṇāṃ yajet | devyāḥ svarūpaṃ deveśi tadvettasyāḥ svarūpakaṃḥ ||
vibhāvya prajaped devi saṃpradāyānusārataḥ | upavāsaṃ prakurvīta dinamedaṃ madritataḥ ||
lakṣamātraṃ japenmantraṃ japa tarpaṇa bhedataḥ | kumāryāmeva saṃpūjya tat tad dīpāt samācaret ||
<182b>
triśakti paravidyādau dīparājaṃ samācaret | dīpāgre dīpīnī japtvā doṣahīnastathā bhavet ||
sindūraṇa kṛtaṃ yantraṃ mūlenāveṣṭitaṃ tataḥ | tatkoṇe kullukāṃ likhya tatra dīpaṃ samācaret ||
aṣṭagaṃdhenapenāpi gaṃdhenadyasṛṇenacaḥ | divyavarṇa na deveśi tena siddhīśvaro bhavet ||
paścimābhimukhaṃ dīpaṃ pātraṃ tripalamātrakaṃ | sauvarṇarājataṃ tāmraṃ mārtikyaṃ dhātuyaṃ bhavet ||
dīpaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena ekaviṃśati taṃtubhiḥ | triyaṃ ca navarudraiśca vitastivartikāṃ caret ||
śopyatena palāṣṭena āhyapātraṃ samācaret | caturaṃgulamucchrāyaṃ sārddhāṃgulasamuttamaṃḥ ||
<183a>
vadhraṃguṇīlaproktaṃ kavacaṃ saptadhā bharet | dīpasvadevisaṃpūjya sāṃgāṃ sāvaraṇā śive ||
evaṃ krameṇa deveśi siddhimāpnoti sādhakaḥ | validānaṃ tataḥ kuryāt sātvikādi prabhedata ||
āpadūrddhārakaṃ japtvā doṣahīno naro bhavet | ayaṃ ca nitya dīpo hi triśakti viṣaṃ ye mataḥ ||
prāyaścitta prasaṃgeṇa kīrtitaḥ parameśvari | evaṃ doṣa vinimuktaḥ punaryantraṃ ca saṃgrahet ||
uktasaṃktāramāsādya svaguruktena vasmanāḥ | mahāvidyā vidhau proktaṃ śaivavaiṣṇava yo śṛṇu ||
upoṣya rajinīmekāmaghoraṃ lakṣamātrakaṃ | taddaśāṃśaṃ homakarma doṣahīnastato bhavet || 1 ||
saurehaṃ saṃjapecchive ||
gāṇape śrīharidrāṣya japtvā siddhiśvaro bhavet |
<183b>
anyathā kurute yastu tatvāpāpo bhaviṣyati | ayutaṃ trayamīcchanti divyaughāścātra pārvati ||
kaulikaḥ paśugāmī ca paraśaktiṃ ramedvalāt | goṣṭī madhye ca yatnena sparśaṃ tasyā na kārayet ||
aviṣekavinābhūte ācāryatvaṃ karoti yaḥ | yoni koṭi śataṃ yāti rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet ||
mātṛrūpaṃ parityajyāstrirūpaṃ śaktimādaret | sayāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ janmakoṭi śatāni ca ||
paraṃ lakṣatrayaṃ japtvā ajapāṃ lakṣameva ca | turyāvījaṃpaṃlakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ śuciṃ samācaret ||
atha mālāyatanādau prāyaścittamāha ||
pramādātmālikābhaṃgo prāyaścittaṃ samācaret | rahasya mālābhaṃge tu dadyācchāga vali naraḥ ||
<184a>
agni dagdhepi lakṣaṃ ca naṣṭe bhahasta cyutā yadi | caurānī ṣaṭ sahasraṃ patite triśataṃ japet ||
karāṅgraṣṭe śabdakṛte prajaperddhi śataṃ śataṃ | puraścaryā jape home mālāhastacyutā yadi ||
prāyaścittaṃ śataṃ japtvā taddaśāṃśa pravarddhanaṃ | tyajed daśāṃśaṃ tyarjāyaṃ prāyaścitta krameṇa ca ||
kecidatramamicchanti puraścaryā punarbhavet | prāyaścitta śataṃ japtvā puraścaranamāścaret ||
truṭitā meru mūle tu striṇāṃ tasya cādiśet | trutitā cet svayaṃ mālā prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ||
gajāntaka sahasraṃ tu japahomasamācaret | punaḥ saṃgrathanaṃ kṛtvā prāṇasthāpanapūrvakaṃ ||
tadā mālā siddhidā syān nānyathā śāṃkaraṃ vaca |
<184b>
atha grahamātṛkā mantramāha ||
athātasaṃḥpravakṣāmi grahamātṛ sudhāsanaṃ | grahamātṛrituṣṭāyaṃ kiṃ grahahaiduritairavi ||
grahamātari tuṣṭāyāṃ sugrahaiḥ kiṃ prayojapaṃ | maṃgarāpiṅgalāḍhānyā bhrāmalī bhadrikā tathā ||
ulkāsiddhāsaṃkaṭā ca vikaṭā garbhapālikā | raudranakṣatra tacāṣṭaujanmādhiṣṭhyā kramād daśā ||
phalaṃ nāmānurūpaṃ syādekopacayamābdayāḥ | piṃgalā sūryajanī mahāvyādhikārikā ||
tuṣṭāvecchatra vargasya ruṣṭā kuryācca sādhake | bjaṃ bījaṃ tu samuccārya piṃgale vairivāriṇi ||
prasīda phalaḍiti proktastrayogni śakti varṇikaḥ | dīrgha ṣaṭkayujā pūrva bījenavaṣaḍaṃgakaṃ ||
<185a>
piṃgavarṇāpiṃgakeśo piṃganetrādhunuḥ śacān | hastātyartha dadhatīṃ padmayugalaṃ tāṃ bhajāmyahaṃ ||
atha pūjā vidhiṃ vakṣya sarvāsāmevataṃ tatraḥ | japā puṣpāni śastā ca dhūpo tuggulasaṃbhavā ||
ghṛtapradīptamadhurā naivadyāḥ pāyasādayaḥ | alaṃkārāstathā raktāstathā vastrāṇi candanaṃ ||
svarṇalaṃkāraṇaiśvāpi samudravyairvahupaṃcakaiḥ | tarpayet parameśāniṃ tattanmantraiḥ sahasradhā ||
suvarṇa patre niḥcchaṃdre hastāyāme manorame | kṛtvā yaṃtraṃ yathoktaṃ tu yoginiṃ tatra pūjayet ||
tattanmantravalaṃ japtvā vighnaṃśātyai sahasrakaḥ | saptāhena prajāyete trividhot pāvavārakaṃ ||
<185b>
tataśca kuṃḍaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā ce caturasrakaṃ | athavā sthaṃḍile śuddhe sulipte gomayāṃ vubhiḥ ||
catuhasta pramāṇena yo jape sthiramānasaḥ | yogīnyaśvitu saṃsthāpya kṛtvā pūrvāditāḥ kriyā ||
anyāsāṃ daśavāraṃ tu viruddhāyāḥ sahasradhāḥ | vilva patrai tatphalaiśca kamallarāgakeśanaiḥ ||
juhuyāt pāyasānnena tathaivahulava pūjayet | sahasramayutaṃ cāpi lakṣaṃ vā kāmarā kramāt ||
athātasaṃpravakṣāmi madhye devīṃ prapūjayet | icchāṃ jñānāṃ kriyāṃ śaktiṃ triṣu koṇe pūjayet ||
pūjā prakāro homaśca sarvāsāmayameva hī | viśeṣaḥṣunaratrāstaśatrocchadābhicārakai ||
<186a>
khaḍgacarmādhārāmudrāṃ dhyāye padbhujadhārīnī | garuḍāsamamāsīnāṃ vainisigraha kālikā ||
lakṣamekaṃ prajapyādau japelakṣaṃ hi tapayet | sarvaśatru vināśaḥ syā duḥkhaṃ nāpnoti kutracit ||
athātasaṃpravakṣāmiścandramātuśca sādhakaḥ | māyādyā vahnijāyānto maṃgale maṃgalālaye ||
ekādaśākṣara mantro maṅgalādyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kṛtvātvena ṣaḍaṃgādi dīrghaṣaḍga pūjā tathā ||
dhyāyad deviṃ trinayanāmudyadāditya saṃnibhāṃ | darasmaramukhāṃ bhojāṃ sindurādharaṃ ||
padma dvaya dhanurvāṇān dadhantī bhujapalavaiḥ | sugaṃjanmajyamaṃjīraṃktaṃcīguṇa virājitāt ||
<186b>
evaṃ dhyātvā maheśāni pūrvavat paripūjayet | tatolabdhaṃ tanuṃ japtvā tāramāyā puraḥsaraṃ ||
yoginī kṣatravaṭuka gaṇādhipavaliṃ haret | sarvāsthayeta pūjāṃte maṃgalaiva prasīdati ||
yoginyārtupasārthāya lakṣajapemanuṃ | duyoginyānāṃ kulyārthaṃ jape tatsaṃkhyakā yutaṃ ||
śraṣṭadṛṣṭa prativaddha śubhāyāstu phalasya ca | prāptaje japatāṃ cat sahasraṃ pratyahaṃ japaṃ ||
prakartavyā varṇaśataṃ yāvaduṣṭā tu yoginī | sraṣṭāyā varṇadaśakaṃ rogiṇaṃ cābhiṃ mantrayet ||
varṇa tulya na mantreṇa yasyāḥ savāparo bhavet | tasya pīḍānivṛttavyodvarṇātyaṃgatatairdinai ||
sāyaṃ vidhirna vāṃtu vijñeyaḥ surasamāḥ |
<187a>
yoginī tulya phaladā vāma mārge ca dakṣiṇeḥ | athātaḥ saṃpravakṣāmi bhrāmarī bhaumamātaraṃ ||
kṣīṃ bhrāmapi padaṃ proktvā jayatāṃ me adhīśvari | bhrāmaya klīṁ ṣoḍaśānaurmatro syāḥ parīkīrtitaḥ ||
piṃgalāvat sarvasyāḥ siddhiyaṃ śarkarāndaśa | mantrayitvā na yāmarge daśadikṣu ca saṃtyajet ||
prātastatā vrajen mārgaṃ mārgasthāḥ sarva eva hi | sarve mohaṃ samāyāti vyāghrā sarpāśca taskarāḥ ||
śuklanāduṣṭabhūcāśca nityamekaṃ samācaret | upānatkatale yasya likhitvā nāma vā vrajet ||
yojanaikaṃ japen mantraṃ sabhramecca vasundharāṃ |
<187b>
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣāmi bhadrikāṃ budhamātara | vlūṁ bījaṃ toyabhūyo gārjānamādau samuccaret ||
bhaktike me mama bhadraṃ dehīti ca padaṃ punaḥ | vadercca parabhadrāṇi nāśaye dvitayaṃ tataḥ ||
svāhāntojinavarṇoyaṃ bhadrikāyā manurmataḥ | ṣaṭdīrgha yuktabījena ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vidhirīritaṃḥ ||
maṃgalā ca cchubhānāṃ syādhyānaṃ duḥphaladāyināṃ | piṃgalāvat samuddiṣṭaṃ japādyaṃ proktavartmanā ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhanyākhyāṃ gurumātaraṃ | śrīdhvajade samurccārya dhanya svāhāṣṭavarṇakaḥ ||
ṣaṭdīrghādya bījena ṣaḍaṃgaṃ vidhiritaḥ | nāsti dhanyā samākācidiha loke phala pradāḥ ||
<188a>
puraścaryā trayaṃ kṛtvā prāgunmārjita pātakaṃ | sastaṃtyadhanyā dadate dhanyatvaṃ sādhakayatu ||
vṛhaspatīśvarālpaścāt kāśvādhanyāṃ vilokayet | puraścaryā tatra kṛtvā vaṃśodhanyaḥ prajāyate ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi siddhyāśukrasya mātaraṃ | hrīṁ siddhamatsarva mānasamuktā sādhayatadvayaṃ ||
hṛdayāntā mantravarṇaḥ siddhāyā manurīritaḥ | bījenaiva ṣaḍaṃgāni japādyaṃ proktavaccaret ||
nāstisiddhā pāsakānāṃ karmasiddhistu kutracit | upāsakāye siddhāyā ye nāmnāya na jāyata ||
tadāmnāya padevānāṃ pākesyāḥ sarvameva hi | ṣaṭ karmasiddhyate tasya manorārādhanaṃ vinā ||
<188b>
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi cotkāmaṃdasya mātaraṃ | oṃ mama rogaṃ nāśāya bhaṃjakāyai daśākṣara ||
sarvarogāpaho mantrā marjanāt saptadyamataḥ | ulkā maṃtro yasya siddhā na gadāstasya maṃdire ||
śītāyāṃ mahāmayā mahiṣaṃ lakṣaṇānvitaṃ | ulkāprītyaitamutsṛjya nagare bhrāmayat punaḥ ||
nānāvādyaiḥ parivṛtaṃ vastrādibhiralaṃkṛtaṃ | utsṛjerttapamaśoyāmupadrava śamo bhavet ||
athāta saṃḥpravakṣyāmi saṃkaṭāṃ rāhumātaraṃ | hrīṁ saṃkaṭā caromame paramaṃ nāśaya dvayaṃ ||
ṣoḍaśārṇastu mantroyaṃ sarvaduḥkha panodayaḥ | kālā gṛhe jape rakṣaṃ bandhamokṣaḥ prajāyate ||
<189a>
vīreśvarādudaṅkāśyāṃ saṃkaṭā yatra saṃsthitā | tatra ṣoḍaśa lakṣāṇi japtvā homastu durvaryā ||
tasyā siddhā bhavenmantrastanmukhādyadi niḥsaret | amukasyāmukaṃ kaṣṭaṃ gaṃtaṃ tadgatameva hi ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi vikaṭāṃ ketu mātalaṃ | tārau namo bhagavati vikaṭe vīra pālike ||
prasīdayugalaṃ maṃtraḥ prakṛrtitā |
kāsyāṃ vīreśvarāsannārpaścime vikaṭā sthitā | tatra maṃtramidaṃ japtvā grahatastāśca vālukāḥ ||
udaraṃ cāpi vaṃdhyātvā praśavaṃbhyāstathā śiraḥ | yātrādibhistyakta vālāntathā mātṛvivarjitān ||
sādhakare pṛṣṭhā nīrogañcarajīvināḥ ||
<189b>
atha muktyupāyamāha ||
devyuvāca ||
kvacid dakṣaṃ kvacid vāmaṃ kvacit saucaṃ ca śāṃbhavaṃ | urddhāmnāyaṃ kvacid dakṣa mūrtaraṃ paraśvimaṃ kvacit ||
atha āmnāyakaṃ cāpi gāṇāpatyaṃ ca vaiṣuvaṃ | pārasīka kvaciddhaurddhā pāṣaṇḍaṃ ca kocikvācit ||
dvīpadharmātkhaṃḍa dharmāt kuladharmātkāladharmānvrāti dharmān kvacit cet |
tatta prakaraṇestauṣikvacinnindasitaṃ punaḥ | taṃtrottamamidaṃ tantraṃ praśannaśvetsurāpiri ||
tadā tatvaṃ mama bruhi niḥsaṃdehātsunītkuruḥ |
śrīśiva uvāca ||
ahokālasya māmyahaṃ taṃtra taṃtra tvayā punaḥ | pṛcchyate tat tadādhikyaṃ sohaṃ kālaṃ vravīmi tat ||
valeyaṃ sātviki carjā vā kālasyamvayā upakārāya sarveṣāṃ pṛtha tatvaṃ vravīmi tat ||
<190a>
yathā veda tathā loke yathākāraṃ prajāyate | yathā brahmāṇḍagoloyaṃ likhyate madhyetaḥ ||
satya tatra ca ṣaśyātvaṃ panitaṃ kiyadaṃtaraṃ | tathā nareṇa kālenta vede netaraśāstrataḥ ||
antaraṃ paśya deveśi śṛṇu tatvaṃ samātaraṃ | yathācānāhataḥ śabdo nare kṣapyaḥ pravartate ||
sa nityopi patetkaṇena kadāpi patet kaṇe | na kadāpi mūmūrṣataḥ ||
mahāpuruṣakālasya tathā vedadhvani smṛtaḥ | kaleddaśa sahasrāṇi yadā varṣāṇi yāṃcita ||
vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt kālā vayava jaṃtubhiḥ | na śrūyate tadā viṃjñeyaḥ(?> kālaḥ samāgataḥ ||
<190b>
vagjambhājuta padādi śabdāścotpartitaśvarā | vedabhinnāśināstrāṇi tathā jānaṃ tu devatāḥ ||
yasya śāstrasya lokesmin pracīrāyāvadastibhi | vātattamārgiṇāṃ saukhyaṃ vedamārgohya kuṃṭhitaḥ ||
tasyā tatmārgakattāraḥ śiṣyāt stanmantra dāyinaḥ | tānā nayaṃtisya mārge yatastāvat sukhaṃ bhavet ||
nṛpāṃ jñānaṃ yathā ṣaḍbhiriṃdriyai parijāyate | tathā ṣadaṃgai vedārtha jñānaṃ bhavati niścitaṃ ||
karmendriyāni ca tathā nṛṇāṃ paṃcamitāni tu | tadvatkāle maheśasya paṃcāmnāyā mayeritāḥ ||
urddhāmnāya samuddiṣṭaṃ vācikaṃ karma tasya tat | tatra pramānaṃ vedāḥ syustadaṃśāḥ syūtayastathā ||
tadaṃgāni purāṇāṇi gāyatryādyāstu devatāḥ |
<191a>
brahmabījaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ saṃskārā brahmasaṃmbhavāḥ | brahmaṇā caraṇaṃ brahma vidyābhi brāhmaṇo bhavet ||
yasyāvakṣyāvayaṃ yasya vāca madhye tu dhāvati | ekasmillakṣaṇe hīne vāgartha manu dhāvati ||
dvihine lakṣaṇe devi svācālā brāhmaṇo bhavet | lakṣaṇa traya hīnoyastaṃtra mārgeṇa siddhyati ||
catulakṣaṇahīnānāṃ mārgāḥ syu kaulikādayaḥ | etallakṣaṇa bhinnena yathā dehaṃ yathākulaṃ ||
yathājāti yathākālaṃ kartavyaṃ dharmasaṃgrahaḥ | mithyāsaṃbhāṣaṇastayaṃ sarvamārgeṣu garhitaṃ ||
yatkiṃcirjanmayet karma na japo na tapaḥ kriyā | jīvanmuktaḥ satya vaktā sarvasatye pratisthitaṃḥ ||
<191b>
ahiṃsā paradharmormaḥ sa ca vākkāya karmabhiḥ | dṛḍho yasya na cāro na jātiḥ sopi muktavat ||
parasartāya tatrantu viṣṭāvadyasya cetasi | sa puṣkalaupi jānī hī jīvanmukta na saṃśayaḥ ||
paḍindriyijñiyajñānavatāṃ sṛṣṭi bhavati maithūnāt | tyaktaṃ tanmanasā yena jīvanmuktaḥ sa kopī hi ||
vedāḥ pūjanamicchaṃtistathādvarddhāḥ pratigrahān | śukavadyo pratigrāhī jīvanmuktaḥ sanyavīhi ||
śaucaṃ prakurvatā nityaṃ viṣṭhā vuddhiḥ kale vale | dehamābhimāno galito jīvamuktaḥ sa eva hi ||
yaṭhecchalābhasaṃtuṣṭaḥ stautinona ca viṃdati | na mukhena dugdhaḥkhe karmanāśāt mucyate ||
<192a>
hitvā viṣaya saukhyaṃ yastapastapati nirjane | na phalaṃ kāmayat kiṃcirjīvamuktaḥ sa eva hi ||
yāvad dehasya nirvāhastāvat kalaṃ parikṣipet | vedasyātyāstaḥ sarvaṃḥ yonayet sa tu mokṣamāt ||
kohaṃ kīṃ dṛśyate kartā kāsyayāti kvacetasi | iti saṃbhāvayaṃ nityaṃ mahākāle layaṃ vrajet ||
kalau pāpa samākīrṇe na samābhirna yogatā | yadi yogā bhaved devi na hi tatra phalaṃ bhavet ||
tasmāt kāraṇatā devi mantrayogaṃ samatyajet | ete tu bhūgamopāya nātracittasthiraṃ bhavet ||
kāmakrodhārisaṃtaptaṃ mahāmāyā vimohitaṃ | durvijñayā durnivārā mahākālāsyagyehinī ||
<192b>
tadaṃśārādhanāt sā tu prasannā cedvimuṃcati | suvuddhibhiḥ priyaiḥ putrairyathā matā pratāyate ||
tathā pratāryate ceyaṃ jīve muktaḥ sa jāyate | kṛtaṃ vaṃdhyārtha manayā khānapānaṃ ca maithunaṃ ||
te naiva cediyaṃ varddhā svayaṃ muktastathā bhavet | vāmikaikolikaistammādajñānaiśca guruṃ vināḥ ||
samastairathavā jñānai vaddhyateyaṃ na cetaraiḥ | vaṃdhyeyaṃ vaṃdhanaiḥ svasya troṭayaṃdvaṃdhanāni ca ||
bhāvayecca mahākālaṃ jīvanmuktastadā bhavet | vaṃdhamokṣa prakārastu tatrayaṃ kulitā matāḥ ||
yaijñānā gurumārgena taivarddheyaṃ sadustarāḥ | sukṛtānmānavo bhūtvā jñānī ce mokṣamāyāt ||
caturāśīti lakṣe vuṃ (?) śarīreṣurīriṇāṃ |
<193a>
namānuṣyaṃ vinānyatra tatvajñānaṃ tu labhyate | atra janma sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrairapi pārvati ||
kadācillabhyate jantu mānuṣyaṃ puṇye saṃcayāt | sopānabhūtaṃ mokṣasya mānuṣyaṃ prāpyadurlabhaṃ ||
yastārayati nānmānaṃ tasyatvāpatarotrakaḥ | naraḥ prāpyottamaṃ janma labddhā cendriya sauṣṭavaṃ ||
na vetyān mahitayamtu sambhavedbrahma ghātakaḥ | vinā dehena kasyāpi puruṣārthā na vidyate ||
tasmād dehaṃ dhanaṃ dhanaṃ rājyaṃ puṇyakarma niyojayet | lakṣayet sarvadānmānamānmā sarvasya bhājanaṃ ||
rakṣaṇe satvamātiṣṭejjīvana bhadrāṇi paḥśyati | punagrāmaṃ punaḥkṣetraṃ punarvittaṃ puna gṛhaṃ ||
<193b>
punaḥ śubhakarma na śarīraṃ punaḥ punaḥ | śarīra rakṣaṇāyā saḥ satataṃ kriyate janaiḥ ||
yāvat tiṣṭhati dehīyaṃ tāva tatvaṃ samabhyaset | brahmāviṣṇumaheśāni devatā bhūtajāyataḥ ||
nāśamevānudhāvaṃti tasmāt tatvaṃ samabhyaset | yāvan na jīyate duḥkhaṃ yovannā yāti cāpadaḥ ||
yāvannendriyakai vaikalpaṃ vartāttatvaṃ samabhyaset | itthaṃ sarvasamākhyāta tavāgremapi pārvatiḥ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgamasāre ṣaṭviṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 26 ||
atha balidānaṃ ||
athāte validānaṃsya vadhiratra nigadyate | valistu trividhau jñeyastāṃtrikasmāttanya vaca ||
<194a>
vaidikaśceti tatrādau tāntrikoṣṭa vidhaḥ smṛtaḥ | nityā'ni paśuvalirnityo naimirttikārcane ||
āvaśyakaḥ paśuvalistasmānnaimirttika vidhau | paśūnāyāṃti bhedena bhinnā ca prokṣaṇa kriyā ||
pūjānte vakṣyate sāpi validāna kṣaṇe priye | valitvena vinirdiṣṭā mahiṣaṣṭāgalādayaḥ ||
jalajāsthā lajāścāpi grāmajāraṇyajāstathā | paśyavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kīṭāstīryagyonayavaca ||
ime vidhātrā vihitā valitvena divaukasāṃ | nānyai naivedye saṃbhāraistathā tuṣyanti devatāṃ ||
yathā paśūnāṃ valibhirvīhigānāṃ tathaiva ca | ata eva hi deveśi yajñādau vihitasvasau ||
devānāṃ priyaśabdastu paśuparyāya ucyate |
<194b>
evaṃ vijñāya siddhantaṃ devyāḥ saṃtoṣahetave ||
paśun dadyād valiṃ tvena madhyānapihitāḥ priye | ālabheta vṛṣaṃ śvetāṃ yajñaṃ gomadhanāmani ||
naramedhe naraṃ cāpi gajakrānte gajantathā | aśvamedha śaṃkhacūḍkṣevahastinaṃ ||
vravīti yatrakaivavidopi tatra cāṇaṇā | tasmānnaimirtīkārcāryā valirāvaśyakaḥ priye ||
viśeṣeṇa pradātavyo devī saṃtoṣahetave | valimvinā naiva devī pūjānaṃgī karoti hi ||
tatrāpyūbhau praśasyate mahiṣañchāga eva ca | anya devo citavali vicāraiḥ kiṃ prayojanaṃ ||
yena saṃtuṣyate kālī tadvicāraṃ bruve dhunā |
<195a>
āraṇya athavā grāmya jalavaijānāṃ ca jāyataḥ | khagānāṃ jātayaścāpi tā evādau vravīmide ||
matsyāmṛgāvarāhaśca kacchapā mahiṣāstathā | gaṃḍakyā godhikāgrāhāḥ śārkalā harayo pivā ||
nakulāśalabhāścāpi gavayāñcāpi galāstathā | manuṣyāpakṣiṇaścāpi teṣāṃ kośā api priye ||
bhagavatyā valitvena vidhātrā vali kalpitāḥ | eteṣāṃ validānena sarvakāryāṇi sādhayet ||
atha validāna phalaṃ ||
valibhivarddhate kāyurvalibhiḥ śāmyaterujā | jayetparātīn valibhirvalibhiḥ prāpyate dhanaṃ ||
valibhistridivaṃ vrajet ||
niṣkāmānaṃ valaudarte prāpyo mokṣyopi yad bhavet |
<195b>
atha jāti bhedā tathovakṣya samāsāduparāraye | aṣṭādaśavidhāmatsyo caturviṃśatidhāmṛgā ||
varāhāḥ paṃcadhā proktāstribhedāḥ kacchapādvibhedāmabhiṣāstadvagaṇḍakāśca caturvidhāḥ ||
gādhikā ca tribhedāsyurdvividhā grāha eva ca | trividhau vyāghrasiṃhau ca nakulo dvidhāpi ca ||
śalabhaiścaikajātiḥ syānnāsya bhedo varānane | gavayastrividhaḥ proktaḥ chāgaḥ ṣaṣṭhavidhau mataḥ ||
caturvidhā manuṣyāśca ṣaṭtriṃśa jātayaḥ khagā | krameṇa nāmānya teṣāṃ vyāharāmi tava priyā ||
atha paśulakṣaṇaṃ ||
śreṣṭastatra kalau devi mahāpīṭhe narovali mahāpīṭhe naro valiḥ || kartavyaḥ sādhakendreṇa sacārogī ca sundaraḥ ||
<196a>
dhātuvarddhaḥ kṛṣṇakurcokṣarādiranulomajaḥ | mulyodgrīhītaḥ pāpiṣṭā devataiḥ svayamāgataḥ ||
varṣaṣaṇmāsamarthavā yathaicchācārapālita | sa bhaved valiyogyastu nānyaścaurādikī hṛtaḥ ||
mahiṣaḥ paṃcamādurddhaṃ daśādhastādvanodbhavaḥ | grāmajopi mahakrūro nīrakusāṃḍaukavarṇakaḥ ||
āraktākṣaścordha gṛgrodīghapucchaśca māṃsala | anāravāhakobhīto vali yogyaḥ paro nasat ||
vanasthāḥścaita varṇoyāvana eva prapālitaḥ | mahāśūromāṃśalaśca śukaro yogya ucyate ||
ūrddhaṃ trivarṣāt saptārvāk magnihīnaśca māsalaḥ |
<196b>
ekavarṇo devatāyā varṇarūpo śadojjhitaḥ | sāṃḍaḥ sasṛgoyurgaśāgaṃdhimānauṣadhādibhiḥ ||
vigaṃdhī kṛtya valaye yohyaṃḥ sarvottamamṛyaṃ | ajasya lakṣaṇaṃ devi kathayāmi viśeṣataḥ ||
urddhasaṃgamurddha lomālambakaṇaśvapīvaraḥ | sāhaṃkāraḥ puṣṭatanurvalīpalita varjitaḥ |
lambakarṇaḥ śurddhakṛṣṇaḥ praśastaḥ paśulakṣaṇaḥ | śvetaḥ kṛṣṇālohitaśca kapilaścitra pāṃḍarau ||
paddhidhañchāgalaḥ proktā gṛhasthānāṃ palovaliḥ | uttamausita kṛṣṇai ca madhyamau citrapāḍalau ||
lohitaḥ kapilañcaiścaiva kaviṣṭha parikīrtitaḥ | trimāsāt parataścaiva yāvarddhorṣa dvayaṃ bhavet ||
urttamosau valiḥ proktāstasmārddhīnodhamaḥ smṛtāḥ |
<197a>
kṛṣṇavarṇo valiryastu śvetapūccho yadā bhavet | cchāgalaṃ tādṛśaṃ vidvān duraḥ parivarjayet ||
evaṃ site kṛṣṇapucche varjayenmatimātsadā | kṛṣṇavarṇyecchagalastu pṛṣṭhavaṃśesito yadi ||
praśastaṃ taṃ vijānīyād viparītaṃ tu varjayet | paṃcābdaṃ mahiṣaṃ śvetaṃ praśastaṃ parikīrtitaṃ ||
sa eva mahiṣaḥ śvetaṃ praśastaṃ parikīrtitaṃ | sa eva mahiṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pāṃḍaleścādhamo valiḥ ||
pañkṣiṇastu praśastāḥ syuḥ sarvavarṇaḥ suśobhanāḥ | tripakṣāt parataścaiva dine cāpi vivarjayeḥ ||
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ devatānāṃ tathaiva ca | ati kālaḥ prītidaśca yajñapyeko viśiṣyate ||
meṣaḥ sa śṛṃgastvājavacchṛṃga hīnopi kutracit | varṣacca yāyārdhaṃ ca gṛhe pālito valavartaraḥ ||
<197b>
māṃsabhārottathodāne nakṣamaḥ sāraso varaḥ | nīlakaṃṭhacchaviḥ kaṃṭhe kaghotaḥ puṣṭakaṃdharaḥ ||
varṣādūrddhaṃ gṛhe puṣṭo valyarthaṃ yogya ucyate | sarvaṣāmagratorauti yaḥ prātarvahuvarṇakaḥ ||
māṃsalastveka varṇe vā tāmracūḍo viśiṣyate ||
atha niṣiddhāni ||
kāścinniṣirddhānukṣyāmi vihiteṣu valiṣvapiḥ | grāmyānāthavanyānāṃ paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||
striyaṃ naiva prajurjīta valikarmani sādhakaḥ | jñānapūrvavaliṃ datvā narakaṃ pratipadyate ||
ajñānena viniryāti kiṃcit pāyaṃ samaśnute | atrisāsasamutpannaṃ paśuṃ na viniyojapet ||
punastarddhānugataṃ jātu devyai samarpayet | bhagnaṃ śṛgaṃ bhagnadantamacchinnānālameva ca ||
kāṇaṃ vyaṃgaṃ roginaṃ ca śṛgāhatanaraṃ tathā |
<198a>
duṣṭaṃ galitaromānaṃ kṣīrapaṃcagaladviśaṃ | paśunadadṛśaṃ tathā caiva hi hāyasaṃ ||
cchinna troṭiṃ cchinnapakṣaṃ nugnamāhāravarjitaṃ | anuḍḍīnaṃ tathā kāśe māturaṅkaparisthitaṃ ||
vihitāvarya vijñatau na dadyāpaśupakṣiṇau ||
bhagnāṅgahīnaḥ kṛrtārṇo vālovṛrddho na śasyate | na dadyāt strī paśormāṃsaṃ havyakavye viśeṣataḥ ||
athānukalpaḥ ||
deveśa cānukalpasya vidhiṃ brūhi satvaraṃḥ | vānaprastho brahmacārī gṛhastho vādayo paraḥ ||
sātvikī brahmaniṣṭhaśca yaśva hiṃsā vivarjataḥ | tena dadyuḥ paśuvalimanukalpaṃ caransvapi ||
tartāt padānānāṃ phalāvātyai varānane | ghṛtagodhumaikṣavyadyaiḥ phātitairanujaistathā ||
kṛtvā taṃ taṃ paśu dadyustartat phalamāpnuyuḥ |
<198b>
kuṣmāṇḍa panasā savū(?) karkaṭī vīlvaḍāḍimāḥ | drākṣākharjuralakucarasālā'malajambūkaṃ ||
nālikelekṣudaṇḍāśca mocāmomrātakatīrkarāḥ | nālikaṃlekṣudaṇḍāśca mocāmrātakatīrkarāḥ ||
bījapūrāgaraṃgāstālāṃ ca phalalāpi | vali tulyāni caitāni chāgatulyāni tṛptiṣu ||
māhiṣatvena kuṣmāṇḍaṃ cchāgatvenaiva karkatīṃ | vṛrtākaṃ kurkuṭe tvena tathā kośātakaṃ mṛge ||
pāyaṃsaṃtugagajatvena mārjātve kulasthakaṃ | paṭolaṃśūkaratvena śarkarāvāllukaṃ tathā ||
khaḍgatvena maheśāni matsatve kadalī phalaṃ | mukhatve mūlakaṃ caiva sāraṃgatvekaliṃjakaṃ ||
<199a>
kalitvenārikelaṃ ca kalpayet parameśvari | māṣāḥ sarva valitvena sarveṣāṃ kṛśarānnataḥ ||
pāyasā pūpasaṃtāpāsnuḍḍrakaiḥ kaśarāntakaiḥ | śākodanaistathā supaipiṇyākādrakapolikā ||
vaṭakālasunaṃ gṛjaṃ kalijaṃ bījahodaraṃ | nānopāyaiḥ ṣaḍrasaiśca valireṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
krūravidyāvidhau devi paśuṃpiṣṭayaṃ caret | yavakṣoda mayaṃ vāpi yadvā dhānyasamudbhavaṃ ||
māṣapiṣṭamayaṃ devi sarvakarmaṇi kārayet | guḍārddhaka dadhiguḍo lavaṇaṃ guḍameva ca ||
kuṣmāṇḍaṃ nālikeraṃ vā śrīphalaṃ cakṣumeva ca | vastra saṃveṣṭitaṃ kṛtvā chedayacchulikādibhiḥ ||
eṣasmārtā valiḥ proktā dharmaśāstrānumināṃ |
<199b>
pūrvapūrvātrāpi coktā viśiṣṭo devatāṣakaḥ | yasya yatrādhibhaktistena tuṣyati devatāḥ ||
vaidikaṃ tu valiṃ dadyādodanaṃ svinna māyamān | sarocana mati krūra daivate vaṭate kānvitaṃ ||
yathānukalpayogena yoginiyaṃ maheśvariḥ | yathoktavidhimāsādya yathoktaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||
atha prokṣaṇaṃ ||
śrīpārvatyuvāca ||
prasūnāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ devi prakārāṇi kathaṃ vibho |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
deyādeya vicārastu etāvānupavarṇitaḥ | sthāna pātrādhikāriṃṣṭa dānakāla kramopi ca ||
idānīṃmekarūpeṇa sarveṣāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu | vārāhī yamunā gaṃgā karatoyā sarasvatī ||
<200a>
kāverī candrabhāgā ca siṃdhu bhairava sāgarāḥ | ajasnane maheśāni sānidhyamiha kalpayet ||
arghapātrodakaiḥ śuddhairmūla na prokṣaya triśaḥ | paśupāvināśāya hemakūṭa sthitāya ca ||
parāya parameṣṭhire hūṃkārāya ca mūrtayet | bilva patrodakairebhiḥ prokṣaṇaṃ kārayedaye ||
paśunāṃ yatra vāhulyaṃ bhavedvirtānusārataḥ | tatraiva prathamaṃ devi sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ ||
ḍḍarjasvinaṃ sundraraśca valinaṃ paśumutsṛjet | anantaraṃ krameṇaiva na ca tatra vicāraṇā ||
astra mantreṇa saṃrakṣya kavacenāva guṇṭha ca | mūlamantraṃ samuccārya dhenumudrāḥ mṛtīkṛtaṃḥ ||
gandhapūṣpākṣataissamyak paripūjyo pacārakaiḥ ||
<200b>
valisaṃpūjya vidhivad gaṃdhapūṣpākṣatādibhiḥ | caitanyaṃ kāma ḍākinyo bījatrayamidaṃ sthitaṃ ||
vākpādo phatparaṃ pāyurūpakhyā cakṣuṣī tataḥ | karṇau sarvāṅganitato manaḥśeṣe nigadyate ||
sarasvati ca pṛthivī mitraśca jalameva ca | tejā nabho diśaḥ kālī līyatāñca kriyā padaṃ ||
hṛdadvastu śīrṣāṇyante ca manavo'ṣṭau sphuṭā matāḥ | pādyārghā camanīyādyau gandhapuṣpai valiṃ tataḥ ||
pūjayed devatā vuddhyā praṇamen manasā tathā ||
atha pasu gāyatrī yathā ||
paśoḥ karṇe cāpi paśu gāyatrīṃ tadanurcaret | tatparaṃ tanmanuṃ cāpi samurddhāraṃ śṛṇu dvayoḥ ||
yoginī bījato ṅentaṃ valirūpaṃ tu vidmahe |
<201a>
devī priye pūrvā vaca dhīmahītiḥ paraṃ | tannaḥ paśuditi procya vadercātha pracodayāt ||
atha khaḍgalakṣaṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tantra vartmanā | yena saṃcchedanenāpi sādhakaḥ siddhimālabhet ||
sarveṣāmurtamaḥ khaḍgaścandrahāsaḥ sukhāvahaḥ | paṃcāśadaṃguloḥ kāryaḥ kimvā tālatrayeṇa tu ||
karavīradalākāraḥ kimvā padma dalā kṛtiḥ | athavā kubjakhaḍgeṇa daṇḍakhaḍgeṇa bhedayet ||
mahāvalīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ dātramatra prakīrtitāt | kartakayāṃ kṣureṇāpi chidyācchurikayā na ca ||
kuṭhāraparśu khaṃḍābhaiścchedadyeyenna kadācana | khaḍgāgramadhyemuṣṭo tu mithunānāṃ trayaṃ japet ||
vāgīśī sahito brahmā lakṣmī nārāyaṇau tathā |
<201b>
umā maheśvaro caiva tata āvāhayedasau | kālī kṛtānta sadṛśīṃ yenacchedyo valiḥ priye ||
māyā kurcaḥ śākini ca ehyehi bhagavatyapi | cāmuṇḍā cātha sānidhyaṃ kuru yugmatyadhiṣṭhitā ||
bhavadvayaṃdhihinaṃ phaṭ yugaṃ śiraḥ | khaḍgasya mūlamantreṇa khaḍgaṃ samābhi pūjayet ||
tārapāśa trayākūrca śākinībhiḥ ucyate | dhyāyet kuśumādāya khaḍgamādau valānane ||
kṛṣṇāpiṇākapāṇi ca kālatārāti svapiṇaṃḥ | ugraṃ raktāsya nayanaṃ raktamālyānulepanaṃ ||
raktāmbara dharaṃ caiva pāśahastaṃ dumbinaṃḥ | pibamānaśca rudhiraṃ bhujānaṃ kravyasaṃhatiṃ ||
kṣobhayantaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kaṃpanādi prasāraṇaiḥ |
<202a>
veṣṭitaṃ mṛtyukālābhyāṃ vāmadakṣiṇabhāgataḥ | pūrvāditena mantreṇa pratyekaṃ kīrtitena hi ||
gandhapūṣpākṣataiddhūpa dīpaipādyādibhairyajet | tato varddhājali mantraṃ paṭhet khaḍgartirīkṣyavīḥ ||
rasanātvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ suraloka prasādhaka | tukṣau tasya paśoraktaṃ kravyasaṃhaṃtimeva ca ||
cchiṃdhīmamiva me śatru magalāni prayaccha ca | daityadānavarakṣo sṛk madonmatta namostute ||
etena khaḍgamāntrya tannāmāṣṭakamuccaran | gṛhnīnniśitaṃ khaḍgaṃ yena satyo bhaved vadhaḥ ||
aśirviṃśa saḥ khaḍgastīkṣnudhārodurāsadaḥ | śrīgarbhā vijayaścaiva dharma pālastu namostuteḥ ||
<202b>
tārakāṃ yugaṃ yajña śārilohapadaṃ vadet | daṃḍāyai nama ityaten mantraṃḥ ṣoḍaśa varṇakaḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā tata utthāya sādhakaḥ | praharāṇāṃ capi kālī teṣāmeva vidhiyate ||
soyaṃ vā bhrātṛ putro vā bhrātā vā suhṛdevatāḥ | sa piṇḍaṃścedeyadvāpi śuddhātaḥ karaṇo yadi ||
nari pūrṇāṃ gahino vā na kāṇaṃ nāpi kubjakaṃ | na yojayecchatru pakṣaṃ valicchadana karmaṇi ||
urtarābhi mukho bhūtvā valipūrva mukhaṃ tathā | nīrīkṣya sadhakaḥ paścādidaṃ mantramudirayet ||
paśustvaṃ vali rūpeṇe mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ | praṇamāmi tataḥ sarvarūpiṇaṃ valilupiṇaṃ ||
caṇḍikā prīti dānena dāturāpadvināśinaṃ | cāmuṇḍā valirūpāya valatubhyaṃ namostuteḥ ||
yajñārthe valayaḥ sṛṣṭāsvayameva svayaṃbhuvā |
<203a>
atastāṃ ghātayāmyadye tasmād yajña vadho'vadheḥ | śivāt kṛtamidaṃ piṇḍaṃ matastvaṃ śivatāṃgataḥ ||
uvuddhyāsvapaśotva hinā śivatvaṃ śivāhyasiḥ ||
aiṃ hrīṁ miti mantreṇa vaṁte valimatsvarūpiṇaṃ | cintayitvā nyaset puṣpaṃ kumbhakenāsyastakaḥ ||
chitvānena paśu sadyastadīyaṃ rudhiraṃ priye | tataḥ svarṇādi pātreṣu gṛhnīyadurṣṇa phaṇilaṃ ||
pātrāṇi yathāḥ ||
atha pātrādi vakṣehaṃ sthāpyate yatra śoṇitaṃ | haime vā rājate tāṃmre grāhyaṃ raktā mahībhṛtāḥ ||
samantarmaṇḍalīkaiśca tāmre vākaṃsyaraisvayoḥ | daridra gṛhibhiścāpi mārtake vātha dārava ||
atha vāṅmapute vānaiva lohe kadācana ||
<203b>
naraṃgesī sakevāpi nālikela phaletvaci | kaulāṇāṃ sarvapātrebhyaḥ kapālaṃ nānyamīṣyate ||
yeṣā paśūnāṃ palalai yāvatī tṛptirīritā | bhagavatyā priye tṛptī rudhirairapi tāvatī ||
nitya naimittike vāpi kātyāyanyāḥ prasūjane | vinā kali naiva dadyādāme palalaśoṇite ||
paśorvā pakṣiṇo vāpi narasyāpi viśeṣataḥ |
atha mastakapati phalaṃ ||
evaṃ datvā valiṃ devyai validānavidhiryayāḥ |
śubhāśubhaṃ svajānīyādrāhyasya ca nṛpasya ca | yadi vayavya digbhāge nairṛtya dakṣiṇepi vā ||
mastake patite caiva hāriratra vinirdīśet | śeṣeṣu dikṣu sarvāsu vidikṣu ca phalaṃ śṛṇuḥ ||
<204a>
sarvacorttara digbhāge patate yadi mastakaḥ | sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ vidyā ḍājārājyaṃ virdiśet ||
bhramitvā dakṣiṇe karṇe yadā patati vai śiraḥ | tadā siddhiṃ ca māsāṃte vāmakarṇe viparbhavet ||
rājñāmagre bhaverddhāṇirgṛhasthānāṃ śubhaṃ bhavet | aiṁśānya madhyayoścaiva patate yadi mastakaṃḥ ||
tadā svalpena kālena sarvasiddhi bhaved dhruvaṃ | cchinnaśiro nipatitaṃ sahāsyaṃ yadi dṛsyateḥ ||
vibhūtiṃ tasya jāniyād rājārājyaṃ vinirdiśet | ekavāre bhavet siddhīṃrdivārehāninucyate ||
gṛhasthānāṃ vijānīyādrājñāṃ bhuviparītakaṃ | yadāśru dṛśyatetra tadāhāniṃ vinirdiśet ||
yadā kaṭakaṭā śabdo dantānā śrūyate kvacit |
<204b>
tadā tu maraṇaṃ vidyārddhāniṃsarvatra vinirdiśet | datyādrakṣasadigbhāge mantrī valiśiraḥ svayaṃ ||
tarddakṣiṇe raktapātraṃ viparītaṃ na saṃdadet | devasya saṃmukhaṃ kṛtvā cchinnaṃ bhāgaṃ prakalpayet ||
tadaiva śastaṃ jānīyān madhyamaṃ viparītakīṃ | valīnāmiti saṃjñānaṃ śiraśca purato dadet ||
kīlakānte nyatsarvaṃ yathākampo na jāyate | śīrṣopari jvalad dīpaṃ pradadyārcandranākṣataṃḥ ||
ghṛtena sārvabhaumaḥ syāta na siddhi ca vindati | śiraśca saṃmukhe sthāpyaṃ sa dīpaṃ pātravarjitaṃ ||
sa cāpi haviraktaḥ syādatha vā tilajākṣitaḥ | sārṣaprana pradātavyaṃ na cānya phalasaṃbhava ||
<205a>
murddhābhidhiktā habhiṣā tailena vahusiddhibhāt | anyavīnodbhavairogaṃ śokaṃ mṛtyu ca vindatiḥ ||
yathā lomāni dahyante yartāt kāryantathā naraiḥ | sūtravartiṃ pradadyārca vastravartyā praśyate ||
aṃguṣṭhasya pramāṇaṃ ca dīrgha caiva ṣaḍaṃgulaṃ | kārtalasutrai dadyādeka viṃśati sūtrakaiḥ ||
sugandhī dravyaista kuryāt kurpūrāgurucandanaiḥ | grahāṇāṃ kacchapānāṃ ca godhāyāśca viśeṣataḥ ||
tatsyārāmapi pakṣīṇāṃ na dīpaṃ dāpayecchiraḥ | śīrṣopari jvalad dipo yāvat kālaṃ vattata ||
tāvat kālaṃ vaset svarga tasmād yatnena dāpayet | homadāhod bhavaṃ gaṃdha ghrātvā devī prasīdatati ||
tasmāt saṃvarddhayedvīpaṃ tasmāt pātraṃ vivarjayet | nirvāṇe mṛtyumāpnoti dīyamāne pradīpake ||
<205b>
tataḥ pātraṃ purakṛtvā devyāḥ paśuśobhitaṃ | śarkarā yutadurvāṇāṃ pradadyā trimahāghṛtaṃ ||
saindhavaṃ śṛṃgavairaṃ ca kadalī phalameva ca | pātayen madhurāṇāṃ ca kāmamurddiśyasādhakaḥ ||
aṣṭadhā vibhajed vidvān madhye caikaṃ kuśādibhiḥ | datvā kiṃcit ghṛta tatra kuryātartapamudrayā ||
tarpaṇaṃ bhāgabhājāṃ vai devīnāṃ dvirdvireva ca | ādyantimautālāhārddi madhya ādi manonipi ||
tartannāmānnamapi ca tarpayāmiti saṃyutaṃḥ | dvitīyaṃ rūpaṃ ṅentāṃ ca tadvitīyo padoditaṃ ||
madhye nityodita ākhyā pātravat pīṭhaśā kriyā | pūrvasyāṃ diṣṭhi cāmuṇḍā dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu yoginī ||
ḍākikhuktā paścimāyā murtarasyāṃ tu bhairavī |
<206a>
vidāgikāgne kāṇe nairṛtyāṃ pāparākṣasī ||
pūtanā cāpi vāyavye aiśāne kālikā tathā | tata stutiṃ prakurvīta varddhājali puṭāgrataḥ ||
jaya devi jagatmātāt rjayapāpaughahāriṇā | jaya janma jalāvyādhi tṛṇyādāvānālā kṛte ||
jayasarvavipartighne jaya tridaśavandite | jayanityānandarūpe jayakaltāṇa dāyine ||
ryayatruśakṣakareryata jayaroga praṇāsini | jayabhīme jayaghore jagaśaṃkaṭatāriṇi ||
jayamṛtarasā svāda tundilāmandavigrahā | trinetra kikalālāsye muṇḍamālāvibhūṣite ||
sarvāsurakṣaye karikhaḍgakhaṭvāṃga dhāriṇī | mahāghore mahārāve daityadarpanisudani ||
imaṃ paśuvaliṃ devi gṛhātvā kālarātrike | prītā bhava mahācaṇḍe rakṣamāṃ śaraṇāgataṃḥ ||
<206b>
āyurā hi dhanaṃ devi bhāgyaṃ kīrtiṃ ca dehi me | striyaṃ dehi sutāndre hi sarvākāmāṃśca dohi me ||
ugra caṇḍe pracaṇḍāsi pracaṇḍakaravālini | mahācaṇḍogradordaṇḍe viśveśvari namostute ||
rakṣamāṃśaraṇāpatvaṃ tvapādārpita mānasaṃ | harapāpaṃharakte haraśokaṃ harāsukhaṃ ||
hararogaṃ harakṣobhaṃ haradaityaṃ hara priye | stuti metāṃ paṭhitvaivaṃ daṇḍavat praṇame bhuvi ||
guhyakāli jagaddhātri sarvāntaryāmi niśvari | gṛhetvemaṃ paśuvaliṃ yathokta phaladā bhava ||
kāyena na manasā vācā tvartā nanyāgatirmamaḥ | antaścarasi bhūtānāṃ uṣṭītvaṃ parameśvariḥ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgamasare saptaviṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 27 ||
<207a>
atha sarvāpayuktatayā mātṛkāvarṇānāṃ pratyekaṃ dhyānādikamāhaḥ ||
śrībhairavovācaḥ ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi pañcāśad varṇa nirṇayaṃ | yairvyāptamakhilaṃ devi traulokyaṃ sa carācaraṃ ||
ekaikasya tu varṇasya dhyānadhāranarūpakaṃḥ | āyudhanyānasaṃṅmudrāḥ karma teṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthak ||
eta sarvaṃ samāse ca śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te | vahuśā mantrakāṭyastu sāsāṃrasaṃ bhavanti ca ||
satpādyāḥ paśavaḥ proktā īśānāntāḥ sumadhyemeḥ | brahmādeṣāṃ caredajño mocānāyānakaṃ prati ||
pañcāśadakṣarā ete kalāḥ pañca tathaiva ca | pṛthivyāṃ jāni bhūtāni pañcaitāni pṛthak pṛthak ||
dvisapta bhuvaṇaṃ sarvaṃ brahma vyāpti samantataḥ | ebhyo mantrā samudbhūtā nānākarmaścarāścaye ||
mantrāṇāṃ caiva rūpaṃñca pramānaṃ daivataṃ tathā |
<207b>
brahmāṇi ca bhujāṃ caiva varṇānvarṇa yudhāni ca | sādhakāya na jānanti na teṣāṃ siddhidā kvacit ||
yāni karmāni kurvaṃnti yatra yatrāpi jojitāḥ | tasmāt sarva prajannena jñātavyā mātṛkā vudhāḥ ||
kakāraṃ kanakābhasaṃ sauvarṇa kalaśāsanaṃḥ | suvarṇakavacaṃ haimaṃ mahāpuruṣavigrahaṃ ||
khaḍgahastaṃ catubhujaṃ mahāsau uṃcatubhujaṃḥ | kṣobhayat pṛthivī sarvāsa śailarakālanaṃḥ ||
puruṣo asmare nityaṃ viṣanāśāyakā kathāḥ || 1 ||
khakālaṃ dhūmravarṇābhaṃ cāpapāṇi kharāsanaṃ | triśīrṣa tribhujaṃ raudraṃ tricālaṃ navalocanaṃḥ ||
sarvagrahaharahyantamantarāya haraṃntathāḥ | sarvajvala halaṃ caiva grahasainya vimardanaṃḥ || 2 ||
<208a>
gakālaṃ gaganārūḍhamaṣṭavāhuṃ catumukhaṃḥ | triśūlapāṇi raudraṃ ca himakundendu sannibhaṃ ||
viṣanāśayate hyeṣamarjāgramasthiśaṃ tathā | gajavaktraṃ svayaṃ hyantaṃ sarvavighnavināśanaṃ || 3 ||
ghakālaṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhaṃ daśavāhuṃ mahāvalaṃ | paṃcavaktraṃ trinetraṃ ca śūrapāṇi mahābhūjaṃ ||
gajacarmottarāsaṃgaṃ ghaṃṭāṭaṃkavibhūṣataṃ | iṃ hrī varadalaśyāmaṃ madhyamaṃmbhīranisvanaṃ ||
brahmarākṣasavetālānnāśayannātrasaṃśayaḥ || 4 ||
ṅakāraṃ nāgamārūḍhaṃ dvibhujaṃ piṃgarocanaṃḥ | harahāsasitaṃ saumyaṃ vīṇākhaḍgarataṃ sadā ||
smaratāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ bālagrahavimardanaṃ | nāśayaśaraṇādeṣa viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamaṃ || 5 ||
cakāraṃ tu hinābhāsaṃ śaśāṅkāṅkitaśekharaṃ |
<208b>
caturvaktraṃ cāṣṭabhujaṃ pāśa paṭṭiśadhāriṇaṃ | padmāsana sthitaṃ nityaṃ sarpamaṇḍitamekhalaṃ ||
dhyānadhāraṇasaṃyuktaṃ ye pāśvadi samanvitaṃ | duṣṭarogaiśvane kecid vyādhikā jvala vyādhibhiḥ ||
sarvate muktarogāṃśca smaraṇāsya na jāyate | gonāsāgaraiddirṣṭāduṃdumāsaiśca māritāḥ ||
viṣaṇāśāśanaṃ hyeṣa kalotyeva na saṃśayaḥ | tadviṣaṃ nāsasāyāti tamaḥ sūryodaya yathā || 6 ||
chakāraṃ śvetavarṇābhaṃ chālasthaṃ ca mahāvalaṃ | bhujaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirdivyairāhumānaṃ yathā raviṃḥ ||
paṭṭisaṃparaśuṃśuraṃ mudgalaṃ kanasaṃ tathā | anyānidhārayasvantamāyudhāni viśeṣataḥ ||
yasmiṃ sthānaṃ viṣaṃ ghoraṃ sthitaṃ sthākarajaṃgamaṃ | nāśayet svaritaṃ hyeṣa smarito nātrasaṃśayaḥ || 7 ||
<209a>
jakāraṃ hariṇākāraṃ dvibhujaṃ navaśīrṣakaṃḥ | śṛṃṣakā cāyudhaṃ tasya śaśāṅkāṅkita śekharaṃ ||
yasyānusmaraṇā devi viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamaṃ | māśaye pathito hyeṣa peyodāmivabhāskaraḥ || 8 ||
ṛkāraṃ kṛṣṇa meghābhaṃ ṣaṭbhujaṃ navalocanaṃ | triśirṣa ca mahākālaṃ uṣṭrālīḍhaṃ valīyasaṃḥ ||
yasya grahā mahāraudrā jvalamvā bhūtadoṣajaṃ | viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ raudraṃ yogānāṃ kṛtrimaṃ tathā ||
muṣṭiṇā grāhayitvā tu utthāpayati tatkṣaṇāt || 9 ||
ñakāraṃ ghanavarṇāhaṃ bhināñcana nibhopamaṃ | kamarasthaṃ catuvaktraṃ bhujāṣṭaka vibhūṣitaṃ ||
asimudgara hastra ca vajrahastaṃ mahāvalaṃ | vālagrahāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ paṭhenād devanāśanaṃ || 10 ||
ṭakāramagnivarṇābhaṃ dahantamiva pāvakaṃ |
<209b>
bhujai ṣoḍaśabhirdevyaiddivyamālyāketaṃ vapuḥ | meṣārudhaṃ mahākāyaṃ sarvamekhala mantritaṃ ||
triśīrṣaṃ ca vṛhadrūpa seṃndurābhaṃ mahādyūtiḥ | jalaṃtaṃ mudgralaṃ śakti jvālā jvalita bhūṣitaṃ ||
grahāṇāṃ nigraho hyeṣa bhūtānāṃ dākinīṣu ca | nimarjatmā japedenaṃ taṃ nayeduṣibhūṣitaḥ || 11 ||
ṭhakāraṃktaṃdapuṣpābhaṃ vṛṣārūḍhaṃ mahāvalaṃ | catubhujaṃ mahākāyameka śīrṣa trirocanaṃ ||
gaukṣiradhavalaṃ nityaṃ viṣasyainyavimardanaṃ | ānmalakṣā parasyaivavarthivā nirjane vane ||
gasiṃhavalāheṣu vyālavyāghra bhayeṣu ca | viṣavaṃdhe pramoktavyaṃ jīvalakṣāsu cintayet ||
suvarṇamamṛtaṃ hyenaṃ kāladraṣṭro bhaved yadi | ahināṃ staṃbhane proktāṃ sarvasatveṣu sītalaṃ || 12 ||
<210a>
ḍakālaṃ hariṃ taṃ dhyāyeduṣṭrābhīṣaṇavigrahaṃ | caturvaktraṃ mahākāyaṃ caturviṃśārddhalocanaṃ ||
dharmāsanasamārūḍhaṃ daṇḍapāṇiṃ jaṭādharaṃ | jakṣarākṣasabhūtādi ḍākini siddhiyogini ||
staṃdādīnī saraughāśyā piśācoragakinnabhāḥ | kuṣmāṇḍarākṣasāṃścaiva smaramā devanāśayet || 13 ||
dhakāraṃ bhujagārūḍhaṃ phaṇilakṣaṇabhūṣitaṃ | jvalanārka pratīkāśamālaktāyata locaṇaṃ ||
draṃṣṭrākalālinaṃ ghoraṃ meghagambhīra niḥsvaraṃḥ | catuḥṣaṣṭhī bhujairdivyaṃnnānā prahaṇā yutādhunaṃ ||
draṣṭrāṭaṃkākṣamālāṃśca śūlapaṭṭaśadhāriṇaṃḥ | gadāmugarapāśāṃśca khaḍgacakraṃ ca vibhratāṃ ||
kṣobhaya pṛthiviṃ sarvāṃ saśailavanakānanāṃ daityadānavalākṣasāṃ |
<210b>
nāgānāṃ damanohyeṣa pātāla bhavavāsiṇī | draḍhimākarṣaṇe yojyaṃ meghānāṃ ca nivāraṇe ||
lūtāgardabha vispho (* *?) sahaliṃgādi carcikāḥ | ḍākinībhūtadoṣāṃśca nāśayennātrasaṃśayaḥ || 14 ||
ṇakāraṃ gauravarṇābhaṃ tāmasī kusuma prabhaṃ | caturbhujaṃ catuvaktraṃ kṛrṣṇaṃ draṃṣṭrākalolinaṃ ||
rājavarṇanibhaṃ śyāmaṃ jvaladbhāsuralocanaṃ | meru śṛgayutaṃ bhīmaṃ cāhahasta vibhūṣitaṃ ||
trāsayantaṃ mahānādaṃ kṣobhayantaṃ rasātaraṃḥ | viṣāṁśca vividhākārā naśyaṃnte nātrasaṃśayaḥ || 15 ||
takālaṃ raktavarṇābhaṃ pūrṇakumbhoparisthitaṃ | śaśāṅkakṛtamurddhānaṃ dvibhujaṃ mīnavāhaṇaṃḥ ||
ekaśīrṣa tatasūkṣmai netratayavibhūṣitaṃ |
<211a>
niḥśeṣaviṣanāganāmaṃtarāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | smaraṇān ṇāśayacchulaṃghanavātāhatāṃ yathā || 16 ||
thakālaṃ hiravarṇābhaṃ śaṃkhakundradunimmalaṃ | makālāpṛṣṭamārūḍhamāraktāpitalocanaṃ ||
dīrghasthaṃdhaṃ surucāpaṃ ca vibhrataṃ | manmathañca svayaṃ devī kandrarpa śahaṇāśanaṃ ||
dīpairagarapuṣpaiñca sugaṃdhauścānu lepanaiḥ | akāramaraṇaṃ hyeṣa nāśayatya vicāranaṃ ||
dīrghasthaṃdhaṃ surūpañca śarācāpaṃ ca vibhratāṃḥ | manmathañca svayaṃ devi kandrarpya grahavarṇābhaṃ kaṃkavāhanasaṃsthitaṃ ||
kṣīrodakalasāvarta madhyagaṃ cintayet sadā | tritrirśīrṣo mahākāyaṃ śobhamīnaṃ trilocanaṃ ||
trinetrāṇi ca pārvāṇi vaktrānimusthitāni ca |
<211b>
jvaraṃnāśayate ghoraṃ tṛtīyaka caturthakaṃḥ ||
sādhyaṃ rātri jvalaṃ caiva śītādāha jvalaṃ tathā || 18 ||
dhakāraṃ pāṭalābhāsaṃ dhanuṣpāṇiṃ caturbhujaṃ | ekaśīrṣamahākāyaṃ siṃhārūḍhaṃ mahāvalaṃ ||
raudrāṭṭahāsaninadaṃ grahasainyavimardanaṃ | tuṣṭā tu harate doṣaṃ chāyādoṣaṃñca nāśayet ||
paradoṣa kṛtaṃ caiva valīnāṃ laṃghanaṃ tathā | aniraghu prahāraiśca rakṣate nātrasaṃśayaḥ || 19 ||
nakāraṃ nīlavarṇābhaṃ kṛtvā sārakṛtāyanaṃ | caturvaktraṃ cāṣṭavahuṃ jvālāvaṃśadharaṃ śubhaṃ ||
tomarāstradhanaṃ śubhaṃ ||
tato rāstradhanaṃ satyaṃ cakrapāṇiṃ subhūṣitaṃ | vividhāni ca yantrāni ca dhāyertu viśeṣataḥ ||
<212a>
ākāśa gagaṇaṃ caiva gulijāñcanasaṃnibhaṃḥ | vetālāsthāpanaṃ caiva svasthāne sarvakarmaṇi || 20 ||
pakāraṃ raktapadmābhaṃ padmasthaṃ padmadhāriṇaṃ | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmapītākārṣāyavāsanaṃ ||
catubhujaṃ catuvaktraṃ padmaśasyoparisthitaṃḥ | yakṣarākṣasa bhūtā ca piśācān brahmarakṣasān ||
kuṣmāṇḍa dākinīṃ caiva bhūtavetālarākṣasāt | apasmāragrahāṃścaiva tathā vālagrahānapi ||
smaraṇānnāśayetyaṣa viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamaṃḥ | kāyikaṃ caicikaṃ caiva mānasaṃ trividhaṃ tathāḥ ||
janmāntara kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayet smaraṇādasau || 21 ||
phalāraṃ pathyate yogī yogīnī hṛdaye tathāḥ | catubhujaṃ caturvaktraṃ haṃsārūḍhaṃ vicintayet ||
<212b>
kapālī cākṣamālī ca mraśvimekhalavānaṃpiḥ | sṛṣṭikartā jagatyaiva trailokya prabhuravyayaṃ ||
amṛtā karṣaṇā hyeṣa jīvadāne viśeṣataḥ | bhayanāśaṃ sadā kuryāt satvānandraviśeṣataḥ || 22 ||
vakālaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇābhaṃ sākṣād varuṇaṃ daivataṃ | nāgāsanasamārūḍhaṃ phaṇivyākulalocanaṃ ||
himakundre saṃkāsaṃ śaṃkhagokṣīrasaṃnibhaṃ | ṣaḍviśārddha bhujaṃ saumyaṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitaṃ ||
gadāpāṇi ca deveśiṃ rāśicakra samākulaṃ | khaḍgapāśadharaṃ saukhyaṃ dāhajvalavināśanaṃ ||
cātikaipaittikaṃ caiva śleṣmaka sānnipātikāṃ | vādhirinnipatena niviṣaṃ kulute kṣaṇāt || 23 ||
phakāṃraṃ kṛrṣṇavarṇābhā pītakausīparāsanaṃ |
<213a>
daṇḍahastaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahiṣāsūravāhaṇaṃḥ | kālapāsadharaṃ raudraṃ māraktāyatalocanaṃ ||
tasmā sarva prayatnena kāladaṣṭāsyajojayet || 24 ||
makāraṃ vṛṣabhārūḍhaṃḥ || bhasmādrūritadhūsaraṃ ||
nīlakaṇṭhañca jatilaṃ sarvaṇitikalaṃ śivaṃḥ | paṃcavaktradaśabhujaṃ triśaddhapiṅgarocanaṃḥ ||
kapālāsidharaṃ tīkṣāṃ triśūrākuśadhāriṇaṃ || 25 ||
yakālaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi svayaṃ vāyuṃ vyavasthitaṃḥ | ṣaḍbhajaṃ śatavaktraṃ ca mahāvalaparākramaṃḥ ||
kulaṃ śāsanamārūḍhaṃ śubhāvaradharaṃ tathā | sarvadoṣāḥ samaṃ yānti siṃhadṛṣṭvā yathāmṛgāḥ || 26 ||
rakāramagnivarṇaṃ tu raktakauśīya vāsanaṃ | raktākṣarakta daṃṣṭrañca rasamāsaptavyākulaṃḥ ||
<213b>
caturbhujaṃ catuvaktraṃ kārāgnirudratejasaṃḥ | duṣṭānāṃ prasamāsthāya viṣasuptaprabodhayat ḥ || 27 ||
lakāraṃ pītavarṇābhaṃ vajrahastaṃ mahāvalaṃḥ | airāvata samārūḍhaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ sureśvaraṃḥ ||
cāmaleṇa suvarṇena vījamānaṃ surāsuraiḥ | meru pṛṣṭa sukhāśinamapsarābhiḥ susevitaṃḥ || 28 ||
vakālaṃ tu hinābhāsaṃ mukhakaparisaṃsthitaṃ | āyudhaṃ tasya pāsaṃ tu catuvaktraṃ catubhujaṃ ||
śuklavastradharaṃ nityaṃ saumyarūpaṃ sulocanaṃ | āpyāyanaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ viṣānāṃ caiva nāśanaṃ || 29 ||
śakāraṃ śitapadmāsthaṃ sitacandaṇaśobhitaṃ | ṣaḍbhujaṃ śaktihastaṃ ca śiśīvāhanasaṃsthitaṃ ||
ṣaḍvaktrāṃ svayameva śataṃ nijaṃ śikhi vallabhaṃ |
<214a>
darśanārtasya naśyanti mahāpātakanāśayaḥ || 30 ||
ṣakāraṃ ṣaḍbhujaṃ raudraṃ triśīrṣa navalocana | tripādaṃ raktanetraṃ ca jvalantamiva pāvakaṃ ||
bhūtapṛṣṭhe samārūḍhaṃ pāśatomaramudgaraiḥ | śobhitaṃ bhujadaṇḍaiśca saumyarūpaṃ mahāprabhuṃ || 31 ||
sakālaṃ sarvabhūteṣu sarvabhūteṣvavasthitaṃ | bhūmikīṭapaṭaṃgoṣu cintayedamṛtopamaṃ || 32 ||
hakāraṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śabdarūpaṃ parātparaṃ | sūkṣaṃ nilaṃjanaṃ nityaṃ śabdātitaṃ parātparaṃḥ ||
bhinnendunīlasaṃkāśaṃ kālindī jalasaṃnibhaṃ | dhyātvā ca nāsayatyeṣa viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamaṃḥ || 33 ||
<214b>
kṣakālaṃ paṭhyate yastu svayaṃbhuvaruṇāyakaṃ | padmāsanasamārūḍhaṃ śaśāṅkaṅkitaśekharaṃ ||
jaṭāmukuṭasannarddhaṃ pacavaktratrilocanaṃ | animādyaṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ sarvāyudhavibhūṣitaṃ ||
daṇḍaṃ kaṃṭhākhya mālāṃ ca gaḍā cakra triśūlikaṃ | akuśaṃ ratnapātraṃ ca sarvatroparivāritaṃ ||
sarvasiddhikalo hyeṣaḥ kṣakāraḥ paripaṭhyatāṃ | brahmāviṣṇumaheśādyā nityaṃ dhyāyanti yogīnaḥ ||
etamantraṃ valaṃ prāpya tyajedanmalālavat ḥ | navatatva samāyuktaṃ kṣakālaṃ paripaṭhyatāṃ ||
vyādhitaskara caurebhyāṃ vaṃdhane grahasaṃkaṭā | japatsmarantaṃ dhyāpayen na bhayaṃ vindate kvacit ||
adhunā saṃpravakṣāmi kalānāñca yatā tathāḥ |
<215a>
pūrvataṃ caiva varṇāṇāṃ tathaiva manupūrvaśaḥ || 34 ||
akālaṃ virṣṇu daivatvaṃ vairṣṇavyācāpālajitaṃ | śaṃkhaṃ cakragadāpāṇi caturvaktraṃ catubhujaṃ ||
garuḍāsanamārūḍhaṃ sarvaduṣṭanikṛntanaṃ || 1 ||
ākāraṃ brahmadaivatyaṃ haṃsārūḍhaṃ catubhujaṃ | caturvaktraṃ sasvarūpaṃ surāktāyitalocanaḥ ||
daṇḍaṃkamaṇḍarūṃ caiva mujamekhaladhāṇiṇaṃ | brahmasūtradharā devī brahmaṇī paripathyatāṃ || 2 ||
ikālaṃ pārvati devī saumyarūpya trīrocana | sabhrūlalāṭhavimboṣṭhā vali tritayaśālikā ||
kuṭilākubjitākeśī pīnnonnata payodhārā || 3 ||
īkālamīśvaraṃ vidyā jatāmukuṭadhāriṇaṃ | śaśāṅka śekharaṃ devi paṃcavaktra trilocanaṃ ||
kapālamālinaṃ devī pacavaktraṃ trilocanaṃḥ |
<215b>
kapālamālinaṃ devi jatāmukuṭadhāriṇaṃ devī | śivasaktyā sahaikoyaṃ tridaśairapi dullabhaṃḥ || 4 ||
ukāraṃ vinatā putraṃ svayaṃ tākṣapatiṃ śubhaṃ | avyāhata gatiṃ nityaṃ bhuvanāni caturdaśaḥ ||
hariṃ vahā tu tarddevī yakṣabhūtāvināśinīḥ | gāruḍī sā tu vijñayā sarvaduṣṭavināśinī ||
sarveṣāṃ ca grahādīnāmunmādakāriṇī śubhāḥ || 5 ||
ūkālaṃ haṃsamītyuktaṃ śaṃkhakuṇḍasi nibhaṃḥ | smaraṇāt sarvapāpāṇī nāśayanātrasaṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
atha ḷ ḹḥ ṛgvedaṃ ca yajuḥ sāmaḥ prasīttitaḥ | vedamārtharvalaṃ caiva pūjākāle tu cintayet || 10 ||
ekāraṃ ṣaṇmukhaṃ vidyārcartuviṃśāddhalocanaṃ | śikhivāhanamāruḍhā śaktihastaṃ mahāvalaṃ ||
<216a>
smaranānnāśaye devī kaumāra grahapīḍanaṃḍanaṃ ||
aiṃkālaṃ surarājendramairāvatarathe sthitaṃ | tejasvinaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ vajrahastaṃ mahāvalaṃ ||
dvibhujaṃ saumyavadanaṃ netraya vibhūṣitaṃ || 12 ||
ukāraṃ siṃhamārūḍhaṃ trinetraṃ ca mahāvalaṃ | dvibhujaṃ saumya vadanaṃ śobhanaṃ ca mahābhujaṃ ||
śivaduti ca sā devī śmaśānilayā priyāḥ || 13 ||
aukālo bhairavaḥ sākṣājvālākapilalocanaṃ | daṃṣṭrākarālinaṃ bhīmaṃ lelihānaṃ subhīṣaṇaṃ ||
tripādaṃ trikaraṃ jñeyaṃ triśīrṣaklaraśeṣaraṃ |
<216b>
adhāramurddhamātṛṇāṃ yogīnīnāṃ sadālayaṃ | śūlamurdgalavīṇāsinī vīṇāṃkuśadharaṃ tathā ||
gajacarmanivardhāṅgaṃ sarvamekhalamaṇḍitaṃ | sarvābharanasaṃyuktaṃ maṇikuṇḍalabhūṣitaṃ ||
nṛtyamānaṃ śmaśāneṣu vetālaiḥ saha krīḍate || 14 ||
aṃgāraṃ vīndusaṃyuktaṃ śuṣkā devi tu bhīṣaṇā | aṃtrātrapiśitā hārā cāsthibhiḥ kṛtamekhalā ||
asthiśeṣā ca nirmāṃsā pretavāhanasaṃsthitvā | daṃṣṭākarāriṇī cāgrāmeghagaṃranitaḥ svārāḥ ||
śuṣkāśuṣkamuṣibhīmā corddhakeśi bhayānakā | samāṃsurudhirāhārā śmaśāne nityavāsīnī ||
gajacarmottarīyā tu nāgabharaṇabhūṣitāḥ | cāmuṇḍāmuṇḍavetā ca khecarī hṛdayaṃ gamā || 15 ||
<217a>
aḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ caiva bījaṃ śītaṃ tu hinaśītalaṃ | pūrṇendu candanaṃ saumyaṃ karo ṣoḍaśavatsadā ||
sicyamānaṃ sa dadhyeyedamṛtaṃ śravate sadā | etaccāpyāyanaṃ jīvo viṣamajvāranāśanaṃ ||
ekāhnikaṃ muhutte ca titiyeka caturthakaṃ | gītajvalamahāghore pirttānmādajvaraṃ tathā ||
māse ṣaṇmāsike caiva tathā sa vatsarādike | nāśaśanaṃ sarvarogāṇāmāyurārārge varddhanaṃ ||
etad devi mayākhyātaṃ dharmasarvasvamātmanaḥ | na kasyacit mayākhyātaṃ tvāṃ vināvaravarṇinī ||
jānujānātimodhātmā mātṛkājñānamurttamaṃ | vyarthapariḥ śramasteṣāṃ siddhiṃ mārgastu duragā ||
kṣame śaṃbhūḥ svayaṃ deve paṃcāsyaścandraśekharaḥ |
<217b>
khaṭvāṃgākuśaśūlākṣāmālāṭaṃkaṃ manīgadāṃ | daṇḍamudgaracakrāṃka daśapāṇirhalāyudhaḥ ||
dharmādharma vedayugo dharmāsanarorddhataḥ | varṇākṣetreśvarā mantrā na pṛthaktvena saṃsthitā ||
siddhidāḥ pūjitā nityaṃ japadhyāna patarpaṇaiḥ | tasmāt sarvaprajannena varṇadhyānaṃ bhujāyutāḥ ||
kāryasiddhi cintaniyāni yojyāstatva darśanā | umātilakanityetāḥ prekṣavākyā gamātvahunuḥ ||
atha nepālapīṭha ||
nepāraṃ tu ikārasyāḥ gudaṃ tatra tu pārvati | tasmād vāmasya mārgasya mūlasthānaṃ taducyateḥ ||
ṣaṭpaṃcāśalakṣamitā bhairavyo bhairavīstathā | śaktināṃ ca sahasre dve pīṭhānāṃ ca śatatrayaṃ ||
cartudaśaśmaśānāni tatra saṃhiti tāni ca |
<218a>
dakṣamārge siddhidānī pīṭhānyaṣṭau ca tapra ca | siddhi vaidika mantrāṇāṃ tatra pītha catuṣṭa ca ||
tanmalaṃ yatra patitaṃ jātaṃ tadupapīṭhakaṃ | nepālāt pūrvadeśe tat kiṃrātairupaveṣṭitaṃ ||
triśattasahasrāṇi devayoni nisaṃti hiḥ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgamasāre aṣṭāviṃśatime paṭalaḥ] || 28 ||
atha daśavidyāyantramāha ||
atha kālī ||
ādau yantraṃ pravakṣyāmi yajñātvāmaratāṃ vrajet | ādau trikoṇaṃ vinyasya trikoṇaṃ tadvahi nyaset ||
tato vai vilikhen mantrī trikoṇa traya muttamaṃ |
<218b>
vṛrtaṃ vilikhya vidhivallikhet padmaṃ surakṣaṇaṃ |
tasyādhyānaṃ ||
dhyānamadhyāḥ pravakṣāmi smaraṇācchivatāṃ vrajet | karāravadanā ghorāṃ muktakeśi catubhujāṃ ||
kālikā dakṣiṇā divyāṃ muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitāṃ | sadya chinnaśiraḥ khaḍga vāmārddhādhaḥ karāṃvujāṃ ||
abhayavaradaṃ caiva dakṣiṇādhorddhapārṇikāṃ | mahāmegha prabhā śyāmaṃ tathā caidivagadigamvarāṃ ||
kaṇṭhāvasiktamuṇḍālī galadrudhira carcitāṃḥ | karṇāvataṃ samānīta savayugma bhayānakāṃ ||
ghoradaṣṭrākalālo ca pīnnonnata payodharāṃḥ | śavānāṃ karaśaṃghātaiḥ kṛtakāñcā sahanmukhī ||
sṛkva dvaya galadrakta dhāro visphuritānanāṃ | ghorarāvāṃ mahāraudrīṃ śāśānālayavāsinīṃ ||
<219a>
atha tārādhāsayāniṃ candanenāṣṭa patrapadmaṃ likhet tataḥ | mṛdumāsena mātahye māyā pūrvadale likhet ||
tasyādhyānaṃ ||
katṛparigatāṃ dhyāyadātmānaṃ tāriṇī mayaṃ | pratyārīḍhaṃ padāṃ ghorāṃ mutramālā vibhūṣitaṃ ||
kharvāraṃ codarīṃ bhāmāṃ vyāghracarma dhṛtā kaṭī | navayaunava saṃpannā paṃcamudrāṃ vibhūṣitāṃḥ ||
bhairavokta mahaṃ vakṣā yantraṃ sarvasamṛrddhīdaṃ | trikoṇaṃ prathame lekhyaṃ khaṭkoṇaiveṣṭayercataṃ ||
trivirti ca tato dadyād guṇānāṃ pariṇamakaṃ | bhūpura tritayaṃ kuryād vajraśūlasaminvitaṃḥ ||
koṇadeśe tato dadyāt ṭaṃkāstra sumanoharaṃ | yathāsthāne likheddhīmān katṛkharparakaṃ śubhaṃ ||
<219b>
ratikāme pādidhyāyed devīṃ vairocanīṃ śubhāṃ |
tasyādhyānaṃ ||
dhyāyed devi mahāmāyāṃ sarvakalyāna kāriṇī | sudhāsāgara dvipai ca smaredudyānamadbhutaṃ ||
tasminamasarastrīreśobhanaṃ raktamaṃtrapaṃ | catudvāra samopeta staṃbharāji vilājitaṃḥ ||
gavākṣmārgadaśaka vāyu yukta sa keśaṇaṃ | sudhāsaṃsāvisatataṃ kalpavikṣya catuṣṭayaṃ ||
niviṣṭāṃ ratna staṃbhe ca saṃsmare nija devatāṃ | śavāśanakatāṃ dhyāyacchinnamaṣṭāṃ mahorarīṃ ||
catubhujāṃ samārūḍhāṃ raktavastrāṃ trilocanāṃ | muktāṭopasaṃpannāṃ dakṣiṇe khaḍgadhāriṇe ||
sātparāṃ vāmahastena dorbhyāṃ pustakadhāriṇiṃ | nikṛtyasaśiraḥ khaḍgaiḥ pivanti rudhīraṃ vahuḥ ||
220a>
udyadinakarābhāvaṃ caṃdrārdhakṛtasekharāṃḥ | yogibhiḥ vyāsamuniśaṃnāga yajñopavītinīṃ ||
tripūrāyā ||
vindutrikoṇavasukoṇadasālayugmaṃnvaśrenāgadalasaṃyutaṃ ṣodasālāṃ vṛttatrayaṃ ca dharanī sadana trayaṃ ca śrīyantrarājamuditaṃ para devatāyāḥ ||
tasyādhyānaṃ ||
vālārkamaṇḍalābhāsāṃ caturvāhuṃ trilocanaṃ | pāśāṅkuśa saraścāpaṃ dhārayantīṃ śivāmbhajet ||
bhairavī jantraṃ ||
tanmadhya kalpayed yantraṃ javajoniṃtmakaṃ śubhaṃ | aṣṭacchadaśva tad vāhye caturamraṃ manoramaṃ ||
tasyā dhyānaṃ ||
raktāṃsurarmūlavilasan manipīṭhagāṃ | saṇipāśakapāleṣu mātuluṃgadhanudharān ||
raktairaraṃ kṛtā pūṣpairmadāghūrṇita rocaṇaṃ | hailāvilāsasaṃpannā navayovanasundarīṃ ||
<220b>
devī dhyātvā jape lakṣaṃ yo bījaṃ madhyamaṃ vaśī | traulokyaṃ kṣobhayadāśuyusāvatsirddhi bhāgasauḥ ||
atha mahālakṣmāyā ||
vālabhāskarasatkāntiṃ śaśiśekharamaṇḍitaṃ | muktāhāro jvatvāṃ ramyāṃ latnākalpavibhūṣitiṃ ||
hastābhājaiśca vibhrāṇāṃ rutamāṃgānimaṃjaliṃ | padma dvayaṃ kaustubhaṃ ca sasmitāsya saroruhāṃ ||
vikacotpala saṃśobhilocanatrayaśobhitāṃ | kvaṇanūpurasaṃsphullaraktotpala padvayaṃ ||
nitambabimbavirasadrasanādrāmanaṃjulāṃ | valitrayalasad devi madhye deśe suśobhanaṃ ||
gambhīrāvattakṛnnābhi hradamaṇḍalamaṇḍitāṃ | yakṣakardamasaṃlipta pinnonnata ghanastanīṃ ||
<221a>
kuṃmbhīkumbhodbhavadrādya muktādāmavirājitāṃḥ | kṣomottarāsaṃgavatī purṣpadāmamabhūṣitāṃ ||
māṇikyasvarṇakhacita vaidaryādyaṃgaṃgado jvalāṃ | kāṃcanodyatpadmarāgamaṇisaṃvaddhakakaṇāṃ nānā vidhaṃ lasadratnamudrikālaṃ kṛtāṃguliṃ ||
kaṃbukaṇṭhakarāravāṃ svarṇagre ve parājitāṃ | vicinta nānālaṃkālā kṛtīlagīsuvismītāṃ ||
udyadarka prabhābhāsvadratnatāṭaṃkaśobhitāṃ | karṇapūri kṛtasvarṇa varddharannāṃ kulāṃ bhubhāṃ ||
pravālavilasaskāntirucirādhārapacikāṃ | śiṣaraprollusadramya daśanāvaliśobhitāṃ ||
nirlāṃcchataśaraḍākākārādhipaśubhānanāṃ | pañcasāyakakodaṇḍa vilāsyadhika cillikāṃ ||
<221b>
vibhrāṇāṃ nāśikāṃ prodyartilapuṣṭā jvalodyatāṃ | śītāṃśu sakalārarucilārikarājitāṃ ||
ghanasaugandhasaṃpanna mṛganābhi viśeṣatāṃḥ | manāktaṃtasasnigdhanīlamaṃjulamurddhajāṃyate ||
pārijātadrukusumagandhavāhi samurddhajāṃḥ | taptahātakasaṃvarddha nānāratnaughaṣarāṃ saundarya bhūmeravadhiṃ tejasāṃ janmabhūmikāṃ ||
vilāsalakṣmī bhavanaṃ mahālakṣmī vicintayet | vāmāladhaḥ karāmaratyadhyāyaddakṣakarāvidhiḥ ||
āyurānī mahārakṣmāḥ karāmbuja gatānimaḥ | dharmādi kalpite pīṭhe bhūradvāraśobhite ||
dalāṣṭakeśarārāḍhya karṇikāyāṃ jajedimāṃ |
<222a>
atha mātaṃgīni ||
ṣaṭkoṇāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ likhen mantraṃ manoramaṃ | etasmin pūjayeṭhe navaśaktiṃ kramāditaḥ ||
tasyādhyānaṃ ||
śyāmāgī śaśiśeṣarāṃ trinayanāṃ sadrannasihāsane saṃskāratnavivibhūṣaṇa yutāṃ kṣīṇa madhyasthalāṃḥ ||
āpīnastana maṇḍalāṃ smitamukhīṃ dhyāyed dadhantī kramādvadairvāhubhiruṃkuśāsilatikepāśaṃ tathā khaṭakaṃ ||
evaṃ dhyātvā mahādevi gandhapuṣpairmanoharaiḥ |
bhuvaneśvarīḥ ||
padmamaṣṭadaraṃ vāhya vṛrtiṣoḍaśabhirdalaiḥ | vilikhet kaṇikā madhya ṣaṭkoṇamakisundraraṃ ||
tasyādhyānaṃ ||
udyadinadyutimindu kiriṭāṃ bhuṃgaṃ kucāṃ nayanatrayayuktāṃ | smeramukhī varadāṃ kuśābhiti karāṃ prabhaje bhuvaneśvarīṃḥ ||
<222b>
atha dhūmāvatī kramaḥ ||
pūrvokta pūjayet pīṭhe jyeṣṭhāṃ śatru nivṛttaye | keśareṣu ṣaḍaṃgāni patrasthā aṣṭaśaktayaḥ ||
asyādhyānaṃ ||
vivarṇācañcalā kṛrṣṇādīrghā ca malināṃvarā | vimuktakuṇḍadīrghā vidhavā viraladvijā ||
kākadhvajarathārūḍhā vilamṛta tavayodharāḥ | śurṣahastātirukṣmākṣī dhutahastātvarānvitā ||
pravṛrddharomā tu bhṛśaṃ jaṭilākuṭilākṣaṇāḥ | kṣutpipāsāditā nityaṃ sadā kalaha tatparā ||
evaṃ vidhā sadā dhyāyet tataḥ karma samācaret |
atha vagalāmukhī ||
madhyayo samālikhya tad vāhye tu ṣaḍaṃmrakaṃ | tadvāhyeṣṭa dalaṃ padmaṃ tad vāhye ṣoḍaśacchadaṃ ||
caturasra trayaṃ vāhye catudvāro paśobhitaṃt |
<223a>
asyādhyānaṃ ||
gabhīrāṃ ca madonmartāṃ taptakāṃcanasaṃnibhāṃ | catubhujāṃ trinayanāṃ kamalāsanasaṃsthitāṃḥ ||
mudgalaṃ dakṣiṇe pāsāṃ vāme jihvāṃ ca vajrakaṃ | pītāmvaladharāṃ sāndra vṛrttapīnapayodharāṃ ||
hemakuṇḍalabhūṣāṃ ca pītacandrārddhaśekharāṃ | pītabhūṣaṇabhūṣā ca svarṇasiṃhāsana sthitā ||
evaṃ dhyātvā ca deveśi śatru staṃbhanakāriṇīṃ ||
atha bhuvaneśvari mantrārtha ||
hahitvā ca haratvā ca muṃpakṛtyostu yuktayoḥ | śliṣṭoccāritamevedaṃ śabdatadrūpamīritaṃ || 1 ||
vyomabīje maheśāni kailāśādriḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | vahni bījāt suvarṇādi niṣpannaṃ vahudhā priye || 2 ||
tena yaṃ vattate loke bhūmaṇḍala sthitaṃ tataḥ |
<223b>
tūryasvareṇa pātāle śeṣarūpeṇa dhāryayet || 3 ||
mahābhūmaṇḍalaṃ tasyāt pātālasyāpi nāyikā | ata eva maheśāni bhuvanādhīśvarī priye || 4 ||
hakāre vyoma tūryeṇa svarenānilasaṃbhava | vākire satile pheṇa sākṣād brahma svarūpīṇi || 5 ||
vahnivīryaṃ vasujñayā tasyodrakevasuṃdharā | ata eva maheśāni ralayoḥ saṃmatā bhavet || 6 ||
biṃdunāmṛtarūpeṇa plāvayantī jagattrayaṃ | dravarūpā bhavet tasmādravanti bodhamātrayā || 7 ||
ata eva maheśāni bhuvaneśīti kathyate ||
atha yoni mudrāmāha ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
yonimudrāvakathitāṃ yatnato brahmakāśitaḥ |
<224a>
sā prataṃ śrotumicchāmi mudrāyāśvapi lakṣaṇaṃ | yoni mudrā ca kiṃ nāma phalaṃ tasyāśca ki prabho ||
vidhanaṃ kaṃ svarūpaṃ ca kathayasva jaga prabho |
śrīśiva uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge mudrājñāna svarūpiṇī | yājñātvā sādhakā sarve jñānapīyuṣa sāgareḥ ||
nimarjanti kulaisārddhaṃ sakṛdatyāsa yogataḥ | ṣannavatyāstulāyaṃ śaśarīramubhayānmakaṃ ||
gudadhvajāntare kendraṃ ḍacchoṣodhyastulaṃ priye | tasya dviguṇavistāraṃ vṛrttarūpena śobhitaṃḥ ||
nādyastatra samutpannā sukhyāsti prātibhāvinī | idāvāme sthitānāḍī piṅgalā dakṣiṇesthītā ||
tayo madhyargatā nāḍī sumnāpṛṣṭharaṃśagā | pādāṅguṣṭa dvayaṃ jāte śikhāyā śiraśā punaḥ ||
brahmasthānaṃ samuyyāgni rūpiṇī ||
<224b>
tasyā madhyagatānāḍī citrākhyā yogī vallabhā | dharmanī citrinā madhyā vajrāyāmedra deśataḥ ||
brahmaraṃdhra vidustatra padmasutranibhaparaṃ | iḍāyā carate candra piṃgalāyāṃ divākaraḥ ||
śṛṇu sarvavidhānena suṣṣnāyānturāvubhau | ādhārakanda madhyasthaṃ trikoṇamati sundaraṃ ||
trikoṇa madhya deveśi kāmabījamanuttamaṃ | kāmabījodbhavaṃ tatra svayaṃbhuliṃgamuttamaṃ ||
tatra trivalayākārā kuṇḍarī paradevatāṃ | śyāmavarṇā mahāśukṣmī svayambhuliṃgaveṣṭitā ||
parisphuratī sarvānmo svayaṃbhuliṃgamurtamaṃ | tatra trivilayākārā kuṇḍarī paradevatāṃ ||
śyāmavarṇā mahāśūkṣmī svayambhuliṃga veṣṭitā | parisphurati sarvātmā suptā hi sadṛśo kṛti ||
<225a>
vibharti kuṇḍalī rūpāmātmānaṃ haṃsamāśritāḥ | haṃsaprāṇāśrayo nityaṃ prāṇānāḍī samāśrayaḥ ||
ādhārāduṅgato vāyu yathā ca sarvadehināṃ | dehaṃ prāpya svanāḍībhiḥ prayānaṃ kurute vahi ||
dvādaśāṅgulamānena tasmāt prāṇasamīritaḥ | rasye mṛrddhāsane śuddhe paṭhyājina kuśodbhave ||
varddheka māsanaṃ yogi yogamārgaṃ paro bhavet | idāyā karṣayed vāyu vāhyaṃ tasmaiva mudrayā ||
dhārayet puritaṃ vāyu ubhābhyāṃ kumbhakena ca | nāḍyāpiṃgalayā caivaṃ recayerca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
bhūyo bhūyaḥ kramātasya vābhyāsena samācaret | evaṃ matyaśataḥ puṃso dehasvadoṅgamodhamaḥ ||
madhyamaḥ kalpayaṃ yukto bhūmityāgo parā tataḥ |
<225b>
evaṃ krameṇa ḍānāṃ ca śodhanaṃ kalpayed budhaḥ ||
tato guhye vāmapāda pārśvañca viniveśayet | tasyaupari mahādevī dakṣapādaṃ nidhāpayet ||
ṛjukāyaḥ śiro grivaḥ kākacañcu puṭai na ca | ākālena vahi vāyuṃ jaṭhare paripūrayet ||
aṅgalībhi dṛḍhaṃ vadhvā karaṇāni samāhitaḥ | aṅguṣṭhābhyāmubhe śrotre tarjanībhyāṃ ca locane ||
nāsārandhre ca madhyābhyāṃ manyābhyāṃ vedanaṃ dṛḍhaṃ | vadhvānmaṇa prāṇasā ekatvaṃ tanmanusmaret ||
dhāraye mārutaṃ samyak yogoyaṃ yogi vallabhāḥ | nādaravasamaḥ paścā ghanamedye svalośataḥ sanaiḥ ||
mattabhṛgyaganāśīta sadṛsaḥ prathimadhvanīḥ |
<226a>
viśikāśvādinā pūrṇa vaṃśasvaninibho paraḥ | ghaṇṭārava samaḥ paścā ghanamedya svaloparaḥ ||
tataḥ saptādi śadṛśīṃ kuṇḍalī paradevatāṃ | suṣamnā mukhamādṛśaveṣṭitāṃ paricintayet ||
kāntāvasthita yonyāstu bhramantaṃ rakta varṇakaṃ | kāmaśivaśca rūpañca cintaye sādhakottamaḥ ||
anāhata tato dhyāye citkalāṃ haṃsamāśritāṃ | pradīpa kalikākārāṃ kuṇḍalyāsaśvarūpinīṃ ||
vikalayā kuṇḍalinīṃ tejo rūpaṃ jagarnmayīṃ | haṃsena manunā devī brahmapadmaṃ nayet sunīḥ ||
paṭ cakra sandhimārgeṇa suṣumnāvanmanā tathā | ūrddhaṃ naye kuṇḍalināṃ jīvonmasahitāṃ parāṃ ||
ādhāro sthita marutā nayed brahma śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
<226b>
te naiva marutā tāni padmānyurddhamukhāni ca | bhāvaye saṃviko yogī jñānamārgena cetasā ||
ādhāre cakrapadma vai vedapatraṃ suśobhanaṃ | svādhiṣṭhāne liṅgamūle ṣaṭdalaṃ paricintayo ||
manipūre nābhimūle digdalaṃ surasundarī | anāhate hṛdi dhyāye dvādaśāṃsalakṣaṇaṃ ||
viśurddhākhyo mahācakre śodaṣecchapaṅkajaṃ | bhuvo madhye mahācakre ājñākhyedirasastathā ||
ādhārādini cakrāni bhitvā teja svarūpinī | brahmapadmaṃ naye devi kuṇḍalīṃ paradevatāṃ ||
ḍākiṇī lākiṇi caiva lākini sākinī tathā | kākini hākini caiva eṭā ṣaṭ cakra devatāḥ ||
etāni yojya ṣaṭcakre brahmatvena maheśvari |
<227a>
brahmaṇaṃndhe sahasrāre kuṇḍalī sthāpaye vadhuḥ ||
paramānmā ca tatraiva brahma padme sthitaḥ prabhuḥ | kuṇḍari śaktirūpā ca paramātmā śirasvayaṃ ||
kriyāsama hi hāreṇa tayoraikyaṃ vibhāvaye | pṛthivyādhini tatvāni jīvabhāve vilinayet ||
tameva parameśānī candramuṇḍarameva ca | amutaparamaṃ sthānaṃ jñānapīyukhasāgalaṃ ||
tasmād vinīrgatā dhārāṃ ṣatvakteṣu vicintayet | tatsaṃgaṅgācca cakrā ca nitejārūpāni cintayet ||
sahasrāre mahāpadme amṛtaṃ viniveśayet | tenāmṛtena saṃprāpya kuṇḍalī paradevatāṃḥ ||
tenaiva varmanā devi svasthānamānayet punaḥ | sohi nityātmanā jñānaṃ bhāvayet sādhakottamaḥ ||
<227b>
ṣaṭcakra devatāstātu lolībhūtā mṛtena ca | cintayitvā mahāpadme svasvasthāne niveśayet ||
vaiṣṇavasya ca śāktasya śauresya ca varānane | śiva saktyā samāyogā mahātajñā prayātape ||
tatastu citrinī nāḍyāmakṣamālāṃ vibhāvayet ḥ | pañcāśanmani rūpā ca mātṛkā ca sarasvatī ||
akārādi kṣakārāntā akṣamālā prakīrtitā | kṣakāla meru rūpantu raṅgā yena kadācana ||
anuroma vilomastha kḷptaya varṇamālayā | ādirāntalādyakārā krameṇa parameśvari ||
aṣṭottara śataṃ mūlaṃ mantraṃ jñāneṇa saṃjapet | manasā ca manuṃ japtvā mantrasiddhā bhave dhruvaṃ ||
aṣṭottara śataṃ jāpe ādau ku(?)vaṃsamācaret |
<228a>
aṣṭavālaṃ japaṃ mantraṃ punaḥ klīvaṃ parityaje | vargāṇāmapavargana aṣṭavāraṃ japet sudhī ||
akacaṭatapaya ityevaṃ cāṣṭavargataḥ | sa vindvaṃ varṇaṃ saṃsmṛtya paścā mantrañca saṃsmaret ||
iti te kathītaṃ devi mudrālakṣaṇamuttamaṃ | anayā mudrayā devī suptāditoṣasāntaya ||
māsamekaṃ japenmantra haviṣyāsī jītendriyaḥ | yoni prākti rūpāya tatra nāsti maheśvari ||
tatra devā na gṛhnaṃti pūjāhomādikaṃ tu yat | śaktihinaṃ guruṃ drāpya śiṣyaḥ śaktīṃ kutaḥ priye ||
mūle cchinne drume devī kutaḥ puṣpa phalādikaṃ | manonyatra śivonyatra śāktiranyatra pārvati ||
na siddhyanti varānane kalpakoṭi śaṭairapi | yonimudrā mahāmudrā jñātavyā yatnataḥ sudhī ||
ajñātvā śakaraṃ devi bhasmī bhavati kāṣṭavet | eṣā mudrā mayā guptā tantrādi yāmalepi ca ||
<228b>
sāmprataṃ kathitaṃ devī śṛṇu parvata kanyake |
iti śrīmantramuktāvalyāṃ śivadevyāsamvāde yonimudrālakṣaṇaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ||
[iti śrīkaularahasya sarvāgamasāre unaviṃśapaṭalaḥ] || 29 ||
atha daśamahāvidyānāṃ kavacamāha ||
tatrādau || śyāmāyā ||
bhairavyuvāca ||
kārī pūjā śrutānātha bhāvāśca trividhāḥ prabho | idāṇīṃ śrotumicchāmi kavacaṃ pūrvasūcitaṃ ||
tvameva śaraṇaṃ nātha ṛhimāṃ duḥkhasaṃkaṭāt |
bhairava uvāca ||
rahasyaṃ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi bhairavī prāṇavallabhe | śrījaganmaṃgalaṃ nāma kavacaṃ mantravigrahaṃ ||
paṭhedvādhārayitvedaṃ trailokyaṃ mohaye kṣaṇāt |
<229a>
nārāyanopiyadhṛtvā nārī bhūtvā maheśvaraṃ | yoge śaṃkṣobhanayaghṛddhṛtvā ca ghudvahaḥ ||
varadṛptā jaghānaiva rāvaṇādi niśā caret | yasya pramādānī śopi trailokyaṃ vijaya prabhuḥ ||
dhanādhipa kuveropiḥ sureśo bhūcarī patiḥ | evaṃ hi śakalā devyāḥ sarvasiddhi svarā priyet ||
śrīpagamaṃgalasyāsya kavacaṃsyariṣiḥ śivaḥ | chandro'nuṣṭubdevatā ca kā dakṣiṇetirā ||
jagatāṃ mohayeduṣṭa vijaya bhuktimuktiṣuḥ | yoṣiḍā karṣaṇe caivai niyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
śiro me kālikāpatukīṃ kāraikākṣarī paraḥ | krīṁ krīṁ krīṁ melalāṭaṃ ca kālikā khaḍgadhāriṇīḥ ||
hūṁ hūṁ pātu netra yugmaṃ hrīṁ hrīṁ pāśu śrutī mama |
<229b>
dakṣiṇe kālīkā pātu ghrāṇayugmaṃ maheśvarī ||
krīṁ krīṁ krīṁ rasatāṃ pātu hūṃ hūṃ pātu kapolakaṃ | vadanaṃ sakalaṃ pātu hrīṁ hrīṁ svāhā svarūpiṇi ||
dvāviṃśa tyakṣarī skaṃdhau mahāvidyā sukhapradā | khaḍgaṃ muṃḍadharākālī sarvāgamabhitovatu ||
krīṁ hūṁ hrīṁñca kṣarī pātu cāmuṃḍā hṛdayaṃ mama | aiṁ hūṁ oṃ aiṁ stana dvadvaṃ hrīṁ phaṭ svāhā kakutsthalaṃ ||
aṣṭākṣarī mahāvidyā bhujau pātu sakartṛkā | krīṁ krīṁ hūṁ hūṁ hrīṁ hrīṁ karau pātu ṣadakṣarī mama ||
hrīṁ nāsiṃ madhyadeśaṃ caḥ dakṣiṇi kālikeva tu | hrīṁ svāhā pātu pṛṣṭha tu kālikā sā daśākṣarī ||
hūṁ hūṁ dakṣiṇa kālike hūṁ hūṁ pātu kaṭi dvayaṃ | kālī daśākṣarī vidyā svāhā sāntauruyugmakaṃḥ ||
<230a>
oṃ jrīṁ hrīṁ me svāhā pātu kālikā jānunī sadā | kālnī hṛnnāma vidyayaṃ catuvargā phala pradā ||
krīṁ hūṁ krīṁ yā tu galphaṃ dakṣiṇe kālikeva tu | hrīṁ hūṁ hrīṁ svāhā pātu caturdaśākṣarī mamaḥ ||
khaḍgamuḍadhalā pātu varadābhaya hārīṇi | vidyābhi sakalābhiśca sarvāgama hito'vatu ||
kāli kapālini kulyā kulukulyā virodhinī | viprācirttā tathā cogrā prabhādīsādyananviṣaḥ ||
nīlāṣanāvalākā ca mātrāmudrāmicamāṃ | etāḥ sarvāḥ khaḍgadharā muṃḍamālā vibhūṣaṇāḥ ||
lakṣa tu digvadikṣu māṃ brāhmī nārāyaṇī tathā | maheśvarī ca cāmuṃḍā kaumārī cāparājitā ||
vārāhi nārasiṃhī ca sarvāśvāsita bhūṣaṇāḥ |
<230b>
lakṣastu āyudhai dikṣugāṃ(?) yathā tathā | iti te kathitaṃ divyaṃ kavacaṃ paramādbhutaṃ ||
śrījaganmaṃgalaṃ nāma mahā (* *?) gha vigrahaṃ | trailokya kavacaṃ brahma kavacaṃ manmukhoditaṃ ||
(* * *?) jaṃ vidhi yathāvidhivat prapaṭhet tataḥ | kavacaṃ triḥsakṛtvāpi yāvad vā paṃcadhā punaḥ(?> ||
etacchatāddhamātṛbhya trailokye vijayi bhavet | trailokyaṃ kṣobhayetyevakavadasya prasādataḥ ||
mahākavirbhavenmāsā sarvasīddhiśvaro bhavet | puṣpāñjali kālikā (* *?) le naiva paṭhet sa kṛt ||
śatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ pūjāphalamāpnuyā |
bhūrje vili (* *) tā (* *) t || svarṇasthaṃ dhārayed yadi ||
śikhāyāṃ dakṣiṇe vāhau kaṃṭhe vā dhārayed yadi |
<231a>
trailokyaṃ mohayet krodhāt trailokyaṃ mohayet kṣaṇā | putravāṃ dhanavān śrīmāvān nānāvidyā nidhirbhavet ||
brahmastrādīṇi nastrāṇi tadgātrasparśanāt tataḥ | nāśamāyāṃti yā nārī vaṃdhyā vā mṛta putriṇī ||
kaṃṭhe vā vāmahau hau vā kavacasya (* * * *?) | vahvapatyā jīvavatsā bhavet pīṭha na śaṃśayeḥ ||
na deyaṃ paraśiṣyasyā (* * * * * * *?) | śiṣyasyo bhakti yuktebhyo nānyadhā mṛtyumāpnuyāt ||
sparddhāmuddhṛva (* * *?) vāgdevī maṃdile mukhe | pautrāntaṃ sthaiyamāsthāya nivasasyovanniścitaṃ ||
i (* *?) vacamajñātvā yo bhavedakṣakālikāṃ | śatalakṣa prajaptopi tasyā vidyā na siddhyati ||
<231b>
maṇantra ghātamāpnoti socirāmṛtyumāpnuyāt | tasmāt sarva prayatnena etarddhartā puraḥsaraṃ ||
saṃjapā siddhidā kālī sādhakāya bhave dhruvaṃ ||
iti śrībhairave bhairavaṃ bhairavī samvāde śyāmā kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃḥ || 1 ||
atha tārā kavacamāha ||
purākailāśaśikhare tālā prapacchaśaṃṅkaraḥ | guptabhāvena vesitha kathayasva tu sādaraṃ ||
kenopāyana śahaśāśarīraṃ sundaḍhaṃ bhavet | kathavā siddhiratulā tava mantravidī priye ||
śrī tārovāca ||
ati guhyataraṃ hyetan niḥsṛtaṃ mukhapaṃkajān | idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ kathayāmi tvayī prabho ||
śrutātāṃ savādhānena kavacaṃ manmukhānsṛte |
<232a>
madhukaiṭabha yo murddhe kathitaṃ padma janmanā ||
tatprabhāvāt tu deveśa nāsaṃ viṣṇu na gacchati | bhava sukathitaṃ pūrvaṃ tanna smarasi mālayā ||
uddhṛtaṃ sārabhūtānāṃ kavacaṃ yoginī mate | na kasmicit pravaktavyaṃ na prakāsyaṃ kathaṃcana ||
ṇapathaṃ kurute devi yadi snehāsti māṃ prati | śruyatāṃ savadhānena kavacaṃ sādhasaṃgrahaṃ ||
satyaṃ satyaṃḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||
kavacena vinā deva yomāmarcayati kṣaṇāt | mataśnomi mahogrāhaṃ yoginīḥ suniścitaṃ ||
brahmaviṣṇu maheśānāṃ bījaṃ lakṣa tu mūlakaṃ | tadurddhaṃ śakti vijaṃntu liṃgaṃ rakṣaṇa yatnataḥ ||
maṇipūraṃ sadā pātu vadhubījaṃ viśeṣataḥ | anāhataṃ varmabījaṃ pātu me sarvasarvataḥ ||
<232b>
astrāṇi sarvadā pātu viśuddhaṃ kaṇṭhabhūṣitaṃ | śeṣastu pātu me nityamājñā sthānaṃ dvipatrakaṃ ||
śīrṣamyā tu tārā jaṭājaṭā pātu sadānanaṃ | nīlasarasvatī pātu vadhubījaṃ sa daiva hi ||
stanadvayaṃ sadā pātu kurcavighna vighātakaṃ | rasanā me sadā pātu lakṣmīddevī ca sāsvatī ||
rasānāgraṃ sadā pātu sarasvati prayatnataḥ | ratiḥ pātu sadā bījaṃ prīti kamme vadanaṃ sadā ||
kīrtiḥ kīrtiṃ sadā pātu śāntiṃḥ śāntiṃḥ sadāvatu | puṣṭirma pātu puṣṭaṃ caṃ tuṣṭiṃ tuṣṭiḥ sadāvatu ||
vairocanaḥ pātu śaṃkhaṃ śaṃkha pūrvastathaivacaḥ | pātulome sadāgaṇḍaṃ pātu nityaṃ ca sarvasaḥ ||
<233a>
padmanābhaḥ sadā pātu nābhimedaśapatrakaṃ | asitābhaḥ pātu liṃgaḥ nāmakaḥ pātu catuṣī ||
māmako me tathā hastai grīvā me pātu pāṇḍaraḥ | tarakvaḥ pātu hṛdayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ padmāntako mama ||
pāśvadvantaṃ sadā pātu mayāntaka narāntako | caraṇai me pātu nityaṃ vighnāntaka sadāṅkayaḥ ||
tāra me pātu satataṃmaṣṭāṃgaṃ parameśvarīḥ | idaṃntu kavacaṃ deva kathitaṃ manmukhātsṛtaṃ ||
pramādādyadi deveśa yatra kutra pakāśyate | yoginībhistadāhantu svayaṃ ca vedhakāriṇī ||
dadyācchāntāṣa śiṣyāya tantramantra yutāya ca | gurubhakti yunma caiva tadā siddhiranuttamā ||
rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ mananta phaladāyakaṃ |
<233b>
gopitavyaṃ tvayā deva na prakāśyaṃ kadācanaḥ ||
iti śrīyoginī tantroktaika jaṭākavacaṃ samāptaṃḥ || 2 ||
atha cchīnnamastākavacaṃ ||
śrībhairavyuvāca ||
kathitāschinnamastāyā yā vidyāḥ sugopitāḥ | tvayā nāthena jīveśa śrutā ca gaditā mayā ||
idāniṃ śotumicchāmi kavacaṃ pūrvasūcitaṃḥ | trailokyavijayaṃnnāma kṛpayā kathyatāṃ vibho ||
bhairavovāca ||
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi deveśi sarvadeva namaskṛte | trailokya vijayannāma kavacaṃ śarvamohanaṃ ||
sarvavidyā mayaṃ sākṣāt surāsura jaya pradaṃḥ | dhāranāt pavanādī śastrailokyaṃ vijayī vibhuḥ ||
brahmāṇārāyaṇarudradhāraṇāt paṃvanādyataḥ |
<234a>
kartā pātā ca saṃhartā bhuvanānāṃ sureśvari | na deyaṃ parasikhyatyapya bhaktebhyo viśeṣataḥ ||
diyaṃ śikhyoya bhaktāya prāṇebhyopyadhikāya ca | devyāśca cchinnamastāyā kavacasya ca bhairavaḥ ||
ṛṣisaṃprāvirātacchandro devatācchinna mastākā | trairukyavijayamukto viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
huṃkāro me śiraḥ pātu cchinnamastā nala prabhā | hrīṁ hūṁ aiṁ śvakṣarī pātu bhālaṃ raktadigaṃvarī ||
śrīṁ krīṁ hū aiṁ dṛpāṇo tu muṃḍeka tridharāpi sā | sā vidyā praṇavādyaṃtā śuci yugmaṃ sadāvatu ||
vajravairocanī huṁ huṁ phaṭ || svāhā dhruvādikaḥ ||
prāṇaṃ pātu cinnamastāṃ svamuṇḍaka tridhārīṇī | śrīmāyā kurcavāgvīje vajravairocanīye huṁ ||
<234b>
huṁ phaṭ svāhā mahāvidyāṃ ṣoḍaśī brahmarūpīṇī | svapārśve kalikābhyāṃ svāmṛgyārāṃvitatīmudā ||
vedanaṃ sarvadā pātu cchinnamastāśasaktikā | mudrākavidharāraktā sādhakābhīṣṭadāyinī ||
varṇīnī ḍākīni yuktā sāpi māmabhitovatu |
cchinnamastāśasaktikā ||
ramādyā pātu jihvāṃ ca larjjā patuṭākaṃṭaka | kurcadyā hṛdayaṃ pātu vāgādyāstanayugmakaṃ ||
ramayā puṭitā vidyā paśvau pātu sureśvarī | māyayā puṭitā pātu nābhideśaṃ digamvarīṃ ||
kurca na puṭitā devī pṛṣṭhadeśe sadāvatu | vāgbījaṃ puṭitā caiva madhya pātu sa śaktikaḥ ||
īśvarī kurca vāgbījaṃ vajravairocanīya huṁ | phet svāheti mahāvidyā koṭisūrya samaprabhāḥ ||
<235a>
cchinnamastā sadāpāyāduruyugmaṃsaśaktikā | hrāṁ huṁ hrīṁ varṇinī jānuṃ śrīṁ hrīṁ hūṁ ḍākinī padaṃ ||
sarvavidyā sthitā nityā sarvāṃgaṃ me sadāvatu | pācyāṃpāyādekaliṃgā yogini pāvakavatu ||
dākiṇi dakṣiṇe pātu śrīśrīmahābhairavī pātu bhairavī paścimeva tu bhai | idrākṣī pātu vāyavyesitāṃ mā pātu cāttare ||
saṃhārini sadā pātu śiva koṇe savartrikā | ityaṣṭa sakayaḥ pātu digvīdikṣa sakatrikāḥ ||
krīṁ krīṁ krīṁ māṃ pātu pūrva hūṁ hūṁ māṃ tu pavake | hrīṁ hrīṁ māṃ dakṣiṇe kālikeva tu || krīṁ krīṁ krīṁ caiva nairṛtyāṃ huṁ huṁ māṃ paścimeva tu || hrīṁ hrīṁ pātu murutkoṇe svāhā pātu sadobhare | mahākālī khaḍgahastā iśakoṇe sadāvartāro māyāvadhukūrca phaṭkāroyaṃ mahāmanuḥ ||
<235b>
khaḍgakatridharāparācodhva deśaṃ sadāvatu | hrīṁ strīṁ hūṁ caiva pātāle pātu nīlasarasvatīḥ ||
iti te kathitaṃ devyāḥ kavacaṃ mantravigrahaṃ | yaddhṛtvā pavanādbhīmaḥ krodhākhyā bhairavaḥ prabhuḥ ||
surāsuramunidrāṇāṃ kartāhartā bhavet svayaṃ | yasyāgyāyāmadhumati sā sādhakāntikaṃ ||
bhūtinyādyāśca yakṣiṇyo ḍākīnyādyāśvare vecarāḥ | ājñā kurvatitāstasya cchinnā devyāḥ prasādataḥ ||
eta deva paraṃ brahma kavacaṃ tanmukhoditaṃ | devimabhyarcya gaṃdhādyaiḥ mūle naivaṃ patsakṛt ||
saṃvasara kṛtāyāntu pūjāyā phalamāpnuyāt | bhuje vilikhitaṃ caitadguṭikāṃcana sthitaṃ ||
dhārayed dakṣiṇe bhāge kaṃveyā yadi bhāgyataḥ | sarveśvarya yuto bhūtvā trailokyaṃ vaśamānasat ||
tasya gehe vasellakṣmīrvāṇī cadananāṃvuje | brahmastrādīnī śāstrāṇi taṅgātre yānti bhagnatāṃ ||
<236a>
idaṃ kavacamajñātvā yojapecchinnamastakāṃ | sopisastra pahāreṇa mṛtyuṃ prāpnoti satvaraṃḥ ||
iti śrībhairavatestre bhairavabhairavīsaṃvāde cchinnamastākalpe trailokyavijayaṃ nāmastārākavacaṃ samāptaṃ || 2 ||
atha mahātripurasundarī kavacamāha ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
bhagavaṃ devadeveśi lokānugrahakarakā | tvat prasādān mahādeva śrutāmantrāstvanekadhā ||
sādhanaṃ vividhaṃ devakīrakorddhāraṇantathā | pāśādi duṣaṇorddhāraḥ śrutastvatto mayā prabho ||
rājarājeśvari vidyāḥ kavacaṃḥ śucitaṃ mayi | śrotumicchāmi tatvartat kathayasva mayī prabho ||
śrī iśvara uvāca ||
lakṣavālasahasrāṇi vāritāsi punaḥ punaḥ | strīsvabhāvān mahādevī pṛcchasitvaṃma priye ||
abhyanta kavacaṃ guptaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ | pītaye tava deveśi kathayāmi śṛṇuṣvat ||
<236b>
asya śrīṣoḍaśī vidyā kavacasya rīṣi smṛtaḥ | mahādevaśca prastāra pakticchandradāhṛtaṃ ||
rājarājeśvari devi devatā parīkīrtitāḥ | sarvārtha sādhana devi vinīproyoga prakīrtitāḥ ||
pūrvamāṃ bhairavī pātu vālāmāṃ pātu trāsinī tattareva tu trāsinī tūttareva tu ||
urddhaṃ pātu mahādevi mahātripurasundarīḥ | adhastānpātu deveśī pātālātalavāsinī ||
ādhāre vāgbhavaḥ pātu kāmarājastathā hṛdi | bhrāmalaḥ pātu mā nityaṃ mastake sarvakāmadaḥ ||
brahmarandhra sarvagātraicchindrasthāne ca sarvadāḥ | māhāvidyā bhagavatī pātu māṃ parameśvari ||
aiṁ klīṁ lalāṭe māṃ pātu pāyāt hrīṁ klīṁ vlūṁ saśva netrayoḥ || nāsāyāṃ varṇayoścaiva drāṁ draṁ drīṁ cibuka tathāḥ || sauṁḥ pātu gale hṛdaye manu saḥ krīṁ nābhiśake ||
<237a>
kala hrīṁ klīṁ strīṁ guhya deśe sa hrīṁ pātu pādayoḥ | sa hrīṁ māṁ pātu sarvatra ma klīṁ māṃ pātu me sandhiṣu ||
jale sthale tathā kāśi dikṣurāja gṛhe tathā | hūṁkhe māṃ tvaritā pātu sa hrīṁ sa krīṁ manobhavāṃ ||
haṃśaśca pāyānmahādevi paraṃ niskara devatāḥ | vijayāmaṃgalādutā kalyāṇī bhagamālinī ||
jñānā ca mālinī vidyā sarvadā pātu mā śivā | ityeva kavacaṃ devi devānāmapi durlabhaṃ ||
tava prītyā mayākhyātaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ | idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ guhyādguhyataraṃ priyet ||
dhānyaṃ yasya māyugmaṃ bhogamokṣa pradaṃ śubhaṃ | duḥsvapnanāsanaṃ pumāṃ naranādi vaśaṃkaraṃ ||
ākarṣaṇa karaṃ devi stambhārcāṭakaraṃ śiveḥ |
<237b>
idaṃ kavacamajñātvā rājarājeśvari śivāṃ | yorcayet yogīnī vṛndaiḥ bhakṣā nātrayasaṃśaye ||
na tasya mantra siddhi syāt kadācidapi śāṃkariḥ | iha loke ca dārogaduḥkha bhayāni ca ||
paratra narakaṃ gatvā paśuyonimavāpnuyā | tasmādetat sadā bhyāsādadhikārī bhavet tataḥ ||
madvaktra nirgatamidaṃ kavacaṃ supuṇyaṃ pūjā vidhiśca puratopi nidhānāyathe tayaḥ | saubhāgya bhogalalitāniśubhānibhuktā devyāḥ padaṃ bhajati tatpunaranta kāle ||
iti kulāntasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīmahātripurasundarī ṣoḍaśī kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ||
atha tripura bhairavyai ||
śrīpārvatyuvāca ||
deva deva mahādeva sarvaśāstra viśārada | kṛpāṃ kuru jagannātha dharmajñāsi mahāmate ||
sundarī yā purā proktā vidyā tripura bhairvikāḥ |
<238a>
tasyāstu kavacaṃ divyaṃ mahye kathaya tatvataḥ | tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā jagādajagadīśvarī ||
abhutaṃ kavacaṃ devyāḥ sundaryādi virupipaiḥ |
śrī iśvaravāca ||
kathayāmi mahāvidyā kavacaṃ sarvadurlabhaṃ | śṛṇuṣvatvaṃ ca vidhinā śrutvā gopyaṃ toyapi tat ||
yasyāḥ prasādānmakaṃlaṃ vibharmi bhuvana trayaṃ | yasyāḥ sarvaṃ samutpannaṃ yasyāmadyāpi tiṣṭhati ||
matāpitā jaganmānyā jagadrakṣāsvarūpiṇī | siddhidātrī ca siddhāsyādasiddhāduṣṭa jantuṣu ||
sarvabhūta hitakarī sarva bhūtasvarūpiṇī | kakāraḥ pātu māṃ devī kāminī kāmadāyinī ||
aiṁ kālī pātu māṃ devī mūlādhālāra svarūpiṇī | ikālī pātu māṃ devī ravi sarvastu svaḥ pradā ||
lakāri pātu māṃ devi idrāṇī varavallabhā | hrīṁ kālī pātu māṃ devī sarvatra (?) śaṃntu(?) sundarī ||
<238b>
etai varṇairmahāmohā śāmbhavī mastakaṃ bhuva | kapāle pātu māṃ devi sarvāṇī hara gehinī ||
makāle pātu māṃ devī sarvapāpa praṇāsinī | kakāre pātu māṃ devi kāmarūpa dharāstadā ||
kakāle pātu māṃ devi śambarāri priyā sadā | lakālī pātu māṃ devī dharādharaṇi rūpadhṛk ||
hrīṁ kālī pātu māṃ devī śaṃkārārddha śarīriṇī | etai varṇai mahāmāyā pātu śakti svarūpiṇī ||
vāgbhavaṃ mastakaṃ pātu vadanaṃ kāmarājikā | śaktisvurūpiṇī pātu hṛdayaṃ mantrasiddhidā ||
sunyarī sarvadā pātu sundrarī parirakṣatu | raktavarṇa sadā pātu sundarī sarvadāyīṇi ||
nānālaṃkārasaṃyuktā sundrarī pātu sarvadāḥ |
sarvāṃgasundrarī pātu sarvadā ||
<239a>
sarvāgasundarī pātu sarvatra śivadāyiṇī | jagadā hlādajananī śaṃbhurūpā ca māṃ sadā ||
sarvamantramayī pātu sarvasaubhāgyadāyiṇī | sarvalakṣmī mayī devī paramānandadāyinī ||
pātu māṃ sarvadā devī nānāśaṃkhā nidhiḥ śivā | tataḥ padma nidhid devi sarvaṇī sarvadāyiṇī ||
dakṣiṇāmūrti māṃ pātu ṛṣiḥ sarvatra mastako paṃktiḥ cchandra svarūpā ca mukhe pātu sureśvarī |
gaṃdhāṣṭakātmikā pātu hṛdayaṃnti śantarī sadā | sarvasanmohinī pātu saṃkṣobhiṇī sadāvatu ||
sarvavidrāviṇī pātu sarvākarṣaṇakāriṇī | sarvā karṣaṇakāhlāda karī pātu sarvasakṣobhiṇī sadā ||
sarvasiddhi pradā pātu sarvākarṣaṇa kāriṇī | kṣobhinī sarvadā vaśīni māṃ sadāvatu ||
ākarṣiṇī sadā pātu saṃmohinī sadāvatu | ratiddevī sadā pātu bhagā māṃ sarvadāvatu ||
<239b>
maheśvarī sadā pātu kaumārī sarvadāvatuḥ | sarvā hlādana kālī māṃ pātu sarvavaśaṃkalī ||
kṣemaṃkarī sadā pātu sarvāṃga sundarī sadā | sarvāṃga yuvatiḥ pātuḥ sarvasaubhāgyadāyiṇī ||
vāgdevī sarvadā pātu vāṇinī sarvadāvatu | vaśinī sarvadā pātu mahāsiddhi pradā sadā ||
sarvavidrāviṇī pātu gaṇanāthaḥ sadāvatuḥ | durgā devī sadā pātu vaṭukaḥ sarvadāvatu ||
kṣetrapālaḥ sadā pātu cādhāraśaktikā | anantaḥ sarvadā pātu vārāhaḥ sarvadā pātu ||
pṛthivī sarvadā pātu svarṇasihāsanaṃ tathā | raktāmṛdaṃ ca sa pātu mā sarvakālataḥ ||
sudhārṇivaḥ sadā pātu kalpakṛkṣeḥ sadāvatu | śvetacchatraṃ sadāpātu raktadīpa sadāvatu ||
<240a>
nandanodyāna satataṃ pātu māṃ sarvasiddhaye | dikapālāḥ sarvadā pātu idrādyāḥ sakalā tathā ||
vāhānānī sadā pātu astrāṇi pāstu sarvadā | śastrāṇi sarvadā pāntu yoginīnyaḥ pātu sarvadā ||
siddhyaḥ pāṃtu sadā devī sarvasiddhi pradāvatu | sarvāṅga sundarī devī sarvatra sarvadāvatu ||
ānandarūpiṇī devī citsvarūpā cidātmikā | sarvāṃgasundarī pātu sundrarī bhava sundarī ||
pṛthag devālaye ghore saṃkaṭe durgame girau | arasya prāntare vāpi pātu māṃ sundarī śivā ||
idaṃ kavacamityuktaṃ mantroddhāraśca pārvati | yaḥ paṭhen prayato bhūtvā trisaṃdhyaṃtiyetaḥ śuciḥ ||
tasya sarvārtha siddhisyāḥ syādyadyanmanasi vartate | gorocanā kuṃkumena raktacandranakena vā ||
svayaṃbhū kusumaiḥ śuklai bhūmi putre śaniścare |
<240b>
śmaśāne prātare vāpi śunyāgare śivālaye | saktya guruṇā yantraṃ pūjayitvā kumārikā ||
tanmanuṃ japayitvā ca gurupakti viśeṣataḥ | pūjayitvā yathāśaktyā stutvā ca vivināsurā ||
dhārayed guruṇā yantraṃ pūjayitvā kumādikā | tanyaunau pūjayitvā ca gurupaktiṃ tathaiva ca ||
devyai valiṃ nivedyātha naramājārasukaraiḥ | nakulai mahiṣairmeṣaiḥ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
dhṛtvāsuvvarṇamadhyasthaṃ kaṃṭhe vāmastake bhuje | sutithau śubhanakṣatra sūryasyodayene tathā ||
dhārayitvā ca kavacaṃ sarvasiddhīṃ labhennaraḥ | kavacasya ca mahātmyaṃ nāhavarṣaśatairapi ||
śaktomi tu maheśāni vaktuṃ tasya phalaṃ ca tat |
<241a>
nāsti caura bhayaṃ tasya na tatrā vyādhi pāḍanaṃ | na durbhikṣa bhayaṃ tatra na ca pīḍanaṃ sadā ||
vighna praśamanaṃ sarvaṃ sarvavyādhi vināsanaṃ | sarvalakṣākaraṃ jambhoścatuvargā phalapradaṃ ||
yatra tatra na vaktavyaṃ na dātavyaṃ kadācana | mantraṃ prāpya vidhānena pūjayet satataṃ sudhī ||
tatrāpi dullabhaṃ manya kavacaṃ devarūpiṇaṃ | guroḥ prasādyā prāpresugopitaṃ ||
tatrāpi kavacaṃ divyaṃ dullabhaṃ bhuvana traye | ślokaṃ vāstavamekaṃ vā yaḥ paṭhen prayataḥ śuciḥ ||
tasya sarvārtha siddhi syācchaṃkareṇa prabhāṣitaṃ | guru devo harasākṣāt parttī tasya ca pārvatī ||
abhedana yajed yastu tasya siddhi na dūrataḥ |
iti śrīviśvasāra tantre tripurabhairavaī kavacaṃ samāptaṃ ||
<241b>
atha lakṣmī kavacaṃ ||
atha vakṣya maheśāni kavacaṃ sarvakāmadaṃ | yasya vijñānamātreṇa bhavet sākṣāt sadāśivaḥ ||
arcanaṃ pūjanaṃ tasyā mantrajāpaṃ japen naraḥ | sabhet pārvatī putra sarvaśāstra puraskṛtaḥ ||
vidyāvatārthinā sevyā viśeṣaviṣṇuvallabhā |
asya śrīcaturakṣarī viṣṇuvatitā kavacasya bhagavān śrīṇiva ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭupchandaḥ vāgbhavī devatā vāgbhavījaṃ larjāśaktiḥ ramākīlakaṃ kāmabījānmakaṃ kavacaṃ mamasvakavitvapāṃḍitya sarvasiddhi samṛddhaye viniyogaḥ ||
aiṃkāro mastake pātu vāgbhabījaṃ dvirdhīdā | hrīṁ pātu cakṣuyo madhye cakṣuyugma ca śākarī ||
jihvāyāṃ mukhavṛtte ca kaṇavāṇasite oṣṭādhare dantapaktau tālumūle halau punaḥ ||
<242a>
pātu māṃ viṣṇuvatitā lakṣmīḥ śrīvarṇarūpiṇī | karṇayugma bhujadvandve peca pārvati ||
hṛdayamaṇi vandha camīvāyāṃ pārśvayoḥ punaḥ | pṛṣṭadaśe tathā guhye vāme ca dakṣiṇe tathā ||
upatthe ca nitambe ca nābhau jaṃgha dvaye punaḥ | jānu cakre padadvaṃdva gutikegulimūlake ||
svadhā tu prāṇaśaktyāṃ me sīmaṃtyāṃ mastake punaḥ | sarvāṅgapākāmeśī mahādevī samunnatiḥ ||
puṣṭiyātu mahāmāyā utkṛṣṭiḥ sarvadāvatu | va ṛṣiḥ pātu me devi sarvatrastu varlabhā ||
vāgbhavī sarvadā pātu pātu māṃ hara gehinī | ramā pātu sadā devī pātu māyā svarāsvayaṃ ||
savvāge pātu māṃ nityumugratārā śatāvatu | pātu māṃ kālikā nityaṃ kālarātriḥ sadāvatu ||
<242b>
navadurgā sadāvatu kāmākhyā sarvadāvatu | yoginyaḥ sarvadā mama mahālakṣmī sadā mama ||
mātrāṃ yāntu sadā devyāśca kuṣṭhāṃ yoginīganā | sarvatra saṃrvakāryaṣu sarvakarma sadārvadā ||
pātu māṃ devadeveśī lakṣmī sarvasamṛddhidā | iti te kavacaṃ divyaṃ kathitaṃ sarvasiddhayet ||
yatra yatra na vaktavyaṃ yadicchedān sanohitaṃ | śaṭhāya bhaktihīnāya nindakāya maheśvarī ||
nyūnāṃge nāni rikta na darśayanna kadācana | nastavaṃśarya ye divyaṃ sadaśya śivahā bhavet ||
kulīnāya maheśāya durgābhakti parāya ca | vaiṣṇavāya viśudhāya dadyāt kacamūrtamaṃ ||
nijaśiṣyāya śāntāya dharmiṇe jñānite tathā | śanaumaṃgala ca nandakaiśca likhen mantraṃ ||
sarvamatrasamanvitaṃ || valikhet kavacaṃ divyaṃ svayaṃbhū kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
<243a>
śvaśukaiḥ paraśuktaiśca nānāgandhasamanvitaiḥ | gorocanāktaṃ mumenaraktacandranake navā ||
sutithau śubhayoge vā śravaṇāyāṃ rave dine | aśvinyāṃ ca maghāsu ca pūrvabhadra padā yāge svābhyāṃ maṃgalavāsare ||
vilikhen prapaṭhe strotraṃ śubhayoge surālaye | āyuṣmāmprīti yoge ca brahmayoge viśeṣaṭaḥ ||
idrayoge śubhe yoge śuklayoge tathauva ca | kaulave vālaṃve caiva vanije caiva sattamaḥ ||
śūnyāgāre śmaśāne vā rijate ca viśeṣataḥ | kumāli pūjayītvā ca jayed devīṃ sanātanīṃ ||
matsyormāṃsaiḥ śākasūpaiḥ pūjayet para devatāṃḥ | ghṛtādyaiścopakaraṇai dhūpadīpai viśeṣataḥ ||
brahmāṇāmbhojayitvā ca pūjayet parameśvari |
<243b>
āṣeṭakamupākhyānaṃ tatra kuryād dina trayaṃ | tadā bhaven mahārakṣā śaṃkareṇa ca bhāṣitaṃ ||
māraṇā dveṣaṇādīnilabhaṃte nātrasaṃśayaḥ | sa bhave pārvatī putraḥ sarvāśāstra vahiḥkṛtaḥ ||
guru devo harasākṣāt patnī tasya hara priye | abhedena yajed yastu tasya siddhirna dūrataḥ ||
paṭhati ya ihamatyo vismimādrā tarātmā japaphalamanumenaṃ lapsate so vidhi yaṃ | sa bhavati padamuccaiḥ saṃpadāṃ pādanamnaḥ kṣiti pada namnaḥ kṣiti panyu kuṭalakṣmī lakṣmāṇānāṃ cirāyaḥ ||
iti śrīviśvasāratantre lakṣmīkavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ||
atha mātaṃgīnī kavacaṃ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi māṃtaṃgī kavacaṃ śubhaṃ |
<244a>
gopanīya mahādevi mauna jāpyaṃ samācaret |
śrīdevyuvāca ||
sādhu sādhu mahādeva kathayasva maheśvaraḥ | yena samyag vidhānena sādhakānāṃ jayaṃ bhavet ||
viṇādhyānaṃ vidhānā mantraṃ vinā homaṃ vinā valiṃ | yena smarana mātrena sādhako dharaṇi patī ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
mātaṃgī kavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvarakṣā karaṃ nṛṇāṃ |
kavitvaṃ ca dhanitvaṃ gagajisukhāni ca mukhaṃ śubhadaṃ sabhya maṇimādi pradāyakaṃ ||
brahmaviṣṇu maheśāni teṣāmādyā maheśvarī | ślokārddhā ślokamekaṃ vāyastu samyakāṭhennaraḥ ||
tasya haste sahai vāsti rājalīkṣmī na saṃśayaḥ | ucchiṣṭa vadanā bhūtvā kamalāsanasaṃsthitaḥ ||
yoni mudrā kale vadhvā śakti dhyāna parāyana | brahmarandhra sanmatyastailokyaiśvaryā bhāgbhavet ||
<244b>
trailokyamaṃgalasāṃsya kavacaṃ mantravigraha ||
siddhi vidyā me devi sarvaiśvarya pradāyakaṃ |
kavacaśyamiṣī śivaḥ ||
chando virāṭ jagarddhātri devatā bhuvaneśvarī | dharmakāmārtha mokṣāṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
hrīṁ bījaṃ me śire pātu aiṃ bhuneśī lalāṭakaṃ | aiṁ pātu rakṣanetraṃ me hrīṁ pātu vāma locanā ||
śrīṁ pātu dakṣakarṇa me trivarṇā maheśvarī | vāmakarṇa sadā pātu aiṁ ghrāṇāṃ pātu me sadā ||
hrīṁ pātu vadanaṃ devī aiṁ pātu rasanāṃ māma | vāk tripumā trivarṇān mā kaṇṭha pātu pātu parāmbikā ||
śrī skaṃdhau pātu niyataṃ hrīṁ pātu bhujā sarvadā | klīṃ kalau tripureśāni tripuṭaiḥ svaryahāyinī ||
āṁ pātu hṛdayaṃ hrāme madhye deśaṃ sā tryakṣarī bhuvaneśvarī |
(Folio 45-46 not found)
<247a>
sarvabījaṃ sadā pṛṣṭhaṃ pātu sarvavaśaṃkarīḥ ||
hrīṁ pātu guhya deśaṃ manamo bhavagavatī kaṭiṃ | māheśvari sadā pātu śaktibījānu yugmakaṃ ||
arṇaṃ pūrṇā sadā pātu svāhā pātu padvayaṃ | sāmāṃ daśākṣarī pāyādannapūrṇākhilaṃ vapuḥ ||
tāraṃ māyāramākāmaḥ ṣoḍaśārṇya tataḥ paraṃ | śirasthā sarvadā pātu viśasvannā sthitā mudā ||
tāraṃ durge yugaṃ rakṣa svāheti cata?ndakṣirī | jaye durgā ghanasyāma pātu sāṃ sarvato bhave ||
mayā bījāṃdikā caiṣā daśārṇā ca tataḥ parāḥ | śirasthā sarvadāḥ pātu viśvartyannā sthitā mudā ||
tāraṃ durge yugaṃ rakṣa svāhati ca daśākṣarī | jaya durgā ca na śyāmā pātu māṃ sarvato mudā ||
māyā bījā śira pātu dasavarṇā ca taḥ parā |
<247b>
prataptakāṃcanā bhāsā jayadurgā nanavatu | tāraṃ hrīṃ duduḥrgāyai namoṣṭavarṇanmikā pārā ||
śaṃkhacakradhunuvyārṇa dharā māṃ dakṣiṇevatu | mahiṣamardanī svāhā vasuvarṇāmikā parā ||
nairṛtyā sarvadā pātu mahiṣāsuranāsinī | māyā padmāvatī svāhā saptārṇā parīkīrtitā ||
padmāvatī padmasaṃsthā paścime māṃ sadā pātu | pāśāṃkuśa puṭāmāyai himaraparameśvari svāhā ||
jayo daśākṣārārṇādyā sāśvarudhānaneva tu | sarasvati pañcaśaro nityā klinne mada drave ||
svāhāratyakṣarī nityā mānuttara sadāvatu | tāraṃ māyā kavacaṃ khecarakṣa tato vadhu ||
krū(-)oṁ kṣa hrīṁ phaṭ mahāvidyā dvādaśārṇākhila pradā |
<248a>
ariṣṭādibhiḥ pāyācchiva kāṇe sadā ca māṃ | aiṁ klīṁ sauṁḥ sātatīvālāmāmurddhā daśetovatu ||
vindvantā bhairavī vālā bhūmau māṃ sarvadāvatu | iti te kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ trailokya maṃgalaṃ paraṃ ||
sārārataraṃ puṇyaṃ mahāvidmaugha vigrahaṃ | asyāpi paṭhanāt sadyaḥ kuveropi dhaneśvaraḥ ||
idrādyāḥ sakalā devā dhāraṇāt paṭhanādyataḥ | sarvasiddhiśvarāḥ santaḥ sarvaiśvaryamavāpnuyā ||
puṣpāñjalyaṣṭakaṃ dadyān mūle naiva pṛthak pṛthak | saṃvalsaraśatāyāstu pūjāyā phalamāpnuyāḥ ||
prītīmanyānyataḥ kṛtvā kamalāśiśvalā gṛhaḥ | vāṇī ca nivasedvaktre satyaṃ satyaṃ tvamaṃśayaḥ ||
yodhārayati puṇyānmātrau lokyamaṃgalābhidha |
<248b>
kavacaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ sopi puṇyavatāṃvaraḥ | sarvaśvarya yuto bhūtvā trailokya vijayī bhavet ||
puruṣo dakṣiṇe vāhau nālī vāma bhuje tathā | vahu putravatī bhūtvā vaṃdhyāpi labhate sutaṃ ||
brahmāstrādiṇi naivadaṃ śāntitaṃjanaṃ | etat kavacamajñātvā jānujā bhuvaneśvarīṃ ||
dāridryaṃ paramaṃ prāpya so cirān mṛtyumāpnuyā |
iti śrīrudrayāmale devī īśvarasaṃvāde trailokyamaṃgalaṃ nāma bhuvaneśvarī kavacaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ||
atha dhūmāvatīkavacamāhaḥ ||
pārvatyuvāca ||
devadevaṃ mahādeva bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ | dhūmāvatyāśru kavacaṃ tu bruhi me karuṇā nidhe ||
mahādeva uvāca ||
asti guhyatamaṃ loke kavacaṃ śatru nigrahaṃ | sarvasthita pradaṃ devi tava snehāṃ prakāśyate ||
<249a>
yacchutvārāmacandreṇa saṃgare rāvane hataḥ | bhogaveṇapi yachutvājitaṃ sarvaṃ carācasaṃ ||
tameva kavacaṃ vacmi sāvadhānāvadhāraya | kavacasya mahādevi pipyada ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ ||
cchandro virāṭ devatā ca śrīmaddhumavatī priye | śatruṇāṃ māraṇā devi vinīyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
tu dhūmāvatāṃ sadā pātu śiro me śatru mardini | caṇḍarūpā mahādevī lalāṭa pātu māṃ sadā ||
kṣukṣā māṃ nayane pātu pātu mā śrutī mamaḥ | kāka dhvajā nāsikāṃ me sarvaśatru vināśīnī ||
praṇamvī sadā pātu vadanaṃ muṇḍamālikā | vikṛtāsyā sadā pātu galaṃ me ripu sundarī ||
dhūṁ bījaṃ khyā sadā pātu ghāṭa me riṣṭitāriṇī | skadhaukaṃkāli
